Las habitaciones no tienen aire acondicionado y si no te asignan una que se ubique hacia el lado de las ventanas, la habitación queda súper encerrada, sin ninguna fuente de luz natura. Además huele a humedad.
La atención es pésima. El personal es súper grosero. En mi caso me trataron mal por solicitar que se descontara la retención en la fuerte que se debe como lo indica el RUT de la empresa y me dijeron que debía “tomar asiento a esperar a que el contador quiera ir porque no me pueden descontar el valor a la mansalva” cuando ya había enviado todos los soportes para la facturación el día anterior.
El desayuno no tiene fruta y es muy grasoso.
En términos generales, la atención es pésima. No lo recomiendo.
review_3_text:
Family atmosphere, all the staff super nice. They helped us at all times for anything we needed.
Very good location, close to restaurants, shops…
100% recommended, if I return to Pereira I will stay again without thinking about it.
P.S: For the air conditioning people, they were already installing them and the installers were machines so in 1 month they will all be working 😎.
review_4_text: Very nice place. Good price.
review_5_text:
El hotel solo tiene dos parqueaderos. Por eso solo me quedaba siempre y cuando viera parqueadero disponible y realizaba la reserva a través de booking
Pero el día que no hice reserva a través de booking, pasé y decidí no quedarme debido a que no había parqueadero disponible . La administradora me contactó solicitando que le pagara la noche . Aun cuando ellos tiene. En su política de booking free cancelation por más de tres meses .
Me pareció una falta de respeto . Me toco pagarle para evitar problema. Pero probablemente pague una noche que no me quede .
Si tienes vehículo no te recomiendo quedarte acá a

2.   La señora Patricia, no me gustó su servicio. El check out es ala 1 y me llama a las 12:30 para salir antes .
3. No recomiendo quedarse en el segundo piso ya que se siente toda la bulla de las otras habitaciones

Me parece les falta tacto para tratar a un cliente que es frecuente.

name: hostal la 18
review_1_text: Very friendly staff. Price is very affordable.
review_2_text: A very quiet and cozy place, I felt at home
review_3_text: 5/5 porque es un lugar muy comodo la gente es muy acomedida, parece que 3s muy lejos de la principal pero no es un muy buen lurgar queda como en una bajada puedes guardar la moto, tiene lo necesario, hay un D1 serca, baño privado o compartido, todo muy limpio acogedor y ordenado incluso puedes llamar antes de ir para preguntar y te atenderán muy bien ; la zona es tranquila y si volvería a hospedarme nuevamente... _Gracias por su buena atención y por prestar ese buen servicio _ ✌👋👊👍Bendiciones
review_4_text: Excelente, muy económico muy acogedor y muy amables los dueños fueron lo mejor, te ofrecen servicio de taxi cómodo y seguro también, ya tengo donde quedarme siempre que vaya a Pereira
review_5_text: Clean, quiet, there is parking for small motorcycles, cold water, very friendly staff. It would be nice if they remodeled the TV and had the fan option

name: HOSTAL LAS HAMACAS
review_1_text: This humble farm stay in the countryside is simple but clean and has everything you need. It’s not luxurious, but it’s comfortable and welcoming. I had a very peaceful night without any traffic noise, just the soothing sounds of birds in the morning. The place is surrounded by beautiful nature, and there’s a playful dog that adds to the charm. The owner was incredibly kind and even prepared a delicious breakfast for a small price.
review_2_text:
Very nice place, surrounded by nature and beautiful animals. If you want to scape from the city for a while this is the perfect place.

Highly recommended, Andres is a really good host
review_3_text: What an amazing place. The hosts were magnificent. The farm environment was such a please. I would love to come back again.
review_4_text: Great place to stay. Beautiful place in the country but close to the city.
review_5_text:
In the middle of nature
Clean rooms
Helpful host

name: Refugio La Esmeralda
review_1_text: Un lugar increíble rodeado de mucha naturaleza. Excelente lugar para descansar y conectar con el patrimonio natural y cultural de la zona. Los paisajes fueron muy hermosos, la comida excelente  y el personal de servicio muy amables. Súper recomendados 🌱🎋💦
review_2_text: It really is a refuge within a beautiful forest and with a platform overlooking the reservoir for bird watching. The facilities are incredible, very comfortable and ideal for a romantic night or getting out of the routine. Super recommended.

name: Hostal Luxury - Hotel Manizales - Hostales - Alojamientos - Habitaciones - Alojamientos
review_1_text: I was treated very well. I had a single room, small but with all the amenities, and a very good price.
review_2_text: I found it a comfortable place, especially with its separate bathroom.... 5 out of 5
review_3_text: A friendly, family-run hostel across from the bus terminal. Comfortable, affordable, and excellent service. I recommend it.

name: Kimaná hostal Santa Rosa
opening_hours: Monday: 3:00 – 10:00 PM|Tuesday: 3:00 – 10:00 PM|Wednesday: 3:00 – 10:00 PM|Thursday: 3:00 – 10:00 PM|Friday: 3:00 – 10:00 PM|Saturday: 3:00 – 10:00 PM|Sunday: 3:00 – 10:00 PM
review_1_text: Absolutely loved my stay at Kimaná Hostal. The staff were incredibly helpful, sweet, caring, and communicative. The staff go above and beyond to make your stay extraordinary. Not only were we greeted by everyone working/volunteering here but also hung out with them and became friends. We were given lots of advice on places to visit, places to eat, and place to drink. They even went out of their way to walk us over to restaurants or bus stops to help us out. They made sure to give us food before heading out on an early morning and answered our calls despite how early it was. The hospitality has been the best I've every received in any place I've stayed. The place is also very cute and walkable to anywhere within the town. We extended our stay 2 more nights because it's been an incredible place.
review_2_text: Had a great time at kimana hostel! The staff here are amazing and make sure you’re taken care and have what you need. They’re all very easy to get along with. With their help we were able to navigate to the San Vincente Termales and they even recommended us restaurants to try. Would definitely stay here again
review_3_text: We had a perfect stay at this place. Super friendly and helpful staff. Had a really cute private room with our own lil patio. All clean and comfortable. Would highly recommend if you stop by in Santa Rosa
review_4_text: I really enjoyed my stay at kimaná hostel. It's at a super central location in Santa Rosa de Cabal but you can relax at the terrace. All the staff are super cute. They'll give you very nice recomendations and help you to book it if needed.
review_5_text: It's honestly a really nice hostel in a safe town with lots of things to do, highly recommend ☺️

name: Golden Frog Mountain Hostel
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text:
Really good hostel right in the city center. The rooms are simple, but they were very clean and affordable.

Álvaro and Angela are great people. I was sick during my stay and they were always making sure if I was doing okay or if I needed anything.

I'd definitely stay here again and I can recommend this place to anyone.
review_2_text: What a lovely hostel! Awesome host with a relaxed vibe. Billiard table and cinema room included. Rooms are quiet and we had an huge, cosy bed. And really great location in the middle of the city! I can highly recommend this place :)
review_3_text: The service was great. The rooms were nice, but they were set up weird, as in way too close to the main hallways and common areas without much separation (everything you do in your room can probably be heard if anyone is close enough, and they will be close enough). The location seemed a little sketchy and is right in front of a main streets which equates to noise, but it wasn’t that bad. We had to do through like three security doors to get in the place, which is good and bad I guess. Still close to many necessary places like banks, bars, and food spots, and it had a nice view from the terrace. The “Cable Tower” street (10 minute drive) was worth it.
review_4_text: We had a wonderful time staying at the Golden Frog! It’s well located in the center of the city, just a couple blocks from the cathedral. Staff were very kind and helpful, and our room and general environment were lovely! Highly recommend!
review_5_text:
We got a private room. The shower was really good and the room was spacious. Two things to note : the window opens onto the corridor so you don’t have much privacy and the bed was very hard.
The service was amazing. The staff were super welcoming and this hostel has a lot to offer: great kitchen, tres bandas table, games room etc…
The atmosphere was cosy and quiet

name: Hostal Arraigo
address: Cra. 16 #11-73 11-71, Centro, Santa Rosa de Cabal
review_1_text:
It was truly a wonderful experience 🙏
The amazing and kind family running this hostal made me feel right at home with their warm hospitality and helpful information about the town and things to do. The place is very clean, cosy, and has a great atmosphere. Plus, the two sweetest cats added a lovely touch of comfort. The option of a delicious breakfast every morning was the perfect start to my day. The location is excellent-right in the centre of town.
Highly recommended for anyone seeking a welcoming and peaceful stay 🫶
review_2_text: Fantastic hostel. All the spaces have a nice atmosphere. Beds are clean and comfortable which is really important for me! Perfect location to explore the town and get transport to the thermals. I also cannot stress enough that the service is absolutely above and beyond! Felt very taken care of here, exceptional value for money. I’d stay here again and would recommend to friends for sure.
review_3_text: Hostal Arraigo is exceptional, truly one of my favorite places of my entire trip through South America. It is run by a super friendly family, who welcomes you with love and with many suggestions for what to do in Santa Rosa. The kitchen is suitable for preparing what you need, the beds are very comfortable and everything is clean. The view of the hostel towards the sunsets is wonderful. The location is perfect, close to a nice square, shops and restaurants. Highly recommended, I hope to return soon!
review_4_text:
I stayed at Hostal Arraigo, and it was exactly what I was looking for as a traveler: a good location, a relaxed atmosphere, and comfort at a good price. It's just two blocks from the center, surrounded by breakfast spots, good red wines, and plenty to explore on foot.

I shared a room with three other guests, but the cleanliness was impeccable and the bed very comfortable. The hostel's atmosphere is peaceful, ideal for relaxing after a busy day. The service was fabulous, always attentive and friendly.

The common areas are a plus: a large lounge next to reception and a larger one downstairs, with a table for about 12 people, board games, and even a pinball machine that adds a fun touch.

It's a great option for backpackers or travelers who don't want to spend a lot but are also looking for a nice, functional place. They also have private rooms for those who prefer more privacy.

Highly recommended. A place with roots for those just passing through. Thank you, Laura, for all the attention and for making me feel at home!
review_5_text:
Fantastic family and wonderful place

Delighting with my stay at Arraigo Hostel, the place is wonderful, super comfortable and with very good views. The family that runs it is fantastic, they are super friendly. It has a kitchen and the beds are comfortable, as well as work space. If I come back to Santa Rosa I will stay here again, I loved the energy of the place! Good luck to the family with their project and may they continue to grow ✨🫶🏻

name: Hotel y Restaurante Los Cambulos
review_1_text: Good location and parking available, also you can have breakfast in the same place, small rooms but suitable with the price.
review_2_text: Strange but convenient location on the highway, close to the bus terminal and the cable car that takes you directly into the centre of Manizales. No noise from the highway, but plently of noise from loud guests. Shower and WiFi temperamental. Good view over the valley. Lovely staff. Hotel restaurant good.
review_3_text: Love the tamal  they have!!!!  I stopped there with my sister and brother to have breakfast after buying my apartment, they loved the breakfast, im so lucky im gonna have this place close when I moved in!!!!!
review_4_text: Cheap and the restaurant downstairs has great food! Great prices.
review_5_text: Quick easy break fast. Traditional Colombian style.

name: Hotel Olimpa
review_1_text: Hotel is safe but a bit noisy. In the middle of the centre.
review_2_text: Comfortable and kind people
review_4_text: Excellent
review_5_text: La verdad aunque el precio es económico, lastimosamente cobran excedente por si una amistad quiere pasar a saludar, aparte la puerta del baño dañada y en si hay mejores opciones...

name: Hostal Don José
opening_hours: Monday: 6:00 AM – 12:00 AM|Tuesday: 6:00 AM – 12:00 AM|Wednesday: 6:00 AM – 12:00 AM|Thursday: 6:00 AM – 12:00 AM|Friday: 6:00 AM – 12:00 AM|Saturday: 6:00 AM – 12:00 AM|Sunday: 6:00 AM – 12:00 AM
review_1_text:
I absolutely loved my stay here!

The friendly and accommodating staff made me feel right at home. The ambience is perfect for a peaceful and relaxing stay, the breakfast is very good and the rooms are clean and comfortable.
You can also enjoy the hammocks outside the rooms, access a fully equipped kitchen and the laundry service is very convenient.

The location is perfect, right in the heart of the city.

I highly recommend Hostal Don José to everyone visiting Santa Rosa de Cabal!
review_2_text:
Amazing hosts always with a smile
We stopped by after our day in the spa thermals and stayed for two nights till our flight…the room is very well kept !clean and comfy,this place has so
Much potential there are hammocks and so much common areas to enjoy..
It was only us staying by ourselves in the whole place so felt a bit alone and off…
Perhaps there is
not much to do around ..and not very touristy.
if you need to stay there I very much recommend it to any1 for a short stop/night
review_3_text:
We stayed three nights in Hostal Don José. The rooms are clean and quite big. There is a nice kitchen with tables and lounge areas. We got always fresh fruit and eggs with arepa for breakfast.
The staff is very friendly and helpful. They booked us a tour to the termales San Vicente. We recommend these thermal baths very much.
review_4_text: This was an amazing place to stay. The staff were unbelievably friendly, treating us like their own family :) they helped us get tickets to the hot springs, helped us arrange transport and even cooked us up a delicious Chorizo Santarosano. Wholeheartedly recommend!!
review_5_text: A modest but attractive hostal and very good value for money with big rooms and a good bathroom. The staff were wonderful - very friendly. And I gained access to my room at 11am.

name: Dam Hotel Pereira
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text: The staff were so beyond kind, and the room was simple but cosy. As others have mentioned, you can hear every single sound as the doors/walls are not thick.
review_2_text: Very welcoming lady at the reception. Clean room. Good for one night because of noise from other rooms and loud music playing nearby all night.
review_3_text: Very good location and friendly service. Most rooms are inside the building, without windows, it gets reaaaaaaly hot. The rooms with windows are a lot better, but know that there is a lot of sound on the streetside from bars. Rooms are very clean.
review_4_text: Good hotel. We walked over and got a room cheaper than booking.
review_5_text: Adriana was great, the owner let us use the washer and dryer.

name: Hostal de la 57
opening_hours: Monday: 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM|Tuesday: 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM|Wednesday: 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM|Thursday: 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM|Friday: 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM|Saturday: 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM|Sunday: 8:00 AM – 9:00 PM
review_1_text:
Really liked this hostel. Wasn't particularly busy when we were there so wouldn't be a "party" hostel. But had some good places to sit and the rooms were really well equipped (the kitchen equipment could have been better!).

Best of all though - we left a really important thing behind and then sent it onto us straight away! Really impressive service.
review_2_text:
Very nice hostel! Thanks especially to Maria and Louisa for being so nice and helpful! People like these make all the difference.
The hostel has everything you need including good WiFi, communal areas, terrace, breakfast (included), lunch and dinner (nit included), cold beer, laundry service, and maps (ots and lots of them!).
Location: quiet residential street just off the main road that runs into cable. The centre is only a 5 to 10 min bus ride away.
Airport: took 20 min by taxi (10,000 COP)
The price was also a factor in giving satisfaction as I got a very good deal as they had lowered their rates for the week I was staying (private room, 4 nights, for 36€. It normally would have cost around 45€).
Good luck to you all, and thanks for the lovely stay!
review_3_text: Amazing hostel very close to the cable nightlife area and many bars and restaraunts. The breakfast was amazing every day! Arepas and eggs! Luisa was the nicest person I have ever met working in a hostel and was a great manager!
review_4_text: Super friendly staff ! Amazing breakfast (free with stay)and a professional cook for lunches . It's a must stay if you're in manizales
review_5_text: Awesome hostel with clean, functional rooms. Spacious guest kitchen, restaurant with very good food, great value for money. Very friendly and helpful staff!

name: Hotel Eje Cafetero
review_1_text: It's a very nice place to stay. Everything is very clean, and the sheets smell good. It's good if you're looking for comfort and affordability. It's very central; if you're Catholic, you have the cathedral nearby and a parish half a block away.
review_2_text: My husband and I really like this place. They have hot water and the manager is very friendly. The beds are comfortable, the blankets smell nice, and the rooms are very clean. 👌 Of course, it's also a bit noisy during the day, but it's quieter at night.

name: Hospedaje El Mirador
address: Km. 5 Vía Termales - La Gaviota, Vereda, Santa Rosa de Cabal
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text: I have stayed at this place 5 times in my life and was a little sad to see it had changed owners. The great thing is  Andres has made it better! It is still as lovely and clean as ever. Me and my family love this place and I highly recommend it. It is walking distance to some great restaurants. Also be sure to take a walk up the mountain on the road right in front of El Mirador and grab some fresh wild black berries and enjoy beautiful views. Andres also makes an excellent breakfast of Arepas, pericos, and fresh hand made cheese from his cows. Andres has connections to get you a private driver back to Cali/Medellin/Bogota for an excellent price, as well as connections with a local driver that can take you to the termales or the town of Santa Rosa for supplies (if needed). Andres, Thank you for the excellent service,  and the habenero seeds (they were just planted here in Texas). My father in law said the zapallo from your garden was excellent and the plantain tree is growing!
review_2_text:
Hospedaje El Mirador is an excellent place—truly beyond words.
If you're looking for peace, nature, and first-class service, this is the place to be. The atmosphere is calm, with beautiful views and surrounded by nature. Don Guillermo is an exceptional person, always kind and attentive. Highly recommended!

Hospedaje El Mirador is an excellent place—truly beyond words.
If you're looking for peace, nature, and great service, this is the place to be. The atmosphere is calm, with beautiful views and surrounded by nature. Don Guillermo is an exceptional person, always kind and attentive. Highly recommended!
review_3_text: A spectacular place surrounded by nature, far from the hustle and bustle of people. Mr. Guillermo's service was especially special; he was very kind, attentive, and willing to help with whatever you needed. Highly recommended.
review_4_text: Lugar acogedor, a 10 minutos en carro del casco urbano de Santa Rosa de Cabal, vía a termales de Santa Rosa. Su diseño en madera, enclavado en las montañas y a 1.900 msnm hacen de este lugar un sitio inigualable para el descanso. La habitación cuenta con baño privado, TV con cable y cómodos colchones para el descanso. Recomiendo mucho los desayunos, acompañados de chocolate o café, arepa paisa, huevos revueltos o fritos y queso, son espectaculares. Tiene parqueadero. El sitio es muy bueno para alejarse del ruido y respirar aire de montaña. La señal de datos en el celular es intermitente pero no la necesitarán, el sitio es muy recomendado.
review_5_text: Good place to rest, comfortable rooms, Wi-Fi, cable TV, large dining room and good service. Very close to the Santa Rosa hot springs

name: Hotel Cañaveral 2
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text:
Terrible service from both receptionists, both day and night.
The day receptionist is very busy, very slow, very rude, and the night receptionist is a thief. So, when I bought two hot juices, I asked her how much they were, and she replied that they were $11,000 (very expensive). I answered, but the price list you have at the front desk and in the room says $4,500 each.
Draw your own conclusions about how many people haven't been overcharged.
I would return to that hotel when those two receptionists no longer work there.
Terrible service.
review_2_text: It has a very good view, and the rooms are good, the place is very central to where you go, and the prices are reasonable, the only thing is the parking, which most hotels in that area don't have and the independent ones are expensive.
review_3_text: Very good hotel, very well located, the rooms are very comfortable and clean, the staff is very friendly and attentive.
review_4_text: I LIKED THE PLACE IN THE CENTER, QUIET, SUPER CLEAN. THE FAILURE WAS IN MY RESERVATION, THEY DID NOT RESPECT IT AND I HAD TO PAY MORE. I DON'T UNDERSTAND WHY YOU MAKE A RESERVATION IF THEY DON'T RESPECT IT.
review_5_text: The rooms are comfortable and the service is very good. As are the prices.

name: Mountain View Hostel
address: Vereda Manzanares, La Argelia Finca La Caimarona, Finca #58, Manizales
review_1_text: The owners are very sweet. The views are amazing. A nice little place close to the city but all on its own.
review_2_text: Excellent service. Is a beautiful and peaceful place to be with friends or to be as a couple. Mr Jose and Mrs Diana are very good hoster.
review_3_text:
5 out of 5, if I could, I'd give it a 10.
Excellent place, spacious, comfortable rooms, delicious food, and super-special attention from Mrs. Diana and Mr. José, who treated us like we were at home. Very grateful.
review_4_text: A spectacular place full of diverse environments, with wonderful landscapes, super food and incredible service, highly recommended
review_5_text: Very nice facilities, Don José and Diana excellent hosts. Super recommended.

name: Casa Azul Boutique Hostel
opening_hours: Monday: 7:00 AM – 10:30 PM|Tuesday: 7:00 AM – 10:30 PM|Wednesday: 7:00 AM – 10:30 PM|Thursday: 7:00 AM – 10:30 PM|Friday: 7:00 AM – 10:30 PM|Saturday: 7:00 AM – 10:30 PM|Sunday: 7:00 AM – 10:30 PM
review_1_text:
Staff is friendly and helpful.
This place is a good, inexpensive option for short-term stays. I do encourage trying out their coffee and all different extraction methods. They have some truly special coffee varieties worth while experiencing.

If you are looking for a quiet place to work remotely, this place will not meet expectations. I would warn you about the noise levels, not only here but everywhere else in Colombia.

The single room, although convenient for short stays, was way too small and got REALLY hot. Even though my booking mentioned there would be a fan, I had to push to get one.

This place is a coffee shop during the day and it gets REALLY loud. I was not a fan of the breakfast option but that's simply a matter of preference.
review_2_text: Extremely nice hostel! The beds are well built and have a little shelf between the bed and wall with a built in electrical outlet as well as a lamp and curtains for privacy. The service is impeccable, the staff is extremely friendly and accommodating. The rooms do get warm during the day, but hey, it's Colombia. The breakfast was fairly basic, but I didnt see breakfast included at any other hostels in the area so it was a good value. The atmosphere was very chill during my stay. The location isnt very central but the area felt safe, and there is a very close olimpica supermarket, as well as a 24 hour tienda. The downstairs cafe is nice and serves food all day which is very convenient because it was not easy for me to find a decent restaurant in Pereira.
review_3_text: Excellent Hostel if youre looking for a quiet clean out of the way place. Every staff member was so kind and went above and beyond to make sure I was comfortable there. Rooms are clean and cozy, staff is unbelievably accommodating. Easy walk to stores and 24hrs convenience in a nice neighborhood, while still walkable to the city center. Im returning to Pereira for a flight soon and have no doubts about where I will stay.
review_4_text:
Nicest hostel I've stayed at in Colombia.
Rooms are clean, service is fantastic. The owner is very helpful and puts an effort in to make sure every guest is happy.

Would highly recommend 💯
(They have fantastic coffee + breakfast options also)
review_5_text:
We stayed in the hostel for just a night.
At the reception you’ll see a sign that you aren’t allowed to bring your own food - sorta weird for a hostel, I bet. Yet, that’s possibly because they are more of a cafe than of accommodation - it really felt as if renting a room in a cafe. The food was great, I strongly recommend their chicken sandwich! The breakfast, included in the room price, was amazing, too. The coffee is delicious and you can buy beans there - such awesome quality at such reasonable prices!!! Our room, "Mokka”, is stuffy and eventually it was impossible to sleep as it was too hot and too little air (the fan wasn't too helpful, alas) - I got up absolutely powerless to an awful headache (this is when the coffee revived me!).
The bathroom is another issue: the shower doesn’t have a door, nor a curtain and you have to be overly careful to avoid turning the space into a swamp)
In general, if ever in Pereira, I'll stay in a different place but drop by for lunch!)

name: Residencias la Marquesa 2
review_1_text:
We arrived to the hostel and the host cancel our reservation (not in booking)
He send us to another hostel that want to charge us in double price .
review_2_text: A prison with a satellite dish... The rooms are 5 square meters, the service is very average, and the atmosphere inside feels heavy. They also charged me the most expensive parking, even though it was just a hallway, which I couldn't access on my own without first informing the attendant. Terrible experience. I don't recommend staying here. Despite the low price, I could have found better options.
review_3_text: On one occasion I stayed but I stayed again and the service and information was very terrible and in that regard they also took my time from the stipulated time and charged me for additional time. In truth, it was already very bad. The service I do not recommend.
review_4_text: Económico, tiene agua caliente, pero las camas son muy incómodas :(
review_5_text: Very good quality/price ratio. Within the historic center and close to the Cyprus neighborhood and other tourist places. Good service and clean rooms, the only thing it needs is some ventilation or a window, but for the price you pay it is the best you can get in the sector

name: De Requka Hostel Boutique
review_1_text: Stayed for 1 night only but absolutely loved this hostel! Everyone was so friendly, the rooms are so clean and well set up and we even had breakfast included. Had the best night sleep here! We went on a day trip and left our bags all day, then when we got back the lady at reception let us shower and gave us a towel too! Thanks so much guys 🤩
review_2_text: Located in a safe area with tons of good restaurants around. Very lively area. The room was clean, all commom areas were always clean. I reached at 8 am while the checkin time is 3, they allowed me to checkin at 8! The staff is super nice, always ready to help. I recommend this hostel!
review_3_text:
This hostel is really well located in Pereira. The rooms are clean and the beds are quiet comfortable compared to the rest of the places I've been to in Colombia. There is plenty of space in the lockers under the beds to put your personal belongings.
The staff was really kind and helpful. Answering all our questions and doubts.
I definitely recommend staying here.
review_4_text: Needed a place to sleep for 1 night and it was all I needed. Nice and gentle people, cute looking place and close to everything I needed. Had good sleep also!
review_5_text: Only spent a single night, but had a blast in the beautiful garden alongside my friends... Wish I could have spent more time, as I was well accomodated and kindly received.

name: Ceiba Rooms
review_1_text: The bathroom was really dirty with hairs in the drain of the shower, on the floor in the room itself were also a few hairs on the ground. Disgusting. We stayed here for just a few hours because we had to wait for our flight for five hours. The moment we came in we went to sleep and because I didn’t tell them straight away they didn’t do anything with it, nor were they understanding about it. Definitely would not recommend! It is close to the airport though.
review_2_text:
The location is not terrible because of the airport, but it's impossible to sleep due to the music playing next door, all night long.
At least that was my experience on a Saturday night.
Staff is very kind, but I could not sleep, which is why I booked the room for
review_3_text: What an amazing place !! The room was great, and the atmosphere was incredible. Theres an amazing view and they have this crazy awesome ecology zone with tables and benches perfect for a picnic! Its right by the airport and they also offer car rentals with great rates. I found it on a whim and ended up extending 2 additional nights.   Also for those who work while traveling the internet was pretty good and all the TV’s were smart so I was able to cast my devices.
review_4_text: Room smelled musty and infested with ants. Staff was unwilling to treat the issue. Look somewhere else.
review_5_text: Good

review_1_text:
Pilar fue una anfitriona espectacular!
Nos recibió siempre con la mejor de las energías, buen café y una sonrisa. El hospedaje es muy tranquilo y con algunas caminatas al alrededor. Esta muy bien ubicado y se puede llegar fácilmente con el transporte público desde el pueblo.
review_2_text: El espacio perfecto para desconectarse. Se siente como llegar a la casa de los tíos. Doña Pilar y don Jorge son maravillosas personas que hacen la estadía más agradable.
review_3_text: Hermoso lugar, camas cómodas, la habitación espectacular y lo mejor de todo la atención de doña Pilar, nuestra estadía fue fenomenal
review_4_text: Nos hemos alojado dos noches. Pilar y Jorge son muy atentos, las cabañas muy limpias,cómodas y bonitas. El entorno es espectacular. 100% recomendado.
review_5_text: The hostess is the most magical thing about the place, she recharges you with energy, she serves you with true love. The facilities are super comfortable, the decoration is magical, the bathrooms are divine, and it is very close to hot springs, the town, and you can take pleasant walks inside and outside the complex.

name: Hotel Risaralda
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text: Good value, quiet, family run. Book directly with hotel or walk-in for the best price.
review_2_text: Great for staying the night before a bus very nice manager and good bed
review_3_text: Regular service, the owner was very friendly, but the rest of the employees spoke just as well. There is not hot water in all rooms, only in one downstairs. The location is close to the center but gives a feeling of insecurity due to the neighboring streets.  The room is clean.
review_4_text:
The attention of the owner was excellent, she is very attentive and helpful, the rooms and common areas always remain very clean.
The hotel is relatively close to everything, it is easy to find restaurants, shops and supermarkets nearby.

The only observation we can make is the cold water and the mattresses are not very comfortable, but this in relation to the price and the excellent service becomes irrelevant, in conclusion it is a good place to recommend if what you want is something good and you can save on accommodation for your vacation.
review_5_text: Excellent attention from the owners, very clean and tidy spaces, central location and at a good price 👏👏 they even helped me take a taxi to the airport in the middle of the morning with all the kindness. 100% recommended!

name: Hacienda Venecia Manizales Hostel
review_1_text: We are traveling Colombia by campervan and we stayed 2 nights but could have easily stayed 4 to truly experience the nirvana. Coffee tour was exceptional and available in English and Spanish. Hummingbird and bird watching from several seating areas & hammocks at the hostel was incredible. Identified 14 new-to-me bird species. Hot showers and super clean bathrooms! We treated ourselves to delicious breakfast for COP120000.  Several other guests arrived by bus and stayed very comfortably in the hostel or lodge. They help arrange pickup/dropoff for buses.
review_2_text: The hostel is in a beautiful location with lots of trees and birds. The staff is very friendly. The coffee tour was pretry cool. I do however advise People to bring their own food. The lunch they offer for 42000cop is really not worth it, very small and nothing special. They do have a small shop at the hostel where they sell pasta, rice, pizza kits and some fruits and veggies, so I still give them 5 stars.
review_3_text: Friendly and warm place to stay. You can walk the trails of the hacienda to watch birds or to enjoy nature. Breakfast, lunch and dinner are tasty every time and clearly made with love. Rooms are super luxurious (we got to stay in the main house after an unexpected upgrade, so we felt like royalty). Every detail is very much taken care of. The coffee tour is super interesting and educational.
review_4_text: Great little secluded location. Nice and clean, big rooms and some chill communal areas to meet people. The only drawback is that it is a bit of a mission to get anywhere if you don't have your own transport
review_5_text: We had a fabulous stay at the Hacienda Vanecia Hostel. The hostel hosts, Gilbert and Jessica, made us feel very welcome and did everything to make sure we were enjoying our stay. We loved our little bungalow, the hammocks for lounging, the outdoor kitchen, and the relaxing atmosphere of being surrounded by nature. The birds that flew around the property were especially fascinating. We added on breakfast each morning and Jessica was an excellent cook. The tiny tienda was reasonably priced and provided essentials to cook for yourself (we had some beers as well as made pizza, pasta, and sausages) We also took the coffee farm tour with Johann and he was a super friendly, knowledgeable guide. The property is massive and beautiful with several options for hiking or lounging. I recommend this place to anyone who wants a relaxing few days in the coffee triangle!

name: Hostal Rosamaria

review_2_text: Excellent. Totally recommended
review_3_text: Lugar recomendadisimo 😁

review_1_text:
A perfect stay! The owners is the most perfect host, will make you feel home
The rooms are very clean, the breakfast is delicious and the location is perfect- a quiet place, 5 mins walk from all the bars and 2 mins walk from the mall.
review_2_text: new, clean, many rooms with private baths--- very nice people!, several speak english and spanish--my first hostel stay--I enjoyed it very much. Very convenient location close to shopping malls (3blocks) and restaurants (some of the best 8 blocks). You'll like it.
review_3_text: Awesome place to stay. Catalina is very friendly and hotel was nice. Room was clean and wifi working superb. Everything was perfect. I reached late night but there was no problem for check in. I recommend this place to live while you are in Manizales.
review_4_text: I spent last week there and it was amazing. Mrs Catalina and Mrs Lucely were very nice and helpful. There is no complaint and the service is good. The rooms are very clean and the service is very good. If you are in Manizales for business or pleasure, this is the correct hostel to stay.I slept very well in a cozy bed.  The breakfast is great and the shower has hot water. The bathrooms are always clean and the basic ammenities available (soap, towel, etc) It is near the hotsprings and el Cable sector, where you can go by walking 4 blocks away find great places to eat, shopping malls and have fun. I will come back with my wife in January for sure. Thank you so much!
review_5_text: Excellent service, attention to detail, rooms, Catalina is a sweetheart ❤️

name: Hotel Adel
review_1_text: The staff is so lovely, and welcoming we got coffee and tee when we arrived. Thanku so much for having us! I would recommend this place because you really feel at home. They will also give some good advice on the surroundings
review_2_text: Everything seems quite new which makes the stay automatically more pleasant in comparison to many average hotels. The (bath)rooms are rather small but acceptable for a short-term stay. Very close to the bus station and free coffee at the reception.
review_3_text:
We stayed for 1 (or is it 2?) Nights at the Adel Hotel.
After a 2 weeks trip in Colombia i m not afraid to say it s been one of the best nightsleep we had. Soft sheets, nice mat, secure environnment.
Rooms are simple but perfectly clean, the shower are hot (yes they are).
5 min walk from the terminal.
And last but not least the owners are the nicest couple. They were so helpful, kind, funny....
Thanks a lot =)
review_4_text: A good place to spend the night and continue the trip or do activities nearby. The couple's attention is very friendly, there is the possibility of parking the motorcycle overnight and where to have breakfast next to the hotel. Good facilities and has wi-fi and hot water.
review_5_text: Excellent location, although it doesn't have parking, it's right across from the terminal parking lot. Impeccable, comfortable, the perfect bathroom, new, very attentive staff, and they gave us the necessary information to have a stay that every traveler desires.

name: RESTAURANTE-HOSTAL ROSA MARIA
review_1_text: Place is very clean and colorful. Beautiful to sit and enjoy the view that is just astonishing. The food was to be honest okish and  could improve. But please do yourself a favor and drink the Linonada de Coco... Foamy with lemon just delicious... More than delicious.
review_2_text: Beautiful views but horrible food.  We ordered two different carnes and both were very tough (dura).  We also think the Punto de Anca is not real...it’s another cut of meat.  Try somewhere else if you can...
review_3_text: Solo fui al restaurante y que decepción tenían niños creo que hasta menores de edad muy tímidos e inexpertos nos tomaron el pedido con su libreta y de nada sirvió pues nunca nos trajeron porción de plátano y limón tres veces la pedimos,la chuleta de cerdo que pedí durísima aparte q la sirven en un plato pequeño y no muy bien presentado a favor la vista q tiene de resto mucho que desear luego en el pueblo me recomendaron los q quedaban al otro lado de la calle
review_4_text:
Excellent price, good service,
A spectacular landscape
review_5_text: Excelente servicio, habitaciones cómodas . Te puedes desconectar del mundo exterior. Sitio super recomendado.

name: Hotel Pereira Central
review_1_text:
I just called to ask about the price of a room because on Booking.com it was 55,000 pesos with breakfast included. To my surprise, the girl told me it was 100,000 pesos, or 45,000 pesos more expensive than on the app. She told me to do it through the app, but when I tried to make the reservation through the app, the girl had already raised the price.
Bully!
review_2_text:
English:
We arrived at night and it wasn't possible to pay with a card, so I had to book and pay through Expedia. The internet didn't work, and it was still down the next day. Breakfast included scrambled eggs with pork ham, three slices of apple, a cracker, and two slices of bread with coffee or hot chocolate. My brother is allergic to pork, and when we asked for eggs without ham, they said no because they cook everything in batches. We offered to pay extra for plain eggs, but they refused. We filed a complaint at the front desk, but they just made excuses. Worst hotel service ever. It's a shame, because the location is good. Also, there was water leaking in the bathroom. Never again.

Spanish:
We arrived at night and you couldn't pay by card, so I had to book and pay through Expedia. The internet was not working and the next day it was still not working. Breakfast consisted of scrambled eggs with pork ham, three slices of apple, a cracker, and two slices of bread with coffee or hot chocolate. My brother is allergic to pork, and when we asked for eggs without ham, we were told it wasn't possible because they were prepared in batches. We offered to pay extra for plain eggs, but they said no. We complained to the front desk, and they only gave excuses. The worst service we've ever received at a hotel. It's a shame because the location is good. Also, there were water leaks in the bathroom. Never again.
review_3_text: The room, although spacious, had to do with the unbearable heat, we made the reservation through Booking and although it said there was no fan, we asked the girl at the reception and she got a small one that helped somewhat but due to the issue of not having air conditioning or really good ventilation, that's why the rating, the large comfortable bed, TV with internet connection, in terms of cleanliness without any reproach, the truth is, well, I would recommend it if you don't have a problem because of the heat, if not, it's better to look for other options.
review_4_text: The girl at the reception was a little impatient, but the breakfast was delicious, and the room was very good in everything.
review_5_text: Super, the hotel is new, the rooms are pleasant, comfortable and a spectacular television with all pay channels included.

review_2_text:
At the Marana Hotel in Manizalez, clients are abused, with constant inexplicable losses of their personal belongings.

review_3_text: Tuve una estancia maravillosa en este hospedaje en Maraná. El servicio fue excelente, el ambiente muy acogedor y la ubicación apenas. Definitivamente volveré y lo recomendaré a amigos y familiares. ¡Gracias por una experiencia tan agradable!
review_4_text: Excelente servicio, muy cómodo y lo más importante es la cercanía a todo por estar en el centro de la ciudad, delicioso el desayuno por la mañana!
review_5_text: The place is quite affordable, the attention and friendliness are excellent. It is close to the city center, the rooms are just enough to sleep in, and there is hot water for the cold of Manizales.

review_2_text: Very nice staff. Well situated and easy to find. Very clean and comfortable.
review_3_text: Very clean, the owner is extremely helpful. I had a super good experience here.

review_3_text:
La Casa Hostal Bosconia es un lugar muy bonito y acogedor.
Además, está ubicado en una buena zona de la ciudad.
La actitud de Don Marino fue lo mejor de todo. Una gran persona con mucho carisma y excelente atención.
Las camas son comodas y se encuentra en una calle muy silenciosa. A pocas cuadras hay un centro comercial y muchos establecimientos para comer o tomar algo.

Lo que me pareció interesante fue una pequeña biblioteca con algunos libros interesantes para sentarse un rato a leer y disfrutar un café.

100% recomendado este lugar.
review_4_text: Cozy atmosphere and. Excellent location. Served by its owner, a Spaniard with good habits and kindness
review_5_text: A beautiful place with history, Mr. Marino's kindness cannot be compared to anything, he is also full of small curiosities, super recommended

name: Mountain Hostels Manizales
review_1_text: Great hostel with cute back patio, free breakfast, and great service. They provided towels and they had laundry service for 8000 cop per kilo which was a pretty good price compared to what I saw at a few other hostels in Colombia. Pretty quiet place, but a quick walk to the bustle of el cable. Overall, very happy with this hostel☺️
review_2_text: Comfortable place, with nice staff and basic breakfast included.  There is no secure parking.  Motorcycles can park off the street just in front of the doors, but there is no one at the desk after 11pm; cars have to park on the street, and there is little room for parking as there are many cars parked along the street.  Neighbours say it's a safe area to park.
review_3_text: Great hostel, with lockers, pretty good kitchen, and amazing staff!  There's a beautiful patio with hammocks to relax, a paid laundry service if you want, and really clean and neat rooms.  There's not many bathrooms per person, but usually there's not a problem.
review_4_text:
Service was amazing, the hosts were great.
Great communal areas.
The only thing I wish is that there were more people at the hostel!!
Also, the wifi could be better. Not great for working.
review_5_text: Not central, but close to shopping centre and in a quiet residential street. Private rooms are hotel standard, almost, private bathrooms are really compact. Bit comfortable beds, well maintained and access to a small kitchen. All this and free breakfast.

The location is unbeatable: right next to the Arboleda shopping center and surrounded by restaurants and clubs. I loved the breakfast: delicious, prompt, and beautifully presented. It's the ideal place to relax, spend time with your partner, work, or sightsee in total comfort. Highly recommended!

name: Hostal Monte Quimbaya
opening_hours: Monday: 8:00 AM – 7:00 AM|Tuesday: 8:00 AM – 7:00 AM|Wednesday: 8:00 AM – 7:00 AM|Thursday: 8:00 AM – 7:00 AM|Friday: 8:00 AM – 7:00 AM|Saturday: 8:00 AM – 7:00 AM|Sunday: 8:00 AM – 7:00 AM
review_1_text: The hostel is a perfect spot for some relaxing days in the middle of the incredible green coffee region. The views are magnificent, the food is delicious, the surroundings are quiet and best of all: Lineth and Arne are the best hosts you could imagine.
review_2_text:
Extraordinary! Lineth and Arne have just opened their hostel 2 months ago. They did a great job, it is beautiful with very pretty decorations and colors. Thanks to your welcome and your availability, you feel at home. Its library, board games and hammocks allow you to rest and enjoy the moment in the center of the coffee region with an incredible view. Their organic coffee is wonderful! They buy it at a coffee farm near the hostel, it is also possible to visit it. The rooms are all built with bamboo, beautiful!!!

Thanks to your advice, I went to the Tierra Viva hot springs at the end of the day on Tuesday, just 30 minutes from Villamaría, very cool.
review_3_text: Hostal Monte Quimbaya is a small hostel on a human scale, with comfortable beds, a magnificent view of the surrounding countryside, a calm which is very good if you are arriving from a city, delicious coffee and above all friendly and interesting hosts. Arne and Lineth have lots of advice for activities nearby in the cafeteria zone or in Manizales and gave us a great welcome. An ideal base for discovering this beautiful region!
review_4_text:
We spent a week in this paradise. The hotel is very nice, very well decorated and we felt very good. The hotel's viewpoint is incredible. We would have liked to stay one more week.

The owners, Lineth and Arne, are adorable and will give you good advice to discover Manizales, Villamaría and the roads near the hotel. Lineth and Arne organized a visit to a coffee farm, from harvest to sale, super interesting!
review_5_text: The managers of this hotel, (not forgetting their little boy), are simply incredible!  We were doing a workaway with my fiancée and they made us feel wonderfully welcome, just like guests. The place is just great for people looking for tranquility. Between walks and treks, thermal baths, discovery of the production of the famous Colombian coffee or authentic rum, parks sheltering diverse and varied species of birds... it is possible to satisfy all tastes. The organic coffee that the managers offer is simply excellent! The layout of the hotel is conducive to spending quality, relaxing moments, far from the noise of the city. The east garden is quite large and the view at the back of the hotel overlooks a valley which is just delicious for the eyes!

review_4_text:
From the moment we arrived, we felt the peace that only comes from the land. The domes are super private, surrounded by nature, and in a location that allows you to disconnect from the noise of the world. Everything is designed to make you feel at home, yet in the middle of the countryside, with that fresh air we love so much here.

The rooms are very sturdy, with no swaying floors or strange things, and everything is tastefully decorated, simple but beautiful, with that rustic touch so typical of our region. The lamps all work, so there's no need to worry about the light, and the bathroom is well laid out, with dividers that keep everything tidy and dry. The shower also has good pressure, perfect for relaxing after a day exploring coffee plantations or the mountains.

The balcony is wonderful. It feels safe, well-built, and has a catamaran net in excellent condition where you can lie down and watch the sunset among the bamboo and coffee fields. The pool, clean and well-maintained, is a tremendous plus for sharing with friends or family in a delightful climate.

The bedding was clean, smelling delicious, and the pillows were super comfortable. No strange smells or unpleasant odors. The curtains provide good coverage, allowing natural light to pass through without sacrificing privacy.

Something we really appreciated was the tranquility. Although they do maintenance work, they do it carefully, without any fuss, and always greet us with that kindness that is so typical of us coffee growers.

The place is completely secure. You can walk around in peace, explore the surroundings, and feel at ease. Plus, there are several activities nearby, from ecological hikes to visits to coffee farms. Everything is close by if you want to get around, but it's also perfect if you're just looking for pure relaxation.

The breakfast... a delight! Homemade, prepared with love, with that flavor that only comes from coffee-growing land. You can truly feel the care in every detail.

In short: A place to return to. Cozy, clean, private, and with all the charm of the Coffee Region. Highly recommended for those looking for a change of scenery, to connect with nature, and to rest properly.

Estuve un semana con mi familia y la experiencia en general fue entre buena y regular, pero nada más de ahí.

En general todo estaba limpio, la finca es bonita y muy grande y habían ambientes diferentes para hacer diferentes actividades.

Por otro lado, la agencia que nos rentó la finca que se llama coffee break deja muchísimo que desear, la comunicación con ellos no es buena, se muestran amigables antes de rentar la finca, pero después el trato no es tan bueno, también al momento de mostrar la finca ofrecieron muchas cosas que después de rentarla y de hospedarnos no cumplieron con ellas como por ejemplo el jacuzzi, o por otro lado unas que la final sí cumplieron como TV y WIFI pero después de mucho llamar, mandar textos, hasta el punto de exigir que se cumpliera con lo acordado, lo cual nadie quisiera hacer mientras está en sus días de “descanso” y en su tiempo familiar. Se supone que no teníamos que preocuparnos por nada de eso, pero en lugar de eso, tuvimos que estar casi que rogándoles que nos pusieran wifi y TV para poder ver la copa America en familia.

Por otro lado, la privacidad de la finca es muy mala, se supone que debe haber una persona cerrando y abriendo la puerta, pero el señor encargado no lo hacía, hasta el punto que se entraron unos desconocidos a la finca.

Las neveras no funcionaban bien y teníamos comida para una semana para casi 50 personas, son neveras muy viejas y en mal estado. Debido a eso la comida se nos estaba dañando.

Muy bonita la finca, pero le falta que le hagan mejoras y que definitivamente cambien de agencia para que renten la finca.

review_5_text:
COMENTARIO 2 (Respuesta al comentario del propietario):
1. Me parece genial que tengáis animales, yo comento que debéis INFORMARLO, hay personas que no pueden convivir por temas médicos... Como es mi caso😅🤦🏽‍♀️

2. Estuvimos pendientes de la ropa, es más comentamos de subirla a la habitación por si se secaba más rápido y se nos dijo que no hacía falta. Sólo comento que quién fuera que viera (porque se ve si una prenda está en el suelo -cuando yo la dejé colgada- sucia y rota) se avisa.

3. Por otro lado, no TODO lo podéis achacar a que estáis en zona rural, repito yo voy mucho a la montaña (y sé que hay insectos) pero la cosa es que no lo tenéis bien adecuado. Ahora mismo, estoy en la montaña cerca del Nevados del Ruiz y este sitio donde estoy ahora, no tiene ni punto de comparación y te aseguro que es muy RURAL.

Ya me pondré en contacto con booking para comentar el caso. ¡Yo no regresaré seguro!
Yo escribí para que los futuros huéspedes estén informados de cosas que no se informan en la página como tal (animales, restaurante, que las habitaciones tienen huecos por debajo las puertas y por el techo, que el camino no es para coches normales,...) mejor tener toda la información.

COMENTARIO 1:
Habiendo estado en otras casas, ésta no la recomiendaría por:

1. El camino hasta llegar a la casa es muy malo, con muchos baches y estrecho; encima también te encuentras algún caminón😅
Sobretodo no vayas si tienes un coche normal, bueno en verdad, yo ni con un Jeep volvería, no por el camino...

2. No avisan del tema de los perros y el gato que tienen, soy al•lergica y me he tenido que medicar (suerte que llevaba algo de medicación) porque me daba alergia, si lo hubiera sabido no hubiera venido a aquí.
Además si quieres descansar, los perros se ponen a ladrar a cualquier persona y también durante la noche y es difícil volver a dormir.

3. La zona de cocina/comedor aún no está bien habilitada, de hecho, estos días la estan pintando incluso mientras comes.
Además, si coinciden muchos huéspedes no sé cómo se lo harán porque el espacio es pequeño y, por lo tanto, hay poca intimidad.

4. Pedimos para lavar la ropa y al recogerla tenía unos pantalones (nuevos) rotos por algun perro (adjunto foto), nadie me dijo nada y estaban colgados nuevamente en el sitio dónde yo los colgué. Completamente sucios (de barro) y rotos, al menos, la persona que los recogió podría haber avisado del incidente (habría dicho mucho de ellos) y no encontrármelos ahí cómo si nada.

5. En la habitación (en 2 noches) encontramos 3 cucarachas y eso que nosotros lo teníamos todo cerrado, la verdad no es para nada agradable... (Adjunto foto)

6. La piscina parece muy bonita en las fotos, pero el agua está turbia y no nos pudimos bañar...

7. La cobertura (nosotros tenemos CLARO) y el wifi de la casa (a nosotros al menos) va mal, para que lo tengáis en cuenta también.

8. Ponen que tienen "restaurante" y no es así, sino que tienes que usar un app de comida a domicilio. Eso no es tener un restaurante en el alojamiento😅

Este alojamiento tiene mucho trabajo por delante para poder ser óptimo y decente. Nuestra recomendación es que no durmáis a aquí.

I wanted to visit this place with my children to enjoy its facilities, especially the pool and the jacuzzi. However, I was informed that the use of the jacuzzi is limited to one hour, which I found unreasonable for a place that promotes itself as family-friendly. For children, one hour is insufficient, and imposing such a time limit feels uncomfortable and frustrating.

Additionally, I was surprised to learn that they charge an extra 50,000 pesos per hour for the use of the jacuzzi, and that access depends on the hotel's occupancy. This policy is unclear and leaves much to be desired in terms of transparency and flexibility. A place that claims to be family-oriented should offer more accessible conditions tailored to the needs of families, allowing everyone to enjoy themselves without pressure or excessive costs.

For children, one hour is not enough, and limiting their time in this way is uncomfortable and frustrating.

Additionally, I was surprised to learn that they charge an additional 50 thousand pesos per hour for the use of the jacuzzi, and that access depends on hotel occupancy. This policy is not clear and leaves much to be desired in terms of transparency and flexibility. A site that is considered family-friendly should offer more accessible conditions adapted to the needs of families, allowing everyone to enjoy themselves without excessive pressures and costs.

She charges a very high price for laundry, even if you do it by hand, and you can't use the kitchen after 9 pm...

review_1_text:
If only zero stars was an option
I want to start by saying this is only the second complaint review I have ever written, and always give places the benefit of the doubt or try and see the positives, but this was a huge struggle, so hope you either read this review, or just read this first part and avoid the misfortune of booking here. The room doesn’t offer robes, water or even a hair dryer, it’s a very basic room for the price and quality you would expect. Re the robes, other guests walk around them to go between pools etc in comfort. When asked they said they had run out, and we struggled to get another set of towels in order to be appropriately covered while going between the pools.
The noise is terrible, they had an event the following day so decided to do a sound test from 11pm to past midnight, when we complained and asked to change rooms we were told that the sound test was only another half an hour. I would think most people would come expecting a relaxing stay not having loud blaring music which causes the windows to vibrate, and that’s not including noise from the parking lot, to the reception, to the next door room.
The restaurant was clearly under staffed, given its ferias in Manizales and the hotel is fully booked, this seems a undersight on the hotels part. Drinks arrived after the food, the pasta arrived cold and 15mins later the chicken sandwich arrived which should have been a la gratin, but was just soggy and came with under cooked french fries. When you check in they say there is room service available, so whilst your not allowed to sleep from the noise of the music being tested you also can’t get a hot drink delivered to the room because the kitchen has closed, and there are no hot drinking facilities in the room.
We were given a ‘luxury room that we were moved to at 12.45am, the room itself isn’t any superior to the last room we were in, in terms of amenities, the only difference being that the layout is slightly different and the thankfully the room in a quieter location.
To top everything off, as with any spa hotel the understanding is that guests are going to get wet, and that as a woman or anyone with fairly long hair you will therefore get it wet, well there are no hairdryers available so don’t be fooled by the pictures of rooms with hairdryers expect a nice cold night with wet hair, and hope to not wake up unwell the next day.
Furthermore the gym is in a horrendous state, and it’s completely unsafe for use, it should not be advertised as having a gym in anyway.
P.s if you do for whatever reason have to stay then bring your own shampoo/body wash etc as this is not provided either.

review_2_text:
Unfortunately this is one of the worst stays I’ve ever experienced. I don’t take pleasure in writing this as I’ve never written a review or complaint online before, but this being the worst stays of my life (for many reasons), has compelled me to write this to warn others not to pay for this over-priced hotel, which really lets itself down in a number of ways. Apologies in advance for the long read below.

i) Restaurant:
Firstly, after my wife and I checked in at around 8pm on Wednesday 8th January, for a one night stay in a “deluxe” room, we thought to get something quick to eat at the hotel restaurant, before relaxing in the termales for the evening.

Unfortunately the sushi was not available to order from the menu - when our food eventually arrived, my wife’s pasta arrived luke warm, and my sandwich and chips arrived 15 mins later, undercooked and un
-edible. The waiter was apologetic and courteous in dealing with this.
During the entire meal a music sound check was taking place for a ferias event the next day (a recurring theme for the rest of the evening) - the music was so loud it sounded like you were in a nightclub while you were eating, unable to hear each other over dinner, which was the opposite of what was meant to be the start of a relaxing evening - Not something you’d expect for a £200+ per night stay.

ii) Amenities:
Guests walk around the termales in their robes between the different thermals baths, when we asked for these were told these had run out and there were no more robes available until morning as they were being washed. (Side note, when I checked back in the morning the robes were still unavailable).

At this time we were not offered a solution, and so when we asked for additional towels in place of the robes, we had to explain in detail why we needed this and sign for them, as if we were excepted to walk around in the cold and throughout the hotel in just our swimsuits.

In addition, our room did not have hair dryers, which is not entirely uncommon for hotels to have these in each individual rooms, however when we asked for one we were told none were available until the morning, so my wife had to go to bed with wet hair.
As a side note, the gym was desolate and unkept.

Again not in keeping something you expect from a “luxury” branded hotel and price you pay.

iii) Noise:
We enjoyed the termales springs and baths for the rest of the evening, however this is was still interrupted by the ongoing music sound check past 10pm.

We returned to our room around 11pm with the sound check still continuing, this time with drums, thundering bass and singing.
We took video evidence of the noise and vibration/rattling sound of our windows as we wanted to sleep.

If the rooms were sound proof this would be acceptable, but you can literally hear everyone and everything from the rooms, such as conversations in the main lobby and the front car park, let alone the music from this event which continued until 12am.

We requested to change rooms as we complained about all of this at the time via WhatsApp conversations with staff, and we were eventually moved room to a quieter room at 1am in the morning, 2 hours later from when we wanted to go to bed. The “luxury” room they moved us to had no working climate controls and the TV looked in disrepair, as a further side point.

There was no prior warning of this event preparation when checking in, which the hotel should have informed guests out of courtesy and respect.

The hotel manager was helpful in hearing our grievances and complaints the following morning - we are awaiting the outcome of our formal feedback provided to the hotel at the time and we were told to expect a call yesterday (9th January) from the reservation team, but have yet to hear back.
review_3_text:
It would have been helpful to know about exemption from taxes for foreign visitors instead of having to pay for the taxes and then applying for a refund at the airport.
The family room was very comfortable but when we arrived the private pool was not filled and it took 5 hours to be ready. Despite being told the room was “ready” from 1pm.
The “gym” was completely abandoned, dirty and unsafe. No dumbells (just empty racks), running machines with no plugs, electric cables exposed, one barbell with no clips, deflated medicine balls and exercise balls. A complete mess and unusable. Why they advertise they have a gym is beyond me. Awful.
review_4_text: The updated part the hotel looks beautiful, good thermal ponds, good food...however, for the price paid the rooms are really outdated not worth what they charge, no heat in the rooms (we got our own heater since we travel with a baby), even though we asked waaaay ahead of time for a crib, the day we arrived there was none available, they sent us a pack and play that didn't stay open. Good food in the restaurant but....ask before your order if you will get what's on the menu, we ordered 2 different plates...when they were brought to the table they weren't as described on the menu, ask our waitress about it...she had no idea and checked with the chef...after a while we were told that the menu wasn't updated and the chef doesn't do it like that anymore, food wasn't bad- it was good- but not what we ordered/expected..no solution was provided just a not heartfelt "sorry". Overall pretty disappointing hotel it was more hype, might be a good place to go spend the day and enjoy the ponds but not to stay, all this issues were brought up to hotel personnel while we were there and all we got was the basic "sorry thank you for letting us know". Will not stay there again and would suggest that you stay in a different hotel...maybe in the city.

This hotel is very central. We just so happened to visit Manizales during the parades , and their route was right by the hotel. This can be cumbersome as that main street is closed/shut down until the parade is finished, meaning if you want to leave with your own vehicle it is not possible until the street opens back up. Manizales is a very hilly city but walkable. You can walk to the Plaza Bolivar, and the cathedral from this location. Its a less than 20 min walk.
The service of the front desk was good. The parking service outside of the garage was excellent, its free and theres a guard there who will watch your car. To park inside the garage it is $2500 COP per day for a car (it more if its a motorcycle or a truck).
The rooms were average. Its by no means a luxury hotel. It appeared some rooms were renovated with fresh paint and new floors, this wasnt the case for all the rooms. On the second floor they have a room there were they do exhibitions, they had a bull statue one during our stay.
I will warn you if you book through booking and there is issues with your booking it will be troublesome to get it fixed/arranged, at least this was case for my dad. There might also just be issues with how your booking is uploaded. For example, I booked a room through booking, and it was described by Booking as having "city views". My room outlooked a window well, no city views whats so ever. The city views from this hotel are nice from the rooms and the dinning area. My room also had a broken lamp it didn't turn on. My dads room also had broken overhead lights. Both of our rooms the shower drain was completely plugged up. As was all of our rooms actually but only two of them were called to be fixed (I didnt notice until there was only night left so I didnt bother). The bathrooms come with only shampoo, and soap, no conditioner or body/hand cream. Additionally, for any foreigners staying here the hot water is the left handle and it must be left on for a bit before the hot water comes out.
The breakfast was included with our stay. Unfortunately it was not great. I ate once and my eggs had shells in them and my dads buñuelos had a long hair in them. It appears that most south american hotels dont do breakfast well. We also all dined for dinner once (8 of us) and the food was okay, not great not bad just fine.
review_4_text: Overpriced on a single room for our friends ! We paid for it and was charged the Gringo price , the price we paid should have been a King suite.   Also after a nice walk about town (which was chilly we check into our room and the window was left open  making the room cold.   Oh,  no heating unit was provided or installed.   I was freezing so I thought a hot bath would help, but great it had a tub, but it was either old old old, or disgustingly dirty.    In the small parking area we had to park our car where the bell hop said to park it and how he wanted our car parked!!!  because of the overprice on rooms and cold  i give it 1 star!!!!!

review_1_text: It is suggested to have a contingency option in case the electronic locks fail, so that other guests don't suffer the same fate as us; the code for our room's electronic lock failed, and we were locked out. Since there was no one directly at the service desk, we were given no solution; our calls were not answered in a timely manner (they did so 8 hours later), and we had to search for new accommodations in the middle of the night. There is no efficient and timely communication channel for any last-minute mishap. Likewise, the refund for the stay service that was not provided (because we had to pay for another hotel) has not been reimbursed, and there was no apparent intention on the part of the person in charge to issue such a refund. There are no clear responses from the service provider. It really is a total lack of respect, since the girl in charge didn't show up until 12 am. That is, 12 hours after the incident and just as check-out was due. Extra blankets are needed for cold days. The room we were assigned has a leak that prevents us from sleeping. Our experience was quite negative and we do not recommend it.

name: Hotel | Owls Watch at Rio Blanco | Avistamiento de Aves
review_1_text:
This retreat is an experience not just a stay. Our family absolutely loved it! The highlight of our Colombia trip. The cabin rooms were tastefully done, the food was delicious, and the views are breathtaking. The hosts Dennis and Adrianna are delightful people. My kids couldn't get enough of feeding the hummingbirds.
We also went bird watching with Juan, the groundskeeper, and thoroughly enjoyed the experience. If we are ever in Manizales, we plan to stay at Owl's Watch.  For those interested in staying, a few things to keep in mind: there is a lot of hiking/walking that is involved immediately upon reaching the area to access the main lobby and cabins. Some places can be quite muddy. Wear your hiking shoes and appropriate clothing before you enter the property. Also in order to be acclimated to the area, I would highly suggest driving into the property during daylight hours.
review_2_text:
We absolutely loved every single detail of this beautiful place. The owner and his team make you feel at home. I was born and raised in Manizales, and I never thought this place existed. The food is amazing, the room is clean and well-decorated. You can tell that the owners built this place with love.
I will definitely recommend Owl’s Watch to all of my friends. Great job guys!!! 🤍🤍
review_3_text: We had an amazing experience at the Owls Watch, it was an absolute highlight in our trip to Colombia. Each cabana is perfectly furnished with great view and hot tub. Each meal was a treat from breakfast to lunch and dinner. We'll definitely come back here.
review_4_text: Owls Watch was the highlight of my trip to Colombia! The location is stunningly beautiful, the cabins are incredibly stylish and well appointed, the nature is spectacular (shout-out to guides Daniel and Diego for their incredible birding expertise), and the food (by chef David) was the best we ate all month. I really hope to come back at some point and spend more time here.
review_5_text:
I stayed here for two incredible nights and wish I had another day. This is a really intimate experience. The lodge has two luxurious cabins, each of which overlook the valley and Manizales with a view of the mountains and volcanoes to the east. It's pretty stunning to sit on the balcony and look out over the valley and see a Masked Trogon at eye level not twenty meters away.

The entire team made my stay super special and we're very attentive. I did a bird walk with their guide Daniel and he was so helpful pointing out birds to me. We saw nearly 70 species that morning.

review_1_text:
The room is spacious with walls of windows overlooking the forest and thermal springs.
Bathroom is nice and modern.
Nevertheless maybe the room is too insulated because if you're not opening the windows it gets very foggy instantly.
The staff is meh, I had to speak to literally everyone walking around to get checked-in and pay hotel & restaurant to different people, quite annoying...
If you're staying at the hotel you can enjoy the pools but also private little bath with a table and chairs, really really nice!
review_2_text:
There was nobody at the reception, then one guy show us were the rooms were. Then back to the reception to pay for the room and then bring us to the actual room. They were doing some renovation so some part of the stairs were not practicable. Also painters were just outside our room windows in the morning. The pools closes at midnight and we could hear the music until late.
BUT the room was very clean, spacious and the bed very comfortable, the best mattress and pillow we got so far in Colombia (9 nights for now).
The private little termal bath was very hot but nice.
The food and beverage were very good and tasty! We got the veggies burger, some home made juice and the breakfast was good as well.
review_3_text:
We stayed at Isabel’s finca in Santa Rosa de Cabal last Saturday as a base to visit the nearby termales, and it was a perfect choice. Isabel was incredibly warm and hospitable—she even helped us plan our visit to Termales San Vicente, which made everything smoother.

The finca itself was cozy, peaceful, and ideally located for exploring the hot springs in the area. Our room was clean, well equipped, and we slept very comfortably.

A special bonus was the presence of many adorable and friendly animals—dogs, cats, pigs, ducks, and even a hen—which made the experience even more memorable. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a tranquil, welcoming stay in the region.
review_4_text: A treasure found not so far from the main city with its quiet surroundings filled with beautiful trees, flowers and plants,  you can easily spend hours or days here in complete peace and quiet that we all need.  Food and service equally great!  will definitely visit again with friends and family!  Thank you!
review_5_text: The rooms are very nice and spacious and each one has a small jacuzzi thermal spring outside for you to use privately. You can also use the big thermal pools as well. The road it’s on passes by some factories, so you would think it’s not going to be a nice place, but it is.

review_1_text: I wet to the restaurant and it was a very pleasant experience. Habitacion con una cama y nevera de bar más baño eso es todo.  Agua turbia, olor a humedad y estás en un contenedor (pequeño) revestido de la madera rústica más antiestética que puedas ver. No hay espacios comunes ni restaurantes dentro del Glamping en un entorno que es un desorden completo, deprimente. Las fotos te lo hacen ver como un espacio muy acogedor pero no vale lo que te cobran. Plus: linda la quebrada que pasa cerca y si vas a los termales sirve la ubicación

review_2_text:
We stayed 2 nights. Book directly with the hotel and the first thing I asked was if the transportation to leave was easy. The answer was yes.
