review_1_text:
Goosebumps.
Tears welling up, stinging behind my eyes.
That’s how deeply I was moved.
Because what do you feel when a condor – the king of the Andes – soars past you at just 20 meters? Everything. Everything all at once. I stood there breathless, in awe, humbled by the sheer majesty of nature.

And that wasn’t even the beginning.
Earlier that morning, I locked eyes with a puma. Two meters away. Two souls, one heartbeat. One of us clearly didn’t belong there – and it was me. It happened in a flash, but the echo of that moment will stay with me forever. All I could think was: that is one enormous cat…

Later that day, we encountered a nervous toucan, perched just three meters away. Its vibrant colors, its delicate presence – another breathtaking gift.
Every encounter felt sacred. As if nature had quietly opened a secret door and invited us in.

If there is a slice of paradise on Earth, it must be here: El Nido del Cóndor.

You sleep in beautiful accommodations, nestled in untouched landscapes where silence speaks and every breath feels like a homecoming. And the people…
Stephanie greets you with a warmth that instantly makes you feel like family. Every meal crafted by Juan is a culinary masterpiece – made with love, using ingredients from their own garden or local surroundings. You can taste the earth, the sun, the patience and passion in every bite.

The hikes and birdwatching are guided by Luis – a biologist and, somehow, a soul connected to the very essence of the wild. His knowledge is immense, but even more striking is how he communicates with nature. Not in words, but in presence, in energy, in deep understanding. As if he belongs to the forest, the sky, the rhythm of it all.

And just when you think it can’t possibly get any better, you’re treated to a warm sauna and a healing massage by Clementina. Gentle, caring, grounding.

What a gift, what a privilege to stay here.
If we lived in Colombia, this would become a yearly tradition –
A few days in paradise. A few days to feel alive, still, and fully awake.

Here, you remember who you are.
review_2_text: Nido de Condor is without a shadow of a doubt my favorite travel destination I've ever been to. I will honestly say, upon our arrival and looking out at the vast and jaw-dropping views I was fighting back tears of joy. My first thought was that I couldn't believe a place this beautiful existed, and how thankful I was to experience it. What an incredible birthday present from my girlfriend! I'll try to name all the things I enjoyed but I'm sure I'll leave a few out... The food was and chef was fantastic, the atmosphere, the design, build and architecture, the hiking, the birds, the employees,  (Stefania, Sebastian and Luis. Can't thank you enough!) the rooms were beautiful, the wildlife around the area, the neatly manicured landscaping, the hummingbirds and of course the Condors! What a spectacle it was to watch them! The other guests were great too. Thank you for your wonderful hospitality! We can't wait to return.
review_3_text:
Nido del Condor is truly a magical place, perched high atop a mountain, offering breathtaking views that are nothing short of extraordinary. From the moment I arrived, I could feel the enchantment in the air—everything about this place is designed with incredible attention to detail. The staff, including Stefania, Luis, and Sebastian, were nothing less than fantastic. They were all so knowledgeable, welcoming, and accommodating, always going above and beyond to ensure our experience was unforgettable.

The owners are incredibly attentive, taking the time to engage with guests and make sure everything is perfect. Every morning, we were treated to the awe-inspiring sight of condors soaring above, an experience that added an almost surreal quality to the entire stay.

The tent was spacious and offered an amazing view that I will never forget. Even the bathroom had its own stunning vista, which is something I've never encountered before. It’s little touches like these that make Nido del Condor feel so unique and special.

Having traveled to many places around the world, I can confidently say that this is my favorite destination. The sense of tranquility, the connection to nature, and the warmth of the people who run the place make it a memory I will always cherish. I can't wait to return.

The food was a delightful surprise—creative and delicious, it was a perfect complement to the surroundings. The hikes and activities available were challenging, but totally worth it if you're looking for adventure. There are also great opportunities for birdwatching and immersing yourself in nature, offering something for everyone.

If you're looking for a place to escape and connect with nature, Nido del Condor is the place to be. It’s an experience I’ll never forget, and I look forward to returning soon.

After hearing of this place for a couple of years I finally made it there last month while visiting birding sites in the Manizales/ Cordillera Central area. I was there explicitly for the bird photography opportunities which are world class, but I think this place would still be a lot of fun for non-birders too, especially if they wanted to just relax, unplug, and be enveloped in the beautiful mountain forest setting.

In the interest of full disclosure I just a cabina to stay in rather than a tent, and it was quite delightful. There was of course electricity (essential for changing batteries) private bath, and hot water.

Claudia the cook and general on-site point person was incredibly kind and welcoming. Mateo the birding guide (I highly recommend booking him at least one day, if not more) is fantastic for locating some of the more challenging species like Black-collared Jay and Ocellated Tapaculo, and has very impressive knowledge of calls and habits.

I would recommend a stay here to anyone who wants to see the incredible birds of central Colombia, particularly the Black-billed Mountain-Toucan which is the speciality of this place. Honestly a perfect experience and great value as well.

- Services - 10 stars! All the staff was super careful, loving, polite and attentive to our needs. When I say all staff I trully mean that. Few places I have been in this world had such people putting so much effort and love into their work.

- Food - can't praise it enough. Best food we have had in Manizales. It was so heartfelt! Big portions and made with care for each of us. Biggest thanks to all those ladies working there. God bless their hands!

I felt like home!

review_1_text:
Bosques de la Pradera is a magical place. A hidden Pearl in the Colombian mountains surrounded by beautiful nature.
You feel welcomed from the moment you walk in. The staff is very helpfull and kind.
The rooms are comfortable and we woke up to the sound of birds singing every day.
Imagine having your first cup of Coffee in the morning, while you watch birds of all kinds, butterflies and hundreds of orchids.  The views are breathtaking.
A perfect place to relax and breathe nothing but peace.
Juan Manuel our host, reminds me of a wizard of the forest. He has so much knowledge to share and he is very passionate about nature.
The place is close to Manizales.
We are coming back!!!!!

We returned our car and were charged, the owner (who was responsible for the damage) has been unable to reimburse us (about $200 USD).  Therefore, I cannot recommend staying here as the owner is not honest or trustworthy.  He has strung us along in trying to get a payment since returning to the States.

Very highly recommended!

We took the orchid tour and were amazed by the sheer variety of over 200 orchids. The afternoon bird-watching tour was a highlight, where we spotted a myriad of bird species in their natural habitat. The meals were a delicious reflection of the local cuisine, and unwinding in the heated jacuzzi amidst such stunning scenery was simply heavenly. The warmth of the staff and their dedication to nature made our visit more than just a stay – it was an unforgettable, heartwarming journey.

Mi experiencia en este hotel fue absolutamente desastrosa. El servicio fue pésimo, la atención fue deficiente y la calidad de las instalaciones fue muy baja.

Al llegar, nos encontramos con que las camas estaban duras y no había sábanas ni cobijas. Tuvimos que pedirlas y, cuando finalmente llegaron, estaban usadas y tardaron en ser entregadas. Las toallas también tardaron en llegar, y tuvimos que esperar más de una hora para recibirlas.

El televisor estaba sin control y apenas funcionaba. Pedimos un ventilador prestado, pero cuando salimos de la habitación, el personal lo retiró y dejó todo desordenado.

La actitud del personal que nos atendió fue tosca, hostil y desagradable. No mostraron ninguna disposición a ayudarnos o a resolver nuestros problemas.

Además, el hotel no proporciona acceso a Internet a través de WiFi, lo que es un servicio básico que se espera en cualquier establecimiento hotelero.

Pero lo peor de todo fue la falta de seguridad. Las puertas de las habitaciones no tenían llave, y no nos proporcionaron ninguna. Tuvimos que dejar las puertas abiertas, lo que nos hizo sentir inseguros. Y si intentábamos usar el pasador para bloquear la puerta, nos dijeron que no era necesario porque el dueño del hotel era "super seguro". Esto es un chiste, porque en realidad, la seguridad era nula.

Para empeorar las cosas, el personal que trabajaba en el hotel parecía no saber nada sobre los servicios que ofrecían. No podían proporcionarnos información sobre los servicios disponibles en la zona o cualquier otra cosa que necesitáramos saber.

En resumen, no recomiendo este hotel a nadie. La calidad del servicio, las instalaciones y la seguridad son muy bajas. Hay muchos otros lugares mejores donde hospedarse.

review_1_text:
I loved my stay in San Jose. Juan and his family made my trip super comfortable. He met me on the main road and I followed him back on my motorcycle. The road was paved the entire way with a couple of cool stops along the way. (The massive Jesus statue in Belezcazar was a cool pit stop.) Juan served healthy food and offered yoga. Water is filtered. Fresh air. Very calm. Comfy bed. Most beautiful views I have ever seen.

All the images I posted are of the location. It’s truly breathtaking and beautiful. You can see for miles and miles in nearly every direction.

I highly recommend!!
review_2_text:
Communication has been excellent with Juan Pablo. We booked the Chivitas Belinda campervan for two weeks in November 2024.

The car was delivered in a semi cleaned state (dogs hair around) , sand at several places , stains on the mattresses, old towels.
We started our trip while getting some recommendations but we didn’t have the chance to speak to JP in more detail about the itinerary.
In our second day we have experienced a terrible experience - the cars brakes were broken on the way down from La Linea - we heard afterwards about the heavy driving conditions and that we had to be using 2nd and 1st gears.
Other issues with the campervan were :
• During rain, water was coming inside the van’s front window (we were informed afterwards that the windshield was changed right before but was not checked extensively about leakages)
• During sleeping time we had the same issue of water coming from the back window on our head (!)
• In warm environments is unpleasantly sleeping in the van due to the lack of anti-mosquito net (we were informed afterwards that this is supposed to be included but we didn’t have it)
• The battery of the car failed to start our engine on multiple times (we were informed afterwards that this is a known issue to the company)
• Windshield wipers also need to be changed (very dangerous while driving in rain conditions)
• We were not informed about some important regulations of Colombia for example the “pico y placa” system (permit system of cars plates in given areas for entering cities and national parks)

We have communicated all the problems above with the company before writing this review. The company confirmed and excused themselves about the issues with the van and offered us 2 free days of future rentals.

All in all, don’t rent the Belinda . It’s the cheapest option but with many many problems. It left us with an unpleasant feeling during and after our trip..
review_3_text:
Juan Pablo could not have been more helpful or hospitable - communication and service were truly outstanding. If we had questions about the van or our route, Chivitas was very quick to respond, and went above and beyond to make sure our experience was a good one. The van itself had everything we could need and is built to allow for more flexibility and freedom in traveling around. If you are planning to drive yourself around Colombia, look no further than Chivitas - they are fairly priced, offer incredible service, and are a family-owned local company focused on giving back to the Colombian communities in need.

Coming from the United States, we are not super familiar with driving manual vehicles nor were we really prepared for the type of roads and general driving experience we found in Colombia. Ultimately, we decided to end our trip with Chivitas early due to this - when we let Juan Pablo know, he was quick to offer us several options to dropping off the van at a different place and time (including helping us get around the coffee region by driving us himself) to ensure we got the most out of our trip - I have honestly never experienced that kind of generosity and hospitality. We are so grateful and would absolutely recommend Chivitas 10/10.
review_4_text: Have enjoyed many times the campervans and great service of Chivitas. It is a wonderful way to discover the country and really experience the amazing nature and people of Colombia. The 4x4 vehicle is very well kept and good for the rougher roads but also the best destinations. Juan's advice was very good and friendly. Recommended.

Last, the process to enter the termales was clumsy and inefficient. We bought our tickets online and had digital proof of admission but the workers at the entrance gate had a very difficult time reconciling the number of tickets purchased with the number of people in our van, plus they required identification of the primary purchaser to verify the ticket purchase. opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text:
I arrived around 2am. I believe it is family owned and the owner woke up at that time to show me the room. Kindest folks you will ever meet. It was dark and I could not see much, but my ears heard the sounds of the river running, nature, sounds of living beings singing. I was excited and went to sleep, hoping the night would pass quickly so I could see what my ears were experiencing.

I was not expecting the beauty I saw when I woke up. The pictures I am posting and others have posted do not do this place justice. You are in the middle of paradise surrounded by mountains, water, birds, reptiles, etc.

Be forewarned that you risk not wanting to go back home. I have never slept so well, I have never felt such peace. I have never been showered with as much love and kindness as I was during my stay here. When I return to Colombia....I will be staying here again.

This location is also the closest to the Hot Springs, which I will not post pictures of, because I want people that go to experience those moments of awe that I got to experience.

They have a restaurant on the premises and the food was delicious and I was even a little embarrassed at how well they treated me. I felt like royalty. Five stars all the way!
review_2_text:
It took a little work because I couldn’t see a way to book a room online, but I persisted and called Hospedaje Cardisch directly. I’m glad I did! A man called Digenes answered the phone and confirmed that they had an available room for that same night. Only $60.000 Columbian pesos, less than $10 USD, per night including breakfast! Diogenes patiently explained how to reach the hospedaje from Cali (a bus to Pereira, another from Pereira to Santa Rosa de Cabal and yet a 3rd bus to the termales, asking to be dropped off at the hospedaje on the way).

I managed the route without incident. I got off the bus, and Antonio was working outside. I asked for reception, and he pointed to the stairs. He led me up to the 2nd floor, and showed me directly to my room and collected the 60.000 pesos en efectivo, in cash. The lodge is closer to the termales (hot springs) than any other, excepting the hotel AT the termales. Easy walking distance, maybe 5 minutes. My room was clean and cozy. The walls are a bit thin, and there was someone talking or listening to a radio or tv through the night. Didn’t bother me, but it might have bothered a light sleeper. The lodge is right along a river, and there are some benches and narrow tables where you can sit and watch the river flow by. I sat there to eat the provided breakfast: scrambled eggs, cheese and an arepa served with something like hot cocoa. A beautiful, modest place to stay at a great value.

review_4_text: Beautiful, rural setting, delicious food, close to the river and the Santa Rosa de Cabal hot springs. The location is safe, and the management is very friendly.

review_1_text: Absolutely stunning! The best hotel I’ve stayed at in Colombia for this budget. Wonderful landscapes, amazing thermal waters, fresh weather and a cherry on top - their chef does magic! Truly delicious cuisine! Will definitely come back
review_2_text:
This hotel feels like it was plucked straight out of a fairy tale! The views are absolutely breathtaking, and the rooms are cozy and well-equipped. I especially loved the heater, private jacuzzi, and sauna in my room—it made the stay feel luxurious and relaxing.

A few things to keep in mind:
- The **day pool pass** is available on a **first-come, first-served basis**, so plan accordingly if you want to enjoy the pool during the day.
- The **more scenic pools** are exclusive to hotel guests, meaning you **must be a guest at the hotel** to access them. This makes the experience feel more private and special, but it’s something to note if you’re considering a day visit.

The food, while delicious, felt a bit overpriced. However, I understand that the remote location might contribute to the higher costs. Speaking of location, the last 10 kilometers to the hotel were a bit rough, so I highly recommend following the staff’s directions carefully to make the journey smoother.

Most of the staff went above and beyond to make our stay enjoyable, but I did find some of the front desk personnel to be less welcoming, which was a bit disappointing. Additionally, after 10 PM, everything shuts down, including the front desk, and you can only contact the emergency number for medical issues. The internet also became practically unusable after 10 PM, so plan accordingly if you need connectivity late at night.

Despite these minor drawbacks, the overall experience was fantastic. The stunning views, luxurious amenities, and attentive service from most of the staff made it a memorable stay. I would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a peaceful, fairy-tale-like getaway—just be prepared for the remote location and a few quirks.
review_3_text: Wow, what a great place to end up at after a long days motorcycling in poor weather. We went straight to the thermal pool, which was lovely and hot, and there was a bar right next to it, perfect. There were also tame hummingbirds all around. Inside the room was very chic, and we enjoyed a very nice dinner there. Highly recommended.

Most everyone who was there for the day had cleared out by 4 and we enjoyed the last two hours which were more peaceful. It was challenging driving down that road in the dark, though!

review_2_text: What a wonderful surprise to find this place! From the moment we walked in, we were welcomed with genuine warmth and kindness. The staff here goes above and beyond to make you feel at home, and their sweet, caring approach makes all the difference. Every detail is thoughtfully taken care of, creating a peaceful and inviting atmosphere. Thank you for making our stay so memorable — we look forward to coming back soon!
review_3_text: Very  nice hotel. Some rooms are small. Good service. They offer a delicious breakfast. Very close to the hot springs. The only inconvenience is that it is not close to a good restaurant.
review_4_text:
Amazing place, very calm and chill. The area around is a gem! A beautiful park down the river, everything taken care and we'll maintained. The double room was spacious and comfortable. Sound isolation was missing a bit, as the river noise is penetrating, however you get used to it and can sleep fine.
Breakfast was served to the terrasse with an unforgettable view. Personnel was very friendly and helpful. Made us feel as home.
review_5_text:
Wonderful experience at Hotel Visperas. The staff were all very welcoming and helpful. Breakfast was good. The view and the landscaping of the property are exceptional. The rooms could use an update to the bathroom, but we were happy to stay there. Loved listening to the river and sounds of nature at night.
Highly recommend eating at Hostal Takuaras across the street for dinner and coffee.

name: Finca Romelia Orchids & Birds - Reservar previamente al email
review_1_text: I went with my mom, to have a look in their orchid collection. We got amazingly surprised with the beauty of the full farm but most of all with the warmth that Jose Fernando his wife and all the people shared with us. Their collection of orchids has been the most unique and gorgeous we have seen. Additionally, if the orchids were not enough, we got to see beautiful birds from different and their collection of bonsais. I completely recommend not just to go but to also to stay. Their house, views, and warmth exemplify the wonderful experience of a Colombian farm.
review_2_text: This is a really lovely farm about an hour out of Manizales. They helped us arrange a driver to take us there and back. The farm itself is beautiful and you can tell the owner takes great pride in taking care of it. Our guide was very knowledgeable and spoke excellent English. Lunch was delicious home cooked food. The drive there is quite twisty and scenic. All in all it was a great way to spend a half day.
review_3_text:
This is a gorgeous place and the people there were so accommodating.

We were a group of older adults and they were very gracious and conscious of helping to make sure that everyone was comfortable.

The grounds were gorgeous and walking through the jungly areas with the guide was really interesting. So nice to have a stop along the way for fun refreshments!

The orchids are the highlight with endless varieties in the collection. Not sure if you will find more variety anyplace in the world. Some extremely beautiful and some very odd orchids. The guide was excellent at explaining - in English - and showing us some of the tiniest ones under a magnifier.

Lunch was delicious. Beautiful home here too. Thank you for sharing your part of the world with our Road Scholar group : )
review_4_text: Wonderful stop for birding, orchids, and hearty food. We had several great local birding guides and the orchards are beautiful. Food was traditional and excellent quality. “Chorizo” is passionate about his orchid collection and will answer any question you might have. Definitely recommend a stop here.
review_5_text: Special people living in a special place. Maybe you go to enjoy the world class collection of orchids or maybe for the amazing variety of birds. You can also expect a uniquely beautiful location, interesting conversations, and delicious food. This is why you travel.

opening_hours: Monday: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM|Tuesday: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM|Wednesday: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM|Thursday: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM|Friday: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM|Saturday: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM|Sunday: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM
review_1_text:
This is definitely a great Experience... The coffee tour by Mateo was great, and much more technical than we've experienced before, a very good thing.
The Cacao workshop, again by Mateo, was a very enlightening experience and totally enjoyable.  Both were presented in Spanish, with just a few translations offered but we loved it for our practice...
Mateo is special and if you can, be sure to get him.
The facility is gorgeous, clean, friendly, easy to get around once you are there ... The one trail we took for a walk offered great view... The mixture of coffee, plantains, cocao, agave, palms, bananas, and extremely wide variety of flowering plants is awesome.
Above all the staff is fantastic.
review_2_text:
Hacienda Venecia is an absolute paradise for coffee lovers and nature enthusiasts alike! I recently stayed in one of their beautiful rooms with breathtaking views of lush green mountains. Waking up to this scenery with tropical birds singing all around was truly magical.
The bird watching tour exceeded all expectations, our knowledgeable guide helped us spot over 15 different bird species! A highlight of my stay was definitely the coffee tour led by Mateo, who expertly explained every aspect of the coffee growing and processing. The coffee tasting was exceptional, and you can purchase some to take home too.
The food was consistently delicious, with every meal being a treat. The attention to detail and cleanliness throughout the property was impressive, and the staff were very nice and accommodating.
review_3_text:
We did the coffee tour here which was incredible. The whole area was picturesque and the coffee tour was informative from start to finish.

The shop had a great coffee selection and we even purchased a coffee sack used to transport coffee so that it can be framed at home. Really unique souvenir opportunity
review_4_text:
What a wonderful place, hidden from the outside world with hummingbirds, peacocks, jasmine and chocolate cake flavour in the air ! And nature is insanely beautiful, such a diverse and peaceful place, walking around this huge domain. Will be back !

Friendly staff, only improving point is - all additional services come at quite an expensive costs.
review_5_text:
What a truely amazing experince we had here. We stayed in the old house and it was perfect and felt very homely. We loved the 3 women who cared for us their food was fresh, well presented, flavorsome and dishs created felt homely and how they were served. Was nice not to know what we were getting for lunch or dinner, the lovely smells greeted you from the kitchen were warming to the heart and soul.
The bar was well stocked and liked the trust side of this and made things more homel. The pool was great to chill out by thd hsmmocks and sitting areas give you a close connection with nature. Peacocks and all sorts of birds, insects, lizards, frogs like a mini zoo.

To be honest the few things we found needs improving are the hiking trails, you are in a wonderfull setting but going on a hike can be daunting just using the basic map. We got lost while out hiking but a few coloured marker points would be good to have. Also we got to a house and the owner came ot he was sending us all way back up steep hill and told us we were far from.hotel. There is a gate at his house which is part of the walking trail that leads onto the road. He did contact you at the hotel to come collect us but waz told everyone went home no drivers. After talking to.him.he let us pass the gate and we only walked 10 minutes or so and backmon the farm but we seen losds of staff and the manager all standing chatting where the vans get weighed before coffee get processed and that was a lie we were told as there were people still around.

We felt the manager of the whole place was a bit creepy and seemed to lean more towards women folk of a certain type. We first arrived there were a family staying with us and never seen him, yet second day another family arrived with few ladies and he was showing a more favourble liking to them than he did with us it was a cold greeting.
So he brings people onto the veranada of the house who are not staying in the house to conduct what looks like  meetings and this is uncomfortable also for guests .

The birds and wildlife is amazing , but going sit to have breakfast while a bird watching group are walking around and photographing the place is bit strange. You pay extra for the luxury of the main house and to have bird watchers is uncomfortable.

We are aware its open space and people walking through is grand but not up onto the verenda.

Its was nice to see the workers preparing and working hard to maintain the building, grounds and staining the furniture it must take alot of effort.

review_1_text: We had a wonderful stay, the host is lovely and we very much enjoyed the tranquility of the Finca and the thermal baths
review_2_text: The hosts were kind and helpful with all the information I needed for my trip. Very comfortable beds and beautiful house. Definitely, the best breakfast of Colombia.
review_3_text: Hermoso lugar para estar tranquilo, rodeado de naturaleza y hermosos anfitriones, entre Isabel que es un encanto de mujer y los animales que tiene la finca,es un lugar lleno de cosas buenas.
review_4_text:
Es un hotel lindo, bien cuidado y muy limpio, tienen como prioridad el cuidado del medio ambiente. Un lugar para descansar, sin ruido, con muy buena atención y realmente Pet Friendly. Dado que llevábamos perros Cristina nos orientó sobre los lugares mas indicados para hacer paradas en la vía Bogotá - Santa Rosa.

Durante nuestra estadía disfrutamos de un desayuno típico muy delicioso, una caminata guiada por la finca,  sugerencias sobre lugares para visitar y en general una excelente atención.

Tienen 5 perros cariñosos y dóciles (coco, bianca, atenea, luna y angus) que hacen sentir a los huéspedes caninos como parte de su manada, al igual que los gatos.

Sin duda un lugar para desconectarse de la ciudad y crear conciencia sobre el cuidado del planeta

Al ser un grupo grande pretendía que mantuvieran os en silencio cuando habían niños y jóvenes.se comporto de una manera grosera y fastidiosa a tal punto que intentó hacer callar a una niña de 3 años por reírse según ella muy duro. La obsesión de esta señora por la limpieza no le permite manejar una finca caída y que no está en óptimas condiciones para garantizar una adecuada estadía. Con la excusa de ser un eco hotel no nos dejaban guardar ni los alimentos en la nevera por economizar energía ni usar el microondas para calentar la comida de los niños. El peor hotel en el que he estado no lo recomiendo por ninguna circunstancia

review_1_text:
Me siento robado.

Tenía una estadía de 2 noches. En la primera noche surgió un problema con fuga de agua en la ducha que generaba ruido. Al siguiente día me percaté de problemas con el calentador. Solicité reparación pero no había personal disponible. Solicité cambio de habitación, pero no había habitaciones disponibles. Decidí cancelar la reserva de la segunda noche y me dijeron que la devolución del dinero tardaba un tiempo, mientras escalaban el tema a administración. El personal fue muy amable en las conversaciones, mientras hacía seguimiento a la reclamación. Sin embargo, luego de casi 2 semanas, no me volvieron a contestar, me dejaron en visto los mensajes de WhatsApp.

No puedo decir mas que me robaron.

Si va a quedarse ahi, asegúrese de que todo en la habitación esté en buen estado, para que no pierda su plata
review_2_text:
Terrible experience, we had a lot of faith in him. It is expensive for what they offer, terrible service, only one of the people is friendly, the rest think they know everything, they are rude when requesting something, and they do not provide good service.
The mattresses are terrible, all the springs feel, it smells of gas constantly as if there was a leak, the place is too noisy, they request silence from a certain hour but you can hear the bell and the "officials" talking and laughing all night.
There is an area that constantly short circuits, and explodes from time to time, the toilet leaks water, the water does not heat up sometimes, there is not even soap for the hands, lack of blankets (they took them one day just in case), they do not clean the toilet unless one requests it, they have an ornamental stove, and it says that there is a refrigerator but it is not true, there is no dishes to even serve a glass of water, the "hotel" food is expensive and bad.
When we arrived at the hotel, the curtain in the room was down, we asked for it to be put back in its place, and when we arrived, the curtain was still down.
There are only 2 hours of breakfast, and if you leave a little earlier, you've already run out of breakfast.
Additionally, they charge for meaningless things, without specifying in advance.
At the time of the reservation it said that there were 2 double beds, when we arrived we found that it was a double (turned to pieces), and a single one with a dog-like mattress (super uncomfortable).
There is constant change of staff and they don't know you, so you arrive at the reception and they try to get you to do the whole process again.
A charger was stolen.

When we arrived (almost midnight) they told us that they were full, that they had canceled our reservation at 6 p.m. even though we had notified them. They did not give us a telephone number to be able to look for other accommodation (I repeat, midnight) and they DO NOT have complaint forms. Very bad experience

Pésimo servicio, de verdad hicieron un infierno nuestra estadía en Pereira.
hice la reservación con 2 meses de anticipación, por teléfono fueron muy amables, cuando llegamos me atendió un chico súper amable y nos explicó que en ese momento sólo quedaba una habitación pero que no tenía televisión que al día siguiente nos cambiarían de habitación o nos colocarían otro televisor pasó el día y nada, hablamos en recepción y nos dijeron que al día siguiente lo harían, pasó el día siguiente y nada pedimos que nos limpiaran la habitación a las 7 de la mañana porque sólo se puede pedir el servicio hasta las 11, no nos limpiaron la habitación la excusa de ellos fue que a la chica se le había olvidado, pedimos entonces que nos cambiaran de habitación porque ni teníamos televisor ni nos habían limpiado la misma, a lo que nos dijeron que mientras no limpiaran la habitación no nos podían cambiar, pero que al día siguiente nuestra habitación sería la primera en limpiarse para cambiarnos de habitación, mi novio pidió la limpieza de la habitación no 1 ni 2 sino 3 veces hasta que a las 11 de la mañana cuando todavía estaba la chica de mantenimiento mi novio volvió a preguntar que cuando nos cambiarían se habitación y le dijeron que ya no se podía porque la chica ya había terminado y que ya no iba a limpiar más habitaciones, mi novio tubo que pagar un adicional para que ese día nos limpiaran la habitación y así poder cambiar de cuarto. Y por hacer esto al día siguiente en el desayuno nos dieron unos huevos crudos y con salchichas de dudosa procedencia olían súper mal, después de eso nos fuimos de allí. De paso piden que pagues tu estadía completa y que no devuelven dinero es decir que prácticamente te quedas allí más que todo porque ya pagaste la estadía completa

name: Bosques del Samán
review_1_text:
This hotel was quite charming and a bit rustic, and I would highly recommend it to Americans visiting Armenia, Colombia!
The young man (Juan) who tended the cow/bull and did the coffee tour, and his wife that was in charge of the rooms and bar area make this place really special.  At 6:00 am/pm Juan allows guests that want to milk the cow.  He was so kind to the animals!
The coffee tour was interesting and the coffee we roasted by fire was delicious!
The room itself was clean and comfortable.
The grounds were beautiful, with lovely views, a pool, and a game room/bar area.
The food served in the restaurant was local and delicious!
review_2_text: No air conditioning, rooms can get to 80 degrees farenheit. Rooms had bad odor, beds are old and no cushion, bathroom literally stinks of sewage. Dirty showers. Insects come in during the night. Etc... can literally keep going. Don't be fooled by the pictures, the rooms are horrible.
review_3_text:
I enjoyed staying here in the coffee region. This is a large resort with many activities for the whole family. It is rustic and remote; not everything is in tip-top shape, but it's all relative.

The resort uses an electric pump for shower water, so when it's off there's no water in the shower. Not a big deal, but no early showers for us.
review_4_text: A great coffee farm. A little bit off the tourist trail, but a piece of luxury tucked away up in the coffee hills. This finca has clean rooms and tidy bathrooms with plenty of hot water. The restaurant often has good local dishes on the menu. For me the best bit was flying over the plantation on zip wires at great speed. Helpful staff and a quiet tranquil environment with perhaps some of the best coffee I've ever tasted.
review_5_text:
The place is a paradise on Earth! Nature, food, weather...everything was ideal!
It is well located for the trips around the region, but the road (last 3km from Alcala down the path Alcala-Filandia) is just horrific if you don't have a high terrain car. So many holes! Hopefully the owners of the local hostels and hotels are going to join and fix the road.

The food is amazing, portions very big and there are options for vegans too! Was sad to hear that I could not buy their cheese, but enjoyed it immensely. The swimming pool too. Everything was clean, people were so kind and helpful! We participated in the activities and I loved it, I learned a lot about coffee making and growing. We bought their coffee and it has wonderful aroma and tase, without the sour aftertaste (that majority of coffee in Europe has). Will definitely come back many times more!

Thank you from Serbia!

The bathrooms smell like sewers and the rooms smell damp, and there is tremendous heat inside them. They have thin or drywall walls and you can hear everything between the rooms. It is a small hotel located near the center of Quimbaya, nearby there is a wood sawmill or carpentry shop and a lot of transportation passes in front of the hotel.

opening_hours: Monday: 6:30 AM – 11:00 PM|Tuesday: 6:30 AM – 11:00 PM|Wednesday: 6:30 AM – 11:00 PM|Thursday: 6:30 AM – 11:00 PM|Friday: 6:30 AM – 11:00 PM|Saturday: 6:30 AM – 11:00 PM|Sunday: 6:30 AM – 11:00 PM
review_1_text:
I've stayed in similar places, United States, Europe, Russia, and other Colombian hotels. This place is by far superior to anyplace I have ever stayed at. Service? It is ridiculous how good the staff is. A to Z, they  have it covered! They know exactly how to take care of visitors. Not too much, not too little, but just right.
Food is extremely good and well prepared. It obvious they have a professional chef and not a "Cook". The ONLY Negative we experienced was the music, we checked in at 3pm so from about 3pm to 20pm it was the sa.e retro type music with the constant thumping you could hear through out the whole facility. It needs to be changed to a cariety maybe or even something with heart and soul, it was really annoying aftet several hours.

The atmosphere is great. Two people stood out for us, Jorge and Danelliea. If you are looking for an upper class place to stay this is it no question about it. The place offers a memorable experience. I HIGHLY recommend this place.
review_2_text:
We loved this hotel. We were fortunate enough to stay in the Pacifico suite with our own pool and jacuzzi which made it feel like we were completely isolated from the world. The views from the room were breathtaking and we watched sunset from bed every night and distant lightning strikes. Room services was great and overall food quality was amazing. We used this hotel as a base to explore Salento, Valle de Cocora & Filandia which were about 30 minutes away. We were unfortunate to not be able to make it to the hummingbird house on the Valle de Cocora hike HOWEVER the purple flowers outside of the hotel room was a magnet for the beautiful green birds. You can save yourself a 3.5 hour trek and just sit outside your room!

Get a taxi from the front desk and then get their WhatsApp so that they can collect you when you need. Taxis are limited in the area so this is a must!
review_3_text:
The room was nested in the forest and gave an immersive feeling of being secluded in . The pool views were beautiful.

Having said that, the service at the restaurant was awful/non-existent. It took ages for a sever to come to our table although the restaurant wasn’t that busy. Drinks came after we finished our appetizers. The mains came lukewarm. Nobody came to check on our food/ask if we wanted more drinks. It seemed impossible to get a hold of a server (although I kept waving and calling the staff to come to our table). After waiting over 20min after finishing our mains, I had to go to the entrance to get the bill. The restaurant supervisor offered me dessert.

The whole diner experience was already ruined by that time and it felt insufficient given the price point. Again, this is supposed to be a very high end/exclusive hotel. The next day, while checking out, I complained to the hotel supervisor who told me she could not give me a discount on the dinner bill (which was around 300k cop) since she had to reach out to a manager first. Although she reassured us we only had to wait for a few minutes for a manager meeting to be over, we left after waiting almost an hour without getting any answer. This experience was incredibly frustrating and  I was very disappointed with the service we got. a 10% discount or even simply writting off our two drinks would have felt like a nice gesture to compensate for the terrible dinner experience we had. I will think twice before recommending this hotel/restaurant to a friend.
review_4_text: Absolutely amazing hotel. Our only regret is not having stayed longer. The views, the restaurant, the amenities… everything was just perfect.
review_5_text:
My partner and I had an unforgettable four days staying here, after it was recommended by a friend. I cannot recommend them enough.

We forgot to book any local experiences/attractions, and didn’t realize until 1-2 days before our trip. While our last minute notice slightly limited our options, the reception worked quickly and diligently to help us book an exceptional coffee tour, spa appointments, as well as an informative and fun on-site birdwatching tour with our guide Brandon (who seriously rocks!!). With Salento/Finlandia also nearby, the reception was also able to get us taxis there to explore on the days we didn’t have experiences booked. With all of this being done in 4 days, we felt we had really nice exposure to the area while also having plenty of time to simply relax and enjoy the tranquil property

Food offerings from the restaurant also seriously 10/10. Complimentary breakfast was robust and always started with delicious fresh fruits/juices/breads/cheeses (all made on site) plus a menu of dishes to choose from. Lunch and dinner menus - each with the chefs unique/creative renditions using classic Colombian flavors and ingredients. We paid compliments to the chef during lunch, who came out immediately after to very kindly greet us. The room service menu is modified from the main restaurant menu, because the dishes need to be transported down the mountain to your suite (quite understandable!) Overall, breakfast, lunch, dinner, room service - all fresh, flavorful, unique, and well-prepared.

The facilities are breathtaking. Staff goes above and beyond. I worked 15 years in the service industry and I can say everybody here takes passion in providing a quality service. I have never written a review this long but I needed to for them. We were extremely impressed and grateful for them. Thank you Nicholas (reception), Manuela (Basto/Wellness spa), Jesus (spa), Christiaan (Basto), and the MANY other people who regularly went out of their way to help/greet us! We will return with family soon. Muy bendiciones!!

review_4_text: Terrible, the rooms smell dirty and damp, they have no ventilation, the photos they show are not of the normal rooms, uncomfortable pillows, too much noise due to its location next to the nightclubs
review_5_text:
Me alojé en una habitación muy cómoda, con todo lo necesario para una buena estancia y por un precio muy justo. A pesar de estar junto al parque central y muy cerca de bares y discotecas, tuve la suerte de estar en una habitación alejada de ello, donde el ruido no fue un problema.
Todo muy bien.

name: FINCA HOTEL SAN ISIDRO
address: POR TROCADEROS VEREDA LA UNION, Naranjal, LA UNIÓN
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text:
Presentation of the person who received us not adequate,
He did not present the hotel services or make a brief description of the spaces in green areas.
The two dogs are very cute and handsome, however they are intimidating to think about going out to explore the green areas at night.
He didn't do a check to ensure he had everything he needed before handing over the room.
I don't know presented
He did not communicate how to look for him if he needed something.
There is no doorbell or phone number to contact someone if I need something.
At 7 pm, there was no one visible to serve customers
The reservation had been made with dinner service to which the man responded that they had not been informed and when we asked if they could do us the favor of preparing something quickly, they refused, they only gave us the option of going to a town, which he did not say which one, he did not give precious information, regarding transportation times, locations. etc, knowing that we were strangers.
To ask for a blanket that was not in the room, both my partner and mine, we had to shout for more than 5 minutes from the dining area.
I stated that my sink was clogged and he didn't pay attention to me.
There was no bath soap.
The sales windows only have an abundant assortment of liquor and soft drinks. Since there was no food, we had to eat something from a package that only had those two.
The manager never came back to see if we needed anything else
review_2_text: Exelente lugar para quedarse muy recomendado exelente atención la tranquilidad es inigualable buenas comidas piscinas mesa de billar ect
review_3_text: It is one of the worst places to stay in the coffee region.  Terrible service, terrible attention, terrible food.  The owner is only interested in receiving the money but has no idea about customer service.  She never appears. Added to all this, there is no control of the guests who literally do whatever they want because there are no basic rules in place.  Don't waste your time or money on this place.   It's unfortunate that there are such low and terrible places like this in such a beautiful area of ​​the country.
review_4_text: Terrible lugar no lo recomiendo para nada. Todo mal sucio, con mal olor en las habitaciones no tienen suministros de aseo. El desayuno un desastre total. EL ruido es una locura total. No hay reglas las personas q lo atienden no tienen el mas minimo conocimiento de atender turistas, lo unico q si saben es cobrar
review_5_text: Muy buena finca. Tiene servicio de desayuno y cena. Lugares amplios y agradables. Zona de piscinas y Jacuzzi.  Zona de juegos y Zona infantil.  En la finca se puede apreciar la naturaleza además de algunos animales domésticos como perros gatos gallinas gansos cabras caballos. Ideal para ir con niños pequeños. Cerca a Panamá y el parque del café.

name: Hotel El Pueblito Cafetero Pereira
address: Vía Mercasa, Avenida de las Américas, entrada 18
opening_hours: Monday: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Tuesday: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Wednesday: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Thursday: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Friday: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Saturday: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Sunday: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM
review_1_text: Wonderful place! Alejandra, Tatiana and the rest of the crew are great hosts.
review_2_text: Beautiful place, offering a view into the past of the region inside the city, lunch was delicious with exotic natural juices and a great service
review_3_text: Nice and peaceful place. Be aware, they do not speak english. Staff very friendly.
review_4_text: Lovely stay, lovely place. Good food.
review_5_text: Full

name: Bidea Hostel
opening_hours: Monday: 8:00 AM – 11:00 PM|Tuesday: 8:00 AM – 11:00 PM|Wednesday: 8:00 AM – 11:00 PM|Thursday: 8:00 AM – 11:00 PM|Friday: 8:00 AM – 11:00 PM|Saturday: 8:00 AM – 11:00 PM|Sunday: 8:00 AM – 11:00 PM
review_1_text: This hostel is the best! It feels like a family. The house is super cute, has lots of plants, a cosy outdoor area, a cat and colorful dorms/rooms. The place is super cheap to stay and it has nice free breakfast included! Would recommend!
review_2_text:
maybe it used to be a nice place, but the pictures are longer representing.
there is no noise isolation, you can hear EVERYTHING in the hostel and ANYTHING on the street.

there is almost no water pressure, so no hot water in the morning on upper floores, so if you take a private room you still need to use the public showers.

the breakfast is bear bones - egg, bread, jam. when I told them I have Celiac and I can't have bread, they just give egg with nothing else.

the hostel is poorly maintained and doesn't feel nice to be in.
review_3_text:
Good hostel if you are not a traveling nomado worker.
I leave this review for nomado worker. There are no place to work in the night.

Unfortunately they are very strict about the curfew.
We are not allowed to be in the common area after 11pm.
It makes this place not an ideal hostel for nomad workers. I don't wanna work with a bright laptop in the dark dorm where people are already sleeping.
It was a hard time when the receptionist kicked me out of common space and asked me to work in the room. Very sad.
review_4_text: Super cozy Hostel with a living room, warm showers, breakfast and nice rooms for a very good price. Nice staff and it’s possible to rent bikes (but not very good bikes). We liked it here a lot.
review_5_text: Very economical, lovely building and staff but a few other downfalls! Kitchen very poorly equipped - most meals there was little to no cutlery to be found anywhere, several lights in the hostel broken, hot water very sporadic, no soundproofing. All signs contradictory so you never know what time breakfast is etc. Lovely bar with a tempting pizza and empanadas menu displayed but no one to cook it so you can’t order food - a simple sign would stop guests getting their hopes up! Two nights of our stay were super loud - on one there was some kind of party in the hostel and people left at 2:30am getting into cars which would suggest they weren’t hostel guests. I’m sure a few improvements would make this a great place to stay.

name: Three House Hostel Boutique
review_1_text:
This hostal is by far the best one I have stayed.

If I ever come back to Filandia I'll definitely stay in this hostal again.

David Jaramillo the recepcionist is what made the difference at this place. He's very charm, friendly and helpful. Exceptional treatment and attention to the customer.

Very clean and organized.

All the best David. It was a pleasured to stay at this hostal.
review_2_text: Great hostel, with modern utilities. The host, David, was incredibly nice, he went above and beyond to ensure a pleasant stay and was very helpful! The location is perfect, right next to the main square. Great value for money. Would definitely recommend!
review_3_text: David makes you feel right at home and entertained at all times. The hostel is clean, has a really cool outdoor terrace perfect for a nice yoga practice or workout. Big kitchen that actually works and remains clean. The dorm is on the top floor where there is also a nice chillout area. Overall really nice place to stay in Filandia.
review_4_text:
I had an incredible experience at Tree House Boutique & Hostel, thanks in large part to David Jaramillo. From the moment I made my reservation, he was attentive and helpful, assisting with tours and ensuring every detail of my stay in Filandia was seamless—even up to the last minute! The hostel itself is spotless, perfectly located just half a block from the central park, and offers a welcoming atmosphere. David’s eagerness to help and his warm hospitality truly made my visit unforgettable. Highly recommend.
Thank you David from the family from California
review_5_text: David was the absolute best and extremely helpful. Nice clean kitchen fully stocked and clean rooms would definitely stay again whenever I'm back to Filandia

name: Hostal Mirador Terracota
review_1_text: Jairo is such a nice friendly interesting person, I had nice experience during the time I am in, I felt like home. If I was not in a rush, I would like to stay there longer. Cheers!
review_2_text: This was one of my favourite hostels in Colombia. Adrian was a wonderful host who made sure we were well looked after whilst still leaving us to do our own thing. Truly great wonderful memories from staying here.
review_3_text: One of my favorite places in Colombia! I stayed for a week in Filandia after planning to stay for one night and felt like home for my entire stay. Jairo is a fantastic host, very knowledgeable about the region and who will go the extra mile to make you feel at home.
review_4_text:
Bravo and a big thank you to Jairo and the Play boy Adrien 😉 for the welcome, their availability and their kindness.
I loved the breakfasts prepared with love... and the good cinnamon chocolate cardamom coffee!
It feels like home, it's my best accommodation in Colombia.
review_5_text: I loved the hostel, very familiar, rooms and all areas super clean, they are very friendly and helpful, judicious, I was very happy, it is very safe. It is very close to the central park of Filandia

name: Elizabetha Hostal
review_1_text: I highly recommend Elizabetha Hostal for anyone looking to stay in a quiet and very comfortable place in Salento. I checked out of a party hostel as I was sick with food poisoning and needed a place where I could recover more comfortably. I stayed at Elizabetha Hostal for approximately 5 days until I recovered from my food poisoning. The beds, rooms, and facilities were very new, comfortable, and clean. Elizabeth made chicken soup for me every morning when I was too sick to eat anything else until I got better. She even called her son-in-law who is a doctor to come check on me and prescribe me some antibiotics without any charge. Elizabeth checked on me everyday to make sure I was doing better and encouraged me to go outside and walk around when I had enough strength. I can't thank Elizabeth enough for her hospitality!
review_2_text: Friendly, clean and comfortable. I loved the terrace. Book here if you want to support a family owned hostal! Elizabeth is super friendly and makes you feel welcome.
review_3_text: We stumbled on this hostel and are glad we did. It's small and owned by a nice retired couple. Place is very clean and service was great. A bit pricey but consider that Salento is a tourist town. Noise can be a problem if you stay during fiestas but that will be a problem anywhere in town. The hostel is located about five blocks from the city square
review_4_text: Great place! Clean and good service. I will come back!
review_5_text: Excelente place to star in Salento

name: Hostal Bremen
review_1_text:
The bed had 2 flat sheets instead of a bottom fitted sheet, and the flat sheet  only just covered the top of the mattress, so it wouldn't tuck in and dislodged in the night - so we were sleeping on the mattress protector which is unhygienic. Even if the proper sheets were in the wash, they should then buy extra sheets. We're paying 120/night so that's a lot to pay for this situation.

The rooms don't have windows, just double wooden doors and we had to keep them shut when sleeping to protect our valuables, therefore not sleeping with fresh air.

The showers were not very warm most of the time with cold drops from the faulty pipe. Only 2 shared toilet & shower rooms between a dorm and 4 private rooms.

It's a basic, old, cute looking hostel which we liked other than that. There's an amazing vegan restaurant in town 2.5 blocks away too.
review_2_text:
Beautiful little hostel. Big rooms with lots of light, a covered green space with tables and chairs to eat and to work outside. We work online and this was a great spot, fast internet. Sebastian, the owner, is very kind! Bathrooms are very clean and there is a kitchen you can use! It’s a great deal.

I guess something not in control of the hostel is the music from the restaurant downstairs.

We will be back for sure! Can’t beat the price just a few blocks from the new central plaza. It’s such a beautiful hostel.
review_3_text: Great hostel in the center of the city. The host was super friendly and welcoming and the hostel lovely (with a panoramic view and spacious rooms). Everything was very clean as well.
review_4_text: Argentinian & Russian hippie volunteer couple were talking, kissing & getting "physical" in their dorm bed like literally two metres away from my head throughout the night & morning. They need a private room or a tent to themselves. Friendly people otherwise. Just no self-awareness. Had to change hostels. I wanted to stay longer than a week but it was too awkward to even say anything to them about it. What a shame. Nice view from the backyard too. Also the washing machine was on the fritz. Couldn't wash my stuff.
review_5_text: Even if you check-in very late, you MUST pay immediately! They will tell you this unpleasantly and impressively… other than that, it is a very colorful place. Kitchen could be more clean. Won‘t stay there again👎

name: Hilltop Hostel
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text:
Even though the staff were lovely, I personally had an awful experience.

My room was flooded because of the frequent rain, and all of my stuff got wet. I woke up one morning and found feces on the top bunk and on my towel. The staff immediately gave me a new one and cleaned the room, but overall, it was an unpleasant stay.

Pool and jacuzzi were nice, great shower.
review_2_text:
Thank you for all,  I really enjoy my time in the hostel. I got good company during my breakfast, made with love 🫶
The hostel is close to everything, nice terrace on the top top enjoy the view.

Thank you for all off you!
review_3_text: Super affordable, safe, clean and nice vibe. Walk up, up, up and enjoy the beautiful view! Watched the birds soaring out my window in the morning amongst the tropical foliage. Restaurants are near, very walkable distances to anything.
review_4_text: Stayed in a private room earlier this year, wasn't my favourite hostel that I stayed at. The outdoor pool area was lovely but unfortunately because of the weather we did not get to appreciate it as much. The views are beautiful though. The rooms were not ideal and very damp - hung up a jumper and it just got more damp rather than dry, all of our clothes we left in our backpacks also ended up being damp somehow? Also not very comfortable. The toilets were to be shared but was always wet (most likely due to other people staying there rather than the hostel) Service was average, a cheaper option for sure but only stayed here for a night to do the Cocora Valley hike.
review_5_text:
This place is relatively cheap, however they play earsplitting, ubiquitous music almost constantly, the rooms are small and smell of decaying carcass as there is no ventilation, and for a cherry on top, the blankets/bedding are dirty and smell awful. Showers are fairly nice however the last time they cleaned them must've been at least a good few months ago, and the same applies for the pools.

The staff, however, are friendly and polite, the cooking smells lovely, and the animals are super sweet and kind. Affordable and high quality washing service, which is a big upside. Only thing is this hostel only takes cash, but strangely enough has no change, which is highly inconvenient as having sencillo is near imperative here.

Would only recommend if you are travelling on a budget, do not mind constant noise/filth and tolerate the near persistent smell of marijuana.

name: The Corner House Hostel
opening_hours: Monday: 6:00 AM – 12:00 AM|Tuesday: 6:00 AM – 12:00 AM|Wednesday: 6:00 AM – 12:00 AM|Thursday: 6:00 AM – 12:00 AM|Friday: 6:00 AM – 12:00 AM|Saturday: 6:00 AM – 12:00 AM|Sunday: 6:00 AM – 12:00 AM
review_1_text: David was amazing on reception. So informative and helpful. Room was great value for money. Fantastic location in the middle of town. Nice view over town as well.
review_2_text: nice hostel right in the city center. they have a kitchen and warm showers!! Andres is a really nice guy, helping you out anytime. Would come again:)
review_3_text:
The hostel is clean and well located.  Every bed in the share dorm rooms have curtains and power plugs. There is a good wifi and hot water in the shower 24h.
The staff is kind and friendly, a particular thanks to Andres, who during my stay in
the Salento has always been ready to help me with the accomodation and recommend me activities and services around town.
review_4_text:
Great Hostel, especially their service.
Juan Gabriel of the reception team was very helpful and kind.
review_5_text: What a great place to stay! Great location and Andres is the best host. The hostel has everything you need and more. Definitely recommend if you’re coming to Salento!

name: Aparta Hotel Las Camelias en La Virginia Risaralda
review_1_text: Wow, 10/10 stay. Perfect location. The host is so nice and the room and place in general is super clean! Kitchen access is great and the room was spacious enough to store my bicycle. It can maybe get a bit loud on weekend evenings on the nearest street corner, so bring earplugs if you're a light sleeper.
review_2_text: Excellent hotel, very central and close to everything, the service and kindness of the administrator is very good, it feels like home, thank you we will return
review_3_text: Excellent place to stay, very clean and cozy, has rooms and kitchen
review_4_text: Excellent place to relax, very good location. Highly recommended.
review_5_text:
Very good service, Mrs. Paola very kind and verbal, we were very satisfied, we will return
.,.

name: hostal bamboo
review_1_text: Pretty good value hostel. Really nice views and garden area. Good hot shower. The only problem was that the room was very damp and mouldy. I know this must be common in a humid place but steps can be taken to improve the mould. It made for very bad air quality in the room and we didn’t want to hang out in there.
review_2_text:
We spent some of our best time in Colombia here. Great value for money. Perfect location within quick walking distance to center, enjoying calm and great view. Also the host is super nice.
Good kitchen. WiFi a bit weak
review_3_text:
It is cheap, which is nice but don't expect more than a very basic room. The room and bathroom were extremely humid and towels never properly dried during our 4 day stay. There was constant condensation on all windows and on the bathroom's walls. The facilities are also basic and not everything is in the best shape.

The kitchen, which is half outdoors, is enough to cook and there's a nice place to chill. Note that there are many insects and big spiders around as most of the common spaces are half outdoors.

Location is good — there's not much interesting just around but it is super close to the center. The host was very friendly and accommodating.
review_4_text: The owner John is super friendly and helpful. The hostel as well as the room we stayed in had a beautiful view into the green countryside, still it is not far from the main square of Salento. The facilities were super clean and we even got warm showers. Highly recommended.
review_5_text:
We recommend 100%!
We loved our stay here so much that we ended up staying longer than planned.

- Jhon makes you feel like at home and is always available if you need anything
- The views are incredible, it's a pleasure to wake up in the morning
- There is also a shared terrace with a nice view towards the city centre and lots of beautiful birds that fly around here
- the room is simple but has everything one needs. Very clean, hot water in the showers also worked & most importantly we had some good and refilling rest 🙏
- Wifi was also good

Thank you Jhon for your hospitality 😊

name: Camelot
review_1_text:
Read the comments below guys. Some people get lucky with the two older ladies (the owners), to us they were very impolite. Anything, like asking, for some drinking water, made us feel like we were creating a huge inconvenience.

Beds have horrible uncomfortable plastic just under the sheet that you feel when you sleep, and that is very loud in a shared room.

After check out, when we asked if we could leave our bags for a while, we were told to get them back before 4, 'otherwise we may lose them'. Not the best people.
review_2_text:
The hostel is nicely decorated, but that's the only good thing I have to say about it.

The staff was unfriendly, the beds were made of plastic which was uncomfortable for sleeping, and there were only cold showers. The rooms are hot and humid 24/7.

If you enjoy going to the toilet and getting wet feet from the person who showered before you, then this is the place for you.

Not recommendable
review_3_text: The Hostel is very beautiful! The people working there are extremely nice. We read comments about not being nice but that absolutely wasn’t true. They are lovely. Room was clean, floor could have been a bit cleaner. But bathroom was perfectly clean. The location is very good. But we wouldn’t recommend the double room with the private room because the bed is very uncomfortable and a bit like plastic. For people who do not care, go for it. Good price, lovely people.
review_4_text: We stayed for 2 nights and the room was clean, overall a good place. Service from the ladies can improve!
review_5_text: I texted them a few hours before arriving, however they didn't want to reserve the room for us. The room itself was okay, however after checkout they wouldn't let us use the bathroom one last time after staying for two nights. Never experienced that in any of the hostels I stayed in. Overall the elderly lady is quite rude.

name: Hostal Cattleya
address: frente al parque de, Cra. 1 Nte. #5-6, Salento
review_1_text: Loved this quiet haven and Señora Elisa who runs it. The garden is a delight and saw loads of different birds coming to the bird table, or in the beautiful large trees in the garden itself. Breakfast was the standard fare but fine.  The 2 dogs on site are wonderful - my favourite was Dante. ❤️ The double room was very comfortable and had a lovely view onto the garden so waking up each morning was a pleasure. The Hostel is opposite the bus station so very convenient and a short walk into town. Not a major issue. There's a Twin room I saw which wasn't great as it's too close to the road and could be a bit noisy. Recommend getting a room away from the main entrance. 👍🏼
review_2_text:
We loved our stay here! The couple that run the hostel are just so kind and helpful. It is excellent value for money and a perfect location.

It is just opposite the coach station so perfect for any early morning coaches. But also only a 10 min walk into the main plaza. The hosts provide a traditional breakfast that is a delicious start to our day - even offering a slightly earlier sitting to accommodate our earlier coach!

The rooms were everything you could need, spacious, warm, en-suite with hot water and good pressure, came with towels. The area felt super safe and comfortable and we enjoyed every second of our stay here.
review_3_text:
This hostel was exactly what I needed. It was almost always empty, but that was perfect for me. It was super beneficial that the bus terminal was across the street.

The hosts were super pleasant and accommodating. The dorm I was in was a little small, but tidy. The dressers were not able to be locked, but at least my big backpack fit inside. There’s dogs that bark sometimes, but I felt safer. The birds talk all night, but I always carry ear plugs.

I took a bigger private room for a few nights, for 95k per night. Those rooms are super decent.

In the end, if you’re not super picky, you get a decent place for a great value.
review_4_text:
Very underrated hostel here in Salento. It is located not far from the main square and conveniently right in front of the bus station.

Seeing how so many people come to this small town, picking a hostel was difficult as many were already full. This one seemed a bit more low key so we decided to give it a try and it didn’t disappoint.

It’s a very clean place with multiple spaces to hang out in and has a well equipped kitchen. Also, the couple who runs the place are quite friendly. They gave us many good recommendations on where to go, what to see, what time to head to cocora, where to eat, etc.
review_5_text: The owners are so kind and helpful and has a decent breakfast included. On Sundays you get a traditional Colombian breakfast which is very tasty and a nice touch. The hostel is clearly a labour of love but there are some areas that let it down. The kitchen is fine but not particularly well equipped and is outside. The beds were nice but the real issue is the noise. Every morning at 6am we were woken up by the dogs whining. They're lovely dogs but they do make so much noise in the mornings and evenings that it did affect our sleep. The price was a little above what I'd expect to pay in Colombia for the room (a twin private). Location is right next to bus station but still close to town.

name: Hostal Colina de Lluvia
review_1_text:
Don’t book here. The pictures aren’t accurate, they will give you a smaller room that is completely different than shown on the website. It didn’t have a bathroom or a window as promised. There is no common area to work as promised either. The owner dismissed the problem, so we asked for our money back and left.

Stay down the street at Hosteria de Mi Pueblo.
review_2_text:
Great hostel. Super clean and fresh feeling. Facilities are good, free WiFi, kitchen, coffee in the morning. What more does one need.
Staff were all friendly and more than willing to help.
We also left our bags in the common area on the last day whilst we did some activities before leaving Filandia.
Great value for money and great location (close to the Parque)
review_3_text:
I really enjoy my stay here. The private room I stayed in is cozy, clean, and not street side, providing a good nights rest. Free coffee and tea is a plus.

Please Note: If you are to use their mountain bikes, make sure they are serviced and in good order

Additionally, DO NOT go with the suggested Barbas Bremen Tour with “Don Luis” Caminatas y Aventuras. Not the actual hike into Barbas Bremen, you spend most of your time walking through pastures, only about 30 minutes in the actual reserve.
review_4_text: Great family run hostel. Feels like home. Great common spaces, free coffee and tea all day, a kitchen, and the staff even took us out to show us the town. It’s obviously a budget place so don’t expect luxury, but my favorite kind of hostel. They also rent bikes for 10k COP / hour.
review_5_text:
Terrible hostel, the rooms are mouldy and they let a mariachi in at midnight for their friends birthday and woke us up?? I asked the staff member why it was happening and that I was annoyed and she laughed at me?!
Edit: I left this review in anger after being woken up but have amended it to more accurately reflect my overall experience. It's not a bad hostel at all, and I'm pretty sure the mariachi thing was a one off.

name: VEINTIUNA HOSTAL Y COLIVING
review_1_text:
Very good hostel with private rooms and mini apartments.
We stayed in a double room which was spacious, clean and comfortable. Although it was right next to the reception and the noise insulation was horrible so avoid room 101 if you can.
Later we moved to another mini apartment which had a small kitchen area but the room itself was less spacious and there is no sitting place so I would keep choosing the double room and use the living room and kitchen are which is to share.
Internet is fast and reliable for work.
Has 24h front desk and nearby supermarket, restaurants and less than 10 min walk to the terminal.
To go to the city center is a bit far: 20-30 min. Same to get money from a free nearby ATM: 15 min walk.
Recommended to set base for start or departure of the coffee axis trip.
review_2_text: Very nice place. I stayed for one night on my way to the Termales in Santa Rosa. Very beautiful and clean place. The staff was very nice & helpful. I stayed in the women’s dorm. I was the only person in the dorm. The place was quiet, not very many people. Maybe it is low season. It is located very central and just 7 minutes walk from the bus station. Lots of stores and restaurants to choose from and they also have a nice kitchen. Highly recommended.
review_3_text:
The location is quite good - close to the bus station. I was alone in the room which was great. The beds are comfy and the room itself was comfortable.
The staff was not very helpful as every single request was a problem.
review_4_text: Great place to stay in Pereira, very close from the bus terminal and around 15 mins by car from la Circunvalar (restaurants, bars and party). The place is very clean, bedas are comfortable and is quiet during night time.
review_5_text:
This is the best hostel we've visited so far in Colombia. It's very new and very clean. The kitchen is a delight, very well equipped, huge fridge and everything you need to make a great meal! The room is spacious, beds are comfortable, with a TV with Netflix and some space for your clothes. The bathroom is amazing with hot shower. Very quiet area, close to the bus station and 10mn driving from the airport (w/ Uber).
And the staff is very nice and helpful, big thank you to Alejandro for being very kind during our stay and even washed & dried our backpackers' clothes (for a very small fee) :)

We recommend 100%!

name: Yambolombia Hostel
review_1_text: An amazing place to stay and I would recommend it to everyone. The host was super friendly, the location away from the town was great and the animals you stay with are really cute. Not to mention the coffee farms surrounding the hostel are some of the best in the world!
review_2_text: Gabriel, our hostel host, was a really lovely fella, he made us the most beautiful breakfast, a work of art!! We booked 2 nights but stayed 3, we loved the Hostel, the land it was set in, the town of Salento was small and welcoming. We met so many great fellow travellers there, had good days out horse riding with them and nights out playing a traditional game of La Tejo. That was fun!! Gabriel had the sweetest of dogs, Jambo & Rasta, one a puppy full of play & one chilled and keeping an eye on the territory. We had a lovely horse too wandering round, beautiful. Great value for money, chilled out atmosphere, plenty of space to mix or have solo time if you need it. The views were stunning. Really close to hike the Cocora Valley or any of the surrounding rainforest by foot or horse. Plenty café farms too worth a visit. I'd love to go back during a different season to experience it, we had a lot of rain but it made no difference to our experience.
review_3_text:
If you love the nature this is the perfect place for you. The hostel is surrounded by a breath taking landscape located in the heart of the Salento’s mountains.

The hostel is located at 25 minutes walk from Salento’ s center square. If you don’t want to walk, you can take a jeep / taxi in the square for around $4 usd. The walk is very safe and great for wind down after a long day full of fun activities around Salento.
review_4_text: Very nice and comfortable hostel with nice hot showers. It is about a 25 minute walk from the town, and completely safe to walk alone at night (just make sure you have battery to use your cellphone flashlight)
review_5_text: We had an incredible stay here for our time. The hostel staff and volunteers were lovely. Breakfast was very well priced and delicious, 15,000. They have a puppy, a horse, dogs, yoga studio, really nice facilities, warm showers, it’s a little bit out of town but an easy walk and you get the peacefulness of the country. I would definitely stay here again

name: Hostal Casa de los Taitas , Salento Quindío
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text: I totally recommend this place. If you are a morning person you’ll love it more. You have a quiet and beautiful sunrise. Bring a book. Grab a cup of premium coffee. Perfect morning before going to the town and around.
review_2_text: Nice guest house a few minutes walk from the village square.  Rooms very clean and good en-suite with plenty of hot water.  Only downside was the plastic sheet on the bed and pillows made the bed a bit noisy. The lady which runs the hostel is very friendly along with her dog Toby. 🐶 In a quiet part of town but only 2 min walk to the main square with restaurants a 1 min walk.
review_3_text: I echo what all of the others have said.  Great location.  Close to the sqaure but still quiet.  Clean rooms, very nice beds, beautiful garden, nice shaded wrap around porches.  Great place if you have a car or motorcycle -plenty of parking behind a fenced perimeter.  I would definitely recommend this place and I would definitely come again.
review_4_text: I do not recommend coming here.  The owner of the hostel lives in the hostel and gives you the feeling that you are staying with her at home for free.  There is also a kitchen but she does not agree to use it, when I opened the fridge she immediately asked me what I was looking for.  Feeling really uncomfortable and not good in the hostel.  The whole time we felt uncomfortable in the hostel I suggest you look for another place to stay.
review_5_text: Place is just great! Mrs. Rosa is the best.  They make you feel like your home and make your stay very comfortable.  We highly recommend this hostal.

name: ATARDECER DE SALENTO
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text: Good hostel. For the given money, perfect. Little trouble with sinks in the bathroom. Little noisy in the night as its close to the bars. Perfect view from the balcony. Nice places to sit at the balcony also. Overall very good hostel with very welcoming and nice owner and staff. Recommend.
review_2_text: The property is excellent value for money, with an incredible view of Salento. Don Antonio is so kind, offering us fresh coffee and even soup one day! 4 stars only because the location is beside a couple bars playing club music that made it hard to sleep, even with earplugs, until the early hours of the morning every night. If you are a light sleeper be aware of this.
