review_3_text: Filthy rooms with paper thin walls. We could hear everything from the bar across the street and the rooms around us. Had issues with the hot water at one point. The kitchen was absolutely disgusting. Owner needs to get his act together his sons are basically running the place.
review_4_text: Best views of the city from your bedroom!! Such a nice hostel to stay and chill. Maria is very friendly and prepares delicious coffee. All what you can expect from a budget hostel with the luxury of Salento under your feet.
review_5_text: Some rooms could use improvements and refreshment, but it's still good place to stay. There's hot water, warm blankets, WiFi, kitchen and really good view of the city from the terrace where you can leisure in hammocks. Cat hunting for bugs in the evening is a free of charge entertainment. Owners are very friendly and can advice you about trails around Salento.

name: Kilómetro Cero Hostel, Mountain Shop & Laundry
review_1_text: Great place to purchase or rent last minute trekking gear.  Great friendly staff.
review_2_text: I really liked this place a lot. Quaint, it was nice, clean, and chill. Great location within walkable distance of restaurants and other things to see and do. Nice place to stay while I stayed in the area. Super friendly staff and it felt safe.
review_3_text: I've almost never felt so at home in a hostel... For me it was perfect to recharge my batteries and have a good time in Salento: it's a very small hostel so when I was there (beginning of November, so not high season) it was just me and another guy in the whole hostel. Thanks to that o really could enjoy some alone time, just cooking on my own, chilling, ... So if you want a hostel with lots of people maybe consider another place, but if you just want something comfortable this is the place for you! Also it's probably the cleanest hostel I've ever been to, and for the price that really is amazing, is was always as if someone just had cleaned! Moreover, the owners really took care of me and looked after me, so thank you so much!! If I ever go back to Salento I'll definitely come back to this hostel! Really really great! :)
review_4_text: Best hostel in Salento because they have full laundry service, a store with all of the gear needed for your mountaineering and camping trips as well as wonderful service!
review_5_text:
Excellent laundry service and reasonably priced. Was ready exactly when they said it would be, and all was folded nicely and out back in the bags we provided. They also respected our request to not out our wool socks in the dryer.

Service in english and spanish.

name: Hostal Salento Sunset
review_1_text: Excellent service. Located very close to the viewpoint

name: Hotel Ensueño - Pereira Colombia
opening_hours: Monday: 8:00 AM – 12:00 AM|Tuesday: 8:00 AM – 12:00 AM|Wednesday: 8:00 AM – 12:00 AM|Thursday: 8:00 AM – 12:00 AM|Friday: 8:00 AM – 12:00 AM|Saturday: 8:00 AM – 12:00 AM|Sunday: 8:00 AM – 12:00 AM
review_1_text: I rarely stay in hotels, but needed to visit the area for work. It was nice and clean, quiet, and easy to get to town. Enjoyed some much needed rest
review_2_text: The service is super good, they offer you very good attention and they help you with whatever you need, both in the hotel and in the car or whatever plan you have to do in the city. The hotel is super comfortable since it has parking and the room is very comfortable and pleasant and the price is very flexible.
review_3_text: Excellent choice, the attention is very good, they helped us with everything and the service was excellent
review_4_text: Very good place the only thing I didn't like was that they charged me too much for a small pet
review_5_text: A very quiet and beautiful place, the service is super good, highly recommended

name: Hostal Vistaguila Salento
opening_hours: Monday: 7:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Tuesday: 7:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Wednesday: 7:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Thursday: 7:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Friday: 7:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Saturday: 7:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Sunday: 7:00 AM – 10:00 PM
review_1_text: The place is cool, but doesn’t look like the photos. It is a cool place outside of the city to stay, but it is still 15 minutes uphill to go to the city center. The guys at reception are lovely and do not hesitate giving you plenty of tips to travel around ! Great !
review_2_text: I tried different hostels, but this the best one! Great people, service, food, yoga and much more! The team made me feel like I’m at home super nice! Try the yoga in the mornings and I highly recommend taking the horse ride from the hostel the best deal and you get a lot value with it. You won’t regret it!
review_3_text: We really loved the walk back and forth from the city center across that wonderful walking bridge. The beds were comfortable, the facility clean, the neighborhood quiet and the hosts were helpful when needed. The only downside we found was nearly zero noise isolation between rooms. Doesn't much matter during the white noise of the daily rainstorm.
review_4_text:
Really nice place, the Colombian staff are really kind and helpful, very clean.
My only complaint is the American owner gives a lot of false and unwarranted advice. For example gave me the wrong advice on how to get from Salento to Jardin and when he realised it was wrong, instead of telling me it was wrong, he asked me to explain to him how to get there and then said "we are saying the same thing". (We weren't). Luckily I didn't listen to him otherwise I wouldn't have made the journey correctly.
review_5_text: Salento and espacially the Vista Guila has our heart. Yoga and Meditation with John was a blessing and the breakfest was amazing. The rooms are comfy. In the bathroom it smelled a bit drainy and the windows were out of metal - but that didnt bother us at all! Recomend the hostel !!❤️

name: hostal 3 leones salento
address: Barrio la floresta, Carrera 3#7-37 apto 1 Via a las fincas de cafe por, Cra. 3
review_1_text: Nice place to stay with nice and friendly hosts. Price is affordable in comparison to other places around Salento. We stayed in a private room which had a very nice view. Eulalia and her husband welcomed us very warmly! Kitchen could be a bit more organized but other than that we had a good stay.
review_2_text: We had a fantastic stay at this hostel. The owners were very nice and warm people, going out of their way to make the place feel welcoming. We got a better room without additional charges, because the one we reserved wasn't available, and after we decided to stay an additional night, the price and the room remained the same. Great experience all in all!
review_3_text:
The owners of Tres Leones are just the sweetest. A family owned hotel/hostel. I was ending my trip and wanted a place that was quiet. The rooms are a little funky but they do the job. There’s hot water which is amazing!
The owners were just so sweet. They let me stay in one of the empty rooms for a nap before my night time flight.
They offer laundry service and if you have any questions they can help you.

They do not speak English but everything went smoothly for me.

Thank you for the hospitality!
review_4_text: It’s clean, friendly and excellent for low-budget travelling. Very convenient that they do a laundry service.
review_5_text: Decent accommodation for the price. Comfy beds and nice owners. No luxury but everything you need!
city: Carrera 3#7-37 apto 1 Via a las fincas de cafe por

name: Hostal la luz de la colina
review_1_text:
Very friendly staff, and they accepted to do our washing.

Rooms were quite tight but we were 2 in a room for 4 so it was ok (4 wouldn't leave space for luggage though).

Location is good, it's a 5mn walk from the center, benefit is that there's no noise.
review_2_text: The place is very nice, you feel at home, the rooms are comfortable, very clean, and you also have good privacy, you can rest very well since the area is very quiet.
review_3_text: Visitado en marzo de 2025. Destaca por la amplitud de la habitación y baño, y su buen aseo. El alojamiento cuenta con todos sus implementos, permite descansar tranquilo y además presenta acceso a la cocina.
review_4_text: Good place, good location, favorable price, good attention from the owners, a little strong siphon smell in the bathroom that was the only unpleasant thing, everything else was fine
review_5_text: I give 2 stars to the service because they did not know where to place me since they had not noted my reservation

name: Hostal FIND LAND & A REST
address: Carrera 7 #7-56 Centro Segundo Piso, Cra. 7 #756, Filandia
opening_hours: Monday: 7:00 AM – 11:00 PM|Tuesday: 7:00 AM – 11:00 PM|Wednesday: 7:00 AM – 11:00 PM|Thursday: 7:00 AM – 11:00 PM|Friday: 7:00 AM – 11:00 PM|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: 7:00 AM – 11:00 PM
review_1_text: Excellent location, in the heart of Filandia, clean, best shower ever! Manuela is a great host so helpful and nice! I definitely consider coming back with my family.
review_2_text: Great spot.  Close to the town Centro and the 'nicer' restaurants to the north.  The hosts were quite friendly and accommodating.  The room was clean, bedding was fine, lots of hot water.  For the price, I don't think you can do better in Finlandia.
review_3_text: Comfortable bed and hot shower. Breakfast is a block away not in the hotel.
review_4_text: Great location close to the main square. Staff is helpful and friendly. Breakfast above average including fresh fruit, cheese, sandwich, eggs and coffee. Rooms are clean and spacious. The only thing lacking for us in the setup was a window. They are currently expanding. We'd stay here again.
review_5_text: there are some improvements, but it's a great place to stay, the breakfast was very good and the location is perfect

name: Hostal Villa del Sol
review_1_text:
A very basic room in a great location!
The hosts are amazing!
Very welcoming !
she did my laundry for free!! The only place in Colombia that didn’t charge for that! And always with a smile ,
it’s a small well
Kept place…has a very nice view in the backyard….! if there were more chairs and tables /couch/swing / and Decor would make the backyard way more approachable…!
We did have some noise from the streets since our window was facing front…so if you have a hard time sleeping with cats /horses passing by ask for a room on the other side looked like it was booked when we were there,
But all in all it was a great stay…!
Thanks again!
review_2_text:
One of the best hostals in Quindío!

Very friendly, family business. Always ready to help, but never in the way, never intrusive. They were always ready to help.

I spent two months there and already miss the place, the general quiet, during fiestas and when the neighbouring hotel has parties you can hear a bit of noise but it's one of the quieter places in Salento to be.

It's very easy to find, easy to get anywhere in Salento on foot and the main square is only a few minutes away.

I had a room facing the mountains which was the best. The sun hits you in the face as you open your door, there's always coffee available and having morning coffee with the sun and the mountain views makes this place the perfect location.

Everything was cleaned regularly and the washing service that was included is another thing I really miss 😅 they even looked after others guests luggage when they had checked out but had some time left in Salento. These extra touches make a bit difference!

Security never felt like a problem, Salento in general is very safe and the family take extra care to make sure that guests are safe.

I miss it all and I'll be back.
review_3_text: Very clean, comfortable, good location and beautiful view to the mountains. The hosts were super nice and helpful. The only thing is that the hot water in the shower wasn’t very stable. But besides that we had a wonderful time (:
review_4_text: The room was big and clean and Daniela and her brother are such nice hosts. Daniela helped us also with the laundry which we appreciated so much! In the common area you have always coffe and water available and the view from the terrace is just stunning. Recommend!
review_5_text:
My stay was absolutely beautiful!!
The woman who hosted us was extremely helpful and made us feel at home, she did our laundry for us and helped us with whatever we needed. The rooms were very spacious and beautiful. Highly recommend this spot!!

name: HOSTAL LOS NUEVOS ALMENDROS
review_1_text: Good option if you work in Quimbaya or if you are passing through Armenia or Panaca. Restaurants very close. Very comfortable and private room. Bathrooms with good cleanliness. Thank you for the attention of the person who was at the hostel. Good price.
review_2_text: Excelente hotel, cerca a la plaza principal de Quimbaya, muy buenas instalaciones, excelente personal, 100% recomendado
review_3_text: Good place to rest
review_4_text: Clean and quiet place, only some windows face the avenue and you can hear the cars a lot but the rest is very clean
review_5_text: Mrs. Hellen is very kind, but the hotel does not comply with what is indicated on Booking and the admin never responded to our messages.

name: Hostel Tralala Salento
opening_hours: Monday: 12:00 AM – 12:00 PM|Tuesday: 12:00 AM – 12:00 PM|Wednesday: 12:00 AM – 12:00 PM|Thursday: 12:00 AM – 12:00 PM|Friday: 12:00 AM – 12:00 PM|Saturday: 12:00 AM – 12:00 PM|Sunday: 12:00 AM – 12:00 PM
review_1_text: Tralala is a true gem—genuinely the best hostel i’ve ever been to. It’s so beautiful, clean and lovingly decorated with handmade furniture and cute little objects. The staff is super helpful and always ready to answer any questions you may have. They let us check-in early which was very appreciated and we were able to have our clothes washed and dried and ready to pick up in less than 3 hours which was super helpful. There were even fresh towels in our rooms which I was super grateful for, all for a very reasonable price. There are 2 kitchens fully equipped with everything you need, including coffee. We extended our stay because we loved it so much! I’ll definitely come back one day :)
review_2_text:
We arrived in Salento after booking a hostel in advance, but when we got there, we found that the room was very uncomfortable, so we wanted to switch. We called hostel Tralala to confirm availability, and as soon as we were told there was space, we canceled our previous reservation and went there with all our things.
A few minutes after arriving, the receptionist told us she had made a mistake and there was actually no availability. We started looking for another place to stay, but after about 10 minutes she asked us to leave because it was the hostel’s quiet hours — even though we were sitting quietly and just looking for a new place on our phones.
We explained that we had nowhere to sleep at the moment and just needed some time to sit and find somewhere, but she said it wasn’t her problem and that we should have been more responsible — even though the reason we canceled our previous booking was because she had told us there was space.
In the end, we found ourselves out on the street at night looking for a place to sleep — when all we needed was just a few minutes to sit in the lobby. That was the bare minimum she could have done after her mistake.
The receptionist’s name was apparently Alla, although it’s possible she gave us a fake name because we asked her after she had kicked us out into the street.
review_3_text: I really enjoyed my stayed at Tralala ! The location of the hostel is close to the main square (making it easy to access transport for tours). The dorms are very clean and nice ! The larger dorm is next to the road so there is some traffic noise when sleeping (unavoidable).
review_4_text: The hostel is in a fabulous location! We were able to walk everywhere in town since it is only one block from the plaza, yet it was very peaceful. The common area courtyard is extraordinary, and the staff was responsive by WhatsApp and arranged an airport ride for us. However, our bathroom had an annoying leak in the shower, which resulted in water all over the floor of the bathroom, no matter how careful we were to close the shower door before turning on the water. When I informed them about it, they didn't even come to look at it or attempt to fix it, offer us a discount, or offer to move us to another room. That was disappointing.
review_5_text:
$18 seemed like an amazing price for a windowless single is a good price for this location close to the square. however, there’s a musty smell and there are bugs over the sink when i use it to brush my teeth this morning, which makes me scared if the same bugs were in my bed last night 😰.

i told the receptionist and i really hope they fix this issue.

Answer to owner response: there should be no quantity of ants or insects like this even if they are harmless. Please spray some bug spray on the room

name: Hostal Casa Vicente
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text: Such an amazing place! The owner is so nice and welcoming and helped me with about everything. The rooms are so nice and very well equipped, the place felt and looked very clean. The showers were hot and comfortable. And yet again the owner was so nice and good to me. Don't miss this amazing place.
review_2_text: A lovely place with very friendly staff. The breakfast was nice, great coffee and hot chocolate! Has secure parking if you need it.
review_3_text: Exceptionally clean and modern hostel well located close to main square restaurants shops etc. Two kitchens where guests can prepare food. I definitely recommend this hostel .
review_4_text: Perfect place to come and relax in the heart of Salento. Wonderful service and good installations. Highly recomend this place.
review_5_text: Excellent!

name: Estrella de Agua
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text:
We love this place!! For the last six years we have stayed here and
every trip has gone very smoothly. It was once again a great trip, but one thing I would recommend is an emergency first aid kit in case of any minor injury.

Thank you!
review_2_text: Had a really enjoyable stay — friendly vibe all round, easy to settle in. Good mix of people, chill energy. I left something behind and the staff were super helpful in getting it back to me. Big thanks again for going the extra mile. Highly recommend!!
review_3_text:
Great hostel, hot shower and really nice place to stay around with the hostel facilities.
The kitchen is very good and clean for your use.
The bad side is only that the ro is little small for two people but the price is worth it!
review_4_text: At first, I liked the friendly atmosphere and staff at this hostel. However, my experience was ruined by a serious issue. The day after I checked out, I developed severe itching and painful bites all over my body. It seems that bed bugs bit me badly, making it almost impossible for me to sleep at night and causing serious problems during my trip. I do not recommend this place at all! I hope the management takes this issue seriously and fixes it immediately.
review_5_text:
Although it has a strategic location, the house is for sale and I think that for this reason they have allowed the hostel to be damaged.

The service is terrible from the moment you enter. At reception, it takes almost 40 minutes to register and receive the key.

The room smelled horribly bad, the bathroom was unhygienic, and the only pleasant thing about the hostel is literally the cats.

It's a hostel with little investment; its rooms shouldn't cost more than €6 for what they offer.

name: Hostal palma de cera
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text: Very nice place with a wonderful view for a fair price. The owner is very friendly. About 200m away from downtown. Definitely a recommendation from me.
review_2_text: very nice and big 2 to 3 bed room with a big terrace and a super nice view, owners are super nice!!!!
review_3_text: Just wonderful, such a great place to visit, you will love it.
review_4_text: It is a beautiful hotel... Mrs. Claudia is super friendly, the hotel is super well located half a block from Calle Real... I only recommend changing the mattresses on the beds for something with more support... they are a little uncomfortable otherwise super good
review_5_text: The attention is very good, recommended.

name: Hostal La Divisa
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text: Es un hostal muy comodo, muy limpio, excelente servicio del peraonal incluyendo la dueña, muy amables, lo único es la ubicación, sin embargo es tranquilo y seguro..
review_2_text: Excelente atención, es un hostal muy limpio, muy bonito, agradable, el desayuno q sirven es espectacular, es abundante con una sazón y una atención muy especial, es alejado del ruido, es un lugar ideal para descansar y pasar una noche en completa tranquilidad, queda a 10 min de Salento, tiene parqueadero, alquiler de motos, y la señora q atiende es muy servicial, recomendado
review_3_text: Muy buen lugar, cómodo limpio, MUY BUEN desayuno. El único detalle es que hay que tener transporte propio para ir. Volveré
review_4_text: Muy buenas instalaciones, baños amplios, la relación calidad-precio es excelente, pero lo mejor de todo es la atención, muy recomendado!
review_5_text: El hostal es muy buen servicio y atención excelente, la carretera es destapada y en la vereda hay muy poca agua.

name: Hostal Johnnier
opening_hours: Monday: 12:00 PM – 12:00 AM|Tuesday: 12:00 PM – 12:00 AM|Wednesday: 12:00 PM – 12:00 AM|Thursday: 12:00 PM – 12:00 AM|Friday: 12:00 PM – 12:00 AM|Saturday: 12:00 PM – 12:00 AM|Sunday: 12:00 PM – 12:00 AM
review_1_text: It was clean, nice atmosphere, friendly staff, close to the center of Salento... Only a short walk. I would consider going again next time.
review_2_text: Very good place to stay near Cocora Valley. Very clean room. Quiet around. Highly recommend.
review_3_text: Very good location, a block and a half from the main park and half a block from the municipal hospital. Very clean, clean and spacious rooms, neat bathrooms, they have a towel, warm sheets and there is a shower with hot water. The best thing is the attention and service, human warmth, Eliana is a great host.
review_4_text: Excelente lugar para visitar el pueblo cerca del centro. Precios accesibles y habitaciones muy limpias. El servicio fue muy atento y tiene lo necesario para cualquier inquietud. Volveré.
review_5_text:
It is a very well located hostel just a block and a half from the main square of Salento. The façade is super pretty and the facilities are cozy. In addition, their staff is very friendly and attentive. They offer water, coffee and aromatics in their rate.
The price is super convenient for its location.

The room, although a little small, the bed comfortable, its flat screen TV with cable, its hot water, toiletries.

Super recommended

name: Hotel Las Palmas
review_1_text: The hotel is very good, excellent service, the rooms are comfortable, clean, and they offer breakfast.
review_2_text: They knock on the door at 6:00 am saying: "remember that the service runs until 6:00 am", remember what? If they don't even notify us upon check-in, they will take us out of the hotel.
review_3_text: Very nice place, excellent room and close to the main park
review_4_text: Good place to spend a night or two. It has the minimum of a hotel. Fan due to lack of air conditioning. Of course, for long stays it is better to look for another place. They charge 3000 for each item of clothing that is washed, and there are no laundromats in the entire town. They don't clean the room unless you ask for it. And suddenly fines can arise for behavior not previously explained in the hotel regulations, which are not visible to guests.
review_5_text: Comfortable and fresh room, it has cold water, cable TV, private bathroom in good condition, comfortable bed. Keep in mind that additional charges apply for damages generated in the facilities (stains on sheets and towels, among others). It is not accessible for people with disabilities. In general terms my stay was comfortable.

name: Dreamer Cocora
review_1_text:
This was, a real standout amongst a field of very very good hostels this trip. The quality and comfort of the beds completely next level.
Incredible setting and grounds (yes that's right, grounds of the hostel) and genuine, friendly and out of the way helpful staff. I'd go out of my way to stay here again.
review_2_text:
Amazing hostel. Great staff. Everyone was super nice, especially Sarah who worked really hard and helped organize cars for us and recommended so many things not only in the area but throughout Colombia.

The entire property was very nice. Atmosphere was good, food was great. Bonfires, a bar, a coffeehouse, and comfortable rooms with hot water. Everything was perfect.
review_3_text: This hostel is amazing! Super calm, amazing views with the mountains around, nice yoga classes, a cozy common room and clean rooms. Highly recommended! The best part is their staff, Sara and Isabella, in the front desk, who are incredibly kind and welcoming. They helped us during all our stay, even when my phone stopped working, they gave all the recommendations to go to a place to fix it.
review_4_text:
We really enjoyed our stay at The Dreamer Cocora. The setting is beautiful, and the staff were really kind and helpful. We were especially grateful for the room upgrade. The on-site restaurant and bar were a highlight—the food was amazing, and the cozy fires created a lovely atmosphere.

A few things to note: the rooms felt a bit damp and there were no mosquito nets on the windows so we got bitten quite a lot trying to air the room out. Also, our room wasn’t cleaned at all during our five-night stay which was a bit disappointing. We had an issue with noise on our first night but this was resolved and the rest of our stay was very peaceful.

Overall, though, we had a great stay and really appreciated the staff going above and beyond to make our stay enjoyable. The adorable dog and cat roaming the property were a lovely bonus! We would recommend.
review_5_text: We’ve had such a good stay at Dreamer Cocora! Isabella on reception is absolutely lovely and has looked after us so well. The bar/ restaurant is gorgeous and feels more like a hotel, as do the rooms with really cool bathrooms and sleek decor. Everything is clean and so well thought out. We were allowed into the rooms early without cost because they were ready and everyone has been so so friendly. We had a good game of pool with great happy hour cocktails from Andres and sheltered from the rain with the indoor fires. The walk into town is pretty and it’s nice to be staying more out into the valley - very cool place to be when there was a thunderstorm! The jeep to the Cocora Valley walk can also drop you off and pick you up from the hostel which reception very kindly organised for us at 7am. Would also recommend doing the coffee tour with the hostel at La Abudancia it was awesome. Thank you!

name: Vivienda Turística Yerbabuena Hostel Filandia
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text: Just at the border of the town you’ll find the hidden gem of Lucia. She’s an amazing host, we arrived a bit last minute without prior notice but she welcomed us with a super nice infusion, in the morning she had for every guest some fruits although breakfast isn’t included. The bed and rooms are very comfortable and there is a small garden in which you can relax. Free coffee with a view in the morning, don’t hesitate stay here!
review_2_text: The place had an excellent view and great facilities. My husband and I stayed on a bikepacking trip and showed up without a reservation but Lucia made us a delicious aromático and we used the kitchen for dinner that was well stocked. The garden is beautiful and the place was quiet on the edge of town.
review_3_text:
Lovely host that explained everything very well and she even let us choose if we wanted the room downstairs or upstairs.
The views are really nice and it is just outside of town so it’s peaceful as well. The pictures you see in the other reviews give you an idea how it looks like, basically everything you need in Filandia.
review_4_text: We were only meant to stay 3 nights and we ended up staying 6. SUCH A LOVELY HOSTEL. It’s incredibly relaxed on the outskirts of town (a short 5-10min walk to the square) with a lovely garden, and amazing views over the Filandia countryside - it’s just what you want if you’re looking for somewhere nice and tranquil. It’s incredibly clean with a good kitchen, lots of beautiful house plants, cold drinks for purchase and fruit in the morning. We had our own bathroom which was great. Lucia is incredibly lovely, she helped us with all of our questions and we really feel that she went above and beyond to make us feel at home. She even lent us a bottle of wine because one evening we forgot to get one in town and wanted to watch the sunset in garden. Thank you so much for a lovely stay Lucia :)
review_5_text:
A wonderful place, the landlady is wonderful an helpful,  and served us fruits salad every morning, kitchen well equipped, clean, little garden.
Is located at the end of the village, so it require some 100s of walk from the center.
The toilets are private but located outside the rooms.

name: Hostal Salento Combi
review_1_text: We booked a room and received a confirmation via Booking.com. However, when we arrived, Hostal Salento Combi told us they didn’t have a room for us and made us feel as if it were our fault. They were very unprofessional, and I wouldn’t recommend staying there. It was clear they weren’t being honest. Very disappointing!
review_2_text: Perfect for couples. Really cheap too (70k for a double bed w private shower). Which is like the same price as a hostel dorm bed in some hostels here. Kitchen quite good too.
review_3_text: Value for money is brilliant. It's a little rough around the edges but perfectly comfortable and the balcony with the mountain view is beautiful. One block (a very steep hill) from the main square where the keeps leave for Cocora which is ideal. There was hot water although it was very patchy.
review_4_text: Super nice and peaceful hostel, we stayed 2 nights we love it so much and also the dog Panda🩷
review_5_text: I stayed in this hostal for 6 nights and loved it! It is small but really well made with everything you need. The view is amazing and there is a kitchen. The staff is super friendly, and you can even borrow boots for the Cocora Hike which is really useful. I definitely recommend!

name: Tukawa
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text: We absolutely loved our stay at Tukawa. The staff was welcoming, king, helpful, and it really feels like a family. We did a coffee tour with Fabian and we learned so much thinks and tried delicious coffee, fruits and chocolate. We definitely recommend!
review_2_text: Excellent stay in the middle of a Finca with coffee, banana and cocoa trees! Proposed activities are amazing, especially the tour of the Finca. Decent food offering and plenty of things to do while you are there! Greatly recommended
review_3_text:
This is by far the best hostel I stayed at while solo traveling. The place is surrounded by coffee farms, banana and palm trees. It has a breathtaking sunset view, creating a cascade of colors that one can enjoy from the swimming pool (the only pool with clean water I have found in Colombia so far).

The hostel is immaculately clean—the rooms, beds and bathrooms are spotless. As an Italian, I am quite picky about food, but the meals here live up to the reputation of the French owners while still being reasonably priced.

The owners are extremely friendly and pleasant to talk to. They genuinely care about the hostel and their guests, actively participating in social activities such as the group dinner and the evening group games, which most guests join.

You can really feel the spirit of Colombia when talking to both the staff and the guests at the hostel. As if the coffee farms weren’t paradisiacal enough, this hostel enhances even further the sense of peace one gets while traveling through the Colombian countryside. I will definitely stop here again on my next trip to Colombia.
review_4_text: Beautiful and amazing place, great to rest and explore the nearby region walking. Its better to have your own truck to get there safely.
review_5_text:
The place is wonderful. I stayed here for four nights and everyone made sure I had a great experience.

The owner is generous, the kitech staff attentive, and the volunteers/staff are friendly

name: Bareque hostal
review_1_text:
TLDR: is ok if you are on a tight budget, but there are nicer places for similar money.
The Hostel/Hotel probably was pretty once, but is a bit run down now (pictures don't show how it looks now). The room was ok, but without a window. We didn't have any water for a whole day, which is very annoying when one was hiking. This is a common problem in Salento, which is why other accomodations have their own water tanks on the roof. Service was fine, but the owner had a weird vibe hanging out with his pitbull in the common area.
review_2_text: Beautiful, clean and great breakfast. Alejandro and Maria are there 24hours taking care of your needs and happy to help you with the excursions. The garden with fishes is calm and relaxing🫶
review_3_text:
This is a very good place to stay when in Salento. Everything was clean, breakfast was very good to.
The host is really nice and helpful.
They have super cute dog.
review_4_text: Very helpful and friendly staff. Clean room & a nice view during breakfast (which is also delicious and every day a bit different). Only 5 minutes to the central town.
review_5_text:
We stayed for four days. No one showed up during those four days, so the hostel was closed. The bathroom filled with water, and since there was no ventilation, it couldn't be solved, and there were no cleaning supplies available.
Every morning, workers came to do things all morning. I understand it was a one-off, but it wasn't convenient, and no one gave us any notice.

The outdoor kitchen area was quite neglected and somewhat dirty, mainly because it was open air, and keeping it clean is complicated without constant cleaning. As I said, no one showed up during the four days. We had to buy basic items like scouring pads, napkins, salt, and even then, we were short on other things like cloths.

On the positive side, there was soap and shampoo in the hostel, it was close to the square, and the room had enough shelves to store clothes, as well as clean towels.

name: Hotel Boutique Santa María
review_1_text:
It is a spectacular place where you can see beautiful gardens. Excellent panoramic view of the Bremen forest. From the kiosk located outside you can enjoy a time of integration with your family and friends if you don't want to go out. Nights of good rest without noise. A beautiful chapel if you want a time of relaxation and peace.
Comfortable rooms to share. Excellent care in cleaning and decoration. Comfortable rooms.
review_2_text: The staff at this hotel were incredibly friendly and helpful throughout our stay. The rooms were spotless and very comfortable. We also enjoyed the scenery each morning and loved the convenient location near Filandia's main attractions
review_3_text:
Super cozy, the attention is excellent.
To rest it is great since you can't hear the noise of the park but it is super close to it. We will return
review_4_text: It is a really cozy place…very quiet after a day of adventure and tour in the town; with a wonderful view of the mountain range; highly recommended!!!!
review_5_text:
It is a beautiful Hotel, full of landscape, comfortable rooms, quiet place to rest.

There is parking right in front

name: Nature Hostel Salento
review_1_text: Many thanks to Gratty and the whole family for the wonderful stay at their hostel. The whole family took such good care of us! From the delicious breakfast to the two cozy rooms with balconies, everything was great. We received a lot of information about the surrounding area and were still able to do many things on foot, which we really enjoyed!
review_2_text:
Gratty is wonderful and the best host ever! Made me feel very welcome and he was so accommodating giving me all the best tips and helped book all my tours / trips. A fantastic host that made all the difference.

The room is huge - incredibly clean and spacious. The property is in the perfect location. Love that there’s a bakery right opposite. Beware though, it can get very noisy outside from very early in the morning, but I know Gratty is working on how to better soundproof the rooms.

This place is recommended for solo travellers and it is exceptional value for money. I will be back!!!
review_3_text: I had an amazing stay at Nature Hostel in Salento, Colombia. Despite not having a reservation, the owner went above and beyond to ensure a room was ready for me. The service was exceptional—he gave great advice on visiting the Cocora Valley and even arranged a coffee farm tour. The cleanliness was impeccable, and the location was perfect for exploring Salento and its surroundings. Highly recommend this place!
review_4_text: We really enjoyed our stay here!! Great location and nice clean room. In addition, the hosts gave us great tips for what to do near Salento and were very friendly and hospitable.
review_5_text: We had the loveliest stay at Nature Hostel! The kindest hosts we have encountered on our 5 month trip. So helpful and nice 😊. The room was impeccably clean and a super comfortable bed. Thanks guys 🙏

name: La Cabaña Eco-Hotel
address: Vía al Valle del Cocora #Km 2, Salento
opening_hours: Monday: 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM|Tuesday: 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM|Wednesday: 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM|Thursday: 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM|Friday: 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM|Saturday: 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM|Sunday: 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM
review_1_text: We had the most incredible four nights at La Cabaña. For us, the location was perfect, in a spectacular valley 5/10 mins outside the beautiful town of Salento. The team running the hotel are so kind and welcoming, and the hotel itself is beautiful, with stunning views, great food and lovely rooms. You are surrounded by the most tranquil and beautiful nature, and it's easy to get to Salento and the incredible Cocora Valley (which is a must visit). We cannot wait to return to this hotel. Loved it.
review_2_text:
Incredible stay - an absolute highlight of our trip in Colombia. Sebastian goes above and beyond with his service. Staff will drive you to Salento town and it is easy to take a public Willy back to the finca, highly recommend staying out of town here.

The horseback riding to Santa Rita waterfall was amazing and a must do!!!
review_3_text:
Absolute amazing place..!❤️
Great surroundings, super nice rooms, excellent food and VERY helpful hosts..!
If we ever come to Colombia again we will for sure stay here again..! 🇨🇴
review_4_text:
What a beautiful Colombian experience! The location is perfect, the service is excellent and the food super delicious and very generous!

If you want to stay at a typical Colombian farm, surrounded by nature and in a perfect location, I highly recommend this place!
review_5_text:
This place is one of a kind. We felt like home from the first second and were so sad to leave after 2 amazing days.
The food is amazing, starting from the breakfast, lunch and dinner - everything is freshly cooked and so delicious. Fresh milk from the farm and always hot, delicious coffee, whenever you want.
Besides the beautiful location and the veeeery comfortable beds - our highlight were the people running this place.
Sebastian, Eduard, la dueña and the rest of the staff are such lovely, warm and welcoming people.

Thank you for this beautiful experience!!!

name: Redwood | Cabañanas Lodge
review_1_text: We stayed here for four nights and had accommodation with a jacuzzi. The staff were friendly and helpful. Unfortunately the room had no mosquito net and none of the days our room was cleaned. The hut is very small and there is no place to put your clothes in a cupboard. Also, the hut is open between the roof and the wall so animals like spiders and geckos are constantly coming in. We had paid for breakfast in advance and even skipped it on one day (due to an excursion) and still had to pay extra for a juice we had ordered on the last day although this was not mentioned at breakfast - I think that's cheeky. To get to Salento you have to stop the bus on the road. A ride costs 2000 pesos per person.
review_2_text: Excelente cabalgata a caballo to the top Of a beautiful mountain. Restaurant with the most tender meat. Nice cold water River,camping and nice hotel.
review_3_text: Beatiful,people were kind and nice ,just expensive
review_4_text: Make sure it's not raining
review_5_text: Nice and delicious

name: ARBOREA ECOLODGE hotel glamping
review_1_text: We booked through air bnb and it was fantastic. Stayed in the 2 BR unit with the hot tub. Was very clean with beautiful views. Short walk up and down some hills into town.
review_2_text: Great views, good service, overall an excellent place to spend a few days. Only a 10 mins walk from town, WiFi was decent (but probably not good enough for work). I’d recommend for a vacation stay!
review_3_text: Surrounded by nature far from the crowds and safe
review_4_text: best place in colombia
review_5_text:
I share my disappointing experience at this hotel. Before booking, I explicitly asked if the place was suitable for a family plan and they assured me it was. However, upon arriving with my young daughter, I found the atmosphere to be more motel-like, which made me feel extremely uncomfortable.

I decided to talk to the owner of the place to express my discomfort, hoping at least for an apology or some solution. Unfortunately, he left me on notice and I did not receive any response. I consider this disrespectful and terrible customer service, especially considering the high rate I paid for the stay.

I do not recommend this hotel to any family looking for a child-friendly place. My experience was very negative and I hope that the hotel improves in the future both in transparency of information and in customer service.

name: Ecohotel la montaña
review_1_text: We had a great time. I went with my partner, and even though we lost our license plate, both Don Hector and the local people helped us in every way they could. The place is beautiful, peaceful, and the service is very warm. I hope to return soon, this time without incident. Thank you for everything!
review_2_text:
The place is terribly neglected, completely different than in the photos.
It's a pity, because the place has potential and is surrounded by a beautiful forest.
Fortunately, we managed to cancel the reservation.
review_3_text:
La gentilezza e cordialità del proprietario Don Hector e la passione della stupenda donna Lucera sono stati il valore aggiunto di questo luogo immerso nella natura, autentico e rurale.
Il figlio del proprietario, sapendo che arrivavo a piedi la sera tardi mi è venuto incontro per farmi strada. Sono stata come in famiglia, ma anche nel rispetto della mia privacy e aiutandomi a organizzare al meglio il tempo a disposizione per visitare queste stupende zone. Mi piacerebbe tornarci un giorno, lo spero.
Questa sarà una delle esperienze che ricorderò con amore del mio viaggio in Colombia. Grazie
review_4_text: Picturesque, natural, the oxygen is 100% pure from the forest that surrounds the site, its rooms are fair and pleasant, the natural environment very green 🌿, tropical coffee climate, sufficient basic amenities, bring mosquito repellent during the day. Just 8 minutes from Salento. The hosts are very attentive.
review_5_text:
Hermosa finca para desconectarse y disfrutar de la naturaleza y la vista hacia la montaña. Buena ubicación, con río y cascadas cerca y a minutos de los pueblos del eje cafetero.
Don Héctor ha sido una gran anfitrión con el cual hicimos una amistad. Me ha hecho sentir como en casa

name: Solana Glamping
review_1_text:
Everything was perfect from start to finish! A very beautiful place, comfortable and intimate. The jacuzzi water was new just for us, so without chlorine, perfect. The copious and qualitative breakfast. The little touches left in the room upon our arrival. We treated ourselves to a small fire in the evening between two baths, ideal!
Jeronimo immediately put us at ease, and took great care of us from start to finish to ensure that our stay went wonderfully! You can also trust him for advice on visits to the region and transport. Thank you so much !
review_2_text: It is a very special place where you can see the delicacy they have with every detail in the place. Jerónimo's attention was excellent from start to finish. The breakfast is delicious and very generous, I will definitely come back!
review_3_text: Un lugar bonito y tranquilo,un buen servicio y los anfitriones muy amables están pendiente de todo, para desconectar de la ciudad es un buen sitio.
review_4_text: Stay away from this "experience" - The glamping door is completely broken and that's why animals and insects enter during the night, the water is not heated and it is impossible to shower. Terrible quality and service.
review_5_text: I loved the place, it was super nice, the climate is cool, super natural and very clean.

name: Glamping Salento
address: finca la Graciela, Via A Vda. el Agrado, Salento
opening_hours: Monday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM|Tuesday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM|Wednesday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM|Thursday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM|Friday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM|Saturday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM|Sunday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
review_1_text: Beautiful place and the service is great everything is organized while you keep your privacy.. only 15 minutes from down town Salento. Half an houre from the Cocora Valley walking tour and park. A place where you have booked to less nights afterwards. Simple lovely.
review_2_text: Beautiful rooms, but a distance from Salento down a dirt road. No food nearby. Walking distance to a coffee farm. Good communication and they able to arrange rides to and from the airport and Cocoa Valley. Definitely the most expensive place we stayed at during our 10 days in Colombia.
review_3_text:
I recommend! A beautiful place. Only advantages!
- the houses have a great atmosphere
- very clean rooms... fragrant towels, clean bed linen.
- luxury combined with the natural environment
- great architecture, well-thought-out, well-integrated into the natural environment.
- very good service,
- a very quiet place away from the city, a lot of privacy.
- very good price
- there is a place to park your car in front of the house.
review_4_text: Excellent place, very attentive and a very good experience.
review_5_text: Excelente destino para hospedarse y entrar en contacto con la naturaleza. Sus espacios rodeados por la naturaleza causan una sensación de paz increíble. Además, su servicio es muy bueno y la comida deliciosa. Sin duda un buen lugar para vacacionar.

name: Glamping Camp De Luxe
review_1_text: We came to Pereira from Germany and stayed for 4 nights. It was very pleasant to stay here at the Glamping De Luxe. The view is amazing. It’s a very quiet place to just relax and enjoy nature. The Cabana was super clean and had everything you can dream of. The staff was super nice and helpful at anytime. It’s really worth to stay here, I can warmly recommend. Thank you!
review_2_text: Simply beautiful. Amazing sunset, breathtaking views... Staying here is a must
review_3_text: Beautiful place, great customer service; definitely I will recommended this place
review_4_text: It is truly spectacular, the cleanliness is incredible, every detail is very well done, the punctuality is the best of all, delicious breakfast, the bed is not to mention, 100-star pillows and blankets, the view is wonderful, 100% recommended
review_5_text:
We had the opportunity to stay in the wooden cabin at this magical place, and it was an incredible experience. The cabin is ideal for disconnecting from the hustle and bustle of the city and connecting with nature. We enjoyed a relaxing jacuzzi with a spectacular view.

Luis's service was excellent, always attentive to detail and willing to accommodate our requests. Dinner and breakfast were delicious.

I recommend bringing hiking shoes to fully enjoy the experience. My husband and I spent a relaxing and very romantic weekend, just what we were looking for. We definitely recommend it and will definitely return as soon as possible. 😊

name: Orange Glamping
address: Km 4 via Quimbaya a, Vía A Panaca
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text: It is a very nice place, the people are very kind and helpful, with a very good view and very quiet, the place does not disappoint, I would definitely come back.
review_2_text:
The site has everything you need for a pleasant experience, it has very comfortable rooms and very good service.

You can opt for food and liquor on site or bring your own supplies.

The included breakfast goes beyond expectations.
review_3_text: A place to disconnect and appreciate nature. Excellent service, delicious breakfast, the only thing that could be improved is the air conditioning inside the rooms since the heat is strong and the air they have does not have good capacity, but in conclusion a highly recommended place.
review_4_text:
They exceeded my expectations
An excellent place to connect with nature, relax, and above all enjoy.
Super recommended, super in love with the facilities, the service and especially the staff that assists you, thank you very much for making us feel at home, the staff always looking for the comfort of the client, I hope to return very soon to enjoy these wonderful facilities.
review_5_text: Excelente un lugar maravilloso para hospedarse, estuve los días del 13 al 15 de mayo. El glamping es divino mi esposo cumplió años y el señor Guillermo el administrador lo adorno muy lindo, es muy confortable, la cama es amplia y muy limpia, la  naturaleza y cada detalle hace que el lugar sea especial. El ofuro es súper, la fogata y cada rinconcito es muy romántico. Lo recomiendo a ojo cerrado. Todo el personal es muy amable y servicial te hacen sentir como en casa. Felicitaciones 👍

name: Cielo Abierto Cabaña Glamping
address: Hotel Casa HH, Vda. Arauca #Km 1, Quimbaya
review_1_text: Super recommended, the attention is very good, the people are very kind, the place is very clean, I loved it, I will come back.😄
review_2_text: Really comfortable bed, room, and great service!
review_3_text:
If you're looking for a place to disconnect from your routine and connect with nature, Cielo Abierto is your place. Excellent service, lovely people, and incredible attention.

It's a very comfortable and beautiful cabin. They've thought of every detail; everything is impeccable and comfortable. The internet is excellent. It has a well-equipped TV. Being able to watch the sky while you rest is a dream.
review_4_text:
Todo o Pessoal muito simpático. Fizeram-nos sentir em casa e só temos a agradecer por isso.
Nota-se que fazem tudo com amor 💚
A hostess é muito prestável e ajudou em tudo que precisávamos, recomendaram uma finca de café para visitar e foi incrível.
A cabana é incrível! Limpa e muito bonita.
A sensação que estávamos no meio da natureza era incrível. Acordar com o som dos pássaros ter uma vista incrível…
Jacuzzi bom para relaxar a noite.
O alojamento tem piscina e o pequeno almoço era bom.
A cabana tinha AC e tv com Netflix.
Um refúgio perfeito para quem quer fugir da cidade e entrar na cultura colombiana da parte do café! As paisagens da zona São incríveis e as pessoa tão simpáticas!
Super recomendado! Obrigado, a nossa experiência foi incrível!
Queremos voltar!
review_5_text:
They took me there as a surprise birthday present, and what a surprise it was!
The physical facilities are spectacular, well-finished, the bed is a 10/10, but the scenery? Wow, it was a plus! It has a cooking area, we made dinner for two, had a bonfire, topped it off with a jacuzzi, and waking up to the birds singing is a truly enriching experience.

If you're looking for a place to get away with that special someone, I can tell you this is a perfect place 💯 I highly recommend it, and the staff is spectacular and very respectful.

name: Glamping Casa Viva
review_1_text: Terrible place, despite having an excellent visit, the hygiene of the place leaves a lot to be desired, at night there is no room for a cockroach in the kitchen, if you go by motorcycle, you should keep in mind something that is not reported. In the place there are many cats that damage the linings of the motorcycles and when a complaint is made the Glamping is very rude and unreceptive, if you have the opportunity to go let it pass, on the site there are other places with better hygiene, more customer friendly and at better prices.
review_2_text:
Hermoso lugar en medio de la natualeza para desconectarse y salirse de la rutina, así como reconectar con tu pareja.
Sea disfrutando de una cerveza bien fría mientras tienes una vista espectacular de la ciudad sea sentado en la terraza o relajado en la malla Catamarán mientras contemplas el cielo.

Además, cuenta con un jacuzzi para tener una velada romántica a la luz de las velas con tu pareja, mientras disfrutan una copa de vino.

La comida deliciosa, pedimos una picada para 2 y excelente porción y sabor.

Las personas del glamping muy atentas y puntuales con los horarios de alimentación.

El Glamping tiene 2 pisos, está equipado con cocina súper completa, cafetera, licuadora, air fryer y platos y cubiertos, además mini nevera. Cuenta con un parlante con bluetooh y su respectivo cargador.

Además cuenta con una cama y un sofá.
Muchos espacios para compartir en pareja o en familia.
review_3_text: Highly recommended, the service is excellent, the facilities are perfect, and the view is spectacular.
review_4_text: Un lugar perfecto para el descanso, lindo, ¡excelente vista! super cerca de la ciudad, silencioso, con buena privacidad, las personas que atienden soy muy amables y se preocupan de que tengas una buena experiencia, la cocina super completa, limpio, y el desayuno delicioso. Muy recomendado
review_5_text: Excellent experience, from the first message to the last moment. Everything very in order, everything very nice, clean and very organized. Delicious meals.  The place is more than perfect with everything one could want for one or many nights enjoying the paradise near Pereira and Dosquebradas.

name: Naby Glamping
review_1_text: Unfortunately we trusted them and at the last minute they canceled our reservation, I booked a month in advance and they waited a day before to say no, that the system had failed and they could not complete my reservation, it was a special date and because of them and their lack of organization we lost this moment, I do not recommend it, lack of ethics and seriousness.
review_2_text: A wonderful place to share as a couple, spend some quality time, and disconnect from the daily stress. The facilities are very comfortable and clean, with hot water and a delicious breakfast. The service is excellent, and Marisela always has a smile. 100% recommended.
review_3_text: Very good service, very clean place and delicious breakfast. I recommend the place ❤️
review_4_text:
Excellent!! The service, the facilities, very clean, the quality of the place, and the packages offered are very good. It's not expensive for everything included. They have contacts for groceries and pre-prepared meals delivered.
Mrs. Mary's service is excellent, and the breakfasts she prepares are delicious.

A very good experience.
review_5_text:
Simply great!!!!

It all starts with the 10/10 service, from Mrs. Mary, who is a kind and attentive host.

The facilities are perfect, and the privacy is outstanding. The comfort is not to be missed. I should clarify that we were in the dome.

The jacuzzi is excellent (the water is a little warm), but it can be fixed by not turning the water on too much, and it comes out a bit cooler.

The view is also amazing, you can see the airport, the planes taking off and landing, something really cool to watch.

The included breakfast is super! Delicious and exquisite.

For the rest of the meals, Mrs. Mary provides contact information for delivery.

Transportation: you can go by car or motorcycle; they have explanatory videos on Instagram, but if you don't have one, Mrs. Mary from the glamping center also provides contact information for Don Mauricio (who will pick you up at the terminal and take you to the glamping center, very cordial, 30,000 pesos as of today).

name: Luna Glamping & Hotels Salento
address: Finca El Tesoro, Via A Vda. el Agrado, Salento
review_1_text: This place is a gem! Sebastian is an excellent host, him and his family have 5 star customer service from the moment you arrive. The place is located in a great location, surrounded by nature with unbelievable views of trees, mountains, and wildlife. Our hobbit hole was cozy, comfortable, and very safe. We opted for the home cooked breakfast in the mornings and it was absolutely delicious. Sebastian has great recommendations for things to do in the area and was always responsive. I’d highly recommend this for anyone who wants a great experience on their journey in the beautiful coffee region in Colombia.
review_2_text: This is an amazing place to connect with the nature, the service is always great and it’s pretty close to Salento

review_3_text: Great service, Amazing view! When you wake up to the landscape infront of you, it's hard to believe you are still on earth. review_4_text: Even though (or because) the place is situated a bit outside the village, this is the perfect place to relax and to avoid the crowds of tourists in the centre. review_5_text:
Please read the entire review because this Hotel could be the best option for some people, but not the best for some others, so please take the time to read it until the end

Why you should reserve a room there?

1. There are only two staff members that maybe will not be enough for larger groups, but they will be ready to fulfill your needs with the best attitude, the best energy and best way possible.
2. The Hotel is close to the main park ( 15 minutes my foot), so you can do bird watching or just do a healthy walking each day.
3. If you are a sociable person, this Hotel is more like a hostel than a hotel, so you feel like being part of a big and diverse family.
4. The rooms are traditional and antique with basic equipment, like a basic shower, a bed and an old TV that could be enough for people that are only looking for a cheap place to sleep and take a shower... Nothing more, nothing less.

Things to consider before you reserve a room.

1. There are only two staff members in charge of the entire Hotel. ( They only speak Spanish).
2. The Hotel is 15 minutes by foot from the  end of the "Camino Real" but you must be aware that this road is not paved and doesn't have street lights, so you must be careful in the night or rainy days.
3. Like you can see in the photos, the Hotel is located in a steep hill, so, no matter if you go by foot or by car/Motorcycle, you must be prepared or at least aware during rainy days to avoid the risk of sliding.
4. You need to take your own bags through a lot of stairs and there is no ramps or any help to do that, so take that in consideration just in case you are traveling with a lot of baggage or with old people who have difficulty to climb all those stairs.
5. The Hotel doesn't have a proper reception to attend you when you get there. It is just a social area like a living room with a dinner table where you could find the   only two staff members most of the time.
6. If you are traveling with kids or if the weather is not good, you will find the rooms quite outdated, because they only have an old TV (CRT TV) and there is no much room to do anything else inside it.
7. The rooms are next to each other and they are not soundproof, so you can easily hear all the neighbors noises quite easily.

To summarize, I had a perfect experience with my wife while visiting this Hotel, because we were prepared, but I saw other people who complained because it was not what they were expecting, so please read other's reviews just to analyze if this is the right place for your trip.

review_2_text:
Two years ago, we visited this property and had an excellent experience. However, this time, unfortunately, the situation was very different and left much to be desired.

From the beginning, the service was poor. The person in charge showed little willingness to address the problems that arose, and his attitude was inappropriate.

The kitchen was in very poor hygienic conditions: it was dirty, insects were coming out of the microwave, the refrigerator had sticky residue inside, and the overall smell was unpleasant.

In the rooms, the bathrooms were also dirty; water stagnated in the showers and there were constant unpleasant odors.

The pool was another major problem. From our arrival, the water was cloudy for the three days of our stay and received no maintenance. This was not only uncomfortable, but some people in our group even developed fungus after using it.

We tried to contact the supposed owner several times to find a solution, but received no response or concrete action. We also discovered the place was sublet, which made us even more uncertain.

It's a huge disappointment to have returned to a place with such fond memories only to find it in such poor condition. We definitely wouldn't recommend it again.

review_2_text: Our experience was not so good, we separated the apartment on the top floor with 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom and 1 kitchen. The back room had so much humidity that it was impossible to sleep in it, when we informed us about it they told us that they were going to validate it, the next day the same room woke up full of water, the owner came in to mop but they didn't tell us anything, the next day it rained and so much water entered that it flooded both the room and the living room and they told us that it was external conditions but this was a lie since the room already had a damp wall and a damage that was not even from those days but is a damage that has been going on for many months. (This can be seen both in the moldy wall and in the blown floor), when we told them that we needed either a change of floor or a refund of a part of the money, they were hesitating, saying that they should talk to the owner when Leidy appeared in chamber and commerce and in all the certificates but she herself said that she was not the owner, after so much pressure they gave us a refund for a single night when we paid for 6 nights and this damage came from a long time ago, I feel that in this place they deceive with what they offer since we did not ask for a discount trusting that the price was in accordance with what they sent in the video but in the video they show the wall with humidity covered with a Curtain, which means that one as a client cannot notice that this room is not in condition for use. They told us that they were going to bring someone to repair the damage but this bothered us the most because they already knew about the damage and it was only until we complained that they indicated that they would bring someone to validate the damage. I feel that in order to save money, they rent the place without solving the problem that the room has and do charge the full price. Another thing that seemed annoying to me was having to write and put so much pressure on the owner Leidy to get a response for the damage or some solution to the non-conformity of the place. name: Hostal campestre las guaduas Salento
review_1_text:
You get exactly what you pay for and nothing more. We stayed in a private and even tough it was cheap, we wished we would’ve paid a bit more to stay somewhere else. To get to the hostel, you have to scramble down a steep dirt road. As seen on the photos, the place looks quite nice which I agree with, but everything around it is not. They are building some houses here so expect A LOT of noise in the mornings as they start around 7:30. The people are also not considerate as they talk and scream to each other.
The kitchen was minimal. It was not clean and the fridge didn’t work.
The location was nice. It’s a few minute walk to the square where the jeeps go to Cocora valley. And the price is nice as it’s very cheap but for obvious reasons.
The room is very basic. It is not closed off (if people smoke, the smoke gets into the room), expect quite some mosquitoes and noise. The wifi doesn’t work for around 90% of the time. Our shower was clogged which was still doable for the few nights we were there but still not nice. Our toilet didn’t have a toilet seat. The bed is too small for 2 people, and has only a blanket, no sheets.
If you’re on a budget, this could be fine for you or if you don’t care about anything of above. I would recommend to spend a bit more money for a better and nicer hostel.
review_2_text: Located less than 5 minutes from the main square in Salento down an unpaved hill. The rooms are basic and small. The wall to the hallway was not "closed" i.e. gaps and so you can hear everything. The walls are thin in general so you can hear everything. The hostel has a dog that started barking at 6am which was not ideal. The shower was basic, hot water came out with low pressure. Basic kitchen with stove and fridge. Overall it's cheap but don't expect any luxuries.
review_3_text: In total a nice accommodation for a very good price. We booked a private room for 12$ a night. The entire house is made of bamboo, so you can hear your neighbours quite well. There is a small kitchen with essentials and a sitting area.
review_4_text:
Positive points:
- close to the center on foot (5 minutes), there is no noise and music from the main avenue.
- the kindness of the lady at reception.
- I had hot water, contrary to some comments, maybe it was my lucky day or they have improved + clean bath towel.

Negatives:
- My room (dormitory) was very humid, there is no insulation, I had the impression that my mattress was wet, my skin stuck, I even had to sleep on top of the blanket but that didn't change much.
- We hear EVERYTHING, the slightest murmur from the people in the next room, but also from neighbors who have children (quite noisy). The insulation is very bad.
- After writing to my host about the humidity in the room, he read it but never replied to me. I prefer to talk to the hosts about it first before posting a comment on the internet to give them a chance to improve, but they don't seem to want to accept the comment.
- Very poor network in the room, although I indicated this to the staff when I arrived, and Ms. assured me that there would be no problem. In the end I read that a lot of people have had the same problem, so they know about it but just don't say it.

The house is charming and it's a shame because there could be more potential. All around it is dilapidated, a rocky path as if abandoned. It helped me out for one night, but not more.
review_5_text: This hostel is atypical since it is entirely made of bamboo (very pretty). As a result, there is no real insulation between the rooms and the corridors so you can hear everything! No sockets in the room but only in the bathroom, and the water in the shower was cold! There is a kitchen. Very good location, 5 minutes from Salento square, however the path is not very easy to access since it is not a road and it is still under construction nearby ;) I still recommend it because we had a good stay here!

Terrible service. DO NOT COME TO THIS HOTEL.

We arrived at 8pm,
We hired 2 rooms, 1 double and 1 triple, which (my mistake) we paid in advance and without seeing the rooms, when we arrived the rooms had a drain smell, one of the rooms had a blanket stained with blood, the same room had the bathroom covered.

With only 10 minutes in the hotel, without even unmaking the beds, we decided to leave the hotel and ask for our money back.

The receptionist and his assistant were more or less friendly but the decision was up to the administrator, a lady who arrived in a defensive attitude, raising her voice and claiming that we had made a reservation at 3pm (which we never did, since we only called to check prices), saying that she could not lose her money, I had the recording of the call I made showing that I had not made any reservation but rather a price inquiry.

In short, we called the police and the lady refunded me 70 thousand of the 125 thousand pesos we paid, reluctantly, she did not recognize the mistake, we had to leave, losing money, late at night to find another hotel.

I DO NOT RECOMMEND this place.
"Cheap" is expensive, and even dangerous for your health.
review_4_text: Comfortable, clean hotel close to the university foundation of the Andean area. It is close to many food places, bars, a bank and the police station in front. Economical place and allows pets. Next door is a parking lot. It did not rate 5 stars for its antique decoration.
review_5_text: I do not recommend this hotel. Terrible service, I arrived with my family for a walk and we only made a price inquiry, we arrived and apparently it looked nice, upon entering the rooms we noticed that the bathrooms in the rooms had a strong smell of plumbing, the blankets were stained with blood, when making the corresponding claim the administration informed us that they were not responsible for the conditions in which the rooms were, for obvious reasons we requested a refund of the money and Oh surprise!!! The administration informed us that since we had already entered the rooms, they discounted us half of the agreed price, with respect that this beautiful city deserves, do not allow that because of an establishment like this your city becomes discredited, I am simply a tourist who came with all the desire to enjoy these beautiful landscapes, but because of "hotels" like this one loses interest in getting to know such a beautiful city, oh and to complete the administration of that place they withheld the bill from us without just cause, and also when we requested the blankets to take photographic records where the blood stains were evident, the administration did not allow us access to them either. review_1_text: The rooms are not equipped with basic amenities. I wasn't able to sleep at all due to the noise loud music from the lobby, and l loud music from the bar next to my room. The window in my room was opened and too high for me to close it. There was no TV remote control in the room. All was very uncomfortable, including the mattress really hard. No AC in the rooms. I needed to warm up water, and I was sent to the kitchen upstairs, and I got grossed out when I saw roaches. I'm definitely not coming back to this place ever. Is not a spa as they advertise themselves.
review_2_text: Excellent service, very friendly staff and always cleaned. I really recommend this place.

Ideal for business travelers, families or tourists looking for quality without paying more. Enjoy free Wi-Fi, included breakfast and excellent service
review_4_text: My stay at this accommodation fell far short of the minimum standards for a decent stay, and the hotel offered no real solutions or refunds. The original room had a leaky ceiling, so after nearly a week and a half of requesting a change, we were moved to another room (Llanos)—the one that was supposed to be the suite (La Perla de Tumaco) with no hot water. Furthermore, the constant noise from nearby bars until 2–3 a.m. made it impossible to rest. The jacuzzi tub had a bad odor; we had to buy scented candles and air fresheners, highlighting hygiene issues. Upon returning one night, the room was not clean nor was the bed made. We were later told in a rude tone that it was because we had taken the only keys to the room. The only alternatives we were given were to return to the leaky room or a smaller one with no ventilation or windows. A terrible experience, considering we had to stay the two weeks we had scheduled because we made the mistake of paying the full amount (since you can pay half at the beginning and the other half at the end) upon arrival, and they wouldn't issue refunds, resulting in a lack of customer service and solutions from the hotel. review_1_text: It's a quiet place to have a good night, good internet connection and you feel as a home.
review_2_text: I stayed at this hotel on January 04 of 2024, my experience wasn’t pleasant, meanwhile the staff is really friendly and the hotel is in a great location, the Room where I stayed, which is called HELICONIAS is very loud, you can hear all the noises from surrounding areas the whole night not only in the morning. Also the room is cold, I don’t think this is a place to rest.
review_3_text: Orfa and Jenny were just amazing hosts! Funny, friendly, good energy and authentic colombians! Nice chill out area, excellent breakfast and 1 min walk to main square and 10 min walk to the 'mirador' - super recommended :)
review_4_text: I stayed in this Hostel for a whole week and I loved my stayed here. Very friendly personnel here. Breakfast is fresh and delicious which is included. review_1_text:
1 Block from town center 👍
Breakfast included! It's a coupon for an adjacent breakfast joint.
Reception, hallways, room clean.
Huge, Room for five in the shower 🤣
I've included a couple photos here from the common area balcony so you can see up and down the street.
review_2_text: My wife and I are from the U.S. and stayed here for 2 nights with her family from Colombia. The owners were very friendly during our stay. They helped us with dinner reservations, directions, and gave us excellent coffee (tintos) in the mornings/evenings. A very pleasant surprise was the hot water in the showers and the great wifi connection as this can be difficult to come by. We would definitely stay here again and we recommend this hostel to anyone visiting Filandia.
review_3_text: Modern hotel inside, very clean with large, comfortable and fresh rooms. Excellent attention.
review_4_text: Excellent place to spend one or several nights, just 40 meters from the central park, its location is excellent. It has an internal patio to store motorcycles. The rooms are very well arranged and grilled. The staff is friendly and cares about your well-being. The price is affordable. Recommended.
review_5_text: A nice, comfortable place to rest. We were able to park our motorcycles, which is something impossible in the town of Filandia, the attention was wonderful, I would definitely return there.

name: Hotel Finca Marina

Rooms were clean, but a major issue was at night I could hear alot of scratching noise and squeaking from above. This made it hard to sleep, if not for the noises at night it would be 5/5 stars
review_2_text:
Excellent stay here
Julio is a great host
Very clean and tidy
review_3_text: El dueño es de malas pulgas y grosero. Desorganizados con las reservaciones. Tuvimos que conseguir otro lugar.
review_4_text: Very comfortable, good price, easy location to different visiting points. Excellent attention.

review_2_text: Nice small hotel / hostel. Very basic but clean and well looked after. Close walk to the square.
review_3_text: Everyone is so friendly and kind places is clean and tidy with beautiful view of mount ruiz
review_4_text: Peaceful
review_5_text: Super
