review_1_text: Okay
review_2_text: Okay
review_3_text: The hotel has a very beautiful architecture, the rooms are spacious, the beds are quite comfortable, the bathroom is clean and the customer service is good and timely. It is also very well located near the cathedral and shopping area.
review_4_text: Sleeping in that hotel in terms of comfort is fine, but the doorbell, the sound of the nightclubs coming from the town center and all that makes it so you don't really sleep. I really recommend it as long as you know you're not going to sleep much :c
review_5_text: Poor service from the manager. It's horrible that not all rooms have private bathrooms, and the bathrooms they do have outside are mixed and mostly don't lock. The mattresses are incredibly uncomfortable and too soft.

name: Un amanecer en Murillo
review_1_text: It is a very pretty town, I recommend purchasing your tours in advance and booking your accommodations well in advance.
review_2_text: Wonderful hotel, service, rooms, attention, and location are excellent. Definitely a comfortable and quiet place.
review_3_text: A comfortable, clean, private and well-priced place
review_4_text:
It is on the outskirts of town, but it is only 500 meters away.

Very good price-service ratio
review_5_text: We only stayed one night. But we found it to be a good and economical hotel.

name: Hostal 7 Colores Murillo Tolima
review_1_text: The place is nice and well-equipped for the cold. The lady in general services is very friendly, but the girl who checks out the rooms is the complete opposite: neither friendly nor helpful. Very poor service from that girl.
review_2_text:
Es un lugar muy central. La atención de la chica y la señora del servicio es excelente.
Las habitaciones están bien equipadas para el clima tan frío y cuentan con buena agua caliente, además, en frente hay un parqueadero muy cercano para aquellos que fuimos en vehículo propio (moto).
En general es un muy buen sitio para hospedarse.
review_3_text: Very good service and excellent attention, very cozy rooms and an excellent location. They have very good and accessible prices for the tours you want to do.
review_4_text: Un hostal muy agradable, con habitaciones cómodas y un ambiente tranquilo, limpio e ideal para la estadía en Murillo. Definitivamente recomiendo el hostal 7 colores.
review_5_text:
Excellent attention from Miss Yaritza, hotel administrator, very kind and attentive; Very good rooms, spacious, comfortable beds and good blankets, very clean and well-equipped bathrooms, and what is important for this climate is that they have hot water, one block from the main park and close to
restaurants, and cafes.

name: HOTEL ARECA
review_1_text: It is a very good place to spend a few days in the wonderful municipality of Murillo. The facilities are very nice, very good beds and blankets and it also has hot water and wi-fi service, it also has parking for both motorcycles and cars and it is a plus. I do not give a 5 since I had made the reservation with enough time in advance for a room with a balcony which has a higher cost than those without a balcony, for some reason they assigned us a room without a balcony and we saw it as a mistake that happens to anyone who oversold one or whatever, but what did seem bad to me was that they charged as if it were a room with a balcony when the first moment it was made clear to them that they had not given us the room reserved weeks in advance.
review_2_text: It has parking, which is a plus. It's affordable, very clean, and the staff is always attentive. Depending on the room and the weather, you might be able to see the snowy peak from the balcony.
review_3_text:
It is a beautiful hotel in a divine municipality, its service is excellent.
Their rooms are very comfortable
Very good parking
review_4_text: Excellent, quiet, comfortable, very nice, with parking, there is no breakfast but you can go to the park, it is 3 blocks away, the town is too quiet, the people are friendly and very willing to meet our needs
review_5_text: Good hotel, excellent cost-benefit ratio, has private parking, they accepted our pet, highly recommended.

name: Casa Amapola
review_1_text: Warm and cozy casa, very clean, hot water, and comfortable beds
review_2_text:
We stayed here as a family with two small children. The place is great and at a great price! Everything was clean and tidy. The best location in town (right on the main square). Above all, the wonderful Andrea helped us with everything we asked for.

We stayed here as a family with two small children. The place is great and at a great price! Everything was clean and tidy. The best location in town (right on the main square). Above all, the wonderful Andrea helped us with everything we asked for.
review_3_text: I loved my stay at this hotel. The room was clean and comfortable, the staff was friendly and attentive, and the location was perfect. 100% recommended!
review_4_text: Excellent place. Very clean, very comfortable beds, excellent location, and Mrs. Andrea, the manager, is very friendly and helpful. Highly recommended.
review_5_text: It's a very, very nice place to stay. The owners are very friendly and help you a lot. The entire team working with them was excellent. We are very, very grateful to Casa Amapola.

name: Hostal tierra de colores HVG murillo tolima
review_1_text:
Wow what an amazing experience we had here in Murillo and in this hostel.
We stayed in Murillo for 3 nights and fell in love with the place. The town has an amazing feeling to it, everyone is so nice and friendly.
Hedilberto was one of the first people we met after arriving to town and he offered us a room at his hostel. The moment we saw the room we loved it because of the view of the mountain from bed.
Also the price was very reasonable and hedilberto was so nice and helpful. He even gave me a poncho to use while we were in town because I didn't bring any warm clothes.
There is a lot to do around Murillo, and if you love natural hot springs this is your spot. We went to termales Canaan, and termales El sifon. We heard a lot about termales la cabaña but didn't go there.
The hostel also has a kitchen you can use which was great for us, and hedilberto was like our family and friend for the whole time we were there, helping out, recommending what to do, and just being an amazing guy.
I highly recommend Murillo, and this hostel.
10/10
review_2_text: Friendly staff, good rates. No social life.
review_3_text:
We stayed for 2 nights on January 26, 2025. The hostel is comfortable, clean and well located. The only thing missing would be some drawers and more hooks to hang clothes on.
Fernando and his family are excellent hosts, a few blocks away is his parents' house who prepared breakfast and snacks in a very "paisa" style.
Likewise, we recommend Fernando as a private guide to the Nevado del Ruiz, it was an unforgettable experience.
We will return with our daughters.
review_4_text:
Buen hotel con bonitas habitaciones y puedo decir que pasamos una noche muy tranquila y el administrador muy amable.
La habitación cuenta con ducha de agua caliente, televisor y buenas cobijas para pasar la noche.
Se encuentra ubicado a unas 3 cuadras del parque principal, pero es importante tener en cuenta que Murillo es un pueblo muy pequeño por lo cual todo queda cerca.
A mejorar la ducha la cual es un poco estrecha y que no hay televisión por cable o TDT, pero si se puede usar para conectarlo al Netflix y otras plataformas. Pero créeme que la tranquilidad de Murillo y el hotel no hace necesario ver televisión, invita al descanso.
review_5_text: The man who serves is very kind, the price is comfortable, it is new, the place would only need a few drawers to hang the rest of the clothes, very organized and beautiful, look at the view....

name: Refugio Paramo Trek Murillo
review_1_text: beautiful location; very quiet place, but less then 5 minutes from the center of Murillo. Felipe, the owner, is a really good person. he helps a lot with info's and is really inspiring to talk with.
review_2_text:
I had a great stay at Refugio Paramo Trek. The hostel is clean, cozy, very cute, all in peace and quiet. I was very well received by Cristina and Santiago, adorable. The Paramo Trek café is also a very friendly place where Cristina welcomes you with her smile and kindness.
I hope I can come back soon!
review_3_text:
The rooms are shared, they have good blankets, the beds are comfortable.
The showers are shared but are separated from the bathrooms, the hot water comes out with good force.

The place is quiet, 7 minutes from the main park.
review_4_text:
Un hostal adorable dans une maison traditionnelle en dehors du village de Murillo.
Les chambres sont grandes, propres, les lits confortables avec de superbes couvertures pour rester au chaud, car les nuits sont fraiches, plusieurs douches et WC.
On se réveille avec le chant des oiseaux.
Les propriétaires, Cristina et Felipe, sont très sympathiques, disponibles et plein de bons conseils.
Ils ont également un très bon restaurant dans le village et une agence de voyage!
Une très bonne adresse dans Murillo!!
review_5_text: A nice country-style place, ideal for relaxing

name: Hostal montañas colombianas
review_1_text: Clean, with large beds... but very overpriced. The price is not in line with the services and facilities. The beds lack sheets, and it was unpleasant to use blankets like that. It didn't meet my expectations. Very expensive for what you get.
review_2_text: Buen lugar, muy nuevo y limpio. lástima que no ofrecen servicio de alimentación ni nada similar, y queda algo retirado de la plaza central para ir a comer cualquier cosa. La atención en si es buena y es recomendable.
review_3_text: I stayed at this place late last year and the place does not match the price. It was a very average room at a glamping price... A single bed for 2, they said there was a kitchen and they don't have a stove, refrigerator or utensils. A bathroom that had bad odors coming out, with a dirty curtain and a water leak. A very cold ceramic floor, which was torture to step on considering the low temperatures, there are no parking cells, you can park in the garage but they could put more vehicles behind you so it is a waste of time waiting for cars to move.
review_4_text:
I do not recommend the Montañas Colombianas hostel, I did not like the service since the person who manages Sandra is not
very cordial.  Apart from the fact that the rooms have 3, 4, beds in a very uncomfortable space, graphically it is like a house with many beds in the living room, kitchen, hallways, bedrooms, there are no beds in the bathroom because there is no room for them. Nothing to see. And only one bathroom for so many people.😒
review_5_text: Excellent place to stay, very cozy and pleasant, especially the attention of Liliana 100/10, she is a great person, I highly recommend her 👌🏽.

name: Hotel Getsemani Murillo
review_1_text:
Wonderful experience, everything since the beginning was very smooth; the staff is lovely and very kind.
The place is very charming and with couple things to do in the hotel.

As a small complain I will say that they do not sell food afterhours but you can always search them in the town (everything in the town close around 8-9 pm) other thing will be that there is not a lot of complementary bathrooms on the premises but that’s okay because they are still building!

Overall I think is the best place to stay in the town and very recommended.
review_2_text: Cabins of various styles, with parking, located at the entrance of Murillo Street, about five blocks from the main park. It's quiet and offers basic amenities in the rooms. The room cleaning service is very basic, with trash collection, towels changed, and the bathroom partially cleaned. Beds are not made, and breakfast is always the same menu with no variety.
review_3_text:
The rooms are very nice, the view spectacular, the majestic Nevado del Ruiz, and that's the plus of this hotel: the view. And it has good parking.
But it wasn't my first time there, and on that occasion, we were quite cold and didn't sleep well. So this time we asked for an extra blanket, and they didn't provide it. Breakfast is always the same menu (parrot eggs or scrambled eggs). There's no small bar that even sells water and snacks.
The weekend we were there, it rained a lot, and we couldn't go out to the park for dinner until late when all the restaurants were closed. That's why I appreciate the small bar selling panela water with cheese and similar drinks in those cases.
That is, there are no other options to offer in case you can't leave the hotel due to bad weather.
review_4_text: Very nice and friendly staff, they just need to leave more sheets for so much cold....😅
review_5_text: Very beautiful spectacular cabins (alpine) the service for us was not so good little information there was no television signal in the room the breakfast never arrived the people who welcomed us were not very sociable there is nothing to eat in the place not even water is necessary to go out or take away I recommend you bring something to snack ☺️ the place is very clean very nice 1/5

name: Hostal Pachanuna
review_1_text: This place was definitely unique. The location, the service, and the recommendations were the best. They made a special date even more beautiful. I would definitely repeat my experience there.
review_2_text: Highly recommended, it's a very warm hostel, excellent service and a location super close to the main park of Murillo
review_3_text: The place is very nice, it is as if you were at home, the service people are very friendly, a very comfortable and clean hostel, the only negative thing is that if you stay on the first floor you can hear the footsteps from above and the voices of the other residents too loud, apart from that the hostel is a very good option to rest
review_4_text: We received very good service, they helped us with our plans in the area, highly recommended
review_5_text: Las habitaciones estaban súper bien, la limpieza y la familiaridad con la que atienden es increíble. El día que llegamos estábamos al borde de la hipotermia ya que nos había llovido y nos recibieron con un buen tinto y ducha caliente. En general creo que es un hostal muy recomendable y acogedor. Las camas son muy cómodas y calientes. Hay un espacio para guardar las motos por si van de viaje en ella y no desean preocuparse por ellas. En general un hostal muy recomendado y al cual volvería si fuera nuevamente a Murillo

name: Hospedaje Atlantis
address: Barrio El Triunfo Manzana AF, Casa 5-6-7, Líbano
review_1_text:
An excellent option for a family stay, this property offers great comfort and a family-friendly atmosphere. The facilities were also very clean. In a short time, we were able to appreciate the tranquility of this area.
We also received excellent service from the lady who greeted us. We highly recommend it and wouldn't hesitate to return.
review_2_text: Highly recommended. It's an excellent place. Very pretty, super comfortable, and has all the spaces for an excellent break. Very affordable for such a beautiful, comfortable, and cozy place. A super quiet and very healthy neighborhood.
review_3_text: During a short stay, we were able to feel like we were with my family in a place with a lot of human warmth, clean and pleasant spaces. The apartment we used exceeded our expectations, with super special and friendly neighbors.
review_4_text: I invite you to enjoy this beautiful place, it is very cozy.
review_5_text: It's a very nice place, it's like feeling at home.

name: Hospedaje familiar el silencio
review_1_text: I found the cabins spectacular, excellently equipped. They have a spacious and clean bathroom for the property. I love the bed layout, and there's a TV and good Wi-Fi. Very cozy. It's true that it's very cold, but if you're well-equipped, it's super manageable. The owners' service is also very friendly and warm, making you feel very comfortable. The only drawback is that the mattresses aren't the most comfortable; my partner and I stayed on one that was already a bit dented.
review_2_text:
Excellent place, excellent service!!! A highly recommended place to rest and return!!!!

And best of all, we're very forgetful and always lose things on every trip! We left something here, and they kindly sent it to our destination!! They've never returned an item to us before!!! Spectacular!!!
review_3_text:
Great place, very comfortable, clean, and safe.
Right next to the Cascade of Silence.
review_4_text:
The cabins are comfortable and cozy, clean and with very complete services in general. The attention of Mr. Jairo and his wife is unbeatable, very friendly and helpful, always with a good attitude and disposition.
It would only improve the leak that falls when it clears because you can hear something loud, although with the tiredness of the day and the cold you end up falling asleep 😅.
review_5_text: Establishing contact by telephone or WhatsApp and social networks was quite complicated. They offered us two lodging options, one in Cabañas El Silencio and another in a new cabin (more expensive, we thought it would be more cozy). We chose the second option, the people who welcomed us were friendly and the place was very neat and clean, but the noise from the road in front of the place made it impossible to rest, all night and early morning the external noise was constant (motorcycles at full speed , trucks, people) in addition, the structure of the cabin is two floors and has approximately 6 rooms and vibrates and moves just by walking, and you can even hear the other guests speaking, zero privacy and silence.

name: Hotel Royal Plaza Resort S.B.
review_1_text: Looked at this hotel yesterday. The desk clerk was asked directly if the hotel's water was hot. Jennifer said the water was hot. We checked in at 3pm to cold water. The hotel desk was informed of the problem with the water twice by my wife. She was informed the water would be hot in a little while. The hotel clerk said Hot water is only available in the morning. Hot waterisn't subjective,  Jennifer attempted to convince us that cold water was indeed hot. Rediculious the way we were treated. The woman outright lied to me and was unapologetic and surly with me when I challenge her attitude. . She could have been truthful the previous days when asked about hot water. But she elected to lie. Not a hotel i can recommend.
review_2_text:
Hotel is very clean and well located  in the center off the city
Only issue  the hot water is limited
Only in the morning
review_3_text:
The attention of the administrator Stella was terrible, always a bad attitude towards everything, complicated, bad, expensive, anyway...
And apart from that there is no hot water and in the rainy season it is necessary.
review_4_text: Bastante cómodo y agradable, muy buena atención y súper limpio.
review_5_text: Un hotel bien ubicado, las habitaciones son limpias, lindas y en general son confortables pero el servicio de las personas que atienden es pésimo. Hacen preguntas y comentarios muy imprudentes. Una energía que da ganas de irse.

name: HOTEL EL CENTAURO
review_1_text: Ideal
review_2_text: Excellent facilities, very good service and location. Of all the hotels I've stayed at when I've been to Lebanon, this has been the one that made me feel most comfortable.
review_3_text: I stayed on Saturday, February 15 - Sunday, February 16. I really liked the place, which was very comfortable to rest and had a private bathroom in the room and good additional services. The attention was great, they were always attentive if we required anything and that we were comfortable.
review_4_text: They do not have hot water for the children's bath and there is no parking or breakfast service. I have stayed in other places for the same price with all the aforementioned services.
review_5_text:
El baño estaba tapado, no se parece a las fotos, no hay servicio de cocina, mucho ruido, el cuarto tenia humedad, la atención de la propietaria pésima, al comunicarle los daños del cuarto, no lo solucionaron.
Rta: Terrible su respuesta,  se supone que tienen un control de seguridad en el ingreso al hotel, donde registran el documento y el nombre, que no quiera reconocer el mal funcionamiento es otra cosa, no lo recomiendo.

name: MS Casa Paraíso Murillo
review_1_text:
We originally planned to stay just two nights in Casa Paraiso but kept extending and ended up staying a full week.

This hotel is really a lodge with lovingly built on extensions. The floors are wood, the beds are large and comfortable, the bathrooms have warm showers. Everything — including the common and dining room — is tastefully decorated and cozy.

Casa Paraiso is locally owned and operated and Gonzalo, who runs it, makes you feel like an intimate guest more than a tourist.

I would especially recommend Casa Paraiso to those looking to write or spend quiet hours reading. We’re journalists and stoped here to file a story - Gonzalo let us use a little cafe, only open to guests, which was a fantastic place to work.

If you’re coming to Murillo, there’s no where I’d recommend more to stay.
review_2_text: We chose Casa Paraíso as our accommodation in the town of Murillo on the recommendation of a friend from Bogota, and we couldn't have been more satisfied. The owner, Gonzalo, and his wife were extremely kind and accommodating. The room was excellent, offering everything two travelers like us could wish for: comfortable beds, a spacious room, and a hot shower. The cleanliness was top-notch. I would particularly like to highlight Mr. Gonzalo, who, despite our lack of Spanish knowledge, helped us organize a hike to the hot springs and the incredibly beautiful Paramo. On the second day of our stay in Murillo, he organized a jeep tour to the hamlet of Canaan, where we got to experience demanding rural life. Every day we were treated to excellent tea made from coca leaves. In the end, he gifted us a piece of quartz and also a volcanic stone that had flown into Murillo like a burning bomb during the eruption of the Nevado del Ruiz volcano in 1985. This gesture means a lot to me and will always remind me of our wonderful stopover in Murillo and at Casa Paraíso. Once again, thank you to Gonzalo and his wife.
review_3_text:
We stayed here for 4 nights while we did 2 tours in the national park. Like the name says; it’s a little paradise in this laidback town. Gonzalo, the host, is super sweet and does everything to give you a great stay. In Murillo, the houses don’t really have heating but in Casa Paraiso you can get as many blankets as you want, tea to warm up and the hot shower is one of the best we’ve encountered in Colombia.

It’s beautifully decorated and very cosy, feels like a home. In the salon there are beautiful books to read.

Wifi works great, considering this remote location. Download is 5 Mbps.

We could also park the car safely inside the gate.

There are 2 friendly big dogs!

In short; we loved it!
review_4_text: A beautiful gem in Murillo! Firstly, the place is so beautiful and quirky. Silvia is so  warm and welcoming, each day she made tea for me at 5.30am before I head out on my tours. The shower is HOT and the bed has so many blankets you won't get cold in the night. Would recommend the place to anyone on an adventure in Murillo.
review_5_text: It is an incredible place, very quiet and impeccable, its host Don Gonzalo is very kind and provides information about the places of interest of the place and its surroundings.

name: HOTEL CALLE REAL DEL LIBANO TOLIMA
review_1_text: Super recommended, economical, very good service, it's really worth taking it.
review_2_text: Good value for money. Located in the center of the town and very close to the Zona Rosa (a popular shopping area, so be aware of the noise at night if you're traveling on a weekend). Clean and friendly staff.
review_3_text: The hotel is cozy, the rooms, although small, are comfortable, and the staff is very friendly and attentive. The reason I rate it 3 stars is that there were constant interruptions in the water service. While this is not a problem since you are outside most of the time, it was somewhat annoying.
review_4_text: Very good service, very clean and cozy
review_5_text: Excellent hotel. It has parking, is close to the center, has hot water, is clean, and has good service. Highly recommended. $70,000 per couple.

name: Hostal Casa Celeste
review_1_text: Located on the main square but as the town isnt very busy it was all good. The room is basic but very clean. Marcella who runs the place also speaks English and is very amicable and helpful. It was nice to meet her. And also Ofir who runs the shop downstairs and make a wonderful coffee with cinamon. We also met a coffee producer (Salinas) who works on producing a more sustainable coffee and has won already some rewards for the quality of his coffee. He gave us a lot of explanations and it was another great encounter.
review_2_text: Great location facing the main square, clean rooms and the two sisters who run the place are so helpful and nice. They know English which made life easier. There’s a store downstairs so that helpful also and restaurants 50-100’ away. Murillo is a little town and it’s like going back in time. I walked from my room to the waterfalls. Cascada el silencio. So beautiful
review_3_text: Excellent, we stayed on February 15 with a group of friends and family for the Murillo a-letters challenge. We loved the location, close to everything; restaurants, cafes, its very well preserved plank architecture. We slept very well, your hosts Marcela and Orfi were very special, always ready to help us and guide us in everything, we felt very welcomed, it is definitely one of those places that stays in your heart!! We will definitely return!
review_4_text: Excellent location on the main square, there's a super-stocked mini-market at the entrance, the hostel has incredible stories, the people who served us were wonderful, the place is magical, very quiet, cozy, I felt like I rested very well.
review_5_text:
Casa Celeste es el lugar perfecto para visitar el hermoso pueblo de Murillo. Los cuartos son cómodos, tienen agua caliente, y la casa, una de las más antiguas del parque, es hermosa. Su anfitriona es muy amable y atenta para vivir una experiencia muy agradable.
Altamente recomendada.

name: La Ranchita del Líbano
review_1_text:
This place is incredible! The space is a  traditional farmhouse lovingly restored to preserve local culture and architecture, but with great upgrades (like comfortable beds and (real) hot showers).

It’s about a 5-10 minute walk to the town square - close to restaurants, bars, everything. Yet, once you step inside all the street noise disappears.

There’s an internal courtyard and garden (extra great for cyclists like us looking for a safe place to keep bikes during our stay), a coffee bar featuring local coffee farmers, and even a small library.

The host is welcoming and passionate about the region and its coffee culture. Can’t recommend La Ranchita enough.
review_2_text: They’re not kidding when they say you’re part of their family as soon as you make a reservation or show up. Very friendly and helpful, generous with their time and coffee, and big breakfasts. The rooms are comfortable, ample hot water, and the casona is beautiful. Nothing against Pantágora which is an impressive hotel, but it’s a conference center while this is real Líbano, including location in-town but sufficiently away from the plaza to be quiet.
review_3_text: Absolutely loved my stay here! The host are some of the most attentive and caring people I’ve ever had the pleasure of meeting. The home itself is beautiful and roomy. I will definitely be coming back and recommend that anyone visiting El Líbano stay here during that time.
review_4_text:
Wonderful place! Not only for it's beauty but also because you can feel the love they put on every piece of the house.
Comfy beds, fast wifi and silence for a great rest at night.
Amanda was a great and caring host 🥰
Highly recommended.
review_5_text: La Ranchita is your gateway to Tolima, an incredible hub for unexpected wonders: volcanos, thermal springs, forests, culinary delights, unpolluted culture and meaningful exchange and connection. The place itself is central in Libron, within walking distance to everything the city has to offer. It is well appointed; a renovated hacienda that has been thoroughly revamped.  The space is bright and colorful, and has a great ambience with plants, a central fountain, lounging areas.  The rooms were super comfortable, warm showers and great bathrooms.  The bed was very comfortable, with lots of room to store your stuff and make you feel like you’re home while you’re there. Extremely clean.  The breakfasts were delicious!  Made with local farm eggs, handmade arepas and other local treats.  And who can forget the coffee, sourced from a friend of the family, the coffee is as good as it gets.  The owners also were great in helping you to navigate all the incredible experiences, restaurants and such locally.  They gave me insights and facilitated me connecting with a local coffee finca, a cocoa finca, a place that facilitated excursions to see the incredible wildlife, and a trip to some of the nondescript thermal rivers and hot springs. They helped me figure out a day-trip to Murillo as well, and I had the inside track on what makes the community special and was able to have a fuller experience as a result.  So if you’re in Tolima, first, make sure to base your experience out of Libron.  Second, make sure to stay at La Ranchita, a great hotel experience that puts the guest’s experience first.

name: Ecoparque Nevado del Ruíz
review_1_text:
I was luck to meet one of the owners and she shared her story of the property/farm being in her family for 3 generations. Such a beautiful place. I was so lucky to have seen the snow peak (nevado del Ruiz) as the cloud opened.

I really had NO Expectations so finding this spot was just perfect for me and my friend (we were on a motorcycle expedition).

The staff was very nice and the owners still work the farm(they grow potatoes and have dairy cows).

At over 3,700 meters in altitude the views can be literally breathtaking and heart stopping all at the same time. Most definitely not for everyone.

If you are looking for a clean bed with a roof over your head out in nature (almost wild) this is definitely the place to stay.

If you are wanting high quality / luxury this maybe  NOT the place for you.

The housekeeping team were not just amazing at their job but wonderful people too. We laughed, played, and they guided us in choosing the best hiking spots and tours to nearby Termales. The food was a tasteful delight, adding to a flawless stay. This was a 10/10 experience, and I can't wait to go back!

A pleasant and quiet place to rest and get away from the noise, with a magnificent view of the snow when the weather permits. It is a mountainous and cold area, so good shelter is recommended at night. The landscapes are very beautiful during the day.

The access road, 3 km long, is uncovered and in fair condition. Cobblestone in poor condition for the most part, with concrete rails in good condition on the steepest climbs, huge but shallow puddles in winter. Not recommended for low cars. They provide little information about it when contact is made.

The facilities are beautiful and varied, although the need for good maintenance is beginning to become evident. It has green areas and trails to explore and many places for nice souvenir photos.

It has a small farm with some animals, and a large grazing area for dairy cattle.

The managers are friendly and very helpful. I think there is a lack of more continuous attention from the owner and not leaving everything in the hands of those in charge.

The only positive thing I have to say about this place is the view.

The locals tell me that they want to promote turism in the area. Unfortunately they have a long way to go and it starts by being proactive in customer service. Small steps will achieve bigger goals. For any international tourist, I would suggest stay at a low cost hotel near the city and just use your cash at restaurants near by. The food at this place is over priced and the taste is mediocre.

For lodging,

It seems to me people exaggerate and make false promises.

1. Customer service- Our guide was kind, but you can tell she is being overwhelmed with her other responsibilities, which results in half done responses.

2. Method of payment- as a experienced tourist it’s always good to have cash as an emergency and so it came in handy. However the owner lied to us, we were informed we were able to pay with credit card payments on arrival, (keep in mind I payed the first half through PayPal, which is a story on its own) upon arrival we were told that the lodging is not accepted for credit cards only the restaurant(keep in mind restaurant and hotel is the same building) obviously I’m upset with the lies, but I payed in cash.

3. No room service/no hot showers -

Again with more false promises, were advised complimentary breakfast and hot showers. Well we did get breakfast, overcooked eggs and stale bread. But no hot showers, and keep in mind it’s very cold in the cabin, no comfort at all. Lastly,  there was no cleaning in the bathroom or the bed. There is Internet but very slow and well there is tv if you wanted to watch Netflix or local tv. Overall my cabin experience wasn’t what I anticipated.

Message to the owner: open you mind, and be more open to foreigners who intend to invest in your towns. Experience like these disuade us from returning. If your settled with how your business runs, then I am right what I posted. No growth in the service industry for international tourist.

review_5_text:
I visited the National Rice Park motivated by an interest in rice culture and the opportunity to explore a new place as a family. The park has potential, but currently has several areas for improvement.

*Location and Access*:
The park is located in the municipality of Alvarado, on the road to Piedras; close to the main Ibagué-Mariquita road (here there is a billboard at the entrance to the municipality of Alvarado that helps identify the place. However, the signage from this point could be clearer). There is parking for around 25 cars.

*Attractions and Activities*:
The main attraction is a wagon tour pulled by a tractor that includes visits to the museum, mills, crops and a river where it is possible to enter. However, this service is limited to certain times (10:30 am and 2:00 pm) and depends on having at least 10 people to perform it. I recommend visiting in a group to guarantee this experience. Additionally, there is a swimming pool, games area (table tennis) and hammocks to rest, although these activities are not very innovative. The park also has accommodation.

*Positive Aspects:*
I highlight the farm for its abundant trees and the friendly attention of the staff.

*Negative Aspects:*

1. The food, although good in taste and presentation, did not seem fresh and some products seemed to have been reheated several times.

2. Problems with insect control: there were many mosquitoes and flies.

3. The pool was dirty, with branches, leaves and insects floating.

4. An unpleasant smell around the pool, like accumulated water or shed water.

5. Lack of clarity and promotion of services, making it difficult to fully enjoy the main route.

6. If the park is called "National Rice Park," more activities related to this product could be included, such as gastronomic or educational experiences, and even selling rice.

*Quality-Price Relationship*:
The entrance fee ($16,000) is reasonable if you use the pool, and the tour price ($77,000, including lunch) would be fair if it were guaranteed to take place. However, the dining experience needs improvement.

*Recommended Duration*:
If you only plan to enjoy the pool and have lunch, 3 hours is enough. If you include the tour, estimate around 5 hours.

*Would I go back?*
Not for now. Perhaps in the future if the aforementioned aspects can be improved.

name: Posada el portal de la Loma
review_1_text:
Colonial house with veranda, caring owner, mountain vistas and tranquility - the Posada Portal de La Loma is located just 1 km from Pesca's center and offers quiet accommodation in family ambience, think BnB style. We stayed 2 nights and enjoyed Doña Julia's hospitality, as well as the beautiful natural attractions surrounding Pesca: Laguna Pantano Grande, El Palmar (small wax palm valley), the rural road to Toca, lots of paramos all around.

Bring your mountain bike, if you can!

If you book via booking.com a superb breakfast is included. We received fabulous breakfast and family stories. There were cats, delicious coffee, rocking chairs on the veranda and beautiful flowers in the garden - great to relax off the beaten path and enjoy Boyacense hospitality. Lunch recommendation: Restaurante Comamos Trucha, a 10 minute drive (Pesca itself is sleepy and does not offer many options - at least not in low season when we were there)
review_2_text:
A country inn in the classic grandmother's style.
The attention from Julia is first class, the family is all very friendly and the place is special, a very comfortable rural house in Pesca, with beautiful landscapes and a calm to rest and disconnect.
Nearby is the wasteland of Laguna Grande, Iza, Tibasosa, Monguí, among others.
review_3_text:
¡RECOMENDADO!
De los mejores y más hermosos sitios en los que he estado:
1. La vista (el paisaje) es espectacular.
2. La casa es antigua (muy linda) y está muy bien cuidada. Cuartos y baños 😉👌🏼
3. Todo permanece aseado y ordenado.
4. La atención es excelente: todos son muy amables y serviciales.
5. Hay parqueadero para varios carros.
6. Es muy seguro.
7. Es muy privada (no se escuchan los ruido de la gente del pueblo), sin embargo, esta a sólo a menos de 10 mins del pueblo.

Volveré muy pronto.

Seeing that the return was still taking a while, we decided to go sightseeing in a nearby town so that by the time we arrived that evening, the room would be ready for us.

Upon arriving at the hotel, we found the hotel owner on duty... We arrived at reception and when we asked for the room key, the hotel owners approached us first, asking us which room we were going to and how much we had paid.

She immediately said there had been a mistake, that the afternoon employee had given us the wrong price and we couldn't take the room, so she would refund our money and that would settle the whole issue, or that we could pay the excess and then take the room since it cost $70,000 more than we were initially told.

As a consumer, I understand that it was entirely the employee's mistake, but I also understand that the consumer is not to blame for matters like this.

There is even a law that protects consumers in these cases (Consumer Statute - Law 1480 of 2011).

Damaris Natalia and her companion (the hotel owners) proceeded to call the police so we could work together to resolve the situation.

The police did indeed find out why we were being refunded, but one of the officers told us that since they were refunding our money, it was best to accept it and look for another hotel by 9:30 pm.

The message is as follows, dear consumer.

It's better to pass on, find a better location, pay a little more, and hopefully find ethical, honest, and humane professionals who are capable of taking responsibility for their mistakes according to what ethics and the law suggest.

Pass on, read other users' reviews carefully, and avoid awkward moments and undesirable services.

review_2_text: Great space with an amazing view, I loved the peacefulness and atmosphere of the place. Really recommended if you want to have a good time with friends or your partner.
review_3_text: I only took the restaurant service, it is very good, the food was great, the view from the restaurant is magnificent, I walked on the glass bridge, it is a must-see place on Lake Tota, highly recommended, excellent experience.
review_4_text: A spectacular place, everyone is very friendly, its facilities are beautiful, delicious food, highly recommended
review_5_text: Great view, design and details but the service and food are not up to the price and what they want to offer, they have a lot of potential but they are still missing. We ordered several trout that were boneless and had excess oil, the seafood casserole did not seem fresh.

name: Decameron refugio Santa Inés - Afiliado
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text: A beautiful place but be carefull as they charge by the person not by room. Also take a shower at night as there's little hot water in the morning as everybody is using. Bring warm clothing as is gets old there. The dining facilities there are good.
review_2_text:
Starting with the good, wonderful views, great bathroom, balcony. Very nice location by a beautiful lake.

However this resort does not deserve the name Decameron...  Wifi never worked, no hangers, no soap holders, no complimentary water, and no extra pillows.  The breakfast was very lacking as well. This hotel has all the makings of one that should be 1/2 the price, 2-3 stars.  Service was mediocre at best.  I am writing this in the hope someone from Decameron reads it and sends someone to improve service.  As someone who knows hotels and the quality of Decameron resorts, This one is currently NOT worth the price paid
review_3_text: Lovely views. Food was good and reasonable prices.
review_4_text: It's a beautiful hotel
review_5_text: Good service beautiful view

name: Hotel Hacienda El Salitre
address: Km. 3 Vìa, Hotel Hacienda del Salitre, Toca
review_1_text: Historical location very worth the visit! Service is amazing because staff is all very helpful, friendly, great attitude. The rooms are beautiful despite having been constructed hundreds of years ago and the thermal pools are relaxing and clean. Food is also delicious! The iconic tree in the courtyard alone is worth the visit :)
review_2_text: Beautiful and well maintained. This historic hotel is an excellent example of colonial Spanish architecture. Old world charm abounds here though the rooms are a bit small, as in the day.   Not recommended for those with mobility issues as there are no ramps AND the cobbled stone floors are rough.
review_3_text:
It's a very nice place, with termal water, the food was delicious, except for one out of 2 pineapple juice that tasted like the pineapple was spoiled.
The cazuela, envueltos, arepas, the fruit, the cheese, the fruit salad, the Baltimore chicken, the rest of the foods was wonderful.
The people who work there are super nice.
It is not adapted for people with mobility issues or on wheelchairs.
review_4_text: Such a beautiful place, you can spend the day there without going in the city. The food and service was A+++
review_5_text: Transported back in time and treated to an experience of tranquillity in beautiful surroundings. Possibly Paipa’s finest hotel and spa. Top quality menu and food with generous portions and set in the most amazing colonial homestead . Rooms with private natural thermal spas available. Fairly priced an all round amazing experience. Highly recommended!!

name: Hospedaje Maria Valentina
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text:
Country-like place
Friendly prices
Beds should be replaced
review_2_text:
The good: The attention from both the lady and her daughter. Both were very kind.

The bad: Almost everything... They're like prefabricated "cabins" that move every time you take a step. They're freezing. The mattress is extremely hard. Too small. There's practically nowhere to put things. The bathroom is tiny, the shower is freezing; even if you want to warm it up a bit, you run the risk of the heel falling off. There were several dogs around, and one of them started barking at 2 a.m. and continued for hours. We couldn't sleep at all.
The stairs to the room are extremely narrow and risky if you're carrying suitcases.

I would definitely never come back.
review_3_text: Excellent cabins to spend with the family, pleasant climate, very close to the Tota lagoon and Playa Blanca.
review_4_text: Excelente lugar, muy limpio y la atención de primera, excelentes anfitriones, doña Estela muy encantadora
review_5_text: Very good service.

name: Hotel Llanero
review_1_text: Excellent place to rest, impeccable service 👍
review_2_text:
Excellent service, clean and pleasant rooms. Very quiet, get plenty of rest during a work trip.

It has a TV. Closet in very good condition, clean.  Super nice bed.
The bathroom is somewhat narrow, but well equipped. Hot water.
review_3_text: The only thing to mention is that at night on Saturday the area is lonely
review_4_text: Very comfortable, economical, has parking and is very well decorated, good service
review_5_text:
Buena atención, las habitacion estan en buen estado y cuenta con tv, wifi.
Pero sus precios son muy altos. Junto al parqueadero.

name: Hotel Portal de Iza
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text:
Character and tranquility in spades
5/5 Stayed Nov 2018
Regina Poveda

What an amazing experience in Boyaca!!! When you arrive, it wasnt what we expected but was way better!.
From the get-go Ricardo was a brilliant host. Really informative and warm. The place is just the comfiest heaven, and the decor is cozy and welcoming. We loved to see green mountains and fresh flowers from their garden throughout, little  kitchen with everything you need to make a nice breakfast. Beds were so comfy. Nice Bathroom, great water pressure and the icing on the cake it has a Jacuzzi!!.
Fresh air aplenty. Literally 10 mins walk to Iza. It was fantastic. Ricardo also was super-accommodating with information and suggestions.
It's like a secret hideaway in the perfect location. Thanks Ricardo for your kind hospitality.
We definitely go back in our next visit to Colombia.
review_2_text: Very nice place to stay and rest. The jacuzzi is a hit
review_3_text: Great looking place near to beautiful small towns and breathtaking sceneries.
review_4_text: Super
review_5_text: The place is very beautiful. It's 800 meters from the town of Iza, which makes it very convenient. The people who work there are very kind and attentive, and their service is impeccable. The cabins have a very beautiful and distinctive architecture and are fully equipped (bathroom, beds, kitchen, dining area, and even a jacuzzi).

name: Celaví Hostel - Monguí
review_1_text: This is a wonderful hostel run by a lovely friendly couple Diana and Quentin. Mongui itself is a beautiful little pueblo and this is a fantastic place to base yourself. A super pretty hostel with lovely wooden floors and great decor. Incredibly clean with a good kitchen. Diana made us very welcome from check in serving us fresh coffee as we obviously looked really tired from our long bus journey. And Quentin took time to chat with us that night in Spanish and English. Both gave great advice on what hikes to do for our level and places to eat and drink. All in all this was a magical stay in a wonderful Boyacá pueblo in a beautiful tranquil hostel with fantastic hosts. Thank you both.
review_2_text: Diana and Quentin are more than just hosts, they truly make staying at Celavi feel like being at home. Their passion and knowledge of Monguí and the surrounding region are contagious, inspiring you to explore and make the most of your trip. I absolutely loved the concept they've created around community and sustainable, eco-friendly tourism. I had originally planned to stay for just two days but ended up staying a whole week at their lovely hostel, always clean, warm and welcoming. I’m sure I’ll be back again!
review_3_text: There is no need to search for an other hostel in Mongui than Celavi : comfy, super clean, kitchen fully equipped and well located, all of this for the best value for money (35000 cop / night in dorm, as per april 2025). But what makes it even more special is the couple who owns the place. Kind and helpful at the highest point, they would for sure help you having the best time possible in Mongui, guiding you to the best see and do here or elsewhere in the country. Don't hesitate to ask them their contacts for visiting the paramo of Oceta, you won't regret it. You won't regret either spending lovely evenings with them and the other guests, in a shared spirit of friendship. Your only regret will be to leave Mongui, as you soon realize you feel really well here.
review_4_text:
One of my top 3 all time hostels.
Sparkling clean, Quentin and Diana are super helpful nice owners. The hostel is new and the rooms are really comfortable. It's also in a great location. So quiet and peaceful at night but close to everything in the centre of Mongui.
The pictures don't do it justice.
review_5_text:
Amazing place. Facilities are excellent (nice beds with curtains, warm showers, etc.), but the real great thing are Diana and Quenten who run the place: it's like being part of the family. Dinner together, go for drinks with them and their friends, etc. They also organize a great deal on a hike to the paramo.

10 out 10, would recommend

name: Villa de Moya Hotel Monguí
review_1_text: Excellent location and service. The room was super comfortable, clean and safe. We loved everything, we would definitely return to the hotel without thinking twice. And the delicious breakfast. Everyone was very friendly and always willing to help. Mongui is very beautiful and a great destination to go with the family🤗🥰🤗
review_2_text:
An excellent place to visit the town, close to the Calicanto bridge and very well located.

It completely exceeded my expectations.
review_3_text: What an incredible place, beautiful that tells very beautiful stories, a space full of culture and modernity. The best thing is the warm and very friendly staff. Thank you
review_4_text: Modern, clean, comfortable rooms, very good staff attention, the location is on the side of the Calicanto bridge, close to restaurants and the central square

name: Hotel Litavira Vintage
review_1_text: Super
review_2_text: Wow
review_3_text: Very average, beds that move due to bad materials, lousy breakfast, they pass leftover jam from another client already used, they do not have any more food options or even coffee, the same person who attends reception works in the kitchen and dining room, I don't know what other functions he will have, and they have no idea about the events in the sector.
review_4_text:
Mi estancia en el Hotel Litavira Vintage fue enriquecedora. El estilo colonial del hotel crea un ambiente encantador. Las habitaciones amplias y la posibilidad de tener una nevera en la habitación son aspectos positivos. Sin embargo, hay algunos detalles a considerar

El encanto histórico del hotel es innegable, espacio suficiente para sentirse cómodo y más si viajas con niños.
El desayuno  Aunque repetitivo, es conveniente para los viajeros.

Las habitaciones están limpias, pero es importante mantener la calidad y la abundancia de sabanas y mantas es incómodo porque se vuelve pesado y algunas son muy rústicas lo cual no permite un sueño reparador.

El hotel está céntrico, lo que facilita explorar la zona a pie y regresar cómodamente.
review_5_text: Las instalaciones son antiguas, de hecho decidieron basar su estilo "vintage" a partir de que la estructura ya tiene tiempo construida. Podría mejorar el tener más tiempo disponible el agua caliente en las habitaciones, intentar modernizarlas un poco y la cobertura del internet definitivamente deja mucho qué desear. El desayuno es básico. La atención como tal de la recepción sí es muy buena, súper atentos. Es un hotel para algunas noches, no tanto para estancias medias o largas. Puntos muy positivos su ubicación y tiene ascensor que es algo muy útil para personas con movilidad reducida.

name: Hotel Camino Real
opening_hours: Monday: 12:00 AM – 11:30 PM|Tuesday: 12:00 AM – 11:30 PM|Wednesday: 12:00 AM – 11:30 PM|Thursday: 12:00 AM – 11:30 PM|Friday: 12:00 AM – 11:30 PM|Saturday: 12:00 AM – 11:30 PM|Sunday: 12:00 AM – 11:30 PM
review_1_text:
Such a beautiful place, peaceful, comfortable. Good wifi and the staff is very friendly and attentive.
We used to go when I was a child and their gardens were amazing, so that's the only thing that needs some maintenance.
review_2_text: Excellent tota lake view, very peaceful, affordable
review_3_text: Cozy, great typical food, the view is just breathtaking
review_4_text: A bit pricey for what it has
review_5_text: We were assigned a wooden cabin inside the hotel, with humidity, bad smell, super small rooms, uneven floor that did not correspond to the published photos. When we saw that it did not correspond to what was published, we requested relocation, but half of the people still had to stay in this unpleasant cabin.

name: Hospedaje Portal de la cascada - Mongui
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text: Good hôtel whit correct price and friendly staff
review_2_text: Offered to pick me up, really nice
review_3_text: Economical and comfortable. Perfect
review_4_text: Wonder place and wonderful hotel
review_5_text: La atención de Zully y servicio excelente, las habitaciones impecables, cómodas y silenciosas, con vista espectacular. Hay nevera para guardar lo que se requiera, hay lavaplatos que se puede usar, cafetera para el tinto de la mañana. Gracias por la experiencia.

name: HOTEL SUITE SANTA LUCIA .
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text: Regular
review_2_text: Lousy mattress, sink clogged, dirty bathrooms. It used to be a motel and they transformed it into a horrible hotel. Don't waste your time look for a real hotel
review_3_text: It actually looks like a remodeled motel. The soft and uncomfortable beds, the dirty bathrooms, the clogged sink, the humidity and dust in the terrible room. For what we paid we expected more. I don't recommend it at all.
review_4_text: Muy malo, es un motel reformado, mucha humedad se siente, uno se hunde en el colchón, el baño queda metido dentro de la habitación sin separación o puerta, lavamanos tapado y muy costoso para lo que ofrece
review_5_text: From the first contact to request information, the attention was great. The hotel is basic, the photos may be a little retouched but a standard room for 2 adults and 1 child up to 6 years old can rest perfectly. The location is excellent and what I value most is the attention of its owner. Always attentive to any request made to him and without any qualms. As a tip, I would say that the bathrooms need a couple of renovations, especially in terms of joints that deteriorate due to humidity, and the rest are completely satisfied with the service. If you are looking for a place to rest after a long day of touring Boyacá, I recommend it.

name: Hotel Restaurante Dylam
review_1_text: Really nice people, the attention they gave us was amazing. kinda far away from the good places to visit on the zone tho, so you gotta rent a bike, which I consider a little dangerous because the road is small and there are so many big trucks and buses running around. I personally find this spot perfect to stay because I took my car and went wherever I wanted easily, they have off course parking spots, and finally the view from the restaurant is really nice.
review_2_text: The hostel is quite cozy. Mrs. Diana was very kind to us and recommended several activities and restaurants nearby. The breakfast is very rich and the restaurant's view of Lake Tota is spectacular in the afternoons. The rooms are small, but big enough to spend a couple of nights. They have parking service, which is spectacular!
review_3_text: Excellent place, a wonderful view and great service. Diana is always attentive and aware of the guest...I will return soon!!
review_4_text:
A powerful cold, an incredible breakfast, an exceptional view and a tranquility that is priceless.

10/10

Greetings to Diana, what a great person and attention.
review_5_text:
Best place on the way, cozy, comfortable, friendly. A virgin cold
There is monopoly
Diana you are the best

name: San Benito Hotel
address: 250 Metros Via a Guatika, Tibasosa-Parque Natural Guátika, Tibasosa
review_1_text: Our stay in Tibasosa was spectacular & San Benito Hotel was the star of the show- a true gem of the Andies! Incredibly friendly & welcoming hosts- you come as guests & leave a friends! The room was impeccably clean,  the property quiet and peaceful with absolutely breathtaking views! And have I mentioned our fresh homemade breakfasts included in the stay?! Wow-- Delicious!! Each day we were served dishes local to this Boyacá region of Colombia. I want to make a visit to San Benito Hotel now an annual occurance. Could not recommend this property more!
review_2_text: Beautiful new hotel overlooking Tibasosa. Within walking distance of the plaza. The owners manage the place and take good care of every detail. Beds are comfortable and a delicious breakfast is included.
review_3_text: The host has an amazing attention, he was so helpful and everyday he offer us a cup of tea or coffee free, also the breakfast were extremely delicious, the rooms and the view are really amazing!
review_4_text: Great stay at Hotel Benito. Super friendly owners, very helpful. Great, modern and clean rooms, all with a balcony. Delicious home made tipical Colombian breakfast. Highly recomended!
review_5_text: It is very satisfying to arrive at a place that exceeds your expectations and makes your stay a pleasant experience. San Benito is a place where love, taste and care are perceived in every detail, a product of the seal imprinted by its excellent hosts: Bladimir and Emilsen. We were 2 adults and a 4 year old child, all 3 of us loved it. And the special breakfast for the child, an unforgettable detail. Totally recommended.

name: Big Day Hotels
review_1_text: Nice hotel. Everything clean,Good rooms, awesome views. Hot water, would be wonderful if some day there's heater in the rooms. Really good breakfast and "agua de panela"
review_2_text: Ok
review_3_text: Too expensive
review_4_text:
A place with dreamlike landscapes, the hotel is beautiful, however there are many deficiencies, it has incredible potential to provide a great experience, they have everything, from infrastructure to the surrounding landscapes to be very well positioned.

A place for people who are not so demanding in their stay.
review_5_text:
In reality it is much less than expected and offered.
There were only two people serving, the room had a bad smell from the siphons, the television did not work and neither did the phones to call reception. Being a very cold place, they should have space heaters.
The dock is completely abandoned and does not provide the necessary safety conditions. It could be much better if the owners paid special attention to real customer service.
They offer a boat ride that never existed and the ecological trail is a place of public access for anyone.

name: Villa Alioc
review_1_text: Quiet, clean, excellent location, with parking, very good service.
review_2_text:
Spectacular stay, the facilities are impeccable, comfortable beds and a very nice and tidy house, also very economical. Mrs. Sandra is a divine person who was always attentive to any situation.
We will surely return🤍
review_3_text: Hotel 🏨 for family in IZA Boyacá... Relax and tranquility. Green nest in the heart of Boyacá... Excellent and cheap...
review_4_text: Excellent place to rest. Location close to town
review_5_text: Un lugar muy tranquilo y acogedor. Excelente atención. Muy recomendado

name: Hotel H53
review_1_text: This is a great place to rest of your day or week, good service and delicious food!!
review_2_text: Its a place to sleep, nothing more. The elevator was not working and the room was on 3th floor. If you have heavy baggage its a pain.
review_3_text: A modern hotel with comfortable beds, a very varied breakfast and excellent staff service, everyone very friendly. The bar on the terrace is very nice.
review_4_text: A great hotel, worthy of 4 stars, has its own parking, elevator and free breakfast, located in the central area.
review_5_text:
Probably the best hotel in Sogamoso. We arrived at 8 at night, it was like a king and the receptionist Ricardo attended to us, expedited the check in to see that we were going with children. Something that is appreciated when what you want is to get to rest. The rooms are spacious, beds well made and clean. There is free parking, pets are accepted and there are supermarkets and restaurants nearby.
Just to improve the breakfast buffet with a little more selection.
Highlight the work of Ricardo the receptionist. Please promote him as he does his excellent work.

name: Hotel Tota Eliseo Playa Blanca Lago de Tota
review_1_text:
I do not recommend this hotel, much less the reservation mechanism they manage. Initially we were going to book through Airbnb, but the host asked us to book directly with them. We made the reservation two weeks in advance and, when we were already arriving in Tota from Bogotá - which is not a short journey - the man canceled citing a supposed breakdown. As a “solution”, he offered us a room with an outside bathroom and communal shower.

A total lack of respect for people's time and planning. In the end, we had to return because we couldn't find availability in other hotels.
review_2_text: I went during the week and was alone. Better for me, there is glamping at 130,000 a night for 2 adults and 1 child, good view near Playa Blanca.
review_3_text:
I loved the place, its location is excellent, the man who serves is very attentive.
It is very cold, but it is because of the location and the characteristics of the landscape, we had many blankets and the heater on but it was still cold; However, it is an experience that I would repeat a thousand times more.
I think the service-price ratio is good.
review_4_text: The hotel is very basic but for me it was not a problem because I was just looking for a place to rest for a few hours and that had a good view to enjoy the magic of the area. The administrator is very attentive and helpful, he helped us with everything we need, the view is incredible and the landscape around is fascinating
review_5_text:
It's lovely! I had the opportunity to stay at the glamping site, it is super basic but beautiful... waking up to the sunlight and that beautiful lake.
I totally recommend it. Don't forget to bring warm clothes as it may be a little cold. At Nobsa they sell very warm socks and great jackets for those cold weather.
It is a fair price and very welcoming.
It has excellent prices.
The only thing it doesn't have are snacks and drinks.
It's super easy to get to. It only has a steep climb at the beginning and the rest is flat and nice.
Supremely close to white silver.

name: Meraki Paipa hotel
review_1_text: Beautiful place surrounded by nature. Everything was excellent.

name: Hotel Cacique Plaza II
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text: Nice and comfortable hotel, spacious room, good service; with parking and delicious breakfast (meat and potato broth recommended)
review_2_text: One of the most amazing hotels I have ever been, I recomend this Hotel to anyone that will come to this beautiful place....
review_3_text:
Excellent hotel
Very comfortable and pleasant rooms
The internet connection could be improved a bit, but nothing that would spoil the experience. I would definitely come back!
review_4_text: Super nice, luxurious, super comfortable and large beds, super spacious room, excellent service, easy to get to and delicious breakfast, 10/10 and the best thing is the price
review_5_text: Para los viajeros y familias de paso por sogamoso, les recomiendo este hotel, excelencia en su servicio y que habitaciones tan limpias y baños pulcros, comodidad, excelente atención. De su personal siempre dispuestos a dar la milla extra, muy recomendado además excelentes precios.

name: Hostal Santa Isabel
review_1_text: The room is very dark and the shower was not clean. The place looks beautiful in the pictures but it is very disappointing in real life. They have a TV with loud volume that don’t let you sleep in a quiet and calm environment. I do not recommend this place.
review_2_text: Excellent service, super spacious rooms, with closet, very comfortable bed. The staff is very attentive, red wine in the morning, delicious breakfast in the middle of a colonial house, private garage service, many plants and a very native atmosphere
review_3_text: Super recommended this place!! It is quiet, very pleasant, it is beautiful, very neat, the connection with greenery and nature is close to the main park and all the most emblematic places. The people who run the place are very gentle and friendly, they make you feel at home, the food is delicious, they have a nice bar and seating areas... in short, a wonder just for disconnecting from the city.
review_4_text: The location of the hostel is excellent, one block from the Main Park where there are several places to have breakfast, lunch and dinner. Mrs. Nohora is very kind and attentive. The room we had was large and quite comfortable, we could also go out to the green area where there were hammocks and relax. The hostel is very quiet and relaxing. Recommended.
review_5_text: Un hotel muy hogareño, estuvimos buscando hotel sin reservación previa y dimos con este, los demás no estaban atendiendo. $40.000 por persona nos valió la noche, pedimos una habitación sencilla, tenía agua caliente y baño privado, televisión, muy acogedora. También nos ofrecieron una cabaña a $70.000 por persona la noche. Allí mismo hay imentación con desayunos o comidas de $10.000 en adelante. Por último, fueron muy amables, además es muy cerca de la plaza principal.

name: Alojamiento Chalet - Monguí
review_1_text: Spectacular! Super comfortable and well equipped. Located 10 minutes from the park (there is a fairly big climb to get there). Clean. The only detail is that the water is not very hot, but I think the same thing happens in all of Mongui.
review_2_text:
Los hosts fueron muy amables durante mi estadía.

Aunque el alojamiento queda un poco retirado del centro, la caminata es corta y se puede apreciar algo del pueblo.

También cabe destacar que está muy cerca de tiendas y puedes usar la cocina y la chimenea.

En general, la relación calidad/precio es muy buena.
review_3_text: Great stay in this little chalet with garden. Kitchen, laundry room, living room. Perfect for staying a few days and visiting the surrounding area. Warm welcome and very good price. I recommend.
review_4_text: Me gustó mucho el hospedaje, queda un poco retirado del parque principal, pero igual es increíble. El chalet es cómodo, tiene para encender la chimenea, perfecto para el clima frío. La atención de los encargados es excelente, siempre pendientes. Lo recomiendo mucho.
review_5_text:
Muy contento de haber encontrado este lugar. Tiene todo lo necesario para tomarlo como apartotel, sea el caso de alquiler de toda la casa, y todo se encontró muy limpio y ordenado. Incluyen una cocina de leña, una de gas (con quemadores de muy buena modulación) y varios utensilios de cocina en muy buen estado.

La casa queda cerca del centro del pueblo realmente, pero si van a pie, hay un par de calles relativamente empinadas que hay que pasar para llegar. Nada del otro mundo realmente, pero solo tomar en cuenta que todos estos lugares están entre lomas.

Si vienen de clima más cálido, aprendan a encender bien la fogata de la chimenea porque la casa en sí es fría, y en este lugar amanece como a 7° C (inicios de junio) así que tengan eso en cuenta.

Las camas (al menos la que me tocó) vienen con una gran cantidad de colchas y abrigamiento que a la hora de dormir funcionaron de maravilla, aun sin chimenea.

Recuerden que el agua en la zona no está tratada, así que asegurense de comprar un poco de agua para beber y cocinar al llegar (hay un abastesedor llamado Tienda Sildana como a 200 m antes, en la cima de una loma, donde venden entre otras cosas de comida y preparación, bolsas de agua grandes, como de seis litros).

Aún con todo esto, el ambiente del lugar es precioso y psara mis exigencias, absolutamente valió la pena llegar a quedarme aquí. Creo que este lugar queda entre mis favoritos por su cuenta y sin comparación, porque tiene una buena mezcla de privacidad, buen ambiente y excelente cordialidad y atención por parte de la anfitriona.

Definitivamente volvería a alquilar una habitación.

name: Cabañás Villa Rosita
review_1_text: Do yourself a bog favour and stay at this place when in the town. You won't find better service and better facilities, including an awesome local breakfast. The distance from the main square is very comfortable as it is walkable easily
review_2_text:
Great place!
Already the welcome is great, thank you to the boy for his kindness and his smile (as well as to the rest of the team).
The cabins are so cute, very clean and comfortable. And there is hot water in the shower :)
The breakfast is very good and complete.
The location is also great because it's away from the noise but not even 5 minutes' walk from the central square.
Plus they have a restaurant with very good dishes (and delicious fresh fruit juices and really cheap beers) which are very affordable.

This area is known for hiking and climbing, so there are plenty of outdoor activities to enjoy. There aren't any shops nearby, but there are frequent buses to Sogamoso and Monguí, so it was easy to go grocery shopping.

The town of Monguí itself is beautiful. I highly recommend this place, especially for digital nomads. I had a truly fulfilling stay!

My favorite was visiting the Páramo de Ocetá and Ciudad Perdida (a 6 hour hike!) - it's out of this world. I also got to check out the area by bus and while mountain biking + climbing with Camilo. We also made brick oven pizza which was so fun!

Overall, I really appreciate their approach to sustainable tourism. I extended my stay and was so sad to leave! 1000% recommend for real experiences of Boyacá, Colombia with amazing company 💕

review_1_text:
We recently had the pleasure of staying at the charming Hostal Villa Isabel in Aquitania, Boyacá, Colombia, and we are delighted to share our experience. From the moment we arrived, we realized that we had made a wise choice for our accommodation.

Our stay at the hostel was extremely pleasant. The room we stayed in was exceptionally clean and pleasant. We were impressed by the attention to detail and care that had been put into keeping the place spotless. Every time we returned to the room after a day of exploring the surroundings, we felt comfortable and relaxed.

But what truly made our stay at Hostal Villa Isabel exceptional were the hosts. From the very beginning, Alejandro, Deniss and his team welcomed us with unmatched warmth and hospitality. They were always willing to assist us with anything we needed, providing us with recommendations on places to visit in the area and offering their help at all times.

We want to particularly highlight an act of generosity that we will never forget. During our stay, my wife experienced a health complication that required urgent medical attention. Since our two-year-old daughter couldn't stay alone, I found myself in a difficult situation as I couldn't accompany my wife to the nearest hospital in the early hours of the morning. However, Alejandro, one of the hostel owners, selflessly offered to take my wife to the hospital and waited there for over three and a half hours until she received proper medical care. His kindness and support during that challenging time deeply touched us.

We are sincerely grateful for the exceptional attention and service we received during our stay at Hostal Villa Isabel. We would highly recommend this place to any traveler seeking cozy and hospitable accommodation in Aquitania, Boyacá. Not only will you find impeccable and comfortable rooms, but also hosts willing to go above and beyond to ensure your stay is memorable. We will not hesitate to return in the future.
review_2_text:
I could give it more than 5 stars, but I really would!!! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

What a beautiful, peaceful place! We had stayed the night before in another terrible place, and when we arrived at Villa Isabel, it was like arriving at a haven of peace. When we visited, the owners weren't there, but they were very attentive via phone and WhatsApp the entire time. Plus, the lady who manages the place, Doña Blanca, is extremely kind, warm, and attentive.

The views of the lake are unparalleled, right across the street, and beyond the onion field (which in itself is very beautiful). The sunrises are gorgeous 🤩

The house has a dining room and a kitchen that you can use freely. They have oil, salt, and cooking basics. There's also a blender, microwave, coffee maker, and unlimited bottled drinking water.

They have hot showers; Sometimes it doesn't heat up completely, but that's not an issue with the accommodation, but with Tota in general, due to the pressure.

Excellent place to return to! And the value for money is simply unbeatable 😍👌🏽

review_3_text: Excellent service, very good location. The spaces are small but the atmosphere is very familiar and friendly. The rooms are neat. It has a sauna and jacuzzi, unfortunately the latter was out of service. Fair breakfast but good flavor.
review_4_text:
Muy bonito y acogedor lugar, las habitaciones muy limpias, las personas muy amables, la tina estaba fuera de servicio...
El desayuno muy rico y rápida atención.
Lo mejor está a media cuadra del parque y el precio es muy asequible
review_5_text: A spectacular hotel, clean and cozy, with very friendly people, the rooms and bathrooms were impeccable, the jacuzzi was delicious, the breakfast seemed very delicious, freshly prepared and just to start the day, it is located half a block from the central square and they provide parking service for people who travel by car, definitely a place to visit again.

name: Playa Blanca Hospedaje MorAndes
review_1_text: Great cabins with great view. Just perfect for a night at Playa Blanca. Communication with host was smooth and the service was very kind. Great value price for the experience.
review_2_text: El mejor palco para apreciar el lago! Una hermosa y tranquila vista! Muchas gracias!!!
review_3_text: Las vistas son hermosas. Hay paz. La atención es muy buena. Pero no es como aparece en las fotos. No tiene una buena relación calidad precio, porque me pareció costos para las cabañas que ofrece. Las escaleras para subir a la cabaña son de lona llenas de arena incrustadas en el suelo, muy empinadas. Cuando llueve hay goteras en el pasillo entre las cabañas y se forma barro. Huele mucho a madera. El piso es en baldosa muy fría. No dan shampoo. El agua en la lavamanos es helada y por eso ponen un tarro de antibacterial para no lavarse las manos.
review_4_text: Taking into account the price, the accommodation is good, suddenly the service and the climb of the mountain need to be improved.
review_5_text: Esta es una estafa. Este hospedaje es falso, en la zona nadie conoce al señor Nelson, el pide pago por nequi y luego desaparece.

name: San Gabriel Hospedería
review_1_text:
A beautiful place!!! The unparalleled attention, the clean room, the spectacular view.
I recommend asking for rooms with mountain views.
It is very close to the square and you can walk there.
The rich breakfast.
review_2_text: Without a doubt, the attention is the best thing about the place, in addition to the location, since it is a few steps from the main park of Tibasosa. The breakfast is very rich, the rooms are very comfortable and the price is very fair. I definitely recommend this hotel!
review_3_text: Very nice and safe, excellent location a few steps from the central park, pleasant breakfast, good service. The entire place very neat. Good cost/benefit ratio.
review_4_text: Un hotel super acogedor 10 de 10 el personal que allí labora super atento y seguramente volveremos a quedarnos allí
review_5_text: The staff that attended us was inexperienced and delayed us in registering, they told us that there was no parking and when we went up to the rooms we observed that there were 5 unoccupied spaces, when we complained they let us use them; At night a man who is a grump answers, I asked him for 2 additional blankets and he answered me rudely that that was why the beds already had them, I insisted and waited 1:40 minutes for him to take them, I really don't recommend it, there is no intercom

review_3_text: Very friendly, super comfortable room, perfect for resting, affordable price. Located one block from the square. Super recommended.

name: HOTEL VILLA DE MONGUI
review_1_text: We stayed here for 3 nights. Mongui is a really nice place you can hike a lot and buy balls manufactured in Mongui. The Hotel is really nice, seams new so we had a private room with bathroom. It also has a kitchen, which is clean and well equipped. The staff is also really friendly. I can totally recommend it.
review_2_text: Beautiful room and lovely staff. Were very helpful and informative. The people of mongui were very very welcoming in general and the town itself and surrounding areas are beautiful.
review_3_text: Good location, very nice owners who help with everything and who even tried their best to make us a vegan breakfast.
review_4_text: Wonderful hotel in Manguí. The staff is very welcoming and the space was very homey. Definitely stop by if you’re staying in town.
review_5_text: Great staff. Super helpful and kind.

review_1_text:
A place to spend a relaxing time. The place is pleasant, and Doña Emilia's service is wonderful, excellent, and prompt; she frequently keeps hot coffee available for guests.

The facilities are poorly maintained. Some doors don't close, and the light switches and outlets are loose.

But the good service doesn't overshadow these two things.
review_2_text: Excellent place, cordial and friendly service, (the lady even helped us prepare birthday decorations), good breakfasts and at a very good price, excellent location to enjoy the nearby natural attractions
review_3_text: Buen servicio las habitaciones están limpias y organizadas tiene televisión eso si no tiene cable y son lo suficientemente grandes para dos personas no tienes la necesidad de salir para conseguir alimentación aparte tienen muy buena sazón
