The place has good rooms, clean, comfortable, warm and quiet.

However, the common areas and the restaurant lack cleanliness.

I didn't find the administration efficient. They didn't take our information, they never gave me the room keys, and the key to my room didn't work. I saw the same thing happening with another room.

The place is not bad for a rave, but for a next walk I would look for another place.
review_5_text: Buen precio, limpio, buena atención.

review_3_text: I was with my family this weekend and the place is cozy, the attention of the girl who welcomed us was good as well as the young man. Monguí is soooo pretty
review_4_text: Servicio económico, WiFi, agua caliente, Tv y lo mejor lejos del ruido. Esta cerca de la Capilla de San Antonio.

review_1_text: Excellent service from Don Miguel and Marina. Two very kind and dear gentlemen; They make you feel welcomed from the first moment. The rooms are neat, comfortable and beautiful. Delicious breakfast. What stands out the most is the beautiful attention I received, so I recommend it 100%.
review_2_text: En nuestro camino al lago de tota, escogimos este alojamiento para dormir que corresponde a una casa colonial muy bien conservada de la zona con bonitos detalles. El desayuno incluido riquísimo con huevos campesinos y una atención impecable. Las habitaciones completas y limpias.
review_3_text: A nice hotel in a quiet town. It loses all its charm when you realize that the noise is terrible, the soundproofing needs to be improved, you can hear everything in the lobby and the room next door. If the plan is to rest completely. IT IS NOT HERE. Especially if large families arrive and stay talking with the host until late.
review_4_text:
El señor Miguel se distingue por su amabilidad y disposición para atender a los huéspedes con gran atención. El servicio de comida, auténtico y destacado por su típica gastronomía local, complementa la experiencia.
El hotel recrea una vivienda tradicional de Boyacá, ofreciendo comodidades modernas que permiten sumergirse plenamente en la experiencia de Tota.
Las habitaciones se mantienen impecables, bien equipadas y los baños disponen de agua caliente para mayor confort.
review_5_text:
Es un hotel muy acogedor, la señora Marina es super amable especial y tiene un excelente sazón 😋😋😋. Don Miguel es muy amable y conoce mucho de la historia de Boyaca, nos orientó en nuestra ruta de Boyaca…
Las habitaciones son cómodas y acogedoras, te transportan a otro lugar cómo una hacienda campesina… lo recomiendo 100%.

Los precios son muy razonables.

review_2_text: Un hotel cómodo, agradable, limpio con excelente atención, además con buenos precios. Muy recomendado para disfrutar de una buena estadía a precios accesibles en un lugar nuevo, limpio, confortable y cómodo.
review_3_text: We received excellent service, friendly and committed, impeccable cleanliness, recommended
review_4_text: Good service, very neat and spacious rooms. The bathroom and showers are very small but well presented. It does not have direct access from the garages to the reception and does not have a wheelchair ramp.
review_5_text: The room they showed us was large and clean, although in the end we did not stay in the hotel because the person who attended us was not a serious person, they promised us parking so we paid in advance and once we were going to settle in they told us that we could no longer use it, so we asked for the money back and they did not want to return the money, it is unfortunate that a hotel that looks good has such terrible service.

Las cabañas son cómodas, limpias y tienen todo lo necesario para una estadía relajante. Me encantó despertar con el sonido de los pájaros y disfrutar del aire fresco. name: Costa Azul Ecolodge
review_1_text: Wow, what an incredible experience! I went for a weekend getaway with one of my girl friends, and we had an absolute blast! The views, the food and the service were all outstanding! Edward and Laura were so personable and made sure our stay was excellent. We booked the package with a boat trip, a hike and a cooking class! All three activities went above and beyond! Our favorite part was the cooking class--the food was delicious and we were given a hot glass of wine afterward which was equally delicious. I will definitely be coming back with my boyfriend! Oh, also, the beds were incredibly comfortable!
review_2_text: The place is beautifully located in Aquitania, Boyaca overlooking Lake Tota. There are a lot of legends that the locals share with you regarding the area. The glamping suite was super comfy, the visit to the lake and its islands were an amazing experience, but my favorite part was the ancient culinary workshop. It was an amazing experience to learn ancient cooking techniques from the "Muiscas" and the food was sooo good! I will definitely come back.
review_3_text: We had an amazing experience! Service was amazing, specially Ivan, he was very nice and kind with us.
review_4_text: Comfortable, clean, attentive, great view, provided games in the room and other activities, hot water
review_5_text: a very welcoming and hospitable place

name: Eco-Hospedaje El Bus De La Rana
review_1_text:
A unique experience in the middle of nature

My stay at this accommodation was incredible and different from any other. The fact that the accommodation is in an adapted bus gives it a unique and special touch that I had never experienced before. The creativity in the transformation of the bus is amazing: it has all the necessary amenities for a comfortable stay without losing the rustic charm of being in the middle of nature.

Waking up surrounded by greenery, with the sound of birds and fresh air is something unmatched. The environment is perfect to disconnect from the stress of the city and reconnect with the tranquility of the countryside. The space is very well used and is surprisingly comfortable. In addition, the bus has careful details that make it very cozy.

I recommend this accommodation to anyone looking for a different experience, who wants to get away from the hustle and bustle and enjoy the peace of nature, without giving up comfort. Without a doubt, a memorable getaway that I hope to repeat.
review_2_text:
I loved the experience, the bus is beautiful, the beds super comfortable. Everything was impeccable, at night they had a bonfire and music, and in the morning a delicious breakfast. The host is super friendly. I left very happy and would return without a doubt.

100% recommended.
review_3_text: A very original space, impeccable attention. They made us feel at home. If you want connection with nature, this is the place. Environmental awareness, campfire, music. Highly recommended!
review_4_text: A perfect place to rest and enjoy the tranquility, trails and hot springs very close, highly recommended.  A project that, because it is innovative, leaves many expectations and will return for sure👏😊.
review_5_text: An excellent place that offers relaxation, surrounded by nature, tranquility, and a very different atmosphere from the traditional—an experience worth repeating.

name: Cabañas, Camping, restaurante San Alejo-Eco Hotel
review_1_text: The camping area is great, the view of the lagoon is extremely beautiful, it has access to the lagoon, if you are looking for a destination to get away from the noise of the city, this is the right place.
review_2_text: Con una ubicación muy buena y una vista maravillosa a orillas del lago. Cuenta con servicios básicos para camping y cabañas. Pueden mejorar la experiencia moderando el ruido tarde en la noche de otros visitantes.
review_3_text:
Excelente lugar para tener una bonita experiencia;muy tranquilo,buena atención de principio a fin…me gusto la ubicación del lugar xq tienes una excelente vista ala Laguna,es seguro,están al pendiente por si se te ofrece algo;además de eso tiene un muelle donde puedes ver la Laguna mucho más de cerca..cuenta con todo lo necesario para tener una buena estadía en el lugar(baños,duchas con agua caliente,servicio de restaurante)🥰.
Eso si,es necesario ir muy bien abrigado,puesto que por la ubicación al Páramo y la Laguna es muy frío 🥶.
Acampe en el lugar y el amanecer 🌅 fue algo maravilloso😊.volvería al lugar con gusto
En la mañana el señor(olvide su nombre🫣😬)nos dio un rico tinto de finca,pasó a agradecer su atención y cordialidad.
review_4_text: Lugar hermoso para acampar al lado de la laguna. Hay cabañas hermosas y posibilidad de camping, la calidad del servicio es y la hospitalidad de los dueños es digna de la región y los desayunos también son impresionantes. Existe la posibilidad de explorar toda la laguna desde este punto y de hacer gran variedad de actividades!
review_5_text: We spent one night in a cabin. It was excellent, we were not cold and everything was very comfortable. Don William was always very attentive, he is very kind. The view of the lake is spectacular, they also have access to the lake. The night is very quiet. It is a highly recommended place.

name: Cabaña El Encanto de ALU
review_1_text: The beautiful El Encanto de Alu Cabin offers easy access, spacious grounds, ample parking, and cozy spaces. It's pet-friendly. It's super close to restaurants, traditional craft areas, and one of the most notable tourist attractions, the Monument to the 14 Lancers, declared a national cultural heritage site. This is where one of the most important episodes in the history of Colombia's freedom took place in these Boyacá lands.
review_2_text: Super cozy and very nice place. A very well-equipped cabin for a pleasant stay.
review_3_text: A very cozy place. Recommended.
review_4_text: Very comfortable

address: vía la cascada, Vda. Perico, Monguí
review_1_text: A very beautiful place. The glamping details are very nice and well-crafted. The service, scenery, and tranquility are wonderful. Perfect for getting away from the city.
review_2_text: The hotel stay was incredible. The breakfast was delicious, and the amenities they provided, like the coffee maker, made us happy to have a hot drink. They recommended the Mapagua activity to us, and we thoroughly enjoyed it. They were always very attentive, especially Mrs. Angela, who was very kind and attentive.
review_3_text: The jacuzzi is a rip-off. For such a cold place, you'd expect warm water, but it never got the slightest bit warm. I highly recommend everything else; it's very nice and cozy, and the service is excellent.
review_4_text: The place is very nice, the cabin is excellent, the food is also very good, the service is very good, but the jacuzzi doesn't really work. They say it works with solar energy to justify it and that the water is warm, but it's not really warm, it's cold. It's time to improve the jacuzzi's operation. For that, you pay something extra.
review_5_text: The place is beautiful, very comfortable, they gave us the best recommendations and were always very attentive. Excellent service, we will return. We really liked the way everything was organized. Great view.

review_1_text: An unforgettable experience! The place is simply spectacular: surrounded by nature, with incredible views and all the amenities one would expect from a first-class glamping site. The service was excellent, the entire team very friendly and attentive to every detail. Perfect for disconnecting and recharging. I will definitely return.
review_2_text:
Excellent place for the view it has, very beautiful, it is very comfortable and quiet.
All the facilities have artificial intelligence and the service as such is too good, I would return many times
review_3_text: It is a very nice, quiet and cozy place, the room is super elegant, the technology they use is interesting, which makes the place more pleasant, also the security of the cabin is good
review_4_text: Cumple con todas las expectativas, realmente el lugar es maravilloso. Su vista increíble, además cuenta con todo lo que necesita. Nos gusto mucho. Con seguridad lo recomiendo y volvería muchas veces más!!!!! 10 de 10 👌🏼
review_5_text: Very good experience, excellent room. The view is privileged, highly recommended.

name: Glamping Boyacá
review_1_text:
One of the most adventurous and fun experiences I’ve ever had! Glamorous camping!

The staff and owners are super friendly, family-oriented and very attentive. Great service!

Enjoyed the accommodations with the jacuzzi and the fire pit was my favorite part! So warm, soothing, and relaxing.

I am very grateful I got to enjoy this and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for fun, romantic night, tranquility, relaxation, and even family fun!
review_2_text: I made a reservation and gave 6 hours notice of my arrival time so the hot tub would be at the right temperature. However, upon arrival the jacuzzi was only 26°C instead of the promised 36°C. Additionally, the zippers to access the glamping site and the bathroom were in poor condition, which made the cold unbearable. After waiting for three hours without the hot tub heating up, we decided to leave the place. Despite all this, they did not refund my full money, which I consider unfair given that the facilities did not fulfill what was promised.
review_3_text: The place is beautiful, an excellent place to share with family, friends or a getaway to get away from the city and renew energy alone... The attention of María and Miguel Ángel was excellent, magnificent people who were always attentive to making our stay pleasant, and it was. Each glamping has a private bathroom, you can also choose the one with a jacuzzi, each space is uniquely private with a small table and chairs, to eat, chat or read if you wish. A bonfire that at night makes it feel comfortable to be in this place. 100% recommended to spend some pleasant days surrounded by nature and comfort. They are PET FRIENDLY... They are so attentive that they brought us a bed for our pet. Thank you Gampling Boyacá!!!!
review_4_text: The place is very nice, perfect for a getaway from the routine of the city 💛 The glamping sites are very nice, they have a bathroom, you can choose between a jacuzzi or sauna, a small outdoor dining room. The service is 10/10, you can write via WhatsApp and they will deliver it to your glamping, or they also have a restaurant, I must say that the food is delicious, fresh and well presented. They have private parking. Super recommended! 🥰
review_5_text: Excellent attention from Mrs. Liliana in charge of the stay, human warmth makes the experience at Boyaca glamping more welcoming, beautiful landscapes and a very pleasant and quiet place to celebrate my daughter's 15th birthday.

review_2_text: We stayed at this glamping site with my family and the experience was very good. The attention of the lady who welcomed us was excellent, always friendly and attentive. The only thing to keep in mind is that, to get there, you have to walk a fairly steep section, which can be a little demanding. In addition, the cold is intense, so it is essential to be well dressed and prepared for the walk. Despite this, the experience is totally worth it.
review_3_text: Spectacular, this place is magical! I've been there twice and they don't disappoint... review_2_text:
A lovely place to connect with nature. Very welcoming, and very attentive service from Mrs. Amanda, who is very kind.

review_5_text:

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED 👌

review_1_text: Amazing place with a stunning view. The appartement was really nice and comfortable.  The owners are so nice and helped with everything we needed. Such lovely people.  The only thing to consider is that it gets really really cold there and there is no heating in the rooms. It was a great amazing stay, we really loved it. Cause of the temperature two days were enough for us.
review_2_text: Great place to spend a weekend with your couple or family.
review_3_text:
Lake Tota is already a naturally interesting place in itself, but Blue Glamp really manages to highlight all the beauty of the surroundings. There's a very nice balance between comfort, attention, and scenery. We took the guided hike and it was a very enriching experience: we learned a lot about the area, took the opportunity to take photos, and it was a great way to get to know the area better.

The next day we were at the dock, and the staff was always attentive to making sure we were having a good time. You can tell they pay special attention to the details. The room was warm, the facilities were clean, and in the morning you could help yourself to coffee and aromatic drinks, which was a nice touch.

I would definitely recommend this place and would love to return. It's a lovely way to connect with nature without the hassle.
review_4_text: The room is nice, the place has a beautiful view, good attention, to improve the issue of planning the activities since a schedule is allocated for example walks, or canoe rides and they are not fulfilled and for this reason, unfortunately we are left without being able to do any of the activities. It is also necessary to inform yourself of additional costs such as firewood.
review_5_text: A beautiful and cozy place, very nice to rest, the place is very clean and tidy. To improve breakfast a little with less fat and more variety.

name: NaturaLove Glamping Monguí
address: Finca San Miguel, Vereda de Tebgua, Monguí
review_1_text:
I decided to spend some quality time with my family and choosing NaturaLove Glamping Monguí has ​​been the best decision I have made.

The place is very quiet and exactly what we needed. Thank you very much Camilo, we had a great time and I will definitely recommend your beautiful place to friends and family.
review_2_text:
Dentro de todo lo hermoso que tiene el pueblo con su tranquilidad y sus tradiciones, éste glamping le da el toque preciso de comodidad y glamour.
Opciones de desayuno (delicioso), zonas amplias, animales, huerta, todo es de ensueño.
Se escucha como pasa el río desde el Glamping, a 8 minutos del pueblo caminando.
El anfitrión muy atento, está muy enterado de las actividades a realizar y de las diferentes opciones que uno puede tener para poder salir de lo convencional.
review_3_text: A great place to relax in nature. There are also many animals such as ponies and rabbits that you can feed and pet. Wonderful views of the mountains and Monguí. The village can be reached on foot without any problems. There is also a grill on the terrace and the breakfast is rich and very tasty. The hosts are super nice and helpful. We had a great 3 days there with our two dogs. Gladly again!
review_4_text:
The place is really one of the best places we have visited, you find an appropriate environment for you and your partner, for your family, for your friends, they fit everything you need.

There is a farm with many animals to share with the little ones in the house, we had a lot of fun with the sheep, goats, rabbits.

We had a guided walk, free of charge, among many other activities.  We were with family, celebrating a special occasion and they supported us with the decoration and typical dishes.

Overall it was a 10 star experience that is worth living and repeating,
review_5_text:
A magical place full of nature, a sensational atmosphere, Glampim, very comfortable and with everything you need for a good rest.
Camilo an excellent host.

name: Terra Luna Glamping
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text: Well worth while experience, secluded in the gorgeous mountains of Boyaca. I loved the fact that each little igloo has it's own private jacuzzi, great if you want to stare at the stars at night with a glass of wine. Breakfast was really good too, Isabelita and her husband always made sure we had everything we needed. Hope to return one day! However, a car is a must as it it's roughly a 10-15 min drive from the Sochagota lake.
review_2_text: Chevere
review_3_text: Amazing experience!
review_4_text:
Igloo-type glamping with a great view, hot water in the jacuzzi, a bathroom with a glass roof that overlooks the trees 👌, the room in general very comfortable, with good privacy. They give you everything to confront the cold at night

It is not very far from the main road but the terrain is unpaved, nothing serious, a 10-minute drive away.

The attention is good, especially from the owners, the kitchen staff is also very friendly.

I would definitely return
review_5_text:
Initially we did not have very friendly attention on the phone, since I had to make a change in the reservation and it was a little complicated, but in the end it was a very nice experience!! nice place!!! The view is spectacular, the glamping is very comfortable and spacious, the bed, excellent blankets and pillows, the private jacuzzi is the best to enjoy at night, Isabel's attention is spectacular, she is a beautiful lady, very helpful and attentive.
To improve, a heater is important because it is quite cold.

name: Finca Hotel La Casona De Suanoga
review_1_text:
Fantastic place to relax and recharge!
Quiet and peaceful. The views and landscape are amazing with plenty of things to do in the area.
Gloria is a great host, she helped us organize a family event in the property and supported us all the way throughout our stay.
I am very glad we selected this historic site for our visit.
review_2_text: Good place to rest or to work in quite environment...
review_3_text: Really quiet place
review_4_text: Charming country house with a spectacular view. Mrs. Gloria very attentive. Rooms all with bathroom, comfortable.
review_5_text: Lots of peace, tranquility, ideal to disconnect

name: El Arca De Noah
opening_hours: Monday: 6:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Tuesday: 6:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Wednesday: 6:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Thursday: 6:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Friday: 6:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Saturday: 6:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Sunday: 6:00 AM – 8:00 PM
review_1_text: We had an absolutely amazing stay at Arca de Noah on Lago Tota. The views were breathtaking and the room we stayed in was by far the best in all of my Colombia travels. The hotel staff were all so kind and helpful, and there were a lot of fun activities to do during the day. The restaurant at the hotel served delicious food and was very quick! Counting down the days till we can go back again!
review_2_text: This family is amazing! I stopped by here for a few days on my way cycling through Colombia. I was welcomed to El Arca De Noah so warmly. These are really kind and generous people and the place is fantastic. The food is tasty and what's more the view from the restaurant across the laguna de Tota is breathtaking! Nothing is too much for these guys.
review_3_text: Don't be put off by the exterior (reason I took 1 star off). Like someone said it is an eyesore and it could be improved, however the rooms inside are beautiful, clean and modern, with great views. The place is a work in progress, the family has been building little by little and they are doing a great job. They are warm and welcoming and one of the guys speaks very good english. The location is great! walk down a steep path to playa blanca (beware if you have mobility issues) and up to the restaurant, which is super convenient to have and they serve good food.
review_4_text:
First, the family who run the place are absolutely WONDERFUL. It’s hard to give 2 stars to a family that is so kind and hospitable but I was totally disappointed this structure is the biggest, ugliest eye sore for the beautiful lake. They are not doing anything to care for it, the hotel is really poorly designed, trash and construction material everywhere...it’s really very sad they could do so much more but it’s just a big ugly cement block creating a huge sore on the beautiful scenery.

If you do go, there’s minimal food so make sure you ask for their menu right when you arrive - food is good and large portions
review_5_text: We ordered different preparations for the trout, and do not know how the "criolla sauce" was cooked and what was in it, because my husband developed a powerful reaction to it. He had a skin rash reaction all over his body to food poisoning for 2 days. Four more people in the group had diarrhea and cramps from the same sauce and the garlic paste.

name: Casona Ananda
review_1_text: Amazing experience!! The rooms are stunning and the location is super strategic, the restaurants in the area have first level food or you could have the same experience dinning at the hotel. The hostess are the best!
review_2_text: The best place ever!!!
review_3_text:
We spent unforgettable days at Casona Ananda. From the very first moment, they made us feel at home, taking care of every detail of our stay with a warmth that is evident in everything: in the service, the spaces, and the energy of the place. The facilities are impeccable, surrounded by a serene and welcoming atmosphere, perfect for disconnecting and truly resting.

The spa was a wonderful experience: tranquil, well-maintained, and with an atmosphere that invites complete relaxation. And what can we say about the breakfast, prepared with care, fresh ingredients, and a special touch that makes it even more delicious? Everything at the house is designed for well-being, connecting with oneself and the environment.

I wholeheartedly recommend this place. We returned refreshed.
review_4_text: Rarely are expectations exceeded by reality, this was the case with Casona Amanda, not only did we find beautiful accommodation, which takes care of every detail, the comfort of the bed and the amenities, but the kindness of César and his family, not to mention the exquisite breakfast, if you go, don't miss the house eggs. We hope to have the pleasure of visiting you again 20/10
review_5_text: An excellent place that you should definitely visit, the service is 10/10, it is super personalized, the room is super comfortable, organized, everything is impeccable. The location is super strategic, close to many points of interest. Really super recommended. Thank you Cesar and Tatiana!

name: Hotel Refugio Génesis
address: Vereda Balcones, Lago de Tota, Cuitiva
opening_hours: Monday: 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Tuesday: 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Wednesday: 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Thursday: 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Friday: 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Saturday: 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Sunday: 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM
review_1_text:
The descent from the main road to the hotel is quite adventurous, but definetly handleable for an experienced driver. The hotel itself is in a good state and the staff constantly work hard go improve it further. For example they inaugurated the brand new sauna and whirlpool for our stay during new years eve.
Our room was also freshly renovated, that one could still smell the paint :-)
The beds were comfy and there were enough warm blankets to get through the quite cold nights of the region. The cabañas even have a chimney so you can enjoy a nice warm fireplace at night!
There is also nice little lagoon where one can enter the lake, but that's only for the most hard suited (water temperature around 10°C).
The food in the restaurant was tasty and in the evening you can play billard and Pingpong inside or watch some movies in the cinema.
Atention for families: right now there is no kids playground, but the hotel staff told us it's on the list of open points and coming soon!
I had some other ideas for improvements and they thankfully added them to the list. They really work hard to make everyone a pleasant stay.
review_2_text: In the Hotel Genésis you can admire the Laguna de Tota, the largest lake in Colombia and enjoy it. The hotel even has a small beach with access to the lake, where its cold water revitalizes you after having some canelazos and hervidos (typical drinks with aguardiente) that help you warm up.
review_3_text:
We came down from Canada with my family, spent few days at the Hotel the place is marvelous itself, lots of activities outdoors, wonderful food. Super friendly staff detail oriented. Highly recommended.
Thank you for making our staying a beautiful memory.
review_4_text: That is a really sweet  place. All the stuff was very nice and professional. I really loved the lake itself, the hotel's location is very special, with the great view from the room.
review_5_text: Wonderful spot nearby to the lake. Awesome view. The staff of the hotel is very kind.

review_1_text: The experience in rural Colombia was very special! The place was very comfy and the host was very accomadating to our questions with our limited spanish. I would reccomend it for a very unique experience with a great price! Would visit again!!
review_2_text: It was one of the best rural hotels ive stayed at, the rooms were clean, staff was friendly. They even had a very friendly dog! The place was great and overall was a great experience.
review_3_text: Incredible site and clean rooms, would definitely stay again. Friendly to foreigners and cozy.
review_5_text:

I repeat what I said when I said goodbye: “I got more than I expected.” A place I recommend and would return to again and again.

Thank you very much.

review_2_text: Very colonial like setting. They make You feel like in your own rustic home. Comfortable accommodations. Aide (manager) is very welcoming and helpful.
review_3_text: Nice and very friendly staff. Good location for seeing the town.
review_4_text: Nice hotel good breakfast the only thing I didn't like is not talking credit cards
review_5_text: Excellent location, clean rooms and very friendly and helpful staff. Breakfast was very rich. It is not very big but the size seems perfect to me and your cats allow themselves to be pampered and are playful

name: Cabañas Santo Tomas Paipa

review_1_text: Excellent and recommended... You have the option of requesting an address from @cosabuenalatam and they will send it there.
review_2_text: La peor experiencia! no se lo deseo ni a mi peor enemigo, el lugar no está adecuado para las condiciones climáticas donde se encuentra, es una casa en madera en medio de la montaña, tiene orificios por todas partes y por la noche es insoportable el frío, el frío se filtra por todos lados, (adjunto fotos para que se vean los orificios) la temperatura en la madrugada eran 6 grados! Y con el frío filtrándose fue una pesadilla, la cama solo tenía una cobija, a las 3 de la mañana nos queríamos ir, nos dolía el cuerpo de tanto frío, solo esperamos a que amaneciera para salir de allí, si tienen la oportunidad de ir, desaprovéchenla, lo que cobran por la estadía es una ofensa para las condiciones tan malas del lugar, fue lo peor.
review_3_text: The truth is I am impressed, I come from Santander and it has been one of the best experiences I have had, I have traveled to Boyacá on previous occasions, I love it, but I have never stayed in a hotel so comfortable, accessible, elegant, with EXCELLENT ATTENTION AND SERVICE AND A WONDERFUL spot, I recommend coming by private car but if you don't have one, it is worth coming to have surgery here even if it is on the outskirts of town, if you really want an experience outside of the noise, pollution, scandal of the city Cabañas Santo Tomas is your best option!!!
review_4_text: The worst experience! After traveling 4 hours to get to the place, they informed us that the reservation was canceled even though we showed evidence that it was confirmed, they did not return the money and closed the door in our face claiming that they had no more rooms available. Terrible service, don't go to that place if you don't want to have an unpleasant experience and have your money stolen
review_5_text: Bien ubicado .... central y silencioso ...buen ontacto con la Naturaleza

review_2_text: Beautiful place to relax, amazing vibes and great food! Great place to disconnect. They offer great spa plans or even sailing options for you to have the best time here.

I especially liked the fireplace service, for 25 mil $8 they will bring firewood and light it for you.  The restaurant has some of the best trout (trucha) I have ever had.  Highly recommended!

review_5_text: Excelent place to have time to relax while enjoying the perfect overview of the Tota's lagoon. Strongly recommended!

name: Finca Colinas y Senderos
review_1_text: Absolutely charming finca, very eco conscious. Perfect for those who want to disconnect from the day to day and reconnect with nature.  The hosts are owner operators and are an absolute delight to deal with and talk to.  A+++ for the entire grounds, facilities and host experience.
review_2_text: My family and I stayed there for 3 nights. We were around 30 people. What a beautiful place. The views and surroundings are gorgeous. The place is clean and very comfortable. The attention we got from the host were also amazing.always there to take care of what we needed. I would totally recommend it.
review_3_text:
Amazing place! To disconnect and relax with nature.  The yurtas were super cute, everything is set up with great taste and to your comfort while giving you the plasure to see every constellation in the sky at night.   The beds were super comfortable and the hot water pressure was great.

Daniel and Jenny were amazing hosts, preparing all kinda of recommendations and an amazing breakfast
review_4_text:
If I could describe this experience, I would do so as unique. I have been to many lodging places and never in my life, literally, have they given me attention and service like what I received there, the warmth of the people was incredible, the attention to detail, to the care of us guests is more than magnificent. The facilities are comfortable, extremely clean and pleasant for an environment of rest and disconnection.

The facilities are about 10 minutes from the main road, but it is a very easy road to navigate even in low vehicles and it is well signposted, so you can't miss it.

If I had to describe the attention received in a rating I would give it a 1000/10, facilities 10/10, disconnection 10/10.
review_5_text: They are very dear, special, attentive people, they made me feel at home, especially Don Daniel and Doña Jenny. Every day on the farm was unique, thanks to them. Super recommended, you can't go to Boyaca without staying there.

name: Tyquy Finca Agroecológica y Turística
review_1_text: It is an incredible space. It is the perfect location to get closer to the serenity of the countryside and forget for a few days about the overwhelming noises and routines of monotony. The attention is excellent, those who provide the lodging service are dreamers and workers with a human warmth that is not frequently found. Do not hesitate to visit them if you have a family trip in mind, with friends or with whoever wants to enjoy memorable moments with beautiful panoramic views of our Colombian countryside. I hope to visit you again very soon.
review_2_text: It is a very pleasant space. The attention is excellent. We had a great time.

review_1_text: Thrilled!!!!! This amazing resort spa turned out to be what I expected and more.  Its natural thermal pool relaxed me but ultimately energized me and alleviated some minor pain  in my back.  The rooms were cleaned, spacious and comfortable.  Our rooms had the most incredible view of Paipa, and the amazing hotel grounds and the spectacular Lake.  Among the many activities available to the guest I can recommend one of the many spa treats.  I personally recommend the “Sochagota Ritual”.  The stay included an espectacular breakfast buffet, with local cuisine as well as continental and American delights.  Last, try the amazing dishes served during dining hours and make sure to try the trout.

review_4_text:
A place that changes your rhythm and your soul.
At Cabañas Yucatán, on the shores of the majestic Lake Tota, we find much more than a break: we live an experience. Waking up to the sound of water, breathing fresh air, and feeling true peace… is priceless.

review_5_text: Un hermoso lugar para conectarse con la naturaleza, descansar y observar paisajes espectaculares como los que se ven en las fotos, la atención es excelente siempre estuvieron muy pendientes de nosotros y de nuestra perrita, también es excelente para llevar a los peluditos porque allá también hay y son muy amigables, nuestra perrita disfrutó como nunca. El desayuno delicioso, tienen parqueadero. No duden en pasar una noche estrellada frente a la laguna más grande de Colombia.

review_2_text:
My family and I have been there several times, but the last time we were very disappointed. Although the prices are fair, the food is actually very simple and doesn't have much flavor. The last time the service was not good. We requested drinks and they told us they were coming, we waited almost half an hour and they never arrived, so we told the gentleman when we were paying and he was unkind and told us it was because they were busy at an event. We didn't really like it. The place is nice, but the service and food were very average.
We left disappointed 😔
review_3_text:
Nice place, nice view of the town and very good food and excellent service. Ample parking.

The only thing I didn't like is that they don't accept credit or debit cards, only transfers and cash.

Otherwise excellent recommended.
review_4_text: Very quiet, excellent views, we were not able to enjoy the entire site but the service in the restaurant was great and the children had a lot of fun. The very beautiful chapel
review_5_text: Excellent service and dishes with an exquisite gourmet.

name: Hotel Casona Nuñez
review_1_text: I love this place. I came for 2 nights and stayed 7. All the staff are very friendly, and the owner Don Alberto is an absolute gentleman. He will bend over backwards to help his guests any way he can.
review_2_text: it's a good place to rest, cheap, and good services including breakfast
review_3_text: Ok.
review_4_text: Excelente ubicación, muy aseado, bonito y el servicio del personal del hotel excelente, muy amables y serviciales, nos hospedaron el puente festivo de reyes del 2025. Don Alberto estuvo muy pendiente de inicio o fin.
review_5_text: Un muy excelente servicio, la atención es realmente cálida y todo es muy espacioso y lindo ♡

name: Bioparque Guátika
opening_hours: Monday: 9:30 AM – 4:00 PM|Tuesday: 9:30 AM – 4:00 PM|Wednesday: 9:30 AM – 4:00 PM|Thursday: 9:30 AM – 4:00 PM|Friday: 9:30 AM – 4:00 PM|Saturday: 9:30 AM – 4:00 PM|Sunday: 9:30 AM – 4:00 PM
review_1_text: Animals are in good shape, maybe lion tiger can have more space but they look very nice activities are awesome
review_2_text: This zoo is in the most unexpected setting. I had assumed that the visit would be just for half a day, but the place is so big that anytime lesser than 1 day is not going to make justice. The whole park is privately managed and it makes all the more challenging to maintain, however the place is very well maintained. Hats off, the animals are also healthy. Well maintained, nice walks.
review_3_text: It's great, you will be able to feed the animals, share good time with your family, ans if you enjoy riding horses, you'll have the opportunity to do that. Don't think a lot about visiting the Zoo.
review_4_text: Happy fat looking animals, clean biggish enclosures, variety of local animals and from abroad. Attractions are good - more fun than extreme. Minus one star for the entrance process which was not welcoming and no habeus data - big no no. Plenty of toilets; cafes with food and drink throughout the park; good signage for Colombia. Not recommended for those who don't like hills, it's very hilly. Really enjoyed giving the animals food, and so did my boy. Min height 1.2m for the attractions.
review_5_text:
Once we arrived. It started to rain and we couldn't make anything. The crew at the park, doesn't have any ATV or vehicle to pick up the visitors and put them on a safety place. Very unorganized. But the zoo is really pretty.
The town where is located, is really beautiful and pleasant.

name: Posada Turistica Altamisal
address: finca Altamizal, Kilómetro 2 vereda Gotua, Firavitoba-Iza
review_1_text: It is a very comfortable and pleasant place where tranquility and peace reigned. The sounds of nature, such as birdsong, helped create a warm and relaxing atmosphere. Without a doubt, one of the best parts of this accommodation was the excellent attention we received from the owners, who were always willing to help with anything necessary.
review_2_text: Comenzaré por decir que tienen una excelente atención y disposición, las habitaciones muy amplias y muy limpio solo falta algo como TV en las habitaciones pero muy tranquilo el lugar, el precio por la ubicación si es algo costoso y teniendo en cuenta que el baño no es privado y se comparte con otros huéspedes.
review_3_text:
Si deseas tener la experiencia de campo, este es el lugar indicado. Excelente atención de sus anfitriones.
Vale la pena conocer este rinconcito de Boyacá.
review_4_text:
An incredible place that gives you peace of mind, and the attention that its owners give you makes you feel at home.
The atmosphere is lovely 🌻🙂
review_5_text: It is a nice, cozy and simple place. Jean Paul's attention and affection is superlative. Duncan behaved like a gentleman

review_2_text: Beautiful place
review_3_text: Awesome

review_5_text: Sehr gute Location für Feste aller Art!

review_2_text: Genuinely gorgeous. Some issues with how what I assume was chimney smoke made it’s way into our rooms and the general comfort of the beds, but with how absolutely beautiful and peaceful everything else is it absolutely does not matter. A must for anyone looking to get away from the craziness of the city.
review_3_text: Hotel with great colonial climate. Great staff, delicious food and very comfy bed. Gardens with plenty of old trees makes it even more cool. We loved the stay and we definitely will be coming back again!
review_4_text: A beautiful getaway in Boyacá.
review_5_text: Sumerced

name: Bahareque CASA Camping

review_1_text: The place is beautiful, with a warm and inviting atmosphere, and the owner, Briam, is incredibly friendly and thoughtful. He goes above and beyond to ensure guests feel at home, which adds a special touch to the experience.
review_2_text: In our small cabana we had lights, Wi-Fi, a portable tv and plenty of blankets. Good value for money. Also recieved advice on tours to Paremo Oceta and were able to arrange the tour upon arrival at 20PM.  The dogs, Tony and Max, were friendly. The tour felt pricey but worth it.
review_3_text: A wonderful and quiet place for camping , surrounded by mountains :) The staff is very friendly and gives you good informations about the region and the walks you can do around Mongui.+++++
review_4_text: A beautiful place with a friendly host and guidance about town and Ocetá páramo. Such a nice place to rest for a very good price.
review_5_text: Cool place

name: Cabañas los Sauces
address: Vereda la puerta, sector Playa Blanca, Tota
review_1_text:
The place is wonderful!
The view is spectacular. The cabin is very romantic and well-located.
The service and attention are also wonderful.
Highly recommended!
review_2_text: Excellent service and attention, the reception and delivery of the cabin by Sergio was very good... Highly recommended for the view and the ideal price
review_3_text: It is spectacular, it is worth all the money in the world, Sergio takes incredible care of us and helped us a lot upon arrival, an excellent person, the view is beautiful, just like the photos. Super recommended. Wear warm pajamas because it is very cold at night
review_4_text: An incredible place, a wonderful view, the cabin very cozy and clean, and Sergio's service was very kind. Ready to go back!!! 🤍🤍🤍
review_5_text: The view is beautiful, super easy to get to, the cabin is much better than the photos, super clean, tidy and cozy, ideal for relaxing.

name: LAGO DE TOTA ECO. La Puerta del Lago
address: Vereda La Puerta, Sector Playa Blanca, Tota
review_1_text: This place is beautiful, and its scenery is beautiful. The experience wasn't very positive. It took a while to get our room. There were cobwebs in the room, and the blankets had the scent of a previous guest. You have to walk uphill quite a bit to get to the inn; there are no proper paths to enjoy the hike. The bathroom flooded, and the shower didn't provide enough water. Although everyone was very friendly, I really wouldn't return.
review_2_text: Ideal location, very cozy and natural place although everything was very well organized. We ran out of water but in the end they fixed it, and to improve the water temperature, it always came out cold for bathing. In the end we were not that close to the people in charge, which contrasted with the day of arrival.
review_3_text:
A magical place of total peace and tranquility.
An incredible view of the Tota lagoon.
Excellent attention and kindness from the teacher and his collaborators....
Various activities to do including horseback riding, boat ride, camping, jet skiing and walking along the trails that surround the cabin.
A wonderful weekend.
review_4_text:
Excellent site, we traveled with our pet, the experience was pleasant, very satisfied with the service and the stay.
100% recommended, we would return without thinking about it.
review_5_text: Fui a celebrar mi aniversario y la atención fue maravillosa, que calidez de familia, desde Karol la hija que te atiende por whatsapp,  hasta los papás que son los que te reciben, el sitio (hasta sopita nos dieron 🥰) no tiene peros es maravillosa la vista las instalaciones y demás, solo lleven ropa bien abrigada y pantaloneta para meterse a la laguna, espero volver con toda mi familia. Mil gracias

name: Cabaña Santo Domingo, Cuitiva
review_1_text: Lindo
review_2_text: Nice place, magnificent view. But you have to do routine maintenance. The wi-fi didn't work for 2 days.
review_3_text: Bello lugar. Muy tranquilo y con una gran atención.
review_4_text: Hermosa vista, muy tranquilo y agradable
review_5_text: Beautiful place next to nature, I loved it!!!

review_3_text: Es un restaurante con platos al horno de leña, especialidad pizzas la atención es excelente y la ubicación es una casona antigua un buen lugar para salir de la rutina en familia en pareja o con amigos.
review_4_text:
Excelente lugar y muy tranquilo.
La administradora es muy amable.
El acceso es relativamente sencillo.
review_5_text: Nice place excellent service.

name: Hotel Libertadores paipa
review_1_text: Eee
review_2_text: The highlight is the service. The staff is excellent at responding to any request. The breakfast option is excellent. The cleaning service is excellent. It's done daily. Overall, everything is very good.
review_3_text: The staff is very friendly and the service and room are comfortable for the price. I think the parking can be improved.
review_4_text: Good stay to continue the family trip. For the holidays, in my case, only breakfast was 1 hour late due to the number of guests, everything was excellent in terms of service, comfort and locality.
review_5_text: Excellent place, spectacular and very delicious breakfast. I recommend it. Excellent view. And very good attention.

name: Playa blanca Glamping bethél
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text: An excellent choice for visiting Lake Tota. The cabin is very nice, clean, and organized. Although the place is very cold, the cabin is very comfortable. They don't have a restaurant, but they do offer home delivery. The only thing that could be improved is the breakfast; otherwise, I highly recommend it.
review_2_text: It exceeded my expectations. It's a glamping site that feels like a treehouse! Very cute, cozy, and conveniently located with an excellent view of the lake. The hosts were very friendly, and it's not expensive considering what it offers and includes breakfast.
review_3_text: I loved it, a magical, wonderful place, the view, the attention of the manager, everything is excellent
review_4_text: The view is beautiful, the breakfast was very filling, and the atmosphere is very peaceful. The cabins have internet access, digital platforms on the TV, and various options for making tourist plans. What should be improved or kept in mind when visiting is to bring warm clothing because it gets very cold at night. The bathroom shower is very small.
review_5_text: A very cozy place, very complete and with a spectacular view of the lake, the breakfast was 10/10 and the host, Don Ferney, was great!!

name: Lago de Tota Playa Blanca- Glamping Kairos
review_1_text: Despite the height, KAIROS glamping is in an excellent location with spectacular scenery. It comes equipped with heating and good thermal blankets. There is also home delivery, which is the most spectacular. Today there was an earthquake and it was a different and adrenaline-filled experience.
review_2_text: The lagoon is beautiful and there are also islands 🏝️ that are not beautiful, there are boats that take you to the islands and also for a tour, it is very beautiful
review_3_text: It is a very beautiful landscape, the water is emerald green and very cold!! Recommended 100℅

review_5_text:
Tiene una excelente vista

name: Hotel Boutique La Marquesa de Pinares
review_1_text:
It is a very nice hotel built on a remodeled colonial-style house. The rooms are very nice and comfortable and open onto a pleasant patio with rocking chairs and a stone fountain.
The hotel is about a 15-minute walk from Tibasosa's central park, making it easier to reach restaurants by car.
review_2_text: Excellent place to stay, quiet, clean, more than timely attention and it is pet friendly - it has an additional cost that we were aware of at all times-
review_3_text:
Es un hotel ubicado en el área rural del municipio lo que lo hace muy agradable y tranquilo. Hermosa casa restaurada, las habitaciones  son muy cómodas, limpias y espaciosas.
El desayuno es muy  bueno y abundante.
La atención es personalizada.
review_4_text: The tranquility of being outside of Tibasosa, but a 20-minute walk from its main park. Very organized, the rooms are very comfortable and the attention of the people who work at the hotel and the hotel owners make the stay very warm. The town is close to many towns worth knowing in Boyaca, such as Laguna Tota, Monguí, Corrales, Nobsa, Pueblito Boyacense, Paipa, Iza, among others. Recommended the hotel
review_5_text:
Hermosa casona colonial de estilo republicano restaurada, actualmente como un hotel acogedor lleno de magia y rodeado de mucha naturaleza.
Desde el momento de nuestra llegada al hotel la señora Fabiola y su familia nos hicieron sentir como en casa, brindándonos una excelente atención y receptivos a todas nuestras necesidades.
La habitación donde nos alojamos muy amplia con cama king y baño muy limpio.
El desayuno incluido con la tarifa es delicioso y muy completo, los anfitriones atentos a los gustos de cada persona.
Durante el alojamiento en el hotel boutique se puede disfrutar de un hermoso paisaje, ver árboles frutales y estar rodeado de vaquitas.
Un lugar totalmente recomendado para quienes buscan descanso, naturaleza y excelente atención.

name: Camping Los Balcones
opening_hours: Monday: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Tuesday: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Wednesday: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Thursday: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Friday: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Saturday: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Sunday: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM
review_1_text: Good place to go and relax, really close to “La laguna de Tota” where you can swim if you like cold water, there are several camping spaces and 2 Glamping and they’re really quite and nice. Their bathrooms are “eco-friendly”, they have a restaurant where you can buy breakfast, lunch and dinner (there’s no restaurants nearby the area).
review_2_text: Has firewood, hot water showers, camping by the water. Nice owner keeps that keeps things quiet after 10pm. Except for the dogs - they run around and bark all night.
review_3_text: Nice place best for camping in tent. For rigs the parking is a bit far from the water
review_4_text: Recommend. Has an excellent view of Tota lake.
review_5_text:
With my girlfriend we went camping to do astronomy and enjoy the view of the lake (very beautiful). We went at the end of January.
It is a good place to do astronomy as long as you can turn off the lights (I was lucky to be the only ones camping during the low season), you also have to prepare very well for the cold and humidity.
small things to improve but overall highly recommended

name: Bella Tierra Hotel Boutique
review_1_text: Beautiful! Had a wonderful time with my family
review_2_text: Cool
review_3_text: The hotel is very nice, the rooms are spacious and the spaces are very cozy, but without a doubt the best thing is the service. They treat you with cordiality and kindness, which should be an example for many tourist destinations in Colombia. All the employees called us by name, smiled and showed interest in knowing how we were doing and treated our children with great love and attention. They prepared special activities for the children's fun and were always open to the requests we made, such as increasing the temperature of the pool water or adapting the menu in the restaurant to the children's tastes. We will definitely return and recommend it to our friends and family.
review_4_text:
✨ A magical place to rest and unwind ✨
Every time I visit Hotel Bella Tierra, I fall more in love. It's a truly romantic place, ideal for resting, pampering, and recharging. The staff is impeccable, always attentive and smiling. The food is delicious, prepared with care and local flavor that you can savor in every bite.

The decor is charming, with details that convey warmth and good taste. The spa and wet areas are perfect for relaxing; I left feeling refreshed. Every time I stay here, I leave with a deep sense of well-being.
Without a doubt, a special place that I recommend a thousand times over. 💫
review_5_text: We stayed at this hotel in Tibasosa and the experience was very good. The rooms are very nice, with a charming colonial style, and the service was friendly and cordial. However, we noticed that more staff were needed, since the lady who served us had to take care of many tasks at the same time. Breakfast was delicious and overall everything went very well. Additionally, the hotel has a heated pool, which was a big plus for the stay. It is important to keep in mind that, to get there, it is necessary to take a car from the town, since the hotel is in an unpaved area, but quite accessible.

name: Monteverde Glamping
review_1_text: Very good experience, they have a unique view, the hosts are very attentive and friendly, recommending!!!
review_2_text: Wonderful place to go with family and relax

name: Camping Playa Blanca Boyaca
review_1_text: Well served, the people of Boyacá are very humble and helpful.
review_2_text: Playa Blanca is one of the most beautiful places in Colombia. Before arriving there are spectacular views of the lagoon surrounded by mountains. Unmatched landscape.
review_3_text:
They do not meet biosafety requirements.

It is a place next to Playa Blanca, unfortunately they charge you to go in to see the lagoon and the service in the place is bad

Although you can take one or another good photo
review_4_text: a beautiful place to get out of the stress of the city, very nice and highly recommended

name: Cabaña Campestre Ciudad Memoria
review_1_text: It's a very cozy, clean place with beautiful mountain views. It's very quiet and rural, perfect for relaxing or just passing through the city. Excellent hospitality from host Jairo, who takes every care to make you feel welcome and inform you about all the activities available.
review_2_text: Wonderful place, pleasant atmosphere, surrounded by nature. I enjoyed the hiking, waterfall views, and I loved it. The rooms are clean and comfortable, and the service is excellent. I highly recommend it for a stay with family, friends, or a couple.
review_3_text: Excellent rural experience close to the city, clean and comfortable; great service and a variety of guided ecotourism activities.
review_4_text: A very nice experience, a very quiet environment and suitable for relaxing in the middle of nature.
review_5_text: Excellent

name: Alojamiento villa cucha
review_1_text:
A wonderful place to rest or to go out to other adventure places.
The service is like being at home, Mrs. Dora's treatment goes far beyond what is necessary and without a doubt makes the experience worth 1000 times more.
Thank you very much for receiving us
review_2_text: A great location in Mongui. Very nice house in a nice quiet location. Dora is extremely hospitable and is always there for you. She helped us with a guide for a hike through the Paramo de Oceta - very nice trip! Vila Cucha is an absolute must for a visit to Mongui!
review_3_text: Dora es muy amable y muy pendiente de sus huéspedes. L lugar es bonito y tranquilo. El problema son las duchas eléctricas que nos son muy caliente y no tiene presión.
review_4_text: Beautiful. Very well cared for. It feels like sleeping in the countryside but very close to the town. Mrs. Dora super friendly. It has parking.
review_5_text: The place is close to the town, the house is very nice, cozy, Mrs. Dora is very hospitable and friendly, a recommended place to disconnect from the city! 5 stars!

name: Posada rural - La Isabela
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text:
La Isabela is located in a small town, Tópaga.
This is a good place to rest, be close to nature and know more about the Colombian history of independence time. The ambiance is familial, all the people living there are kind and helpful. If you get there, Don Antonio will help you with directions to go to other towns, but if you prefer, he could take you to some places such as La Laguna Negra, La Cascada, and some others. What I recommend is having warm or winter clothes cause it is near the Páramo de Ocetá, the one you can visit also if you want.
I liked this place because of the consciousness this family has about the environment, you feel like home, is close to other towns to know, and the nature surrounding everything, If you ask me, I would go back again.
review_2_text: Una linda casa, lo más lindo fue la amabilidad de la familia. Las habitaciones están bien, dato importante: la casa es compartida. Tiene varias habitaciones y van moviendo las camas de acuerdo a las reservas. Todo limpio. La cocina amplia, es un lugar  perfecto para mascotas, pueden andar libre por la casa y salir a la zona verde que es cerrada. Lo recomiendo para familias o grupos de amigos. Ubicación perfecta para ir a visitar los pueblitos de la provincia Sugamuxi.
review_3_text:
Un lugar bastante agradable y acogedor, con unos paisajes increíbles a sus alrededores, tiene buen espacio con zona verde, BBQ...

Es una casa que está en buen estado, además de bien aseada y con todo lo necesario para pasar unas buenas vacaciones.
review_4_text:
Excellent attention 🙂
Everything clean and well-groomed👍
review_5_text: The attention from its owners is unsurpassed. Super friendly people, they make you feel at home. Warm atmosphere.

name: Hostal La Cazihita
opening_hours: Monday: 12:00 – 11:00 PM|Tuesday: 12:00 – 11:00 PM|Wednesday: 12:00 – 11:00 PM|Thursday: 12:00 – 11:00 PM|Friday: 12:00 – 11:00 PM|Saturday: 12:00 – 11:00 PM|Sunday: 12:00 – 11:00 PM
review_1_text: This place was just wonderful and a dreamy one in such a peculiar town! It is so colloquial and the owner is so attentive and kind! The house 🏡 is magic, I'd come back hundreds times as needed! Thanks For everything!
review_2_text: Cozy, clean and quiet place that felt like home. It was great having access to a kitchen and lovely garden. Miguel is really nice and is knowledgeable about local attractions and hikes.
review_3_text:
Cozy hostel, but extremely dusty. I struggled with my allergies a lot

We were disappointed with their lack of interest in helping explain the local sights to visit
review_4_text: Perfect if you’re looking for a quiet, safe place to rest. Nice kitchen and Miguel is a very kind and helpful host. Thank you!
review_5_text: Really nice and cozy place I feel like home. that's the place if you're looking to get some good rest.

name: Restaurante Hostal De La Villa Pa Sumerce
opening_hours: Monday: 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM|Tuesday: 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM|Wednesday: 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM|Thursday: 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM|Friday: 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM|Saturday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM|Sunday: 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM
review_1_text: We had the best salmon of our lives here. Excellent service and great view of the mountains. Best restaurant in all of Mongui!
review_2_text: Delicious, great value food and excellent service with a smile. Vegetarian options available, we were offered a mixed salad or fruit salad instead of the chicken soup and both were great. Highly recommended
review_3_text:
The restaurant serves amazing menu executivo!  Huge delicious portions for 22k pesos. Excellent service y the downstairs dining room has a great view of the valley 😋 👌 😀 👍 I had pechuga, salad, rice, soup  potatoes y platano with jello desert, my husband had touchable with the same sides.

They are open daily until 4 serving breakfast y lunch. By far our favorite lunch in Mongui!  Highest of recommendations!!!
review_4_text: We stayed in this lovely hostel for 5 nights, we actually booked for 3 nights, but kept on extending our stay, just because we loved the village and the hostel so much. The hostel is super clean, calm and quiet. We enjoyed the room, kitchen and living room, and small balcony for morning coffee in the sun. The owners are very friendly and helpful, they helped out with  our questions, laundry service and excellent food. Every day started with great coffee, fresh fruits and eggs. We could not have asked for more. Muchas gracias por tu hospitalidad!

name: Hospedaje Rural Villa Sadais
review_1_text:
Staying at Mrs. Libia's house is an endearing experience. He did everything possible to make me feel comfortable and even organized a visit to the Páramo de Ocetá for us and his son so that we wouldn't have to go through an agency and pay exorbitant prices! The panela water that he prepares feeds the soul:)

Perhaps the only thing, the accommodation is somewhat on the outskirts of town (15min walk), but it is a unique experience!
review_2_text: It is a normal rural place, it is clean, the Libyan lady is very friendly, but access by car is 4x4, a small one is not recommended. For the economical price it does the basics.
review_3_text: Room not clean, bathroom dirty and toilet didn't flush on the second day. We preferred not to have breakfast because of the dirt in the kitchen. According to the pictures it looked much better. Even if it is cheap, you can expect cleanliness. The rooms border directly on the living room and the kitchen, so you can hear everything early on, not to mention the rooster that knows how to crow. The taxi ordered by the owner still hadn't arrived after more than 30 minutes, so we walked to the main square with our heavy backpacks. We then met the taxi driver, but he seemed very unprofessional with red eyes and we took the bus.
review_4_text: The rooms require more cleaning, the bed is comfortable, the super attention is very very friendly, the location is a bit uncrowded to get to.
review_5_text: The house is clean, as is the room, nothing extraordinary, it fits the price, the only thing is that if you don't go with your own transportation, it is far from the main square.

review_1_text: The house is pleasant, however, for the price we paid for our stay we do not feel that the accommodations nor service offered is up to par. First of all, the side of the house we were placed in did not even have a working kitchen. Access to a refrigerator was provided but you had to go through the staff to get something stored in a refrigerator we did not have access to. There was not even a microwave available to heat up food or make some popcorn. The lamp on the nightstand in one of the bedrooms did not even have a lightbulb. When we requested one, we were told the cable did not reach the outlet. When we informed them it did, we were told that the lamp was just a "decorative" fixture. Lol. For the money we paid, I think they could've found a lightbulb somewhere. The breakfast service was mediocre at best. The person serving breakfast on the first day would bring in one item at a time for our group of 7 people. Additionally, when we initially booked, we had been told we would have 3 rooms for our larger group. Upon checking in, we were only given 2 rooms, which turned out ok as one of our group was not able to travel. However, if the group had been it's original size, the 2 rooms would not have been enough to accommodate our group and it would have been uncomfortable to accommodate. Just because a bed can fit 2 people doesn't mean those 2 people want to sleep together. The house is not centrally located so if you don't have a car, don't stay here. Additionally, the fact that you share the house with other guests does not make for a comfortable stay. It was ok, but I would not stay here again and we feel the price paid does not reflect the accommodations or service offered. The staff at check in was welcoming but after that there was not a welcoming vibe there.

Hotel Campestre Villa Los Duraznos is a charming bed and breakfast nestled in the heart of Paipa, Colombia. From the moment I arrived, I was greeted by the warm hospitality of the staff, led by the gracious host, Kathi. The hotel's serene location and well-appointed facilities create an atmosphere of relaxation and comfort.
Spacious and Well-Appointed Rooms
The rooms at Hotel Campestre Villa Los Duraznos are spacious, clean, and well-maintained. Each room is tastefully decorated with a touch of rustic elegance, providing a cozy and inviting ambiance. The beds are comfortable, ensuring a restful night's sleep after a day of exploring the surrounding area.
Exceptional Service and Facilities
The hotel's staff is attentive, friendly, and well-guided by Kathi. They go above and beyond to ensure that guests have a memorable stay, offering helpful recommendations and assisting with any requests. The facilities at Hotel Campestre Villa Los Duraznos are well-maintained and include amenities such as free WiFi, a picnic area, and a sun terrace.
Ideal Location for Exploring Paipa
The hotel's location is ideal for those looking to explore the charming town of Paipa and its surrounding attractions. It is situated in a quiet area, providing a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. The hotel's proximity to local attractions makes it easy to discover the best of Paipa.
Exceptional Value for Money
Hotel Campestre Villa Los Duraznos offers exceptional value for money. The combination of spacious rooms, excellent service, and ideal location makes it a top choice for travelers seeking a comfortable and enjoyable stay in Paipa.
In conclusion, Hotel Campestre Villa Los Duraznos is a hidden gem in Paipa, Colombia. With its spacious rooms, exceptional service, and ideal location, it is the perfect choice for those looking to escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life and immerse themselves in the beauty of Colombia's countryside. I highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Paipa.

review_1_text: What a magical place this is! The house is beautiful and very well appointed. The views are spectacular. There is a lovely walkway that leads to a couple of areas where you can enjoy hanging out, having your morning coffee and taking in the beauty all around you. It's easy enough to walk out of the property and take a beautiful walk. If you're up for getting away from it all and enjoying a vacation in the midst of nature, this is the place to be. The most activity you will see is the cows all around munching all day and then heading back to their barns in the evening. It's peaceful and wonderful. The host will make sure to take loving care of anything you need. She'll deliver breakfast in a lovely basket with fresh -picked flowers.
review_2_text: Amazing place and experience. I highly recommend staying at Casa Barcelona. Martha, our hostess, was very attentive and always ready to help with any request.

review_1_text: Very beautiful views and a very safe location for Americans vacationing in Colombia. Huge beds and an amazing clean kitchen for cooking! review_2_text:
Hello friends!

I want to recommend the perfect cabin for a getaway in the mountains with a spectacular viewpoint of the city of Paipa in Boyacá.  I recently had the opportunity to stay in a cabin with my family and it was an incredible experience, good host, impeccable cleanliness and pleasant location, the cabin is located in a beautiful natural environment, close to waterfalls, surrounded by forests perfect for hiking and with panoramic views of the Sochagota lakes that will leave you breathless. It is the ideal place to disconnect, relax and enjoy the tranquility that only nature can provide.

In addition, it has all the necessary amenities for a comfortable stay, outside it has a cozy fireplace for cool nights, spaces for a bonfire, a terrace, catamaran and a covered jacuzzi perfect for enjoying the landscape, and a rustic decoration that will make you feel at home.

If you are looking for a place to recharge your batteries and connect with nature, this cabin is undoubtedly the perfect option. You will not regret living this unique experience!
I hope you enjoy this special corner in the Paipa mountains as much as I do!

Greetings!
review_3_text: Wonderful, the host is very gracious and the experience is fantastic. I recommend bringing food since it is far from the city.
review_4_text: I found it to be a very clean cabin, the sofas were impeccable, the sheets smelled delicious, clean, the jacuzzi in front of the view of the lake and the mountains is spectacular and it is inside the cabin that makes it feel like a more cozy and comfortable place since you can enjoy the jacuzzi at night or during the day. Además, el orden y la limpieza impecables del lugar contribuyen a crear una atmosfera de serenidad y bienestar. cada detalle cuidadosamente pensado y mantenido, lo que permite una estancia placentera. con excelente vista al municipio de Paipa y los lagos Sochagota, el lugar permite un refugio especial para desconectar del ajetreo diario y recargar energías. !recomendado si están buscando un ambiente acogedor, ordenado y limpio ara disfrutar de momentos de paz y tranquilidad¡

The rooms, although perhaps not luxurious, are cozy and clean, providing a pleasant atmosphere for guests. The staff stands out for their kindness and willingness to help, creating a welcoming atmosphere.

In terms of amenities, Hotel Boston has basic but essential services, such as reliable Wi-Fi and satisfying breakfast. The common spaces are well maintained, offering a pleasant place to relax.

In short, the Boston Hotel is a solid choice for those who value practicality and hospitality when visiting the Colombian capital.

opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text:
Do NOT book your event at Hotel Sabana Park — especially if you value organization, communication, or your sanity.

We had friends and family stay at this hotel over a 4-day period in March 2024, and I cannot stress this enough: if you are planning any kind of group event here — wedding, business meeting, family reunion — turn around and run. Hotel Sabana Park might look appealing from the outside, and yes, the food and basic staff interactions were decent. But behind the scenes, this hotel is a logistical nightmare.

The biggest issue is Mariana, the so-called “Commercial Director.” She was the only person we were allowed to deal with, and she was completely unprofessional. She routinely ignored emails, sent us incorrect pricing and information multiple times, and was either shockingly rude or completely MIA. Her quotes for group dinners and event spaces were wildly overpriced — think Manhattan rooftop rates in a Bogotá suburb. Nothing made sense, nothing was itemized clearly, and any time we asked for clarification, we were either brushed off or met with more errors.

Reservations were lost. Bills were confusing. One section of the hotel had a leaking roof. And every time we asked to speak with someone else, we were told Mariana was our only option.

There are plenty of beautiful, professional venues in the Bogotá area — this is not one of them. If you're simply staying a night and have no need to interact with management, you might be fine. But if you’re organizing anything that requires coordination, clear communication, or basic respect for your time and money, avoid Hotel Sabana Park at all costs.
