review_5_text: Comfortable and well-equipped rooms, in addition to their cleanliness, typical and delicious breakfast (Paid separately from accommodation). Your host very friendly and attentive. Close to town and good parking space. At dawn you will feel the atmosphere of a dairy farm, as it is surrounded by cows grazing around a large lagoon.

name: Cacique Real Hotel
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text:
I will highly recommend Hotel Cacique Real.
Everyone was extremely friendly and helpful. I booked my stay for 5 days but extended to 10 days.
The breakfast was fantastic,  the room very comfortable and clean, perfect location. If I could give 10 stars I would.
Thank you to everyone for making my stay so memorable.
review_2_text: I absolutely love this hotel. The courtyard was beautiful. The rooms were comfortable. It was very authentic. It had wonderful antiques and I just fell in love with the city.
review_3_text: Wow, what a great find. We were very comfortable in the modern side of the hotel.  The beds, bedding and towells were excellent. The rooms were very clean. The front desk staff were very kind. It was easy to make a reservation with What's App. They have a secure parking lot. The breakfast was included and had variety every day. The price was fair for all we got. The only thing that was not good is that that WiFi was very weak. But they advised us ahead, so it was not a surprise.
review_4_text:
Hotel Cacique Real is a charming colonial house meticulously restored to its former glory. The clean and well-appointed rooms offer all the necessary amenities for a comfortable stay. The friendly and accommodating staff add to the welcoming atmosphere, ensuring guests feel right at home.

One of the highlights of the hotel is its stunning interior courtyard, a peaceful oasis perfect for relaxation. Guests can unwind amidst the lush greenery and picturesque surroundings, providing a tranquil escape from the hustle and bustle of the city.

The hotel's prime location offers easy access to numerous restaurants and a supermarket, making it convenient for guests to explore the local dining scene and stock up on essentials.

While the breakfast may not be extravagant, it is tasty and satisfying, providing a good start to the day. Overall, Hotel Cacique Real is a highly recommended choice for travelers seeking a comfortable and authentic Colombian experience. Its combination of historic charm, attentive service, and convenient location make it a standout option in the area.
review_5_text: Very close to downtown and the main plazas! Affordable prices

name: Hotel Vigua
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text:
Small, but enough space to spend a night. It was a cold day and quite cold in the room also. Some rooms don't have an outside window.
No food/drinks, except from the cooler by the reception.
Very close to the cathedral of salt.
Good value for the money.
review_2_text: It's a good place to stay when short on budget, it's easy to contact the owners (which are really nice people).
review_3_text: Lovely place to stay, hot water fast Wi-Fi good location
review_4_text: They disconnect the fridge to save electricity, this causes warm beer!!!
review_5_text: Ok

name: Hotel California
review_1_text: Full
review_2_text: The photos they publish of the facilities and the rooms are so different; in reality, they're in very poor condition. It's a shame. It used to be a nice hotel, but now it's quite run down. The breakfast is too basic, and for a rate of $220,000, it's too high. It needs a major renovation. Pacho is a municipality in Cundinamarca with a fairly good highway; they're currently fixing it, and they charge double tolls—terrible.
review_3_text: Excellent service, it is a little far from the town but the facilities are very nice.
review_4_text: Pleasant atmosphere, delicious breakfast, great pool, excellent service and comfortable rooms.
review_5_text: It is a nice place, very quiet and the service is excellent.

name: ibis Chia
review_1_text: Right what you need! Rooms are comfortable and spacious. The food at the breakfast buffet and at the restaurant is really good. It far exceeds expectations. Notably, everyone is wonderful! They are truly welcoming and caring. Highly recommended!
review_2_text: Our experience at the hotel was disappointing. First, we found the rooms to be quite small, which was not suitable for our family. When we asked the front desk for a room change, even if it meant paying extra, we were informed that all rooms have the same setup. The bathroom was very outdated; the toilet cover fell off and made loud noises. We were also disappointed to learn that the hotel does not offer in-room service, which meant we had to go downstairs whenever we needed anything. Additionally, the breakfast options were of poor quality and overpriced. Overall, based on this experience, we would not consider returning to this hotel in the future. When we discovered these issues on the day we checked in, we requested a refund, but we were informed that there was no possibility of getting even half of our money back. This was the worst service/management we have ever encountered at a hotel.
review_3_text: No room service, on second night ( May 16th on 2025) I had to wait for an hour someone would bring me any meal to my table, although I tried to chat with the supposed "help" number. No waiter attended my requests, only the girl in reception helped me with a dirty menu.
review_4_text: Mediocre service, uncomfortable beds, no mini fridge, no ice bucket or ice machines. The best thing was the breakfast, which was just ok. Cannot recommend.
review_5_text: It was perfect for a night. We needed just to spend a night in Chia so It was very convenient and for the right price. Perfect room, clean, nicely decorated for bussines, good breakfast. I dont have any complaints.

name: Hotel Camelia Real Briceño
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text: Mmmmm
review_2_text: We had reserved half the price at the hotel in Sopo, which is more family-friendly, but when we arrived, they told us there was no reservation. They ended up sending us to the Briseño hotel. They should be more organized with reservations and honor them. It wasn't what we expected, as the rooms were more for couples, so we had chosen the Sopo hotel with multiple occupancy and family-style rooms. In addition, the towels were in poor condition, torn, and very worn.
review_3_text: Excellent place to stay very good room service the girls are very friendly recommended
review_4_text: Excellent service near Jaime Duque Park.
review_5_text: Excelente hotel, la atención fue lo mejor, la verdad lo hacen sentir muy cómodo, además si quieren visitar el parque Jaime duque les queda muy cerca aproximadamente 5 minutos en automóvil

name: Hotel La Posada de Charrito
review_1_text: It is a quiet, clean place. Not so much luxury but very pleasant. Excellent attention!!
review_2_text: Quiet, good for resting, large and clean beds, as well as the bathroom. 👍
review_3_text: It is a simple hotel. It has no luxuries. It's clean.
review_4_text: Good service, clean and simple
review_5_text: Excellent service and very good hotel

name: Hotel Villa Juliana
review_1_text:
Spent a night outside Bogata hete on our way to Villa de Layva.
Security cameras everywhere, Spotlessly clean, bed was very firm for me but I just doubled the duvet and slept under the blanket and sheet no problem.
A hearty breakfast included. I just paid the extra 7pst for 2 good sized water bottles and a extra hot chocolate from my room's refrigerator.
The ladies in the kitchen were so sweet and, again, I am surprised by people's kindness towards us.
review_2_text:
We stayed for 1 night and didn't have a good experience.
We liked the location but the place is very noisy. From dogs barking throughout the night,  people ringing the doorbell after what quiet hours were supposed to be to roosters clucking at 4 am, it was impossible to get any sleep.
The following morning, I was told that one of the rooms we stayed at was always noisy. Really? And you still rent it out?
The worst part was that there was never an apology on the hotel's part. They admitted to how bad things are. I told them that they should describe the place better so people would know what to expect, and avoid having a bad experience.
review_3_text: We stayed there two nights when we didn’t have hot water at our house. Great service, the lady at the front desk is so helpful. Rooms are a little dated, but clean. Parking is available inside the gated area.
review_4_text: Clean and beautiful place, professional owner is always there to help! Great hospitality! I was there years ago, the best place you can find if you visit Chia and nearby!
review_5_text:
Best place what i visit in this area.
Nice, clean, great personal, laundry, bikes, breakfast, kitchen stuff, cleaning every day, small breakfast included.
Only barking dogs in neighbor are annoying sometimes.

name: Quinta de Fagua
address: Quinta de Fagua Quinta de Fagua, Cr. Novoa #01, Sutatausa
review_1_text: Best place ever
review_2_text:
Visitamos el sitio en familia para camping.
El lugar es apropiado para descansar y aislarse del estrés de la ciudad. En el día nos hizo un sol espectacular en la  madrugada nos hizo bastante frío (importante ir preparados y todo perfecto). La limpieza de las diferentes zonas es excelente. Los baños impecables.
Se cuenta con nevera y casilleros para guardar los alimentos.
La atención y disposición de las personas a cargo  20/10
Muy contentos con la experiencia.
review_3_text: (Camping) Excellent service, the person who served us (Daniel) was very helpful, the spaces are adequate, the facilities are in excellent condition, 100% recommended
review_4_text: Excellent place!! Very quiet, perfect for connecting with nature, easy access allowing small cars to enter. Spectacular views ideal for hiking and walking.
review_5_text: Excellent place, very quiet and very well located. The facilities surprised my partner and me, with very comfortable common areas, a kitchen and a hot shower that is not usually common in this type of places. In addition to the company of Estrella, the beautiful dog who accompanied us throughout the stay and who even accompanied us to climb the cliffs as our guide. We will see you again, pretty thing!

name: HOSPEDAJE LA MAGIA DE ZIPAQUIRA
review_1_text: We arrived and had to be assisted by the insurance agent from the floor below because the receptionist wasn't there, and the lady on duty wasn't keeping track of the guests. We had booked 15 days in advance, and they asked us for a 50% deposit to secure the room, even though the app stated it wasn't required. However, upon arrival, they told us that due to an unforeseen event, our rooms were unavailable. They assigned us other rooms that were nothing like the ones in the photos, and for the rest of our stay, we had no contact with anyone who could assist us. At the end of the stay, they tried to charge us for the rooms we weren't assigned and had the nerve to claim we hadn't received poor service.
review_2_text: The disappointment of Zipaquirá is that they require you to pay a 50% deposit, 15 days in advance to secure your room. Once you arrive at the hotel, they tell you there was an emergency and the room wasn't available. The rest was self-service, with no customer service staff or anything like that.
review_3_text: It was self-service, the person in charge, whether receptionist or administrator, never showed up. Upon arrival, we wrote to the manager and he didn't respond. A girl who works in the insurance office below the hotel answered the question. The cleaning lady had no information or knowledge whatsoever (that's not her job).
review_4_text:
THE HOTEL IS MANAGED BY PEOPLE WHO ASK YOU PRIVATELY TO MAKE TRANSFER TO THEM “IN ORDER TO ENSURE THE RESERVATION”.
WHICH IS A SCAM AND IT GOES AGAINST BOOKING POLICY. IF YOU DON'T MAKE THE TRANSFER THEY LEAVE YOU ON THE STREET. I FOUND MYSELF ON THE STREET WITH MY GIRLFRIEND LATE IN THE EVENING AND IN A DANGEROUS PLACE. FLEE THIS HOTEL!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
review_5_text: Cuidado !!!!! Este hotel después de reservar pide tranferecias bancarias a cuentas extrañas !!! Todo parece ser un robo y al llegar al hotel nunca tuvieron en cuenta la reserva que además había sido confirmada en Booking !!!!!!! Hallan de este hotel !!!!!?

name: Fortaleza Diosa Chia
review_1_text:
We didn't like it. When we arrived on the first day there was water rationing but they did not warn us about this, there was water from the tank only for the shower, NOT for the toilets, I had to ask them for a bucket and draw water from the shower.
On the second day, around 4:00 a.m., someone came to the hotel's entrance door ringing like crazy, they rang for 15 minutes about 10 times and no one answered, obviously that didn't let us sleep.
The bed in the room only has a blanket and it is cold in Chia, I couldn't sleep well during my stay.
I do not recommend this hotel, lousy service, a lot of disturbance.
review_2_text: Me pareció un maravilloso lugar para dormir comodamente y compartir con mis mascotas. Ya que en Chía es difícil encontrar un sitio así.
review_3_text: Super recommended, it is a warm and friendly place, I felt like I was at home, the service and attention is as close as possible to everything.
review_4_text: Excellent service. It is a very central place to everything. Easy transportation and the hosts help you get situated.
review_5_text: ¡Por fin pude descansar bien! Gran servicio, buenas instalaciones y queda súper cerca a todo.

name: Hospedaje La Casona -
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text:
Very cozy place, I really love the colonial, hall-based design of the place. The owners and staff are very friendly as well.

The bed is cozy, there is hot water in the shower, small TV, and lots of board games.

They also give free coffee and bread in the morning.

Bonus points for not charging extra for checking out 2 hours later, as we wanted to enjoy the thermal baths, but the day before we arrived destroyed from a long cycling trip.

Highly recommended for high tier service and cozy accommodation.
review_2_text:
So, I lived at La Casona for over eight months and this is how I experienced it...

Service: ⭐⭐⭐
I like the hostel. Most of the staff is friendly, however one of the housekeepers steals money and tech stuff from the room. Besides that, you have to ring the front door to get in and that same housekeeper yells from his room that he's coming or that you have to wait while he is finishing their game.

Amenities: ⭐⭐⭐⭐
There is a kitchen, so you can cook and there are 2 living rooms. One of them has a big TV. The WiFi doesn't work most of the time, so if you are a foreigner and you are planning on staying there a few nights, it might be a good idea to get a Colombian SIM card first, so you can use mobile data.

Room: ⭐⭐⭐
My room is full of spiders. My closet, my curtains, my bathroom, my ceiling.. everywhere are spiders. It's quite disgusting. No matter how many spiders you kill or remove from the room, there will always be more.

Also, some weekends the place is really crowded and then you might not get too much sleep due to people talking in the hallways and the living rooms at night. The doors and windows let a lot of noise through. But don't worry, it's not like that all the time. Just thought I'd mention it.

Location: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
The hostel is located in the center of Tabio. There are bus stops, hairdressers, bakeries, restaurants... Everything you could possibly need is nearby.
review_3_text: This place is absolutely amazing!, I can't find another place to recommend when you are staying in Tabio than La Casona. The place is full of details from A-Z, coffee & tea with breads at mornings, sauna, board games for all the family, good Wi-Fi connection, hot water (for me is a must in cold weather), but what makes this place so special is all the staff, Miss Laura and all the ladies are absolutely dedicated to the guests, offering an A+ in customer service, they are also very savvy about touristic places to visit in Tabio and surroundings. I am planning to go in December and guess what? I will stay in La Casona!
review_4_text: Small hotel with very friendly staff. They even got up at 4 a.m. just to make us coffee before we leave.
review_5_text: A very good location with lots of restaurants around. Very close to the historical center and the other points of interest in this beautiful village.

name: La Puerta Rota
review_1_text: A good place to spend a night in Zipaquira
review_2_text: Is ok for a few days
review_4_text: The stay was excellent, the location is very good, it is a very central place, the cleanliness is excellent, the security to enter and leave is good, since it is with a chip this makes access easier. The receptionists are friendly, always willing to help the client; If it is necessary to leave earlier, they open the parking lot at the necessary time. A very good experience, I totally recommend it.
review_5_text: The room was a bit small but in good condition. The bathroom door was too small for overweight people, but it was very clean. There was coffee and herbs, and free parking.

If you’re planning on traveling in this area I would recommend this place for its great value, location, and accessibility to beautiful spots worth exploring.
review_2_text: Excellent location and hosting 👍
review_3_text:
Excellent place to rest. It's very quiet at night, which makes it easy to sleep. You can't hear a thing. Everything is very clean and tidy. The breakfast they provide is like being at home!

Adolfo and Liliana are two super friendly people who are always ready to help you.
review_4_text:
I really liked my stay in the area, it was very pleasant and quiet, Mr. Adolfo and his wife are very kind and attentive people.
The rooms are just like those found on the page.
review_5_text: It was a very good experience, we liked the service and the treatment of the Hotel managers.

name: LIMA LIMÓN TABIO ECO HOSTEL
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text:
We got here in the rain on our bikes after a tough go.  Our Spanish was mediocre.  We ended up staying 3 nights because the owners and staff is amazing.  We ended up meeting many people from the town and they all were so patient and helped us learn Spanish.  I will be coming back here.  If you like clean air and don’t have to be in Bogota come here.

We ended up setting up our tent in the back to save a few pesos. But it’s affordable all around.  You likely won’t meet 30 other travelers but you won’t have to share the place.  Plus the coffee... it ain’t that instant stuff that most Colombians know.
review_2_text: Pleasant facilities with colonial vintage style and exceptional service, the coffee that was offered I liked the most, in the hostel you will find some bright bathrooms, a library and a recreation area with videogames and movies, they also offer the service to camp.
review_3_text: stayed two days in Tabio and I loved so much this place! The hostel is a great 100 year-old colonial house which has been entirely remodeled with ecological material but in a very comfortable way. This is the kind of peaceful house you'd like to stay forever. They have a great patio with hammocks and a great space outside with an organic garden. Beds are comfortable and the place is very quiet at night. In Tabio you can take eco-tourism walks in the mountains and there are also thermal waters.
review_4_text: It is closed or relocated.
review_5_text: A newly restored hostel. It is a beautiful old house that has been lovingly done, with good taste. Simple, clean and the owner very friendly. I recommend it!!

name: Hostel Vanguardia Zipaquirá
review_1_text: I really enjoyed my time here! The hostel is new and the rooms are nice and fully equipped. My room was all Van Gogh styled: blu painted wall and cool paintings! The family who managed the hostel was the nicest host I could ask for! They were really helpful with suggestions and tips, and Ivan even dropped me off to the terminal bus! Totally recommended
review_2_text:
We're so glad we stayed here!

This is a new hostel - only open a few months I believe. It's been decorated with pride and care - and Ivan and his father, Gustavo, are super kind and friendly.

Our room was really nice - we were lucky enough to get the Van Gogh room; the bed is really comfortable and the temperature just right.

We were shown around the next day by Iván, who was so helpful!

The bar downstairs should be open by March I believe - it's gonna be a really nice place to get a beer and a taco.

Don't hesitate - this is the place to stay in Zipaquirá!
review_3_text: Beautiful place, well decorated. Lightning fast internet. A good shower. Close to lots of nice places
review_4_text: Ok
review_5_text: Vreemde ervaring met dit hostel. Nergens aan de buitenkant geeft aan dat er een hostel is. Je herkent het alleen aan de ‘Van Gogh-achtige’ geverfde buitenmuur. We vroegen om een kamer, maar ze gaven aan dat ze volledig volgeboekt waren. Dat is overduidelijk niet waar. Waarom zegt men niet gewoon dat het hostel gesloten is. Stuur mij niet met een leugen weg.

name: ECO GLAMPING BACATA
review_1_text: La peor experiencia en este lugar, el agua del Jacuzzi tiene un olor súper desagradable además salen una especie de renacuajos al llenarlo, nadie entrega ni recibe las cabañas, prometen cosas que no cumplen, la persona que dice ser la encargada (Santiago Cañon) solo responde cuando se le hace el pago luego de esto no vuelve a haber respuesta, no funciona el calentador de la habitación, las toallas súper sucias, las cabañas la estructuración se encuentra en mal estado, las puertas sin chapas, nunca recibimos el desayuno, es un lugar que no recomendaría y jamás volvería.
review_2_text: I made the reservation with 50/ they arrived two hours late, the place was super dirty, without hot water, there was no toilet paper, towels, soap. The breakfast never arrived, they did not change the sheets, it smelled strange, they did not refund the money, terrible place and experience, this place is a total theft, the cabins in a terrible state of cleanliness and structures is a danger!!! I don't understand why they keep this kind of place running, the worst of the worst!!!
review_3_text:
The reservation was made and we stayed on Saturday, October 5, but there were no towels or soap, to top it off, the water in the jacuzzi has a strange smell.
We paid for the breakfast service the next day which never arrived, we contacted Santiago Cañón the host several times and he only gave excuses, then he promised a refund that to this day he does not respond.

The host is not nearby for the requirements that one needs and does not comply with the refunds he promises due to non-compliance with the service provided that was paid in full, because to charge there if he answers and answers the cell phone.

I do not recommend the place, TERRIBLE SERVICE.
review_4_text: The worst experience of my life, ZERO RECOMMENDED. A place made of dirt. Besides, the claim is made and the money is stolen, they do not respond
review_5_text:
Very bad service.
They receive the money and disappear, the beds were dirty, there was no hot water and it was very cold, the heater didn't work, they didn't ask for breakfast, they didn't clean the room, the bathroom didn't have a door and the sink didn't work.
The truth is it was a bad experience and I would not return, I recommend not going to this place.

name: La Meca Glamping
review_1_text:
A really nice place to rest. It's really cold at night but you can sleep nice and well. they have a campfire at night. the view is beautiful

the bathroom is outside the dome (room) and it has hot water.

the place has horses, 2 cats and occasionally a couple of dogs from neighbors.

Alejo and the staff are super friendly and attentive.

The restaurant is incredible. I was astonished to find this quality of food this far from Bogotá.

Try the toast bread with cheese and jam. the meat is awesome as well, I didn't try the pizza but I will the next time.

This place is totally worth even if only for the food. But if you can go for the full experience
review_2_text: Nice glamping spot. Dome tents just a bit outside of town. The family running the place were very anntentive though slightly disorganized at first taking a while to check in and ready the room. Water didnt seem hot and there isnt a heater but they had good clean blankets. Good food, bar and lobby area.
review_3_text: The restaurant was great. Excellent food and service.
review_4_text:
Excellent place for lunch or dinner, very attentive service and delicious food.
Highly recommended
review_5_text: The restaurant is incredible very very good. Haute cuisine. Excellent attention. Super recommended and there is a glamping option, it also looks good. Even if I'm just stopping by for lunch. 5 stars

name: storia glamping
review_1_text:
I made a reservation in February to stay on May 24th. Upon arriving at the property, a person from the property opened the door and told us that Emanuel hadn't informed them that they would have guests. Additionally, the power had been out since the day before, and we clearly couldn't get in. It was very disappointing:
1. We had made the reservation three months in advance, confirmed it in March, and confirmed it again a week before our stay. I even sent them the breakfast menu they requested, and to arrive there and find out they didn't know there were guests—it seems terrible to me to play with people's time. As I respectfully mentioned to Emanuel, if you can't provide a service, don't provide it and save yourself the trouble.
2. We fully understood the electricity issue. However, he should have notified us the day he left, or at least the same morning, and not at the property that the electricity was out. It's clear he didn't even remember us coming, because his excuse was the electricity, but the person at the property wasn't even aware of our stay.
3. When we asked for our money back, he wanted us to wait until 6 p.m. to do so. He clarified our check-in was at 3 p.m. We arrived at 4:30 p.m. and wanted us to wait outside for an hour and a half until he could make the payment. This seemed rude and unsympathetic, considering we're not from the area. We were coming by motorcycle from a distance, tired, and intending to rest. We put in some pressure, and the guy in charge of the place helped us by getting our money back immediately, and that's what happened... at least. 4. It was disappointing to see that they showed not the slightest interest in fixing the error, and that leaves a lot to talk about and think about.
I know it's not the point, but in the area, it was somewhat difficult for us to find a hotel practically at dusk.
As a recommendation: have a system that allows you to have 100% control of your reservations, attention to detail, and timely and efficient resolution of issues. Don't do this to people because it's very disrespectful and in poor taste.
review_2_text:
Terrible service! It's a total scam. I had the worst December 24 of my life, thanks to Storia Glamping. They charged me $1,300,000 for a Christmas dinner with Turkey and a night with special Christmas decorations; and despite the fact that I had requested the menu two weeks before; They left me starving because I'm allergic to red meat and the menu that night was rice stuffed full of meat. And not to mention the dessert and decoration!
I arrived and the staff wasn't even there to greet us; much less the room decorated and ready. Everything was dirty and messy.
They failed to comply with everything they had offered. Even with the bottle of champagne that they offered in the plan, but they did have a bottle of wine to sell for $120,000 despite having already paid for it.
Emanuel, the owner apologized and said he was going to give me back part of that night; but then he was rude and ended up blocking me from WhatsApp and Instagram so I wouldn't demand my money from him.
Really a scam! I don't recommend it. For $1,300,000 they spend two nights in any 5-star hotel and are not exposed to hunger and spending the worst night of their lives.

Response to owner:
After reading Mr. Emanuel's pack of lies, I attach a screenshot where he accepts that it was a fiasco that night. It is a pity that the audios of the man in question cannot be attached, where he accepts all the failures at the time. It is incredible as a person without a word, without scruples; You can invent so much, just to not assume your responsibility and make the refund for a deplorable and deceptive service. He is a scammer, since from that date he was deceiving me with message after message that he had already given me the refund and it never happened like that. The solution was to block and invent so as not to pay.
I CLARIFY:
1. I was never rude to the staff, on the contrary, I was very understanding with them since they argued that Mr. Emanuel never informed them of the menu, and that he had not even sent them the money that day to buy the things.
2. What he says about the conditions in which I supposedly left the room is totally insulting and false; I don't even wear makeup, enough for me to invent so much, just to not assume my responsibility and keep my word.
3. As I told him; If I had received and enjoyed everything he promised, my disagreement would never have existed. That is precisely why I complained, because they did not comply with even 20% of the plan offered for $1,300,000.

review_5_text:
La peor experiencia, el hotel está caído, tiene múltiples fallas empezando por el servicio al cliente.  Es una trampa porque las fotos no muestran el olor ni el mal estado del sitio. El dueño-manager es una persona no grata. Terrible. Nos trató de estafadores cuando le dijimos que no queríamos pasar una noche más allí. La noche que pasamos fue muy mala porque el frío era terrible, la chimenea o servía y se entraba el aire congelado por las ventanas y las grietas. Los muebles parecen recogidos de la basura, la alfombra vieja y despegada. Cables electricos en la ducha, el techo cayéndose a pedazos, el piso de madera flojo. Nos quedamos allí la primera noche porque llegamos tarde de otro país y no teníamos otra opción, además somos personas positivas y no habíamos visto los cuartos, solo nos guiamos por las fotos y las reseñas de booking, pero todo fue una enseñanza porque de verdad toca que revisar bien y leer todos los comentarios nuevos.
El sitio tiene unas reseñas hermosas pero son de hace 20 años. Todo estaba viejo y quebrado, nada funcionaba bien. El restaurante nos sirvió desayuno en platos rotos, tazas despicadas. En la habitación no había agua, ni vasos.
Cuando le dije al dueño que nos queríamos ir porque habíamos cambiado de planes (la verdad fue demasiado asustador hablar con esa persona). Nos cerró la reja del hotel con candado y no nos dejó salir hasta que pagáramos un excedente porque su política del hotel es no devolver dineros. Le dije que yo le pagaba un desagravio y esta persona me gritó que no podíamos salir hasta que no canceláramos todo  el dinero, y que yo era una ladrona prácticamente.
Fue demasiado estresante es como una película de terror.  Yo había separado el hotel con la mitad, pero como éramos una familia grande estábamos esperando que llegaran todos para pagar. Mi pobre prima y su mamá si pagaron completo y no les devolvieron nada. Bueno decidimos pagar el excedente  y salir de allí.
En ese momento llegó la policía de Colombia.
El dueño llamó a la policía y ellos vinieron a hablar conmigo, revisaron mis papeles y yo les conté todo lo que había pasado y les mostré el sitio.
Yo estoy muy orgullosa de mi país porque los policías nos escoltaron para salir y fueron muy éticos y responsables Me sentí totalmente respaldada. Fue un mal momento que me dio dolor de cabeza y por eso estoy escribiendo aquí mi historia para que no le pase a nadie más.

No contrate sus eventos o este lugar para nada es una estafa , no pierda su tiempo , dinero y tranquilidad .
8 meses antes del evento prometen cielo y tierra, después no responden mensajes emails llamadas ni ningún medio de comunicación . 1 semana antes del evento nos tocó medio organizar todo por que pensamos por un momento hasta cancelar y re programar la fecha en vista de que no había nada confirmado , no habían flores , comida , lugar , notario, sacerdote , decoración . Al final mi matrimonio se llevó acabo peor fue la peor pesadilla de todas . review_1_text: It was quite easy to get there. The host is very kind. We chose to stay at the chalet, it's a rustic cabin (domi like), with a big window from where you can see Tomine's lake. review_2_text:
The owner is a scammer and we recommend avoiding this place. There are a lot of other glamping options available in the area.

Here’s the full story: My wife and I came here for a romantic evening and all the issues we faced really ruined our night:
1. Room was very cold and not well insulated.
2. Shower was either freezing cold or boiling hot. There was no way to select a moderate temperature. It was actually so hot, that my wife, who typically showers with very hot water, could not even use it.
3. Building construction is very flimsy and it feels unsafe.
4. Window was cracking in the night due to the wind and waking us up.
5. In the room, there are various locations where sharp ends of nails/screws were popping out, which is dangerous as scratches via it can cause tetanus. This is serious!
6. Lock on the room door doesn't work.
+ various other small issues.

But worst of all was this: we had a cordial discussion with the owner about all this in the morning and he assured us that if we put forward an official refund request via booking.com, he’ll give us a refund. For Colombian standards, this is not a cheap room (we stayed in their most expensive dome-shaped room), and at this price point, we had enjoyed various other very high-quality properties in the country.

But he is a scammer. It has been over 10 days since our official refund request via booking.com, and he is ignoring all methods of communication from them. The image that I can’t get out of my head is the comforting smile he put on his face that morning when we had the discussion as if everything will be taken care of, but that was just a smile of a scam artist.

Seriously, Guatavita is very beautiful, and if you want to enjoy your time here, you should avoid this property.
review_3_text: Wonderful place very recommended! You can enjoy the best moment with your love and with the best landscape.
review_4_text:
Imagine waking up and having the love of your life next to you, and looking back to enjoy those beautiful, sunny and green landscapes without getting out of bed like the one I show you in the attached video. That's what I felt there. A unique feeling of peace and tranquility.
For us there were many options to review before staying one night in Guatavita, but this was without a doubt a great option. The cabins are quite independent, they have their own bathroom, a balcony, table and chairs to be more comfortable. The bed is large and has fairly warm blankets considering the weather at night. We did not have the opportunity to try the food there, but the prices were quite affordable, it should be noted that we had an adequate budget for that trip. But we didn't try the local food because we were prepared to have lunch and dinner in the town, which is quite well located from the place, just 5 minutes by car, approximately 15 on foot and it is beautiful because it is on the road that overlooks the reservoir, and you can also delight your eyes with the dance of the land, the forest and the water together, especially at sunset. The place is highly recommended for a stay, more than for a day trip, so try it and also enjoy the kindness of the owners and above all, the views, the comfort and a town that I like so much, Guatavita. name: Rancho las santas
review_1_text:
Beautiful rolling hills and sprawling meadows, our recent family retreat at the Ranch was nothing short of magical. From the moment we arrived, we were taken into the tranquil beauty of the countryside, far removed from the hustle and bustle of city life. A warm welcome and tour of the ranch from Gaby was exactly what we needed. You can tell she really cares about protecting the nature and the animals on the ranch.
The accommodations in the converted trucks, RVs, buses, were cozy yet spacious, allowing us to unwind and feel at home right away. The rustic charm of the ranch added to the experience, with every corner decorated with thoughtful details that reflected the spirit of the countryside.
But it was the activities that truly made our stay unforgettable. From horseback riding (Santiago was amazing with the kids), ATVs, Beer Brewery, Small Gym, Farm animals, etc., there was never a dull moment. The kids were especially thrilled to learn about farm life, eagerly helping with chores and feeding the animals under the guidance of the friendly staff.
Evenings were spent gathered around the crackling bonfire, sharing stories and roasting marshmallows under the starlit sky. It was a rare opportunity for us to reconnect as a family, away from screens and distractions, and we cherished every moment of it.
The hospitality of the ranch staff was exemplary, making us feel like part of their extended family. Their warmth and genuine care of nature and conservation added an extra layer of joy to our stay, leaving us with cherished memories that we'll treasure for years to come.
In conclusion, our time at the Ranch was nothing short of wonderful. It provided the perfect blend of adventure, relaxation, and quality family time, leaving us refreshed and rejuvenated. We can't wait to return for another unforgettable escape into the heart of nature!

review_1_text: This place is a hidden gem. It is a 10 minute walk from the Termales Guascas and 10 minute taxi ride from the center of town. I stayed in a triple room with 2 friends. The beds were super comfy and warm. Plus our room had a wood burning stove which we used during the night. The cabanas were really nice and offered a beautiful view of the lush green hills below. review_2_text: A wonderful weekend. The site has an unparalleled view. The fully comfortable and comfortable cabins. Spectacular attention. Everything 10/10 highly recommended!
review_3_text: I was with my wife this weekend and everything was excellent, the location is very good and easy to access, the cleanliness of all spaces is the best, the cabin is very nice highlighting the view, the cleanliness and the amenities, the common areas are the best, added to this I must highlight the attention of the hosts, their willingness to serve, the quality of the breakfast and their kindness is something phenomenal, we would definitely return!
review_4_text:
Es un lugar sencillo, pero con una atención inigualable que te invita a vivir una auténtica experiencia local. Las cabañas cuentan con camas dobles cómodas, un colchón de excelente calidad, sábanas suaves, frazadas acogedoras y, en caso de necesidad, chimenea. Además, siempre tendrás a tu disposición cobijas extra, agua y todo lo necesario para una estancia cómoda. En resumen, es un GRAN lugar con un SERVICIO EXCEPCIONAL.

Escribo esto desde la admiración que me genera cada emprendimiento: el poder de soñar y hacer realidad un proyecto es inspirador. También lo hago con la responsabilidad de compartir información confiable, para que cada persona pueda tomar una decisión acorde a sus expectativas.

Acceso (Perfecto y sencillo)
El camino sin pavimentar dura aproximadamente 15 minutos en auto y no presenta ninguna dificultad. Incluso la última parte, que es una pendiente algo pronunciada, está pavimentada, lo que garantiza un acceso fácil para cualquier tipo de vehículo.

Atención (Impecable)
Los dueños son cálidos, atentos y se encargan personalmente de cuidar cada detalle. El ambiente es acogedor, con espacios ideales para disfrutar del paisaje, una zona de chimenea, televisión, café, té, vino y todo lo que puedas necesitar. Llegamos tarde en la noche y se aseguraron de que estuviéramos cómodos desde el primer momento. Su hospitalidad es admirable.

Espacio y comodidades
El lugar cuenta con cinco cabañas, cada una con un pequeño balcón perfecto para relajarse, disfrutar de una copa de vino y contemplar la vista. Aunque las cabañas son compactas, ofrecen todo lo necesario para una estancia cómoda: camas confortables, iluminación adecuada y ropa de cama impecable. Hay que tener en cuenta que no es un sitio de lujo, sino un refugio para conectar con la naturaleza y disfrutar de la paz que brinda el entorno.

Los espacios comunes incluyen un jardín y una agradable zona de bar/restaurante decorada con detalles retro, que crean un ambiente cálido y acogedor.

Nuestra experiencia
Para nosotros, fue una experiencia encantadora. Cada detalle fue cuidadosamente atendido. Incluso nos prepararon snacks fuera del menú, y el desayuno fue delicioso. Es un lugar ideal para desconectarse y disfrutar de la tranquilidad, perfecto para una o dos personas.

Aunque las cabañas cuentan con una cama adicional sencilla, desde nuestra perspectiva no es lo más cómodo para una estancia prolongada, pero es una opción viable. Sin duda, los dueños se esmerarán para que la experiencia sea memorable para cada persona que visita.

Esperamos regresar pronto.
review_5_text: Pasé un fin de semana increíble en las cabañas de Refugio del Santo. Todo fue excelente: el servicio, la comida y la vista. El personal fue muy atento y amable, haciendo que nuestra estadía fuera aún más especial. Las cabañas son cómodas y acogedoras, perfectas para desconectarse y disfrutar de la naturaleza. #1 stay in Colombia. The hospitality that we received from Mark and Catherine was unbeatable. They were helpful from the moment we inquired about the cabin providing directions, information about the cabins, and a delicious home cooked dinner and breakfast. The cabin was also stocked with water, pop, beer, a selection of wine, and liquor. This felt like an all inclusive bed and breakfast - we had everything we needed on site and never even left.

The cabins themselves are beautiful. We were lucky enough to stay in Cabana Armonia, their newest build, and it is stunning. It is very stylish but cozy. There is an adorable nook with a day bed and pull out bed underneath - the perfect place to curl up and read a book. The bed was SO comfortable and the host is kind enough to offer a pillow selection - three options from softer to more firm. That is a 5 star amenity. We enjoyed the wood stove and rocking chairs, hammock, and outdoor seating options.

The view from this place cannot be beat. The cabins are perched on a large piece of land and they have a breathtaking view of the Tomine Reservoir. You constantly see paragliders in the distance. The property was so relaxing and we felt refreshed when we left.

If you are looking for a place to get away from the hustle and bustle of the city, this is your place. You will be so happy you chose to stay here.

review_1_text:
I had a great time at Hostel Caminos de Suesca. My friend and I originally booked 5 nights and ended up staying for 2 weeks for the entire vacation in Sursca. We came for the climbing and I am glad we chose this hostel because it’s the closest place to stay at the crag.

Felipe the owner is a local climbing guide and was able to help us find awesome climbs and all of the local advice/beta we needed. We brought all our own gear  so we didn’t need to hire him as a guide but we still were able to pick his brain about what to climb which was a huge bonus. We even climbed one of the routes he set himself! Behind the Virgin there’s a sport 5.9 he put up.

The hostel itself is cozy and a good value. We stayed in a double room meaning two rooms with a bed in each and our own bathroom. The shower had hot water and he changed the sheets and cleaned our room which was great.

There is a shared kitchen which we didn’t end up using because food in town was good and cheap. Felipe also shared with us all his favorite restaurants and cafes which were all delicious. If you need a place to stay for a day or two weeks and want value and proximity to the climbing then this is the place!

Colombians are some of the most kind people I’ve met and Felipe, his family, are just that, extremely helpful and friendly! Can’t wait to come back and spend time here again. Peace Suesca, see you next time!
review_2_text: Had a great Stay at Caminos de Suesca! It’s right next to the entrance of the climbing and the best place to stay as a climber. Also, the owner Felipe is the absolute best and was a ton of help. He offered me a good deal to rent some climbing gear that I lacked and was extremely flexible. Couldn’t recommended this hostel more!
review_3_text:
I wouldn’t expect much if you’re hoping to have a social experience here. There are few rooms and it was a ghost town. Amenities are bare necessities, the showers are lukewarm, and communication leaves a bit to be desired. Locks on the doors to the rooms can be jimmied open with very little elbow grease so if security is high priority keep that in mind. I hate to say it but the whole place feels like an afterthought. Oh and the hang board is slightly terrifying

That said, this is the closest cheap lodging you’ll find for the crags, basically next door to a convenience store with pastries, next to the climbing store, and you’re only 20 minutes walk away from great CHEAP food.

So, if literally all you care about is having a mattress, a roof, and privacy, then this is great.
review_4_text: Felipe is a climber's climber.  We planned to stay only a week and ended up staying for more than a month.  He is super gracious, sincere and time after time we saw him take time with travelers to help them make plans for their next journeys in Colombia.  His hostel is as close to the climbing sectors as you can get.  I recommend him if you want to take a climbing course.  He knows his stuff and is a safe operator.  He speaks English and Spanish.  If you're learning Spanish, he speaks really slowly and clearly.  And he's a natural teacher.  I felt I came a long way in my language skills during our stay.
review_5_text: Cozy little hostel, perfect for climbers. The rocks of Suesca are 5 minutes away on foot. The owner Felipe is himself a climber. He runs courses, guided climbs and climbing trips across Colombia, and his enthusiasm is only matched by his friendliness. Highly recommended

DO NOT GO TO THIS PLACE!
First we wanted to go to El Nomada, but nobody was there. Unfortunately we went to Villa Ines. Big mistake...
After staying for three days, we asked them if we can leave our bikes there for a visit of Bogota (two nights). They said it's absolutely no problem. It's a huge property.
We did something like this thousands of times in South America and never paid for it, we thought it would be free of charge as they would have told us a price if it weren't.
When we came back, they told us we have to pay 160.000 COP for this "service". When we refused to pay this ridiculous price, they told us, they have "evidence" against us and won't open the gates unless we pay.
We would have called the police, but didn't wanted to spend no longer time at this place so we paid them off, saying that we will warn other travellers. They were arrogant enough to laugh about it.
So, just letting you know: These are sneaky people who want to rip of extranjeros.

review_5_text:
A beautiful place, comfortable, quiet, clean
Viviana's excellent attention!! He spoiled us a lot.

review_1_text: A jewel within the center of Suesca.  The hotel is beautifully designed to blend with the breath taking views.  Staff are very friendly and accommodating.  Our room was very comfortable and clean.   Highly recommend visiting the beautiful town of Suesca and staying at the Hotel Casona Quesada.
review_2_text: It's a great place to stay. The architecture it's beautiful. The environment it's old and you feel that you are in another age. The room it's very comfortable and clean. I would stay there definitely.
review_3_text: Great colonial-style hotel, spacious rooms. We had a room with a view to the garden, which was very nice and light. Other rooms can be a bit dark. Breakfast ok, nothing special.
review_4_text: Good wifi. They had no hot water but I am still giving it five stars because I just really liked the place.
review_5_text: this place is beautiful, will maintained and very secure.  The town is right around the corner so easy access.

name: El sol de mis tesoros
review_1_text: Simply a place to meet nature and yourself.... To get away from the noise and fast-paced life of the city.... Magnificent attention, where you can stay either in a room with all the comforts of a hotel, or outdoors in a tent and enjoy a night full of peace and tranquility. RECOMMENDED 1A
review_2_text: The attention is excellent. It is a place with a beautiful view, a very clean place, perfect to enjoy with the family, and highly recommended to get away from the city.
review_3_text: Qué lugar tan especial y bonito para compartir en pareja o con amigos. La atención de la familia es maravillosa y muy detallada 🌱❤️.
review_4_text: Excellent place to camp. They provide the tents and everything you need. The human warmth is unmatched. Super recommended
review_5_text:
Spectacular, a place to rest and reconsider the hustle and bustle.
A little hidden but the staff who run the hotel are very friendly.

review_5_text: Brilliant

review_2_text:

review_3_text: Excelente vista hacia Sesquilé y el embalse 🥰. Un sitio muy acogedor y tranquilo. Súper recomendado 👌🏼
review_4_text: A perfect place to rest and disconnect
review_5_text: The viewpoint is unique!

name: Tu Glamping
review_1_text: A really really nice and beautiful place. We stayed for just 1 night but the attention was so good I will come back anytime now. They have really nice attention and the food is amazing as well. You can do s lot of things and the environment is just fascinating. The decorations and the place are spot on. They also give you the option to have like a small bbq or heating barrel for the night if you like fire and do marshmallows of that kind of thing so it was a really nice touch. Lots of parking space and the road is not bad at all. A bit rough but even on a small car not very high we were able to get there with 0 problems
review_2_text: It is a great option to be in a farm to see and feel the nature, there are some nice  things to do
review_3_text: Amazing, a place you gonna love.
review_4_text: It's a very quiet place, ideal for couples. It's very cold, but enjoyable. It has good bar service and cuisine with fair prices.
review_5_text:
It is a very quiet place, its landscape is beautiful. It depends on the Glamping is the bathroom.
It's an interesting project. It went well for us and we felt comfortable.

Keep in mind that there are no TVs and you must go to the reception or bar if you require anything.

name: Mirror Glamping
review_1_text: Beautiful dome! Very beautiful landscapes and very good communication with the hosts! It was a super nice experience and we loved the fireplace and jacuzzi! We went with our two little daughters and they enjoyed it very much. Very rich hot water, modern bathroom and kitchen has everything to cook and heat food. The only thing that was a little ugly was the road we took to get there from Ubaté. We took the wrong one and it was difficult in our cart. It would be better to have a 4 by 4 but I think there is another way that is much better and not so steep.
review_2_text: Good service, very quiet, excellent condition of everything in the Glamping, just a little far from town
review_3_text: A place to get away from the city, quiet, pleasant, very independent, large, it has all the possible comforts to be in a place with the people you love, excellent service and full of love 😍 and nature 🏞️ I loved it!!, I recommend it for you to share with your partner or family and enjoy this quiet place full of peace 🕊️
review_4_text: Perfecto para desconectarse del ruido y estrés de la ciudad.

name: GOLDEN GLAMPING GUATAVITA
review_1_text: Both facilities Glamping and villa are breathtaking ! The service is excellent with a very friendly and accommodating staff . The food was delicious and the place was very clean . Highly recommend ! The views are amazing and relaxing .
review_2_text:
Golden Glamping is truly a hidden gem! From start to finish, the experience was incredible. The service was top-notch, and it was clear that the owners care deeply about making guests feel at home. The views are simply breathtaking—you’re surrounded by stunning natural beauty, with easy access to nearby lakes and plenty of outdoor activities.

Despite feeling like a peaceful escape, it’s conveniently close to Bogota, so getting there was not difficult. The accommodations were perfect—comfortable and well-equipped, with just the right amount of rustic charm. Plus, it’s very affordable for the quality and experience you get.

If you’re looking for a unique getaway near Bogota, I can’t recommend Golden Glamping enough! Thanks to my hosts for such a memorable stay.
review_3_text: Impecable facilities and friendly staff ! Would recommend 100%
review_4_text: My boyfriend and I spent a wonderful night in this Glamping. Wonderful view, great jacuzzi, 100% recommended. Best of all, staff were extremely friendly and detail-oriented. Thank you so so much. We’ll happily come back.
review_5_text: I stayed here with my girlfriend to celebrate my birthday and it was such a great experience! When we arrived we were greeted very warmly and the glamping was decorated for my birthday. We enjoyed the jacuzzi & the net a lot. It was a 10/10 stay.  The activities in the Pueblo was a major plus as well.

review_1_text: Love it, great service, great food, large menu. Quiet and calm. A great place to rest and enjoy with your family some board games (they've got plenty). If you are thinking on parting or getting drunk, this is not the place for you. Beds are comfortable and warm. I'll definitely return. We had a great time. Thanks Edgar for your attention.
review_2_text:
The place was simply awesome!
We expended two nights there.
Peaceful and quiet.
Everything was wonderful.
The room was beautiful. We had the best view.
It is an small place with only 7 rooms.
The staff make you feel in home.
Food was amazing!
I am half Peruvian and they offered "Lomo salteado" in the menu. I was afraid to ask for it but at the end it was very well cooked.
We were at "Tulipanes" room.
In the night they gave us hot water bottles and also they turned on the chimney for us.
¡Awesome!
Recommended 100%

Only one thing we didn't enjoyed.
The pressure of the water in the shower is totally rubbish lol... Try the shower before get inside naked with your partner!
Ther is not enough water even for one person. 😂😂
review_3_text: Quite a nice quaint place with good food. The road there is absolutely terrible though. Don't bring a nice car! It is also very difficult to find in the dark.
review_4_text: Awesome quiet place, good food good wine beautiful landscape
review_5_text: It is a great place for share with the person you love. Very good recomendation!!!

name: Finca hotel spa zhay
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text:
We arrived at the hotel by chance and were pleasantly surprised. It is a beautiful place, the facilities are surrounded by vegetation and the Guatanfur River surrounds it. There is an atmosphere of peace and tranquility. The service is good and the costs are affordable. Although it does not have swimming pools, it has an agreement with some nearby hot springs (five minutes by car). They offer different plans that include accommodation, a day at the hot springs and breakfast.
I would return without thinking to enjoy the climate and beauty of the region.
review_2_text: It is a temperate climate, ideal for those who do not like too much cold or too much heat. It's warm delicious. It's a little expensive but it's worth it. Lots of nature and the attention is excellent. Deli pra slept and went to the river and hot springs. The hot springs are a little dirty.
review_3_text: Es un sitio ideal para descansar. Está ubicado en un excelente sitio con acceso al río. Esto fue lo que más me gustó. La comida es buena en sabor y cantidad. Los masajes también son buenos. Sugerencia: poner ventiladores o aire acondicionado en las habitaciones, porque hasta la 1 ó 2am el calor no deja dormir. Precios cómodos y buena atención.
review_4_text: Excellent place to rest and be calm, the best thing is the mascot that is part of the farm King guides you to the river and accompanies you everywhere, it is beautiful, delicious food, it has hot springs 5 ​​minutes from the site and massages within the farm; definitely a good place to get away from the city.
review_5_text:
Muy bonito el lugar, son muy amables las personas que lo atienden, es muy cómodo el lugar, bastante contacto con la naturaleza, se puede acceder al río.
Las habitaciones son cómodas y limpias

name: HOTEL ROCAS DEL PARAISO
opening_hours: Monday: 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Tuesday: 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Wednesday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM|Thursday: 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Friday: 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Saturday: 9:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Sunday: Closed
review_1_text:
Recommended for resting!
Rocas del paraiso is an excellent place to rest. Surrounded by nature, quiet and about 100 meters from the main road. They offer generous breakfasts and good lunches with very good sized portions of protein.
The attention is the best. It is a family hotel and everyone is very friendly and attentive.
The room is spacious, clean, with a good bathroom and hot water.
At night they lit a bonfire for us, even when the hotel was almost alone.
There are climbing and hiking routes nearby.

To improve: the curtains do not allow the room to be dark and the bed makes a lot of noise
review_2_text:
Necesita URGENTEMENTE CARIÑO 😕.
Tener un tipo de alojamiento como ese no es solo tener la estructura; hay que tener las cosas para la comodidad del turista para que decida regresar y recomendar (no es mi caso).

La cocina no tenía nada para ayudar a cocinar (utensilios y consumibles).

Todo huele a moho 🫥

Las gavetas todas descuadradas, daba miedo abrirlas.

La ducha eléctrica tenia los cables por fuera (nada seguro) ⚡️💥

Y otras cosas… pero, la idea es simplemente que los dueños tomen conciencia y que pongan un poco de cariño al lugar, que, ciertamente tiene una ubicación genial 👌🏻

Puntos positivos:
Ubicación
Estructuras
Juegos de mesa disponibles
review_3_text: Excellent place to rest and/or play sports
review_4_text: Great site. Excellent price-quality ratio. It can improve the issue of water management because the bathrooms have a lot of siphon smell. The attention was very pleasant.
review_5_text: Super recomendado, el sitio me parecio agradable y el servicio excelente, muy amables todos. Las cabañas son comodas y el sitio es muy tranquilo. No pudimos hacer la caminata por las lluvias, pero hicimos uso de la zona de barbacoa para hacer asados.

name: Finca Glamping el Porvenir

review_1_text:
Excellent place to spend the weekend, on the mountain side, great panoramic view, very clean and friendly.
Unexpected amazing Italian food.
Recommended to anyone for this adventure. Well maintained garden and surrounding areas.Both glamping and cabin, well worth it.
review_2_text: Amazing experience, we had a great time at Juan’s place. The food, view and hospitality was the best. We strongly recommend this beautiful place if you want to relax and enjoy Mother Nature.
review_3_text: A wonderful, quiet place, an incredible view but the best of all is the attention they give you there. I went to spend my birthday alone, the hosts shared a dessert and a pleasant time with me. They really go out of their way to make you feel great. Thank you Olguita and Juan for my excellent stay
review_4_text: Excellent service from the lady in charge. The place (Glamping) has an outdoor bathroom, 1 double bed, and 1 sofa bed. Everything is in excellent condition and clean.
review_5_text:
A quiet place, full of peace.
Mrs. Olga's attention was excellent, very kind and attentive.
The spectacular view

name: Termales Los Volcanes
address: Km 13 vía, El Sisga - Macheta, Chocontá
opening_hours: Monday: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Tuesday: 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM|Wednesday: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Thursday: 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM|Friday: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Saturday: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Sunday: 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM
review_1_text: We were there for a couple of hours and it was so nice to relax there surrounded by nature. Go early to get a nice spot around the pool. We ended up on the small hill which was nice but far from everything. Service in general is good but could be better.
review_2_text: This place is amazing and a must see for any tourist. They have a beautiful setup. There's a trail you can walk around the outside of the hot pools , there's waterfalls and beautiful flowers and landscape. They also have a hot steam room with eucalyptus plants that is amazing for opening up your sinuses and any congestion you may have.
review_3_text:
This was my first experience in Bogota, and unfortunately, it left a very sour impression. I accidentally booked the wrong date and contacted the property immediately—within the hour—to try to correct the mistake. However, I only received an automated response at the time. The next day, they claimed they had waited for me all night, which felt completely dishonest since they never responded to my message when I tried to reach them.

I find it appalling how they handled the situation, especially knowing I’m a foreign visitor unfamiliar with local practices. Their refusal to offer any refund despite my quick response reflects very poorly on how they treat tourists. I would urge other travelers to be extremely cautious when booking here. This experience felt not only dismissive but exploitative toward someone unfamiliar with the area.
review_4_text: Surrounded by nature, wonderful place to relax and enjoy the hot springs. Food and drinks are not allowed and the food and drinks you find at the restaurant and cafeteria are expensive. There were lots of fun activities like the nature walk and aerobics in the water. Looking forward to going back soon!
review_5_text: Very lovely place, cozy, spacious, and also a bunch of space. When I visited it was Sunday, read the reviews here and was set to be disappointed by the huge crowd, but in the end, there wasn't a crowd, and was a lovely place to enjoy as a couple.

name: Refugio de Guacheneque
opening_hours: Monday: Closed|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text: The family at the refugio welcomed me into the most stunning accommodation with hot water, a cozy bed, and beautiful views. They shared dinner with me (trout, salad, and potatoes - my favorite) while helping me to practice my Spanish. It felt like home and the location was excellent. Breakfast the next morning was lovely as well. They sent me off with plenty of water and a hug for another long day on my bike! I couldn’t recommend this place enough.
review_2_text: Very fun! Great food! We loved visiting this place.
review_3_text: Incredibly friendly Esperance. Basic but comfortable.  Clean, cozy, warm.
review_4_text: We stayed here for three days. Claudia and her family were excellent hosts. The food is delicious and the prices are reasonable. The view is beautiful; unfortunately, the weather wasn't quite on our side, but it was still a wonderful experience. Thank you so much!
review_5_text:
I was there in November 2024 and the experience was incredible; The trails enabled for walking up to km 8 of the source of the Bogotá River, the view from any room and the plans that can be made from there are very good.
The vegetarian food is delicious, they were very inventive when creating new dishes.
The attention of Claudia and her family was incredible, they made me feel very comfortable.
It is a great place to telework and if you travel alone I also highly recommend it.

name: FINCA AMARELO
review_1_text: Cozy cabin to spend the night. It has the basic stuff needed: stove, fireplace, refrigerator. There are routes for cycling
review_2_text: Lovely place to stay one night or weekend
review_3_text: Es un lugar increíble, es tranquilo, higiénico. No hay ruido el servicio es rápido si necesitas algo para sustituir los recursos de la cabaña. Es pequeño pero muy cómodo y sobre todo es muy bello. Eso sí hace frío y es aconsejable llevar botas porque la lluvia genera lodo.
review_4_text:
The place is really cozy. Our cabin was a small space but perfect for couples. It has everything you need for a stay and comfort. The hostess was really friendly and attentive. The space outside the cabin is spacious, with a cold climate and a quiet environment.

Access to the house is very simple and is exactly the address marked on Google maps.

As a recommendation, bring clothing for the cold and possible rain, in addition to having the market ready, especially if you are not traveling by private car.

In my case I went with 3 dogs which really enjoyed the space and the climate and were treated with great affection.

Super recommended!
review_5_text: I loved the place, very quiet, it has everything you need for a complete stay, the cabin was very well equipped, we were able to make a bonfire, use the BBQ, the fireplace and we used the jacuzzi, the only thing to improve is that the jacuzzi felt a lot of chlorine. But the stay was great, it's petfrindly so it makes the place much more charming to go with the family!

name: Niddo Suesca
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Closed|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text: We did two nights in the glamping tents, two dinners at the resultant, and one picnic for two. Breakfast was included. The camp site was amazingly decorated in the very large tent and the stellar bathroom with very hot water and gorgeous shower that they clean daily! The staff was incredibly nice and accommodating. The trails were plentiful and had tons of little surprises. Would recommend - and our dog had a blast too!
review_2_text: It's a five star venue, sadly very expensive. The cost is high though you can manage to accommodate one night, enjoy the amenities and restaurant veggie or full BBQ and go hiking; thus it's an excellent two-day one-night adventure. Beautiful sights, fresh air, and cozy beds inside beautiful glamping style
review_3_text:
We had a great time. it was an amazing experience  because we were in contact with nature all the time and felt part of the landscape, which is very  beautiful by the way.

Is like camping, but with all the comfort !!!

The people is very kind and is always trying to help you with everything you need.

We can't wait to come back and highly recommended it.
review_4_text: Place is  deteriorating and they seem not to care to properly clean or maintain the tents ( there were full of mold and dust) I stayed in one of the cabins and the tent zipper was broken they didn’t put shampoo and soap on our bathroom, the manager is non existing here, employees smoking and rude they lack of costumer service skills, for what you pay you expect certain luxury but it is not the case. Food was average not a lot of options, we went to the caves (by the way the best part of the trip) we arrived at 2pm at the hotel super tired and we couldn’t took a shower since our room was not cleaned. (They were only two couples at the hotel) and the cleaning lady preferred to clean the empty rooms first.... we Wanted to go on a bike trip there where nobody to take us, we liked  the concept but it definitely needs somebody in charge who puts order there.
review_5_text: Amazing views and trails, I highly recommend the barefoot "Camino de mil pasos". There is outdoor rock climbing which is great for beginners of all ages, and the instructors we got (Juan y Carolina) are amazing. I would give 4.5 stars because the food at the restaurant is nothing special, but still good (get the patacones con carne for sure). The view from the restaurant is beautiful though.

name: Hotel Rokas de Suesca
address: Finca Alberto Reyes, Vereda de Güita, Suesca
review_1_text:
The owners are amazing. So friendly and helpful, they helped us order takeaway dinner and a taxi back to Bogota. The rooms are lovely, rustic and basic but great design. Good spot for climbers and just a relaxing weekend.
Highly recommend!
review_2_text: Amazing place and excellent host! Truly beautifully arranged rooms and the whole area. Great hospitality. Muchas gracias!!!!
review_3_text: awesome place for rock climbers !!
review_4_text: We stayed at the Los Pinos cabin, with a spectacular view of the rocks and nature in general. Derly is incredibly attentive and takes care of the rooms, the kitchen, everything! A very peaceful space, delicious food. The place even has a function room.
review_5_text: Excelente servicio, hospedaje impecable, buen ambiente, excelente atención, la comida es deliciosa, fogata al aire libre, son petfriendly, chimenea en la habitación, hay varios lugares para conectar con la naturaleza

name: Carpe Diem
opening_hours: Monday: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Tuesday: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Wednesday: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Thursday: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Friday: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Saturday: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Sunday: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM
review_1_text: They open the doors of their farm in a very noble way for other people and animals. They have cows and sheep. The food is varied and abundant. If you bring pets, make sure they are friendly with the local animals.
review_2_text: It is a place with a beautiful view, a space that allows you to connect as a family around a campfire. The attention is very warm, the people are extremely attentive. Delicious food with that warmth of home. We had a happy time and achieved our goal of disconnecting from the city. love the attention
review_3_text: Me encantó, super recomendado. Vinimos  con idea de desconectarnos de la gran Bogotá y lo logramos, vamos a volver eso está seguro, comida deliciosa a buen costo, desayunos almuerzo y cenas, servicio atención al cliente excelente.
review_4_text:
El lugar es espectacular. Tranquilo, cómodo, con una vista increíble. Excelente servicio por parte de la administración.
No queda tan retirado del pueblo más o menos a unos 10 minutos en carro. La relación calidad-precio está muy bien planteada.
Es perfecto para desconectarse del caos de la ciudad, descansar y disfrutar de una fogata con vista a las estrellas.
Lo recomiendo a ojo cerrado
review_5_text: Un lugar maravilloso si la idea es desconectarse un poco del ruido, es un plan muy lindo para parejas o para grupo de amigos , también las mascotas son bienvenidas y pasan felices pues se tiene un espacio verde con una vista hermosa a las montañas. Sus carpas son muy cómodas y cuentan  con lo necesario para no sentir frío, recomendable ir abrigado ya que Guatavita en sí es frío y el lugar queda a las afueras del pueblo. Es fácil de llegar y si no tienes como, la administración te ayuda para que llegues. La atención es hermosa siempre dispuestos para lo que necesites, hay vaquitas  con las  que puedes compartir y un salón grande para cargar celulares , conectarse al wifi o cocinar 😋.

name: Alma de Campo - Glamping

review_1_text:
A beautiful placed, wonderful views, nice food and comfortable glampings, a place to breathe and take a break it just just right for it.

Th people, just like the place a real pleasure to spend time with.

Keep going!
review_2_text: I have to say the best vacation ever. Very friendly staff, very clean, amazing food, beautiful view. I highly Recemended it
review_3_text:
One of the best glampings in Colombia ever!
Amazing food, Juan and his staff offer the best service and kindness, the nature of the place, views and activities all on point!

I hope to go back soon 🤍
review_4_text: Outstanding service!
review_5_text: It's a pleasant place, known for its tranquility and views of the Suesca Lagoon. Their pets are very special and offer nothing but love. However, it's a bit remote, the glamping site is small, and there's no bathroom inside. Regarding the food, the breakfast is very complete, well included, and the rest of the breakfast is delicious, but its price is high for what it is. It would be advisable to adjust the prices and portions. The service was good; they were always attentive to our concerns.

name: Hotel Flora Suesca

review_1_text: Although the rooms are a bit small, they are very comfortable. The service is very good; they are willing to help you with everything and provide information for making plans. The rooms have hot water and a television. The advantage is that the hotel is located right on the highway and is about 5 minutes from town.
review_2_text:
Excellent location, very friendly host, and impeccable facilities.
Highly recommended
review_3_text: Excellent, good service, good breakfast, close to activities
review_4_text: A strategic place for hiking lovers. Excellent staff attention
review_5_text: Excellent hotel, the service is wonderful, Mrs. Sandra makes the client feel very comfortable, totally clean. I would return without a doubt.
