The accommodation view is amazing, right on top of the Suesca rocks! The host is very kind, helpful and attentive to the guest needs. The breakfast was delicious. All three meals are available at the accommodation and vegetarian options are available! Which were very tasty and great value for money.
Overall I'm very satisfied with my experience in this place, the cabins are very comfy.
review_2_text: I love this place, always come back for its fantastic view and friendly locals. Just relax and enjoy.
review_3_text: The mini cabin is very small, but cozy. It is very well accompanied by a larger space to rest in front. Alejandra's service is very special. It has a very good offer of food, activities and amenities for your stay. The place is very nice with original decoration details reusing materials.
review_4_text: From the moment you enter, the service is excellent. It's a clean, quiet place with activities to do, including rappelling, rock climbing, horseback riding—an unforgettable experience I highly recommend. The view is spectacular, and the hosts are very cordial.
review_5_text: A beautiful place to spend your holidays, it is very close to all the tourist places and with good access to the farm. Being on the rock, the view is very beautiful. The staff in charge was very friendly and hospitable.

name: Sumangá Hotel Boutique
review_1_text: Perfect place to relax and enjoy nature. Excellent place, service and food. Definitely will be back
review_2_text:
The facilities are top-notch, and the service provided by Nicolás and Mrs. María Consuelo is warm, flexible, and friendly. They are exceptional hosts who connect guests with the best of Sutatausa: its doctrinal temple, the Farallones, and the local crafts and cuisine.

They work with community members who are fantastic in their art, their guidance, and their deep knowledge of the area, history, and traditional knowledge. The massages are professional and relaxing. The food, featuring local produce, is simply delicious and beautifully executed.

And as a final touch, the loving company of Poncho, Dante, and Olivia, the furry hosts.
A unique place, more than five stars. Highly recommended.
review_3_text: In a privileged location, amidst mountains steeped in history, we highly recommend this cozy and delightful spot... from the natural tranquility, the well-designed facilities, the wonderful cuisine, and the best service from this Salamanca family, incredible people (including their pets: Dante, Olivia, and Poncho).
review_4_text: Located just 10 minutes from Sutatausa, this boutique hotel offers an experience of total connection with nature. Its rooms and common areas stand out for their impeccable care, access is comfortable for any type of vehicle and, inside the hotel, you will find everything you need to enjoy a few days of absolute tranquility. The most notable thing is the attention of its owners: careful, genuine and of the highest quality.
review_5_text:
¡Simplemente un lugar de ensueño!

La atención y calidad humana de Nicolás y María C son insuperables.

El desayuno es delicioso y lleno de detalles.

La sazón es de primera,  desde el desayuno hasta el pic Nic.

El sitio es un rincón mágico del universo.

La arquitectura de la casa respeta la naturaleza, está llena de detalles, la decoración es elegante y muy bonita.

Las actividades que ofrece el lugar están muy bien organizadas : Cabalgata, Jacuzzi, caminatas, entre otras.

Felicitaciones a todo el equipo del hotel.

name: Casita en la montaña
review_1_text: If you want beautiful mountain views or a peaceful place to relax then this is the perfect place. Also a great base for hiking further up the mountains. Alejandro and his parents who run the mountain huts are so kind and helpful. The huts are small and cosy but have everything you need with a gas cooker, sink and basic shower. I would definitely revisit if back in the area
review_2_text: Nice space for a couple, the houses are super nice, cozy, super basic, a good place to relax, be surrounded by a lot of nature and share an incredible space as a couple, highly recommended
review_3_text: A great place to rest and enjoy nature, the service from the owners is friendly and equally people full of courage, passion and humility
review_4_text: Grateful, we wanted rest and so we got it here, pure rest, zero noise, what a delight
review_5_text: Excellent place, an incredible view when you wake up and the service from the administrators was quite good.

name: Hospedaje Villa Rosita
address: finca el mirador, Via Cacicazgo, Suesca
opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text: Nice place to relax. The cabañas are family owned. Juan Carlos and his wife are very friendly. You can enjoy their beautiful garden. The cabañas are very clean and the public space is well equipped with a kitchen, living room and open fire.
review_2_text: Recommended 100%, Mrs. Fabiola's attention is incomparable. The cabins are beautiful with just the right size for a couple. There are common spaces and a beautiful view 🌠🤍 Everything is very well taken care of, you can see the love with which they do everything.
review_3_text: Excellent option to stay near the rocks of Suesca, Mrs. Fabiola and her family are very kind and attentive, the breakfast is rich and tasty, we spent a couple of very pleasant days, the cabins are comfortable and the common areas very nice, I highly recommend it, we will surely return!
review_4_text:
Excellent service! This accommodation, in addition to being suitable for all occasions, has the best host.

They were attentive to every detail and treated us better than at home. Definitely recommended if you want to go, call them and they will give you the best attention and guidance in the place.

My recommendation is the social area, with a fireplace and board games, it is ideal for meeting people or spending time with friends.
review_5_text: El hospedaje Villa Rosita es un lugar maravilloso, nos atendió Doña Fabiola, una mujer que se caracteriza por su amabilidad, amor y porque logra hacerte sentir como en casa. Es un lugar con una magia inexplicable, donde puedes descansar tranquilamente y disfrutar de lo que es la verdadera paz. Las habitaciones son comodas y muy limpias y se encuentra muy cerca de las principales actividades de Suesca. Lo recomiendo totalmente!!!

name: Villa Rebequita
review_1_text: Great place to rest near Villa Pinzón. Mrs. Raquel was very kind, the glamping was very comfortable and cozy. There are animals on the site, which gives it a country atmosphere.
review_2_text: Excelente servicio muy limpio dejan llevar a tu mascota una linda experiencia
review_3_text:
Excellent site! Super quiet, for an excellent plan as a couple or family!!
I loved the weather and the bonfire.
review_4_text: Excellent place to disconnect, ideal to take the long road from the town's market square
review_5_text: El mejor hospedaje, lleno de amor y paz

review_1_text: The service from the moment you contact them until you check out is excellent, they make you feel welcome and the response times are very good. The place is unique, we stayed in the tree house and it has everything you need for a comfortable stay, all the details are very well thought out. The food was generous and delicious, we recommend the trout. Recommended!
review_2_text: Magical place, every detail thought according to the architecture and philosophy of the place. Perfect to rest surrounded by nature with unbeatable attention. Thank you
review_3_text: The place is very nice, and I think the Paisa food is excellent, but I ordered something that has nothing to do with this food. If you go to a Paisa restaurant you have to order Paisa food. If you order another food, it is very average. The waiters are very friendly and they serve you super fast.  I have to go back and see how it goes.
review_4_text:
Very nice and the attention was good.
They need to have 1 bell at the entrance so that visitors can announce themselves.
review_5_text: Beautiful place. The attention of the people in charge is excellent.

name: Bosque Escondido Lodge
review_1_text: Fellow hikers and nature lovers you will absolutely enjoy your time here. It is cold at night, so get well dressed. The Cabañas have really warm blankets and the food is good. They sell limited choice of food but it is all delicious. Just make sure you check the menu before you go. Gina and Bray are great hosts. Thank you for all you did to make our stay unforgettable.
review_2_text: A beautiful experience my parents and I have had prior to our visit and 1 nights' stay and such an excellent environment set within the hidden forests of Colombia with cabins and decommissioned Volkswagon Camping Vans also used for lodging rooms with outdoor restrooms for each different sections. Also the owners are super friendly, very attentive and have provided us with their great service. Although the weather is cold and especially at night with all the breeze blowing throughout  so be prepared  to strap yourselves with some sweaters, a jacket, a hat and some gloves! Such a fantastic and lovely experience and many thanks!!!
review_3_text: Very nice, quiet and beautiful place, it is the perfect plan to rest and take a natural breath
review_4_text: Nice place
review_5_text:
Este lugar es perfecto para escapar del estrés y el ruido de la ciudad y conectarte con la naturaleza. El entorno es tranquilo y sereno, rodeado de árboles y vegetación, lo que te hace sentir como si estuvieras en un mundo aparte.

El parche es excelente, con una variedad de opciones para todos los gustos. La calidad es impresionante y el servicio es atento y amable.

Lo que más me gustó de Bosque Escondido es la atmósfera relajante y pacífica que se respira en el aire. Es el lugar perfecto para desconectar y recargar energías. ¡Lo recomiendo altamente!

name: Agua fresca glamping
review_1_text:
We stayed 3 nights and the stay was very pleasant! We enjoyed everything a lot.

The landscape and nature make the site an incredible space to rest and disconnect.

The cabins are very nice, the beds are comfortable, they have blankets with heaters, the fireplace is very pleasant at night. It needs a closet to store things, garbage 🗑️ and I would put a coffee maker to make coffee in the morning as soon as you get up, since breakfast arrives at 8:30 am.

The pool is very good, the temperature is perfect, the bar service is very good. The water is a little cloudy and in general this space needs cleaning.

The restaurant in general was very good for us, the food is tasty, they are punctual, the only thing is that they serve the food a little cold.

The service is very good, very helpful, everything we asked they helped us with! Paola and Michael are very friendly.
review_2_text: Excellent experience, a recommended place to go with your family to rest and disconnect. Very good attention from all the staff, the cabins are spacious and comfortable, they make every effort to have the place arranged and clean, beautiful landscapes and delicious food.
review_3_text: Getting there is very complicated, the roads are not suitable for small cars, the weather is always very cold. They have a warm water pool, it's not that hot, and a Turkish bath and a sauna that's kind of meh, the beds have a blanket to generate heat... If you go, bring a Bluetooth speaker or something like that, because in the cabins there is no TV or sound system (or at least in the junior ones) nothing.
review_4_text:
Es un lugar muy bonito y tranquilo. La piscina  es caliente y el almuerzo estuvo muy rico.
Fue un día de descanso y conexión con la naturaleza.
Gracias a los avisos que están ubicados en el camino, es fácil llegar.
Los colaboradores del lugar son muy atentos y amables.
Lo recomiendo.
review_5_text: Very good experience, especially to go with children, the arrival is well signposted, the attention of the people is very good, attentive all the time, the dishes have a good relationship between quality and quantity, the heated pool. The bikes for rent are in good condition and the animals on site are very beautiful, the view and tranquility 10/10.

name: Hotel Pueblo Dorado
review_1_text: This place is a hidden gem – a beautiful colonial building with plants everywhere, a lovely garden and a cosy fireplace for the evenings. The breakfast was huge and delicious. Leydi and Felipe were always on hand to answer any questions and they went above and beyond to make sure that our stay was perfect. 100% recommend.
review_2_text:
Amazing place to rest and enjoy nature. The hotel is located in sesquile, 2 blocks away from the main plaza. It is a colonial restored house. The owners, Felipe and his wife, have made this house a cozy hotel with historical objects that decorate the walls and rooms.

They offer excellent service, always willing to help the guest. We have stayed there 2 times over 2 years and everytime we go there, the place has more to offer. They just opened a new vintage Bar, with a chimney for cold evenings and a great variety of cocktails. The atmosphere is ideal for all.

I recommend this place for anyone who wants to scape the city, be near the "Leyenda del Dorado: Guatavita", do any tracking or water activities in Tomine. And if you like rock climbing, the place is near Suesca, where all the climbers go to test their abilities.

Be ready to be surprise for the warm and kind vibes that the Hotel Las Tres Viejas has for you
review_3_text: Hace poco tuve el placer de alojarme en hotel pueblo dorado y fue una experiencia inolvidable. Desde el momento en que llegué, el personal hizo todo lo posible para garantizar mi comodidad y satisfacción, El ambiente es cálido y acogedor, el lujoso alojamiento ofrece una deliciosa variedad de platos unido a un servicio excepcional, hizo que mi estancia fuera realmente memorable. "Muy recomendable".
review_4_text: Beautiful place to get out of the routine and disconnect, I highlight the attention from the staff who were attentive to every detail. The architecture of the house takes you back in time and its beautiful garden makes your stay more pleasant.
review_5_text: If I had to recommend a hotel where I felt very welcoming, without hesitation I would recommend the Pueblo Dorado hotel, excellent service, excellent atmosphere and above all excellent staff where they were attentive to us at all times, making us feel at home. Total gratitude for the welcome and as soon as I have the opportunity to return, I will be there again delighting in the wonders of that place... 💕💝

name: Finca el placer
review_1_text: Muchas gracias por el espacio super recomendado para organizadores de eventos y eventos corporativos.
review_2_text: It is cozy with beautiful nature landscapes. Good attention
review_3_text: Excellent viewpoint to have a good time
review_4_text: Excellent place to rest and enjoy nature
review_5_text: Excellent service. Highly recommended.

review_1_text: I only went there for the activity, I had a blast. It's safe and well supervised. The view is great and the bar is just incredible!!
review_2_text:
Yesterday I celebrated my birthday in this wonderful place, it was an excellent decision to have chosen this space to start a new year, I loved being able to disconnect from the chaos of the city and leave completely renewed, the host 10/10
Good luck with this wonderful project!
review_3_text:
A dream place to rest and enjoy nature. We loved the beautiful room with a magical view, excellent bathroom and the host was very attentive to us.
Super recommended 10/10
review_4_text: Place with a special energy, ideal for rest, they have beautiful wooden cabins, a Tibetan bridge to challenge fear, I love the green area and the viewpoints
review_5_text: Highly recommended, super service, diverse activities and spectacular view.

review_1_text: Ana María and Felipe are wonderful hosts and have built a truly magical farm experience with yoga, herbs, chickens and even a labrynth. A great way to Colombia off the beaten tourist path.
review_2_text: Great place with organic garden!
review_3_text: A truly magic place
review_4_text: A wonderful place where you can rest and enjoy, get closer to the countryside and be part of different planting, yoga, food sovereignty and permaculture activities. Wonderful people and excellent human networking work.
review_5_text: Spectacular place, the tranquility and kindness of the hosts is unmatched, the family atmosphere and quality of the facilities are excellent.

Pésimo servicio, pensaba alquilar el lugar para un grupo , me dieron unas tarifas y me las cambiaron , me incluían desayuno , después me lo quitaron y en carta con precio desde 16 mil pesos me lo aumentaron a 25 mil pesos , fui hasta el lugar a conocerlo y con habitaciones de múltiple ocupación me lo limitaron a la mitad !

Me perjudicaron a mi y a mi grupo quedando en una muy mala posición con mis invitados!

@superintendencia_sic @camaracomerbog @bogota_turismo
review_4_text: Difficult access both to get to the property and to get to the rooms, especially when it rains. We had a not very pleasant stay, the first day there was no hot water and the second day there was no water. The bathrooms covered. And dirty bathtubs. The good attention and hard work of those in charge is rescued. And good horses for horseback riding. There is still a lot to improve, the place has spectacular landscapes.
review_5_text:
It is an excellent place to rest. It really disconnects from the city. There is no cell phone signal and there are no televisions in the rooms.

The place is surrounded by many green areas, camping areas, glamping, cabins. There are many areas to walk.

The people who served us are super friendly, Gabriel and his family are always attentive to what the guests need

We had only one problem and ironically it was the administrator of the place who apparently is not aware of his reservations and left us without lunch the first day. However, the hotel staff was always attentive.

Keep in mind that it is not an easily accessible site, the roads are rural between the farms and can be complicated in some sections.

name: Yugos
review_1_text: super
review_2_text:
Excellent experience.
The service is exceptional, the scenery is fabulous, and the cabins are very cozy.
Highly recommended.
review_3_text: Excellent plan for couples
review_4_text:
It's a very private and quiet place, with clean, warm rooms.
The cabins with fireplaces are a hit. The service is very prompt and timely.
review_5_text: A nice cabin next to the bar where there is loud music until 3am, if you want to rest it is not the ideal place

name: LA CASA DE RUANA
review_1_text:
I stayed at the Ruana house, with incredible scenery. The Macheta climate is cold at night, but the cabins are well-equipped to make it less noticeable.
It's important to bring repellent, as the area is very mosquito-infested.
I really liked it.
review_2_text: It's a wonderful place, truly worth it. It's a peaceful, rural space perfect for family enjoyment. It's truly worth every penny spent. I highly recommend it! (Great experience)
review_3_text: I really liked it. It's a great place to share with friends or as a couple. It's close to Bogotá, has beautiful scenery, and the facilities are clean and very welcoming. It has a very pleasant campfire area. You can feel the fresh air and the tranquility of the countryside. The staff is very friendly and helpful. I highly recommend it.
review_4_text:
A natural refuge to unwind and recharge

This weekend I had the opportunity to visit a place that has undoubtedly become my new favorite spot to escape the chaos of the city. Located in a setting surrounded by nature, it's the ideal place for those looking for a respite from the frenetic pace of urban life.

From the moment we arrived, the tranquility was palpable: the fresh air, the sound of the trees swaying in the wind, and the harmony of the surroundings invite you to leave your worries aside and simply enjoy the present. It's the perfect place to recharge, whether as a couple, with friends, or even alone if you're looking for a space to reconnect with yourself.

It's undoubtedly a refuge of peace and tranquility, and an experience I recommend to anyone who needs a break from their daily lives. Ideal for relaxing, recharging, and returning to the hustle and bustle of the city with a feeling of calm and renewal.
review_5_text:
I loved the experience, a spectacular place to unwind and relax!
The best part is that your furry friend can go with you, and they'll enjoy it to the fullest, too.

name: LA TATA Cabaña y Zona de Camping cucunubá cundinamarca
review_1_text: A delightful stay! The cabin is simple, but has everything you need for relaxation, and everything was very clean. The place is quiet, peaceful, with no noise except for nature. A delicious breakfast; they served us a delicious soup that tasted like firewood in the evening. The friendliness of Luz Dary and Anderson is the best of all! It's a great way to support rural tourism.
review_2_text: Anderson is a very friendly and attentive host. The camping facilities are very good; there's a roof under which you can pitch your tent, which was perfect for the rainy night we had. The bathroom is clean and comfortable. And the breakfast is filling, nutritious, and delicious. Getting to the campsite is easy. Cucunubá offers many outdoor activities, so we'll definitely come back and stay here again. Recommended.
review_3_text:
A very beautiful and very quiet place!!! They are really kind people.
Of course I will return!! And without fear of making mistakes, they have given me the best red wine of all!!! Thank you very much for having me 🌻
review_4_text:
The warmth of Anderson and his family make one feel at home. In addition, the place has a spectacular view and its proximity to the Suesca lagoon and mountain trails allow you to walk and discover places full of nature.
I highly recommend it and I will return to do the different activities that can be done.
review_5_text: Un lugar para descansar y desconectarse de la rutina, una excelente atención, muy amables, los recomendó mucho, para que pueda pasar un rato agradable con su familia y amigos.

name: Hotel Casa Manoa Sesquilé

review_1_text: Beautifully restored historic house, comfy beds and super-friendly service. We really felt warmly treated like individuals. Only the rooms could have had a wee bit more light (due to the building style, the only window is one that is part of the door). Breakfast overlooking the nice patio was also a treat. Would not hesitate a minute to book with them again when back in town.
review_2_text: My family and I had the best experience at Hotel Casa Manoa.  The rooms are just as they appear in the pictures...impeccably clean.  The on-site parking is extremely convenient.  The breakfast was delicious.   I have zero complaints.   We will probably be back when family comes in town.
review_3_text:
We had a great 3-day stay at casa manoa. The host family provided great service and made us feel at home from the first moment on. The rooms offer a good standard and are very cozy, everything was very clean. The breakfast was also good, fresh pastries from the bakery across the street, eggs and fruit - a normal Colombian choice. Despite being located in the heart of sesquile, the yard is very quiet and offers places to relax with a book enjoying a good coffee.
I can recommend a stay at casa manoa 100%.
review_4_text: Great little hotel. Personalized attentional in a beautifully renovated colonial house in Sesquike.. Close to many attractions in a little town that is not overrun by tourist and still maintains its character. Highly recommended
review_5_text: We had a fantastic experience during our stay at Casa Manoa.  Our hosts were very welcoming and provided us with excellent service. From the moment we arrived they made us feel at home, gave us clear information, answered our questions and were available to respond to our requests. The house has been beautifully restored to provide all the modern comforts and was impeccably clean. Breakfast was freshly made and delicious. My parents loved the warmth of the fireplace in their room and my husband enjoyed Toro’s company . We all look forward to returning to Casa Manoa in the near future.

review_1_text: Good place. Could improve
review_2_text: Muy muy mal el menu de la casa. Pedimos unas costillas de cena y llegaron 100g. recomiendo llevar comida. Las zonas humedas las cobran aparte y no funcionan bien. La casa es bonita y tiene buena vista al lago. La habitacion es comoda y tiene buena ducha.
review_3_text:
We had lunch there because the restaurant we were going to was closed. I didn't see the rooms, only the common areas which are very pleasant.  It has a very spacious dining room and star room and outdoor dining room.  It has areas to contemplate the dam and a nice view.
The person who served us was very friendly, the prices of the dishes were very expensive.
It has location and maintenance improvements that could make the place more in line with the concept of a boutique hotel.
review_4_text: Disappointing, the facilities are nice but the service is very poor, they were not ready to receive us when we arrived (they didn't even know which room we were going to), the food has limited options and is average (they even gave us raw chicken). The fireplace was requested to be lit and it took almost 3 hours to do so. They offer services that they do not have (horseback riding, heating) and the worst thing was that they asked us for the room before check out (it is at 1:30 p.m. according to their website and they asked for it at 1 p.m.), also when we paid they had the garage opened as if they were throwing us out of the place, not very friendly, really bad service, we would never recommend it
review_5_text: It is a spectacular place, with a beautiful landscape. All rooms have a view of the reservoir, so every morning you have an incredible view. The attention is the best, they are always looking out for you, the food is gourmet, delicious and sophisticated dishes. You can also kayak with complete peace of mind. 100% recommended.

review_5_text: Good service, economical, comfortable, neat

review_1_text: Comfortable, although without windows. The noise from the hallway can be annoying.
review_2_text:
Overall, it's fine.
However, they don't provide quick responses. You can hear a lot of noise from the reception desk very early in the morning. They're also changing tiles and working early in the morning, so the noise is quite bothersome.
As a suggestion, they should always have someone available to open the parking lot. Although it's on the corner, you always have to call to have it opened and closed.

review_4_text: Affordable, clean, with friendly staff and a nice touch. The only two issues are that one day I smelled a strong odor from the bathroom, and the next day I showered with cold water, as the hot water isn't permanent; they turn it on at 7 a.m. I would definitely go back.

review_2_text:
1000 out of 10! A paradise in the mountains 🌄✨

Our stay at Glamping Caelum in the municipality of Machetá, Cundinamarca, was simply spectacular. From the first moment, you feel like it's a magical space, carefully designed to disconnect from the noise of the city and reconnect with nature and tranquility.

The room is a gem: comfortable, cozy, and with a stunning view of the mountains. The bathroom... wow! It's an experience in itself: natural decor with plants, handmade soaps with delicious aromas, and a design that makes you feel like you're in a private spa in the middle of the forest.

The kitchen has all the necessary elements, and even a minibar with drinks and food available! Everything is impeccable and very well thought out. Plus, there's a perfect space for a safe campfire and an outdoor jacuzzi strategically located to enjoy the starry sky. A luxurious experience under the stars!

The included breakfast was delicious, prepared with care. And what can we say about Doña María, the hostess? A wonderful, kind, and attentive woman who welcomed us warmly and made us feel at home. Her tour of the place was charming and full of details.

Glamping Caelum is definitely a 5-star place, perfect for resting, reconnecting, and enjoying nature with all the comforts. Highly recommended, we will definitely be returning many more times. 💚

name: Anuk Chocontá
review_1_text: Incredible service, amazing view, and very relaxing experience.  David went above and beyond to make sure we had a memorable stay. Highly recommended in a wonderful place to be very much in touch with nature.
review_2_text:
1. The cuisine is the highlight of the place. On the one hand, the menu for the romantic dinner plan wasn't very extensive, with only three options. We tried two of them. I highly recommend the filet mignon with Creole mashed potatoes (remember that it contains blue cheese, so since we're not fans of aged cheeses, we decided to specifically ask for very little, and they followed the instructions to the letter). The breakfast was delicious and plentiful (it comes in two parts). If you have any allergies, they'll ask before scheduling.

2. The place is beautiful, with nature everywhere you look. They have three accommodation options. I think it's worth deciding carefully. The dome says it gets a lot of light in the morning. Regarding the alpine cabins, the one at the back offers more privacy because no one has to go through it to get to their room. However, the cabin closest to the entrance doesn't have curtains, so you feel less private, as you have to go through it if you go to the alpine cabin at the back.

3. We were offered an eco-hike, but upon arrival, they told us the trail wasn't in good condition because they were doing construction for an event. I think they should mention this before booking.

4. There are about six dogs in the glamping area, so if you don't like dogs or have allergies, think twice. For my part, the only thing that bothered me was some barking during the morning, but nothing serious.

5. The atmosphere is very family-like, in the sense that the people are very warm, and if you decide to have any of your meals in the main house, there's no problem. They are actually friendly and easy to talk to. However, if you're planning a more private romantic dinner, you can have it in your room at a table decorated with a very "minimalist" concept, according to the owners. After asking them, it's not the traditional romantic decor, unless you request it separately, with details of what you'd like. They provided a small vase of flowers and some lamps on the wall.

6. The room is exactly as shown in the photos on the website and social media. They aren't very spacious, but they are cozy and well-equipped. The Jacuzzi heats perfectly. Although it's worth mentioning that the internal staircase of the alpine cabin is quite steep, if you suffer from vertigo or have difficulty moving, think twice, because upstairs is the room itself and the balcony, which has a beautiful view.

7. Mosquitoes appeared at night, so the buzzing was a bit annoying. We decided to leave some options handy, like raid pills.

8. It's quite cold in the area, but they provide good blankets and slippers, and you can even light a fireplace or request a space heater.

9. They offered us panela water with cinnamon, which was spectacular for that cold.

10. Considering the pros and cons of the entire experience, I think we would return, but it depends on individual tastes.

11. Last but not least, part of the road leading to the property is unpaved, and in fact, the entrance to the site is difficult to access (we had a flat tire and were rescued by a member of the Anuk family), so please be very careful. We heard that arriving by motorcycle is not recommended.

Greetings, travelers, and thank you to those who hosted us; they were very kind. We truly wish you the best in your endeavors.

name: El Cobijo
review_1_text:
Very little honesty.
We had reserved two nights in the big house. We arrived at noon and there was no electricity. We spoke to Donald, who told us he would arrive at 5 pm. The power didn't come until 9 pm. The house was not equipped for this, there was only a flashlight that ran out of charge very quickly and some very small candles that did not provide light. The meat and dairy products we had brought were damaged.
We asked Donald for compensation, since we found out that the damage had been going on for four days (according to him, what they told us is not true, although one house had reported that it was without power at least a day before). He decided not to be honest and tell us this beforehand, but to receive the money even if we were going to be uncomfortable. He didn't want to give us any compensation. He said it was not his fault a public service. We pay for an experience we do not receive.
To have electricity we had to take two bundles of firewood and pay for that. He didn't even offer us complimentary firewood so we would have some light.
The house only had a flashlight, which was discharged quickly, and small white candles, which do not provide light.
I recommend not going to this place and looking for honest accommodations.

The tent smells of plastic. Speaking to the manager, said that no staff came in to work and it is why it is the way it is. The 2 guys working looked exhausted. The place has potential but needs some major upkeep. As I said, the manager was kind enough to not charge us for the spa and was very apologetic of the situation. He did upgrade us no charge which was kind of him.

Nowadays there's better glampings around that beautiful area offering better service for a reasonable price -particularly if you're coming with a foreigner.

review_4_text:
# tl;dr

The campsite: 4/5
The view: 4/5
Check-in Experience: 3/5
Room Service: 2.5/5
Check-out Experience: 1.5/5
The Drive to the Campsite: 1/5

---

# The Review

I'm going to try and make this positive while trying to provide contructive criticism. Which to be honest, probably isn't constructive because my idea of glamping and actual glamping are two different concepts. First I need to explain that this was my first experience glamping. I thought glamping would be very similar to an experience at a hotel. Combining the outdoors with the luxuries of a hotel. While this might be the concept I think looking at this linearly the outdoors part of glamping takes precedence. Which, for people who like glamping, probably understand and more importantly enjoy this.

The road to the camping site was very bad. I think it's important that guests know they should have an SUV or be aware that they must traverse a mountain to get to the site. This was not mentioned anywhere but again, perhaps this is common with all glamping sites.

The website made it appear that any dome style site (which we had) would come with a net we could lay on. Ours didn't come with one so I think it's important to look at the ammenenties or ask them before booking if your site explcitly will have a net if you want one.

It was literally freezing at night. This is something we were not prepared for but again, as I told my wife, most people who go camping realize this and probably bring a personal heater to protect them from the freezing temperatures. We only had to battle 3 bugs which I thought was a miracle and I'm happy about that. I also think people who go camping realize this battle and bring bug spray or a fly swatter to fight these battles.

When we arrived we had to walk up the side of the mountain to our camp site but I was thinking the luxury part of glamping would have provided an ATV to transport us to our glamping site. But again, most people probably expect and are happy with the journey.

When we checked in they asked what time we wanted breakfast and we told them 8:30. At 9 we decided to send a message via whatsapp (their preferred method of calling the "Front Desk"). They responded with "Ya subiendo." The breakfast arrived at 9:27. I think "Ya subiendo" meant, "oh yeah, you want breakfast and we forgot about you and we will start working on your breakfast right away and send it up when it's ready. lol

Wifi is very important for me and my work. I was without wifi during my entire stay. que triste. After reading more closely their website, the free wifi is actually only available near check-in which made it pointless to say you offer wifi as most people stay in their campsite for the duration of their stay. Searching for wifi and nearby glamping site had wifi access. If you use Claro you won't have coverage (at least at the time of writing this), if you use movistar you will have coverage. Luckily my wife uses movistar. If you want wifi, you won't have it. At the very minimum they should offer wifi throughout the campsites so that every campsite has wifi access in the comfort of their accomodations.

They don't accept apple pay. lol

I really liked the view from our campsite. I guess that was my favorite thing. I'm happy to have experienced glamping in Colombia. I'm excited to try glamping once more in the United States simply for comparison and next time I will be better prepared thanks to our experience at Bajo Cielo Glamping.

review_1_text:
We spent a beautiful weekend at Villa Boutique Guatavita.
For a family like ours, with a three-year-old child and a large breed dog, it is not easy to find a Glamping where they can be well and here we were all happy.

The place is fenced so our dog was able to roam free all the time. The cabin is picturesque, and although it is cold at night, it is not freezing.
We appreciate the constant communication and the fact that they were attentive to all our requests which made our stay easier. Like most glamping sites, this one operates more like an Airbnb than a hotel and it is good to keep this in mind so as not to have wrong expectations about the services of the place.

The jacuzzi does take a long time to heat up, so I advise turning it on as soon as you arrive or, if possible, requesting that it be turned on before arriving at the place.

One of the things I liked about this cabin, besides the view, is that it feels big inside, you can walk around, be on a couch or in the chairs in front of the fireplace.

Please be careful with the stairs, surely the young audience will not have problems with this... but those of us who have hip or knee problems, because the years do not come alone, we must be careful.

Finally, keep in mind that the bed is on the second floor of the cabin and nothing else, the bathroom is on the first. (Maybe this information will help someone, especially someone who gets up to the bathroom at night like me 😅)

For breakfast, there is the option of having it in a very nearby restaurant that has a beautiful view or they have it delivered to your home the next day.

In general we really liked this place apart from being so close to Bogotá. We disconnected, we oxygenated ourselves and we all as a family had an incredible time. Thank you Villa Switzerland!!
review_2_text: An excellent place to disconnect and rest in the middle of nature, jacuzzi, fireplace, kitchen, living room, dining room, bedroom and bathroom. The breakfast service at Casa García is spectacular. Highly recommended. Point to improve the hot water in the shower.
review_3_text:
It's a shame because it has a lot of potential and could offer a better experience with small details.

The jacuzzi water is very unpleasant, yellow and filthy, and the entire water in the place is like this. What they don't warn you about is that it takes two hours to heat the water.

Be careful with the floor; there are loose nails on the balcony that stick out a bit and can cut.

The bathroom is poorly designed; when you use the shower, the water comes out and wets the entire bathroom floor.

Be careful when leaving the place by car when it rains, as it turns into mud and the car skids. Several people have gotten stuck, according to what we were told, and they still haven't made any adjustments to the entrance to prevent cars from skidding when it rains. To get them out, they charge between 50 for a neighbor with a pickup truck and 200 for a towing service.

No sticks were left in the fireplace to start the fire.

The clotheslines were stained and covered in other people's hair.
The stairs leading down to the bathroom are very uncomfortable because they are sloping and very thin.
review_4_text: We had a very bad experience with La Villa Suiza headquarters Guatavita. We rented the largest villa for 2 (boutique villa) that has a Jacuzzi included. The worst thing about this reservation and that sums up everything bad that happened to us, is the NON-EXISTENT service on the site. When you go to a glamping site, you expect someone to welcome you, take care of you with whatever you need, that there is at least a glamping kitchen and that they serve their own food, but this is more of an Airbnb with a different name. I list the problems we found: There is no one to receive you and give you the cabin. They offer services but they all outsource them, including the food (breakfast arrives in polystyrene packaging at home). We ordered a romantic dinner with decoration and wine, the wine did not arrive and the decoration was a stationery candle in a container (of course, with food from some restaurant outside of "glamping" although it did arrive on a plate at least). Robes with burned parts. They didn't warn us that the jacuzzi would take 2 and a half hours to be ready and if we don't ask how to turn it on they don't say anything, and apart from that it never heated the water when we tried to use it. The shower with problems evacuating water. Dirty blankets. Dog manure outside the cabin. It's cold weather, very cold, and you can't find even a little coffee or bags of aromatic infusion. Completely empty refrigerator. There were only 2 half rolls of toilet paper in the bathroom. At least there was a shower with hot water. Terrible service and this is definitely not glamping. They offered me compensation with a free night, but I would never stay there again.
review_5_text:
There is no one who attends the place in person, Villa Tiny is a space where you practically have to walk crouching all the time, there is nowhere to store your luggage, the bathroom practically has the shower over the cistern and the curtain and the door are loose and the water leaks into the room.
Breakfast is brought in Styrofoam containers at half past nine in the morning. The bonfire area is not suitable for lighting and there is no one to attend.
The curtains are fabrics glued with nylon and bugs.
It's really not a comfortable or pleasant enough place.
Maybe it is worth renting the one next door, but unfortunately it was not available, it is better that they only offer the large one and not a small place, which is not suitable for the glamping concept, since I have stayed in others for the same price and they are much better.
Many aspects to improve, starting because practically everything has to be asked, and even ask for matches to light a bonfire (the matches arrived the next day).
As a suggestion, keep these recommendations in mind to provide a better experience.
We left there and they didn't even ask us what we thought.

review_5_text: Para el presupuesto que se maneja se encuentra muy aseado, con muy buena atención, un buen desayuno adicional a 12.000. La ubicación es buena, es rural, cerca al municipio sin embargo el único acceso es con vehículo, sea moto o carro. En general un lugar muy recomendado si tiene vehículo

We booked for the 24th. I don't recommend it, the worst, walls full of damp and the smell is terrible. A room with dirty clothes and the lady didn't know who it belonged to. We couldn't stay that night because of the terrible
Smell, we had to pay another hotel. The lady hands over the keys and runs quickly to avoid the comments, and then she doesn't even answer the phone. If I were honest, I wouldn't post misleading photos of the hotel.
review_3_text: It is a very quiet place, quite central, its location allows you to move around within Sopo very easily, with a cozy atmosphere.
review_4_text:
Reservamos con el 50% una vez llegamos al hotel nos toca esperar mientras nos atendían porque nadie salió, luego salió un señor gordo y alto y dijo que debíamos esperar y nos cerró la puerta del hotel dejándonos afuera, las habitación son muy feas en mal estado, lo peor de todo es que no nos quisieron hacer devolución de dinero.

Si tienen la oportunidad de quedarse en este hotel, pierdansela!!!!!
review_5_text:
El hotel está muy bien ubicado, la atención es buena y es tranquilo
Sin embrago, las paredes están demasiado agrietadas, la habitación presenta mucha humedad, no nos brindaron jabón de baño sino solo de manos, habían muchos pelos en las almohadas y en las camas

name: HOSPEDAJE LA ROKA
review_1_text:
Me gusto mucho el lugar, la habitación es muy cómoda con su baño privado, hay cocina para prepararse lo que necesita.
Buena ubicación para lo que necesitaba.
Tiene lugar de estacionamiento.
review_2_text: Este lugar no lo recomiendo la señora Marisol el día viernes 11 de agosto no nos comunico con tiempo que tenía un escape de gas. En ese momento mis compañeras de trabajo y mi mami tuvieron síntomas de intoxicación. A ella no le importó y no me quiso devolver lo que se le transfirió en su totalidad pues nos tocó irnos a otro hotel.
review_3_text: A very quiet place, beautiful views and very comfortable. Excellent service, the lady is very kind and cordial. We hope to return 😊
review_4_text: Hace 2 días , servicio excelente, habitación,súper con una vista hermosa 😊 recomendable para un par de días en paz tranquilidad!!!;
review_5_text: A very clean, quiet place, excellent view, has parking and Mrs. Marisol is very friendly. I recommend it

name: El MØNTE teepee hostel
opening_hours: Monday: Closed|Tuesday: Closed|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text: My brother brought us here for a surprise celebration 🎉. The location is stunning 🤩 and the place is set up with amazing good taste. Service in the other hand is very far from being what you would expect at a place that looks this good, if it wasn’t for Emanuel who is the most hard working and kind person I have ever seen, the place would not run. But just one guy for such a big operation is not enough, foreign bar tenders have no clue of what is going on and the registration and check out processes were a night mare. The teepees are amazing, beads are super comfy and the linens are impeccable. Food was also really really good.
review_2_text:
The hostel is amazing, food is great (you need to try pizza for sure). Hostel staff is very nice and friendly. The landscape is gorgeous and it’s very peaceful. Teepees are very comfortable, bed is warm and cozy. Bathrooms are not so close so keep that in mind.

We’ve been there twice and both times we had problems with our car. First time we didn’t know what the road looked like and we took a regular car, the bottom part of the the car got damaged because there’s no paved road. Second time we took a taller car and the road was so muddy that we almost overturned leaving the hostel. If you are going PLEASE take a 4x4.
review_3_text: A beautiful spot in the hills just outside Bogotá. The staff is super friendly and helpful. Even spoke English. We had a tipi which was beautiful with a very comfy bed and enough blankets cause it gets really cold at night. Food there is great too. Bit pricy the whole stay but totally worth it.
review_4_text:
Such a nice hostel, the entire place is magic. It is like a city contemporary hostel in middle of country side woods.
The teepees (rooms) are incredible, comfortables well designed, the garden bar invite to you to get some drink and spend time sitting  by fire. The food is good, very nice staff
review_5_text: A nice and different place near Bogota. Teepees are fun Cabañas with personal touch and food really good. Don't miss the special nights with singer and comedians

review_1_text: Probably one of the best places to stay at Sopó. Traditional old house with patrimonial value for the town. Besides that is just a normal place where you'll be safe and have a good night but not too amazing for anything else than sleeping there.
review_2_text: Great place. If you are a fan of those rustic colonial architecture, you will love. Our stay was a delight, thanks to Don Javier. Centrally located, very friendly people, clean rooms...I really like it!!!
review_3_text: Loved it
review_4_text: I really liked the place; considering it's a small town, it's quite nice. Being a colonial house, it has a very well-kept central courtyard, and at night it's spectacular. I definitely promise to return.
review_5_text:
Beautiful. A colonial house very well adapted for service. Comfortable price. Located in the central area of ​​Sopó, near the transport terminal.
The staff is very friendly.

name: Hotel Mi Villa Vida
address: Sector de Paso hondo, Cundinamarca Vereda la Trinidad, Guasca
review_1_text: Un lugar genial para olvidar el bullicio de la ciudad, como el espacio es tan grande se pueden hacer un sinfin de actividades al aire libre, recomendando para pasar un día en familia o con amigos !
review_2_text: A place with great architecture and a wonderful landscape, ideal for resting and also for doing a wide variety of outdoor activities!
review_3_text: Excellent place to share with family and friends. Nature is an essential part of the plans throughout the site. 5/5
review_4_text: Very good service and facilities, ideal to get out of the routine and enjoy nature. Delicious food 👌100% recommended.
review_5_text: The very cozy place, the perfect place to rest, even better the disposition and service of the family that cares for and attended to during the stay

name: La Casa en el Arbol Guatavita
review_1_text: The tree house is simpel and has very nice views to lake and eucalyptus leaves. Be prepared what you have booked (amount and if breakfast is included).
review_2_text: Very nice and cozy, it's close to the town center so it's easy to get to. They offer a reasonably priced breakfast. The heater needs improvement, as it doesn't really generate much heat, and the area is quite cold in the early morning. It would also be nice if they included board games to pass the time. Otherwise, the service is excellent.
review_3_text: Incredible place to go to connect with nature, super quiet, you can only hear the animals and the wind... I would return many more times... delicious breakfast, excellent view, the truth is 10/10
review_4_text: Excellent service, a perfect space to rest, very good attention and the best thing is that we were able to be with our dog
review_5_text: Un lugar tranquilo para descansar. atención  muy buena me encanto volverémos

name: Posada del Páramo
review_1_text:
If you're looking for a place to disconnect from the city, the chaos, and the daily grind, this is definitely the place to stay. Upon arrival, you can hear the sounds of the characteristic fauna of the high Andean forest, and it's very close if your goal is to hike the Siecha Lagoons trail in Chingaza.

The service from before you arrive is more than excellent, as they pay attention to every detail.

The food has exceptional flavor and cooking. The only thing that could be better than the size of the food is just right for those who prefer larger portions. But that's nothing to add to the variety on the menu. The hospitality of Mrs. Mercedes, who personally ensures that all your needs are met, is impressive.

Please note that connectivity is not very good, and much of this is due to weather factors that may be beyond the facility's control.

I would definitely return and recommend it.

Note: The road may be in poor condition if rainfall is very heavy at the time of year. Otherwise, it's passable, but I wouldn't recommend a car.
review_2_text:
Rooms: we had a very spacious and comfortable room, with a kind of closed balcony with a beautiful view. The inn has a lot of character and very comfortable spaces. I would only note that the internet connection does not work well in the room.
Service: Although the hostess was unhelpful while we were there, the service was impeccable. She is a very cultured person with a good sense of hosting. Very good breakfast, good food in general. As a special feature, there is a library in the inn.
Location: It is in a rural area and you have to climb to about 3,200 meters. Of course the road is uncovered because it is a nature reserve. The surrounding area is Andean forest. Very beautiful. With walking paths and a stream of water. I was able to see many birds and wild animals.
I'll be back!
review_3_text:
Lo bueno: la atención por Ana la dueña es excelente, la casa es realmente hermosa junto con todo lo que hay al rededor. Muy cuidada, limpia y caliente para el frío de la zona. La comida es muy, muy buena con opciones para vegetarianos si es que alguien lo es. Las habitaciones preciosas, amplias, cómodas.
Lo malo: la via desde Guasca son 12 kilómetros no paviemntados, aunque la vía tiene un estado aceptable para carros bajos. No tendría inconveniente para camionetas.
Lo feo: el trayecto desde Guasca puede ser un poco incierto ya que hasta que no estás cerca al hotel no hay señalización de cómo llegar al hotel, el Google maps puede fallar un poco. Bueno todo tiene solución que es preguntar muy bien como llegar a Ana o preguntar por el camino como llegar a la posada
review_4_text: A site located in a nature reserve. Ideal for resting and disconnecting from usual activities. The house has very nice places such as the living room with a spectacular fireplace, the master bedroom with a fireplace and a spectacular bathroom. The exquisite food. All run by its owner Ana Mercedes who is personally in charge of making the guest feel at home. The service in general impeccable. You have to be well dressed to go out. Place to return.
review_5_text:
He tenido el gusto de compartir este espacio en escenarios de recreación y de trabajo, siempre atendidas excelencia y calidez.

La Posada cuenta con espacios pensados para la creación, para tranquilizarse, para sembrar y / cosechar, para reconectarse con otras formas de disfrutar el tiempo.

Recientemente recibimos la buena noticia de que cuentan con un aula ambiental con capacidad de hasta 50 personas, compartir tiempo en la Posada es hacer parte de las propuestas de cuidado y conservación de nuestros espacios naturales.

name: Hotel Tominé
review_1_text:
Excellent hotel. We arrived a little late to ask and Mrs. Carolina very kindly assisted us. The comfortable and quiet room.
We stayed 2 nights. Everything magnificent, clean and close to the central square.
I would only improve the towels.
But in general very very good, I recommend everything. fair prices
review_2_text: The place is very nice, the price is lower than what is offered and the service is very good
review_3_text: The restaurant's menu offers enough variety for various tastes. The dishes do not have any gastronomic pretensions but they are well prepared and the portions are fair, so the appetite is satisfied and payment for the service is made with gratitude. The service and atmosphere are familiar. Particularly, not only in this establishment but, apparently, in the entire municipality, which is a tourist destination, the use of the dataphone is not common to make payments.
review_4_text: Good hotel. Good price. Central and close to places of interest. I would stay there again. Very nice, private, quiet. Comfortable and pleasant room. A cool balcony. I only would have liked the water to come out warm and not cool, because Guatavita is very cold, but it can be corrected (it would be my only observation). Whoever received us is friendly, that is vital.
review_5_text: Terrible service in the restaurant. Because the customer is made to wait approximately 20 minutes after requesting the a la carte dishes. And then they come to the table to say that there are not the requested products. 😡😡😡😡😡🤬🤬🤬😕

name: Hotel Colonial Villa Mercedes
review_1_text: I spent about a week here and I really enjoyed my stay. The people that operate the hotel are very helpful and friendly. The hotel itself feels cozy and always smells great. If you are a golfer or cyclist this is the perfect place to stay because you are close to all of the action. Thank you Hotel Villa Mercedes for the hospitality!
review_3_text: Excellent service, the friendliness stands out from the moment you arrive until you leave the hotel, the rooms are very nice, very comfortable, the service is 10/10, highly recommended, and it is very well located.
review_4_text:
Excellent hotel located in front of Jaime Duque Park (they have an agreement for discounts) in a house that preserves the architecture of yesteryear. The rooms were immaculate, organized, clean and very good furniture.
The attention from the staff is excellent.
It has private parking.
Very quiet spaces, ideal for a good rest, slightly away from the main road which contributes to noise levels not being very high.
Recommended.
review_5_text:
It is a very nice hotel. It's quiet. It has a modern touch and is colonial.
We were greatly surprised with this hotel in the area. Best of all, they have an agreement with the Jaime Duque park and they give you a discount on tickets. Super recommended 💯

review_1_text: The grounds are breathtaking with colourful native flowers and lovely shaded areas to sit and read. The rooms are a unique visual treat with a personality all of their own. Olivia is very friendly and enjoys pets, and the three lamas can be tempted with grass. The owner, David, is the definition of hospitable and his staff goes above and beyond every day. Special shout out to Enrique who put up with us coming in late and lighting our stove to keep us warm. 1000000/10 I am definitely coming back.
review_2_text:
Very nice and romantic place. Perfect for a romantic getaway...you can spend the night there.

The weather is usually cold for Colombia between 12-16C° and below 8 C° in the night.

The food is very good, you have a lot of choices between beef, chicken and fish. The best dishes are the chicken/salmon seven cheeses.
review_3_text: In my opinion and my husband's the food was the best one we had in Colombia. Very nice place to stay too.
review_4_text: Great place, very cozy and romantic, all the staff Is super friendly and ahead of what se needed. The food is excelent, verte tasty dishes, we highly recommend the pork ribs, Is perfect for a nigth dinner for two.
review_5_text: Super great experience here at cafe la Huerta. We had a lomo de queso azul which was top notch. Charming ambiance.

name: Glamping en La Calera Paraíso en La Montaña
review_1_text: Superb spot! Completely off the beaten path. You have to go by jeep to final destination.  Close to natural Park and possibilities to go in an horse into the park! 🌟
review_2_text:
An absolutely beautiful, magical place, surrounded by nature.
The food is delicious and the service is 10 stars, they are excellent hosts.
Thank you, geacias, thank you, it was a beautiful experience
review_3_text: It is a wonderful place, very quiet and disconnected from everything! For me it was the best because it was the idea of ​​disconnecting, they mention that it is very cold at night, for me and in my case it did not seem like it, I recommend good footwear that is to say footwear with grip, you cannot get to the place in a normal car, so they offer you a parking lot nearby and later they pick you up in a 4x4, the people who serve are very friendly and respectful, I just had breakfast and it was very delicious, the cabin very organized, clean and very well maintained
review_4_text:
Fantastic! It is a magical place, absolute privacy in the middle of a totally unique landscape. The cabin has everything you need and is beautiful and comfortable, the attention of Laura and her family is out of the ordinary, never better cared for.

If you want beauty, kindness and disconnection in the middle of nature, you have to go!
review_5_text: A nice place to really connect with nature, the cabins are cool and everyone is very friendly. You can go hiking and horseback riding and the guide is the best!  A perfect plan to go as a couple and they are also pet-friendly.

name: Cabaña Villa doralis

review_2_text:
Wow, what a beautiful view and very cozy for a weekend getaway.
😍😍😍

review_1_text: Amazing peacful place with incredible hosts. Wonderful attention and will be back.
review_2_text: What a wonderful cozy place;  nature, outdoors, tranquility, the best hosts, they are friendly, helpful, I will return very soon. Gratitude with Rubiela and Jairo
review_3_text:
A very quiet, pleasant and cozy place in a very beautiful region. The attention of the owners is excellent. Our stay included breakfast, very good.

Highly recommended for rest plans as a couple, family or friends. I would return.

review_5_text:
Excellent place, very quiet, the attention is very good, the owners are very attentive, it is very neat.
Beautiful place, I recommend it, I would return many times.

review_1_text: The place is beautiful. Is close enough to the town but far enough to be peaceful and quiet. Great views and surroundings.
review_2_text: La vista es muy bonita, se alcanza a ver el aeropuerto y el río. El mirador no está muy bien arreglado y hay que tener precaución pero es una de las zonas mas llamativas para apreciar el paisaje de la naturaleza sobre la ciudad.
review_3_text:
This accommodation is actually unique👌. It is a very cozy, quiet, comfortable and very beautiful cabin. The details with which it is decorated make it even more welcoming. It has an excellent view and the environment is completely pleasant, quiet and safe. It is also very warm inside.
We went with my husband and my son. Our experience met expectations.
The bonfire was very enjoyable. Breakfast, complete and delicious😋!
The service, excellent!! It is attended by its owner, who is very gentle and cordial. He is very ready for whatever is needed.
The truth is, a beautiful experience that we can repeat!!!
Recommending!! 😊
review_4_text: It is an excellent space to rest and meditate, very quiet. The cabin is very cozy, with an interesting landscape, set against the view of the reservoir. The service is excellent.
review_5_text: A very nice and cozy place, the view of the reservoir is spectacular, the cabin is very comfortable and clean, the service was great. Super recommended.

review_3_text: Cool

review_1_text: Great service and I really liked it. They are very friendly, the food is delicious. I recommend it. Everything is very nice.
review_2_text:
It is a very nice hotel, comfortable, excellent service.
Recommended!
review_3_text:
Nice and organized country place.
Comfortable rooms, the only thing to improve is the bathroom, the showers are not in good condition and that is why you have to wait more than 10 minutes for warm water to come out.
They delay answering the phone or do not respond.
These two aspects must improve.
Recommended for a good rest.
review_4_text: What good is a nice place if the service is terrible?  Gentlemen, you don't have the quality of customer service. Incredible, after an hour of waiting we decided to leave, in a hurry, charging for products that were not consumed. I definitely do not recommend this place at all, it does not represent the friendliness and excellent service of other places in our region. Also, the scandal was uncomfortable, the chef shouting at the waiters (they are the ones who are least to blame).
review_5_text:
A bad experience, they deceived us with breakfast, they were not clear about what it included. It supposedly includes breakfast, but when we left they charged us for everything.
Additionally, the restaurant service had a very bad attitude and a bad face. They didn't have anything we asked for and as if they weren't going to charge us, they made the food reluctantly.
The cleaning service was bad, although they told us that they had already done the cleaning, we found everything dirty.
The noise from the parties they have is uncomfortable, because although it is a country hotel to rest, they attend events for third parties, all day, whose sound bounces around the rooms, making it impossible to fall asleep or rest.
It is not a place to go with the family, nor as a place to relax. Overall, not a good place to visit.

name: Casa Azulejo Sopo
review_1_text:
Sus habitaciones me encantaron. Tiene una vista hermosa. Una cocina práctica, por si deseas cocinar.
El diseño de la casa es precioso, permite descansar y liberarse del estrés. Es un lugar silencioso
review_2_text: The house is beautiful, everything is very nice, clean and tidy, the view is spectacular. It is an ideal place to rest and breathe fresh air. The host is very attentive and willing to help as much as possible.
review_3_text: Todo esta muy bien acomodado, el asado puede ser mejor, es un poco pequeño pero es funcional. Súper lindo para desconectarse y son pet friendly, loa perritos están bien porque todo esta cercado.
review_4_text: It is an excellent option to disconnect, very close to Bogotá, the food is delicious, the view is beautiful, the service is great, and the facilities are very comfortable.
review_5_text: The house is divine, impeccable in every way and the attention is unmatched, we will definitely return!

name: El Tábano Eco-Hotel
review_1_text: Excellent place, everything thought out in detail, you can see the dedication and dedication so that it is in harmony with the environment and provides well-being and peace to visitors.  Super recommended. ❤️
review_2_text: A place to dream

name: Ribera del ave
review_1_text: We visited Guasca and stopped at this amazing boutique hotel to visit Rafael. Rafael previous owned a famous Italian restaurant in Bogota which hosted celebrities, CEOs of mega corporations, and world leaders. He was incredibly nice and allowed us to tour the entire hotel, guest rooms, and sprawling estate. We were first greeted by two baby goats and then met the staff who would later prepare a stunning lunch. They have a full kitchen, large pizza oven, and outdoor dining room. Breakfasts are serviced daily and included with your room fee. While lunch was being prepared, we were offered beers and walked across the small bridge to visit two incredibly friendly horses and several chunky, happy dogs. After lunch we soaked in the natural hot springs and were rejuvenated from the minerals. Visiting this hotel was a highlight of our trip to Bogota and meeting Rafael and his family was absolutely wonderful.
review_2_text:
Being in this hotel is like being in the Italian countryside. It is a romantic and paradisiacal place, full of vegetation like something out of a fairy tale. It is a pleasure to go for a walk through its gardens surrounded by flowers and with a beautiful river that runs through half of its green meadows.
The rooms are like magazines from another era, comfortable and full of details that make them very cozy.
The food goes without saying, exquisite, simple but very well prepared, all the dishes are really delicious!
Anyway, how delicious to come back!
review_3_text: This is a fraud. The photos on the page are faked, the truth is it is horrible, messy, dirty, you cannot call this place a hotel, it is very poorly maintained, it is a house and its decoration is in bad taste. Their price offer is 5 stars, in terms of accommodation and food, but it does not even reach a star. The thermal springs have nothing to see, everything is fallen and deteriorated. We booked a supreme room with a fireplace and they were putting us in either one. The rooms are full of trash, furniture, and piled up mattresses. Their employees don't even have uniforms.
review_4_text: Espectacular sitio, reservado, atención exclusiva y muy amable. Comida deliciosa y termales privados. Decoración, espacios verdes y jardines un sitio ideal para descansar y recargar energía
review_5_text: I found this place through a publication made by the singer Andrés Cepeda, we visited it to celebrate our anniversary ❤️, which was ideal on this special date, beautiful and quiet place to enjoy nature, delicious food and excellent service, it is also pet friendly 👌👏 🐕🏡🏡💯

opening_hours: Monday: 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM|Tuesday: 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM|Wednesday: 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM|Thursday: 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM|Friday: 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM|Saturday: 11:00 AM – 7:00 PM|Sunday: 11:00 AM – 7:00 PM
review_1_text: A very nice place, with an excellent location and a beautiful view. The service is friendly and courteous. The rooms and common areas are very clean. There's plenty of parking. They offer breakfast, and that's fine! You can hear noise from other rooms, especially those adjacent to them, but nothing too loud in my opinion. Bring pajamas. I went with my wife and 10-year-old son, and it was a good experience.
review_2_text: Excellent place, very nice, the breakfast is quite good and the service is good
review_3_text: It took them an hour to serve, the only nice thing is the view, but the service was very bad, the couple who was next to us got tired of waiting and left
review_4_text:
Bad customer service
I went with my boyfriend and friends
Delayed food, we notified and they got upset
The food was tasteless, the only thing that was delicious was the rice, the meat didn't even have salt and was poorly cooked, the pork and grilled ingredients were dry, bad-tasting lemonade, the guacamole didn't taste like anything…
When I say bad service, I mean that the person who served us made a bad face about everything and, not using what we asked for things (salt, cutlery, extra lemonade), she threw things at us at the table.
We only paid for the dishes consumed, we did not want to pay for service. Appalling. Beautiful landscape! Bad experience and it makes me sad because we wanted a nice lunch that ended in a very bad time 😩🤦🏻‍♂️
review_5_text: It is a very nice place, very very clean, Mrs. Gloria and Sandra are very attentive to whatever one needs, and well, the view... Little to say.

name: Glamping
review_1_text:
Rooms are way overpriced for what you get compared to places nearby. Other naive foreigners are raving about this place in the reviews but it's not worth it.

The $100 one with the "jacuzzi" is a complete joke. The jacuzzi barely heats up and there was loud music. Look elsewhere.
review_2_text: Best glamping experience we've had with my family. An excellent host, excellent breakfast. We accidentally booked the reservation in the wrong month. However the host graciously allowed us to change the booking on the day, came in an hour notice and took his own time to give us the best service. Fully recommend this experience to everyone!
review_3_text:
There are no words to explain  The experience that I lived there!
The personnel is very kind.
The place is amazing, each detail inside the glamping count.
The view, I think is the best of all in the area.
My recommendation for your first night is to take a shower before arriving, there is hot water but after a shower, it's too cold outsidee.
review_4_text:
¡Un lugar increíble! Muy buena atención de principio a fin. Queda a 15 minutos del pueblo de Guatavita. Con una vista panorámica al embalse de Tominé, los Glampings están super bien adecuados, con agua caliente, calentador, camas cómodas y todo lo que uno puede necesitar.

El desayuno estaba delicioso y superó nuestras expectativas. También tienen un menú para cenar con buenos precios y muy buen sabor.

Hace bastante frío en la noche así que hay que llevar buen abrigo.

Recomendados 100%
review_5_text:
The place is beautiful, nice view day and night (ideal for seeing the stars), good service, delicious and balanced breakfast, the weather is very cold at night and very hot during the day!
The bathroom is beautiful, there is hot water, the decoration is well thought out. There are board games, cushions and you also have free coffee, tea and water.
I advise you to bring sunscreen for the day and warm clothes for the night. If you order food at home, you should do it in advance and if you go by car, I hope it is not a small one so that you can go up from the main road to the glamping via an uncovered road.
I do not recommend the space to do remote work, during the day it is very hot inside the glamping and the sun is strong outside.

I recommend the sailboat ride, it is beautiful!

name: Glamping Store
review_1_text: It’s a really special place. Service is very good and the landscape is amazing. We choose this place because it’s pet friendly and our dog enjoyed the place a lot. We took the option to sail in the reservoir! It was spectacular!
review_2_text: Great host. I had lots of fun. I only stayed one night, but the host offered to take me hiking and parasailing on top of the stay. A very generous and incredible man. I would highly recommend! (plus it included a breakfast)! 💯
review_3_text: Beautiful place to stay 2 plus nights
review_4_text: Per friendly
review_5_text:
It was a very bittersweet experience, we made the reservation several days in advance and they told us to make the payment and they would schedule us, everything was fine, on the day of the reservation we still wrote to the owner to find out that everything was okay, the owner told us that there was no problem... When we arrived at the glamping, the owner told us that he could not receive us and that he had to send us to another glamping, which disappointed us quite a bit because although he was going to provide us with the services, it was not where we had planned... He took us by car to the other glamping, there they treated us super well, but I repeat, it was not what we hired... The owner gave us a sailboat ride as "compensation", the owner picked us up by car again, took us to the place but there were more people and they never informed us of this (it was supposed to be only my boyfriend, I and the owner of the sailboat), there were 2 more people, who although they were super friendly, it was uncomfortable at a certain point; Additionally, when we arrived at the sailboat, it was drizzling, and the owner was telling us that the tour wouldn't be possible and that he was sorry, but in a tone as if he wanted us to leave. In the end, the tour was possible, but we had to find our own way back to Guatavita. It wasn't a good experience, as we both thought the owner would take us back to town. Since the sailing location was quite far away, we had to pay an extra fee that wasn't included.

Another point was that we told the owner on Saturday that we wanted to go horseback riding on Sunday. He said it was no problem. On Sunday, when we asked, it turned out there weren't any horse providers in the area, which, according to sources, was a "no-show" request.

Overall, the good experience we had was at the other glamping site where we were provided service. Although they tried to fix the damage, it was a huge mistake, since they confirmed our reservation knowing they couldn't accommodate us.

Excelente lugar, buena atención, limpio y muy acogedor. La vista es increíble, volvería sin dudarlo.

review_1_text: Es un lugar súper lindo para relajarse, disfrutar en familia, hacer caminatas y conectar con la naturaleza, Doña Flor es muy atenta y amable, nos preparó un desayuno espectacular... Pola es sin duda un personaje que deben conocer. La pasamos muy bien, sin duda volveremos…
review_2_text:
Posada Agroturistica de la Region del Guavio (The water source of the city), Municipality of Gacheta Cundinamarca, we chose it to visit, rest, get out of the routine of the city and relax.

review_3_text: A very clean, quiet hotel, perfect for a family getaway. The staff are very friendly. The sauna and steam room are highly recommended.

review_1_text:
Camping spot close to the city however I do not recommend to stay here. The owner are not really friendly and seemed more annoyed by my arrival. Biggest issue with the dogs. I got attacked by five docs when I arrived and the docs were all around the Camping ground so you could not leave anything without watching. The dog even peed on my tent. When I was leaving the ground, I had a pin in my wheel.
And neighbours place is full of rubbish.
review_2_text: The place is very nice, it has clean bathrooms, a mirror, a shower, places to make a bonfire, they sell wood (cut) and even barbecue skewers, that saved our night. The next morning they offered us breakfast or it is very close to the town on foot. The service is very attentive, there are several modalities to stay (I didn't take room service but I saw a tree house, tents and mini cabins) or space to camp and it went very well for us. Thanks to the owners for their kindness.
review_3_text: Informationen in booking.com sehr fehlerhaft. Vor ort wurde mir ein teurerer preis angeboten als vorher besprochen. Habe mich betrogen gefühlt. Eigentlich ganz ok der campingplatz. Auch für längere aufenthalte. Aber bei diesem service würde ich davon abraten.
review_4_text: Excellent camping! One of the best we went to. A beautiful view with the reservoir in front, the land is very spacious, with a space to make a campfire and some benches for each tent. Very nice, clean bathrooms and hot showers. Highly recommended.
review_5_text: I loved the place and the people who run it ☺️ are very friendly.

name: Cabañas Finca las acacias
review_1_text: The cabins are beautiful, with a super nice view of the reservoir. They're very quiet and a five-minute walk from town. Lizeth and Laura are wonderful hosts. We had a problem with the bathroom, and they fixed it quickly. I'll definitely be back.
review_2_text: Excellent, definitely a place to disconnect, highly recommended! Good attitude in the service, close to the town, excellent view of the reservoir, delicious food and beautiful green areas
review_3_text: It's a very cozy place, with an excellent view and an unbeatable location close to Guatavita's main attractions. The price was as expected, and the service was excellent. I recommend it and would return.
review_4_text: Excellent place to get out of the routine, nice view, very pleasant and cozy. The managers are very attentive to everything you need. 10 out of 10.
review_5_text: It is a perfect cabin to spend a quiet time with your partner or family. The view is very beautiful and it is close to the town. Recommended

review_1_text: Cozy, pleasant, neat and very friendly Claudia who attended to us and made us feel at ease
review_2_text: No imagine que dormiria en una cabaña de madera en medio del campo. Llegue de noche, estaba de paso y pense que era una habitacion de hotel, comun y corriente, de las que vi en las fotos, pero no fue asi. Pero valio la pena, fue una experiencia distinta y a pesar de que fue el sitio mas frio que visite, en la cabaña y con sus cobijas, pudimos conseguir algo de calor.
review_3_text: Excellent Place. Perfect to connect with nature and de-stress, breathe clean air and be in a safe and quiet place. It is a pleasant place where the host strives to make you feel at home. Highly recommended.
review_4_text: It is a place 10 minutes from La Calera, and if you are going to go, take things to eat and drink at once. There are a couple of very, very basic stores, so it is better to bring things prepared to enjoy there.
