The landscapes are beautiful and there are several tourist places nearby to visit, I recommend going early.
review_2_text: The site has a unique view of the Gama Municipality, it looks like a small manger town. The rooms are warm and Carlos's attention is also unique. The charisma he has and the stories are quite a story. Highly recommended. And it has divine surveillance 🐶🐶🐶...
review_3_text: Very quiet and the landscape is phenomenal...
review_4_text: Excelente lugar, acampamos, amabilidad 100% de Don Carlos, un lugar muy agradable, volveremos con seguridad.
review_5_text: The best place to camp or stay in the Guavio registry office and its beautiful Gama town.

review_1_text: What a great place for recreation not far away from stinky Bogotá. The staff here is really nice, very friendly and they put a lot of love into the interior. The nature is beautiful, there is a lake and the air is the freshest I have breathed so far here in Colombia. The food in the restaurant was fantastic too btw.
review_2_text: A luxury getaway with the friendliest staff! They take care of all of your needs. The location is STUNNING. Not only do they offer gourmet foods, but they also offer beautiful nature hikes.
review_3_text: Fabulous food, view, and service. My 3 stars come from the fact we ordered the only red wine, Quinta Las Cabras Cabernet Sauvignon and they charged 22.000 pesos for a glass. The bottle costs 14.000 pesos at D1, the cheap chain supermarket. I complained and they refunded 1 of the 2 glasses we had. Still, at half price, it’s almost the same as the whole bottle. Oh, and they were mad at me, not embarrassed in the least. In the end I left with a sour feeling after a really great meal.
review_4_text: Food is great! I ordered San Antonio style ribs; they were amazing. Very tender and tasty.
review_5_text: Estacia San Antonio is a wonderful place to visit, offering great service and stunning views of the surrounding landscape.

review_1_text: Great place to enjoy with friends or family or to decompress outside of Bogota. Slept well with a great view of the water reserve. Service was excellent! Family owned and extremely friendly. It gets cold at night, pack extra layers and good socks. The almojabanas are delicious.  Fire wood was a little damp from the moisture in the environment, but they owners gave us more and we're extremely accommodating. Cristina the owner is great and always available if you have any questions. Highly recommend!
review_2_text: Disconnect from the city to connect with your family. Excellent place. Cristina and Andrés are the best hosts and the place is beautiful to go connect the furry ones. It is close to town to go eat lunch or dinner and the view is priceless.
review_3_text:
Es un lugar único, desde la atención al cliente, desde la estadía es cálida, su comida es exquisita y a eso agrégale un poco de formalidad o amor de familia todo un equipo de trabajo, el cual es familiar sus dueños, un ambiente para todo tipo de planes en familia solo en pareja en fin volvería sin duda

review_5_text: La atención por parte de los dueños es excelente. Su cercanía al pueblo lo hace muy cómodo para salir a caminar sin necesidad de carro. Quizás a nuestro gusto le haría falta un poco más de comodidad al baño, nosotros escogimos el glamping suizo

review_2_text: nice place, very quiet, beautiful view, for a perfect rest, delicious breakfast. Thank you, Mrs. Sindi, for your attention.
review_3_text: Es un lugar fantástico atreve a disfrutar.. excelente servicio

review_5_text: Muy lindo es un lugar muy agradable y tranquilo dónde puede uno disfrutar de la naturaleza me encantó

review_1_text:

🤗🤗🤗

Excelente lugar, excelente atención y sobretodo calidad humana de sus propietarios Francisco y Lourdes, además de su administradora Cecilia.

review_3_text: The attention, the cabins, the very cozy atmosphere, the hosts are the best, we feel at home, the fireplace makes the cabin magical, the sunset from the room and it is also close to the town, everything is beautiful, highly recommended, we had a great time, we will return very very soon.
review_4_text: The place is very cozy and comfortable and the kindness of the hosts makes you feel even more comfortable. They are cabins to rest and recharge energy with a very nice view of the reservoir.
review_5_text: It is a very cozy and comfortable place, the service is very good, they are located at the entrance to Guatavita, the only thing that may bother you is the noise of the cars at night, otherwise it is a place with quite a bit of privacy.

name: Dante Glamping
review_1_text:
This place is an absolute dream, after a few busy days in Bogota its exactly what me and my darling needed!

Peace and quiet with incredible views everywhere you look, you will not be disappointed!

The service provided Erik and his family is second to none, we felt welcome from the moment we arrived and they looked after all the details perfectly! We ate very well with breakfast included and meals priced very reasonably and very tasty..

To make things even better they have two beautiful dogs that are happy to hang out and make your stay even more enjoyable!

Highly recommend a stay at dante glamping, really was difficult or expensive to get to from Bogota without your own vehicle and relying on public transport!

Thank you so much for a wonderful time guys we loved every minute!! ❤
review_2_text: The best private and quiet place to rest. Pet friendly! You'll be surrounded by nature and a beautiful view of the Tominé dam waters with the Guatavita town in the far side. The hosts are very kind and respectful, and will always be there for anything you need. The cabin is cozy, has a hot water shower, a minibar, table games, an air heater, books, a water boiler and coffee to make whenever you want... and the best bed I have ever slept on. They will even light a campfire for you to enjoy some marshmallows under the stars. Included breakfast and delicious meals for dinner.
review_3_text:
First: do not trust Cabify or Uber. It is not a 70.000$ taxi ride from Bogota because it is outside the service area.

Taxi is about 200.000$ as a realistic price.

You can come with a cheap bus (Valle de tenza) up to Guasca and taxi from there.

The place is among the most romantic and beautiful scenery. You are by yourself in a bungalow, the fireplace burns, dinner is served. Worry free life. The are a hundred little thoughtful things that make the place special. (Wine glasses and Marshmallows for the fire are among them).

The hosts (Gloria,Erik) are among the most hospitable persons you can find in Colombia. They attented to us, helped us, got a good price on tours to Guatavita and Horseback.
review_4_text: Spectacular... we loved it, away from everything, you only experience peace and tranquility there. Very friendly people and Dante, excellent host
review_5_text: Es un lugar muy hermoso, tranquilo, privado, excelente atención y comida deliciosa hecha con amor. Tienen dos peluditos muy hermosos Dante y Kira que te acompañan y te cuidan. Además es Pet friendly, pudimos ir con nuestros perritos sin problema.

name: Hotel Villa Blanca Boutique & Spa
review_1_text: Nos encantó. El servicio fue súper atento. Nos dieron recomendaciones para hacer diferentes cosas en Guatavita. La comunicación fue súper rápida y efectiva. La habitación con balcón tiene una vista increíble. Un baño grande.
review_2_text: This hotel is perfect, the view is amazing, the rooms super clean and beautiful, the hosts are excellent, friendly and give great recommendations for activities and restaurants. Super recommended
review_3_text: The worst hotel in the world! They are irresponsible and scammers! I booked 1 month in advance, and 1 day before the date they canceled my reservation with absurd justifications and they didn't even apologize, instead of having notified me beforehand so I could have booked somewhere else on time, what a lack of respect! And after the fact they tried to charge me the cancellation fine. They are bold, shameless! I do not recommend the site at all, it is not reliable to book in a place where you do not know if they will feel like canceling suddenly and ruining all the plans. I hope they go bankrupt because they are unfortunate!
review_4_text: It is a perfect space to rest, the attention of the hosts 10 out of 10. The recommendations and activities were incredible 💜
review_5_text: Excellent place. I want to highlight the kindness of the hosts, I recommend the Balcony room, beautiful view

name: NATURE LUXURY GLAMPING
review_1_text: Buen lugar, faltaron mantas lo cual debería estar como un servicio adicional y disponible dentro del GLAMPING. En cuanto al desayuno no tienen variedad y sería muy bueno si la habitación la limpiaran y organizaran a diario ya que este servicio no lo ofrecieron.
review_2_text: Excellent place to rest and disconnect from everyday life. Super service. Very friendly and attentive hosts.
review_3_text: Me encantó el lugar y el servicio! La vista es inmejorable y cada detalle está pensado para hacer de la estadía, una memorable.
review_4_text: We loved the place, incredible peace and its hosts put a lot of love into what they do. The delicious food.
review_5_text: This weekend we were in Guatavita Cundinamarca, we stayed at glampimg Glamping natura and the truth is 100% recommended and to my friends and family ☺️… the attention, the quality of the food, the glamping and the view it had 😎 without car noises and absolute peace... 100% recommended for you to go 🏕

name: Camping San Francisco - Guatavita
opening_hours: Monday: 6:00 – 10:00 PM|Tuesday: 6:00 – 10:00 PM|Wednesday: 6:00 – 10:00 PM|Thursday: 6:00 – 10:00 PM|Friday: 6:00 – 11:00 PM|Saturday: 9:30 AM – 9:00 PM|Sunday: 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM
review_1_text: Super nice place to camp 🏕 and spend a great time with your pets. We climbed the Cerrillo mount, tough hike, but awesome rewarding views. Recommended.
review_2_text: We stayed with our van Don Pablo and his family are simply the best! Great amenities, views, and company. Very peaceful.
review_3_text: It is a good place to camp if you go during the week, the weekend depends on the people who go, there are noisy people and others who are calmer, there is no clear regulation on this and it depends on common sense, which is sometimes the least common of the senses.  It has a large flat area, with some undulations from planting done in the past, but you can find a good place, especially for floor tents.  The bathrooms were always clean even though there were people and the showers were very clean, with hot water.  They have a small store with basic products to have a pleasant time.  The access road is for passing slowly but even small cars can access it.
review_4_text: A place of total relaxation, nature, landscape, perfect for camping, excellent service, safe place and has services such as toilets, shower, restaurant, store in the middle of the mountain. Beautiful.
review_5_text: The place is beautiful, the view is spectacular, but the service is bad, we went because it appeared open on Google and they didn't respond to us, we had to go somewhere else

name: HOSPEDAJE Y GLAMPING CASA BLANCA
review_1_text: We loved this place! It’s quiet and out of the way. The hosts we kind and very hospitable. Dinner (fish) was fantastic! We hope to return again and visit this beautiful place and family!
review_2_text: The truth is, the photos and publications of the place are very different, there is no variety of food, if you arrive after 7 pm at the place they will only offer you very basic fast food, for breakfast (which according to them is included in the plan) they will only offer you eggs because if you order broth or something else it is additional and is not a pleasure for the very expensive price that we have to pay, and to top it off the fruit that arrived tasted like onion, which leaves a lot to think about cross contamination and hygiene practices when cooking... I don't know if It was a Booking error. But when the reservation was made they offered a jacuzzi, an advance had to be made and when the consignment was made they informed that there was no longer a jacuzzi, they charged a lot for a decoration and the truth was super basic, only about 5 balloons stuck in the glamping and the rest just petals (very expensive and you have to pay for it separately from the room). The truth is that it is very expensive for the attention they give and what they offer.
review_3_text: Excellent place to rest and enjoy an excellent evening.
review_4_text: Felicitaciones 🥳 super lindo lo recomiendo 👌🥰
review_5_text: Fue muy fácil de llegar a través de google maps, está a 10 minutos del pueblo de Guatavita y a 4 minutos de la atracción de la casa loca. Un lugar muy tranquilo, bonito,  camas y bedding muy confortable. Muy atentos a todos tus requerimientos.

Highly recommended
review_3_text:

Recommended!
review_4_text: Excelente servicio, cabañas muy cómodas y acojedoras, Totalmente recomendado

review_1_text: El hotel es bueno y tiene habitaciones cómodas, sin embargo en noche de sábado 01 de marzo hubo una muy ruidosa fiesta hasta la madrugada impidiendo dormír a huéspedes. Si eso es frecuente, no recomendable. El pueblo es tranquilo.
review_2_text: Zero privacy, the curtains don't cover the windows well and you could see from one bathroom to the other, the service is terrible, more than a week to get them to send me the electronic invoice, they also have a nightclub on the first floor
review_3_text: We stayed the night of March 22. Impossible to rest. The noise from the nearby nightclub/bar lasted until after midnight.
review_4_text: Very friendly, good location, excellent cleanliness, expensive for the location
review_5_text:
Je ne recommande pas cet hotel. Bookez autre part (à Zipaquera par exemple). Dans la chambre, pas d’eau chaude et lits inconfortables…
Nous avons reservé une nuit avec Booking et arrivés devant l’hotel a 21h, les grilles étaient fermées et personne ne répondait au téléphone. Après une heure d’attente un voisin nous a ouvert la grille et a réveillé la personne de l’accueil qui nous a accueilli de manière très désagréable. Le check-in était horriblement long.

name: Ecocabana Piemonte
review_1_text: Excelente ubicación, a 15 min caminando del pueblo. Desde el lugar se alcanza a ver un poco el Embalse de Tominé. Maravillosa atención, todes muy amables. Un lugar maravilloso para compartir en pareja, amigos o incluso en soledad, con vistas y espacios increíbles. Te ofrecen juegos, libros, música. La mejor opción para pernoctar en Guasca.
review_2_text: El lugar es hermoso y los hosts son muy amables, recomendado 💕
review_3_text: Excelente atención un lugar campestre y acogedor

name: ALTOZANO CABAÑAS
review_1_text: Great place to stay in a quiet place over the hills of Guatavita.
review_2_text: Fantastic
review_3_text:
Una experiencia increíble en Altozano Cabañas. Desde el primer momento, el equipo fue sumamente amable y atento, asegurándose de que tuviéramos todo lo necesario para una estadía perfecta. La amabilidad del personal es definitivamente uno de sus puntos más fuertes, siempre dispuestos a ayudar en lo que necesites. Incluso nos consiguieron una guitarra para entretenernos, un detalle que habla de su excelente servicio.

Las cabañas son hermosas, acogedoras y bien equipadas, perfectas para desconectarse y relajarse. El desayuno fue excelente, con opciones deliciosas y bien preparadas. Además, ofrecen planes extra para disfrutar aún más la experiencia, lo que hace que la estadía sea aún más especial.

Definitivamente volveremos. ¡100% recomendado!
review_4_text: An excellent place to rest
review_5_text: Excelente lugar ,buena ubicación, la atención Excelente, nos gusto todo

name: Glamping & Cabaña San Martin Guatavita
opening_hours: Monday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM|Tuesday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM|Wednesday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM|Thursday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM|Friday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM|Saturday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM|Sunday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
review_1_text: Super
review_2_text:
Mi esposa y yo pasamos un fin de semana espacial, si espacial, del otro mundo. Si quieres escuchar el silencio este es el lugar, un sitio espectacular, la cabaña tiene un balcón desde donde observas el lago y la ladera de la montaña, no le quitaría ni le pondría nada, simplemente espectacular. Limpia , agradable, impecable, cobijas, agua caliente, juegos de mesa, si deseas puedes solicitar servicio de leña, caminatas, motos cuatro ruedas, caballos y ellos amablemente la suministran con un costo adicional, ,  La atención de la señora Patricia de primera, te hace
sentir en casa. El desayuno lo acuerdas a una hora y no tienes que preocuparte a esa hora lo tienes, impecablemente servido, caliente. Puedes solicitar otras comidas si lo deseas a muy buenos precios. De Bogotá nos tardamos hora y media vía la Calera, la carretera muy buena. Y el sitio queda a media hora del pueblo de Guatavita lo que permite ir al pueblo a dar una vuelta conocer  y tener una estadía aún más cómoda. Volveremos con toda seguridad. Recomendadisimo.
Saludos y muchos éxitos.
review_3_text:
Excellent place for a wonderful rest, ideal customer service, impeccable cleaning conditions and care in every detail.
The cabins are wonderful, with everything you need for comfort.
The food is delicious!👌

Grateful to Mrs Yaneris and her family for their collaboration.
Patricia with excellent service, thanks to the entire team 🥰
review_4_text: Excellent view, impeccable service from the owner and her family, very good food and above all the tranquility, priceless. It has additional services such as a bonfire, which is worth it, horseback riding or paragliding. The weather is cold, but we didn't need to use the heater because we had enough with the 3 blankets on the bed. The bed is very comfortable! Breakfast is American type, very good and hygienically packaged. We will definitely be back!
review_5_text: Very comfortable, the cabin is quite cozy, they leave a water heater and a speaker, the bed is very comfortable and you don't feel cold, they also leave several blankets, the shower didn't heat very well, and without a doubt the best thing is the view, the landscape of the mountains, the reservoir and the town in front is great. There is a restaurant nearby, very cozy although somewhat expensive.

name: Hospedaje Gratitud Guatavita
review_1_text: Wonderful place...I felt at home...bonfire night, masmelos and wine...the cabin is comfortable...very familiar...Diana and David are wonderful hosts, very attentive to what we needed and excellent people...very good weekend...we will return without hesitation
review_2_text:
Beautiful cabin outside of Guatavita, but you can walk to the urban area.
The hosts are great; warm and attentive.
The space is very comfortable and the view incredible.
review_3_text: The place is quiet, excellent, it has a very good view, well equipped, the beds are very comfortable, there is a fireplace, you can play music, there is hot water, ample space to park and also have a barbecue. I would definitely return
review_4_text: Everything very nice and pleasant, more than we expected 🤍

name: Hotel Albergue el Refugio
review_1_text: A bit expensive for what they give you. It was 96K pesos. Bed is rock hard. Wifi only works in the lobby. No fan for the stuffy room. First night was ok. Second day a pool party got started at 12 noon. Despite the town having no electricity the music was VERY loud. When it got dark they started a very loud generator in the lobby so they could continue the party. It lasted until 2 a.m. and was impossible to sleep. Be sure to ask them if there are any parties planned.
review_2_text: Due to limited internet connectivity we couldn't reserve a room in advance but they found a room for is anyways. The staff is very helpful and friendly. The road to Tierradentro is quite good and mostly paved.
review_3_text: The worst place i have ever stayed!!! AVOID AT ALL COSTS. Does not deserve the name hotel - rather is actual hell. Impossible to contact in advance. Staff / family who run it cannot speak english. staff is extremely unfriendly and unhelpful. hotel is the ugliest & dirtiest i have ever seen. Bugs in the bathroom, stains on bedsheets, no hot water, no wifi literally hell on earth. Would rather sleep in my car, ended up leaving the same night as it was so horrible. Please please please respect yourself enough to not go
review_4_text: A little bit expensive
review_5_text: Needs urgently renovation

name: Hospedaje Tierradentro & Tienda Ricos Jugos
opening_hours: Monday: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Tuesday: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Wednesday: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Thursday: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Friday: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Saturday: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM|Sunday: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM
review_1_text:
Good place in front of the park, so practical...
Rooms are basic and small but cheap and clean.
We got offered an upgrade to a bigger room the second night.
They helped with organizing public transport from and to la plata.
We recommend the hotel and the park although it takes time to get there
review_2_text:
The perfect place to stay near the entrance of the archeological park. The owners are very friendly and helpful. They have contacts with local transport and kindly helped us organize our travel to Popayán.
The juice shop served a nice breakfast and the most delicious juice - especially the combination of lulo & limon👌
Thank you for everything!
review_3_text:
Nice cozy rooms with hot shower.
It is perfectly situated right next to the park entrance.
There is only one restaurant y the close area. If you want more you need to walk to the town (San Andrés de Pisimbalá) which will take 20-25 minutos.

The host is really nice and helps you organise transport if needed.

The fruit juices are really good! :)
review_4_text: Friendly people, they have rooms with private bathroom with hot water. You can fill your water bottles at the filter installation in the kitchen (bottled water is relatively expensive in the village, and you'll need a bit to hike up to alto de aguacate!) They serve breakfast, but for dinner and lunch you'll need to make reservations at the restaurant 100m up the road, or go to the village.
review_5_text: Small rooms with private bathroom and hot water! Very hospitable and friendly owner who was always ready to help. Breakfast was delicious. And just loved the whole area! Best place to stay!

name: Majestic Coffee Hotel And Restaurant
opening_hours: Monday: 8:00 AM – 8:30 PM|Tuesday: 8:00 AM – 8:30 PM|Wednesday: 8:00 AM – 8:30 PM|Thursday: 8:00 AM – 8:30 PM|Friday: 8:00 AM – 8:30 PM|Saturday: 8:00 AM – 8:30 PM|Sunday: 8:00 AM – 8:30 PM
review_1_text: Beautifully located small family hotel (4th generation) in one of the most naturally peaceful settings we’ve ever been in. Our sizable room had a huge picture window that opened to a bamboo forest filled with tropical plants, birds, nature. The room itself is charming, with private bath, instant hot water for the shower (a little tricky to use, but if you turn the faucet slowly the water becomes nice and warm), and comfortable new mattress, sheets and pillows. We ate fresh trout dinner here one night and it was delicious. Very friendly owners. Great made to order breakfast. A lovely and unique setting that you will not find anywhere else. Muchas gracias!!
review_2_text:
The hotel owners gave us a warm welcome and a tour of their beautiful garden, explaining the different types of vegetation that grow in the area.

Would definitely recommend staying here!
review_3_text:
Best lodge hotel experience.
We were very well received. The owner even stopped our transport so that we could get off right in front of his house.
We were able to discover its beautiful garden.
The kitchen is very good. My partner unfortunately had a little indigestion and Aristide suggested a herbal solution, we stayed a little longer to rest. I will definitely go back!!
The breakfast is also very good!
review_4_text: It is a spectacular place, the experience in the sector was excellent, both in this hotel where everything is absolutely beautiful, and the service is excellent, and in the park and in the other businesses. Its unique facilities and landscapes, along with the ecological tourism offer made the difference.
review_5_text:
Au cœur d'un cadre paradisiaque , l'hôtel Majestic se distingue par son accueil des plus chaleureux et serviable, orchestré par Francy et son frère Aristide. Leur hospitalité authentique et attentive est l'une des nombreuses raisons pour lesquelles cet établissement mérite amplement ses éloges. Dès l'aube, Francy n'a pas hésité à nous préparer un petit-déjeuner copieux à 5h30 du matin pour que nous puissions partir avec notre guide aux premières lueurs du jour – un geste aussi rare qu'apprécié.

Les installations de l'hôtel, modernes et bien entretenues, ajoutent au confort du séjour. Les chambres, vastes et lumineuses, offrent un espace généreux pour se détendre, tandis que les salles de bain, d'une propreté irréprochable, sont un véritable plaisir à utiliser après une journée d'exploration.

En outre, la situation géographique de l'hôtel est idéale pour les amateurs de culture et d'histoire, offrant un accès facile aux principaux sites archéologiques de la région. Que ce soit pour un court séjour ou une escapade prolongée, l'hôtel Majestic est un choix parfait pour ceux qui recherchent à la fois confort, commodité, et un accueil inoubliable.

name: Hospedaje Tia Maria
review_1_text: It was difficult to book online these local hotels so we took a chance. 3 full capacities later, we were recommended to this spot. They were super accommodating, really went out of their way, and it is all you need for a night’s rest. Clean sheets, clean towels, hot water … I would highly recommend !!!! Believe they are 1/2 the price of the other spots.
review_2_text:
Excellent welcome and friendliness from Maria and her family.
Rooms with private bathrooms available.
Small shops and simple restaurants nearby.
A 5-minute walk from the archaeological site.
Often unreachable by phone, go directly to the site.
During the low tourist season, you'll always find a room. Otherwise, neighboring hotels have some. Here, everyone knows each other and helps each other out.
review_3_text: I stayed there a long time ago with my family, it is very simple but very pleasant, Mrs. Maria is a very attentive and kind person. I hope to return soon
review_4_text: A typical hospedaje, at an unbeatable price. A good welcome with some explanations about the surroundings. The room with clean bathroom and hot water. Small negative point the room overlooking the street with a lot of noise during the night (motorcycles, cars, animals, people)... even in the countryside there is always life in Colombia.
review_5_text: Maria is very friendly, the place is simple and very affordable. I really liked it, and they made me feel very welcome during my stay.

name: Restaurante Hostal La Posada
review_1_text: Like others in the region, its services are basic. Its amenities are minimal, perfect for those who are undemanding and just want a place to sleep. It's best to eat out, as there's no breakfast if you get up early, nor is there any lunch. The service is good, but they can forget you're a guest and don't give you a copy of your room key to charge; there's only one, which is best left at the hotel, as it's very reliable and safe.
review_2_text: Nice hotel, great rooms, and good food in the town, very close and well connected to the coffee park.
review_3_text: Typical food from the area, recommended above all for the pleasant service.
review_4_text: The place is cozy and has a good location.
review_5_text: Good, very calm environment

name: Hostal Casa Verde
review_1_text: A safe, comfortable and economical place!

name: La Portada en Tierradentro Restaurante y Hospedaje
opening_hours: Monday: 8:00 AM – 7:00 PM|Tuesday: 8:00 AM – 7:00 PM|Wednesday: 8:00 AM – 7:00 PM|Thursday: 8:00 AM – 7:00 PM|Friday: 8:00 AM – 7:00 PM|Saturday: 8:00 AM – 7:00 PM|Sunday: 8:00 AM – 7:00 PM
review_1_text: Good food for a great price, good service, the staff are friendly and welcoming. Simple menu but food and juices are fresh. There are only two restaurants in town and this one is definitely the best! Breakfast was $11,000 and lunch was $20,000 but came with soup, salad, rice, beans, porkchop and fresh juice.
review_2_text:
A mum and dad run restaurant & accommodation. They only speak Spanish but we were able to communicate. Food is excellent, 20,000COP for lunch or dinner meal. They even had wine in stock. Showers hot, bed comfortable. This is a remote location that was difficult to get to but made so much better by the warm hospitality received from the owners on our arrival. Waking up to views of the hills and birds chirping was bliss.
Location is in the middle of the Tierradentro UNESCO listed park. For us it was worth the travel to get to and one of our highlights of our trip so far.
review_3_text: La Portada is a special inn situated in a quiet but vibrant rural community. The rooms are simple and straightforward and there are nice outdoor areas for relaxing. We spent 3 wonderful nights there while visiting the UNESCO archaeological sites in the surrounding area. Our hosts, Leonardo and Eva María are genuine and warm and are committed to providing their visitors an authentic visit. Leonardo was a fantastic guide to all of the sites for 2 entire days. We ate all of our meals in the restaurant. María Eva’s food is terrifically fresh and tasty including homemade breads and jams. We highly recommend staying here and wish we could return again.
review_4_text: We stayed here for 5 days because of car problems. Eva and Leonardo made us feel at home immediately and are very hospitable people. The rooms are very clean and the beds are good. The food Eva cooks is amazing!!! Fresh every day with lots of vegetables. Try the Jugo Mora (best we tried). Definitely one of the best places we ate local food  in Colombia! Leonardo is also very helpful as he helped us contact mechanics and helped us relax when the problems kept extending. Highly Recommend this place!!!
review_5_text: Lovely place to go and explore the Tombs. Very good food, feels like you are at your grandmas place. If in San Andres, stay here. Leonardo is very helpful with what to do.

name: Hospedaje RICABET
review_1_text: The nicest of people in this moderate lodge.
review_2_text: Before my favorite lodging, very friendly, very welcoming! Absolutely recommended! Simple pieces, but absolutely clean. Comfortable prices.
review_3_text: A very nice place, clean and with super service from Doña Ángela, in this area you can easily find accommodation and food.
review_4_text: Excelente lugar para pasar la noche , muy económico.
review_5_text: Excellent place, very quiet and very cozy

name: Ecohotel Semilla y Vida
review_1_text: Amazing place for relax and enjoy the nature.
review_2_text: A magical and welcoming place, the people have a unique human warmth, comfortable, comfortable and clean rooms, homemade and delicious food, it is close to the Tierradentro archaeological park. We traveled by motorcycle from Medellín, on the way we lost our documents in a town called Totoró, a person kept them for us and gave them to us, demonstrating the principles and values ​​of an indigenous community that has made history. For its part, Semilla y vida is a place to disconnect from routine and connect with nature. Very grateful for receiving us so well, a thousand blessings. We will definitely return.
review_3_text: Excellent accommodation, family warmth. I was staying there for work but they made me feel at home, this is a hidden paradise where you can enjoy nature, and hidden treasures from your ancestors.
review_4_text:
Excellent service and attention. They are wonderful people. They offer food service.
I recommend using Google Maps to get there instead of Waze, as the location is somewhat remote and Waze doesn't have updated routes. It was 100% worth it.
On clear nights, you can see the starry sky.
review_5_text: It's a wonderful place, in touch with nature, with excellent service. The best place to share with family or as a couple.

review_2_text: Ok
review_3_text: I can't comment on the hotel or the staff, I made a reservation on Booking, I was traveling with my baby and my husband, Booking said it had private parking and I made the reservation, we arrived at 11 pm with the peace of mind of having a reservation because we were only passing through, but when we arrived the reality was that there was no private parking. At that time we had to look for another hotel but on Booking they say they have private parking but when we called 3 or 4 they didn't have them.
review_4_text: En una habitación para dos personas nos brindaron solo una toalla, un solo jabón y cero cobija (solo contábamos con el cobertor de la cama, tuvimos que pedir cobija adicional en medio de la noche). La habitación contaba con un tomacorriente a más de dos metros de altura, al lado del televisor y dos en el baño, al lado del lavamanos. El timbre del hotel es elevado y sonó mucho durante la noche
review_5_text: Comfortable and clean rooms, without humidity, comfortable and clean mattresses. Clean sheets and blankets, good lighting inside and outside the rooms, comfortable common areas, clean showers and bathrooms, 40-inch televisions, furniture to accommodate clothes, it is quiet without noise, to rest, excellent service. They offer coffee to guests, comfortable prices and an excellent location three blocks from Caldas Park in the heart of Popayan.

review_1_text: Went with my wife in August ‘22 and always meant to leave a review, great for a quiet getaway … check out the termales, there are these small fish that almost immediately start softly plucking for dead skin … walk around town … we had a funny tour guide: a stray mother dog that lives at the hotel led us all around one afternoon

It's a nice place located in the middle of a wonderful landscape... However, its restaurant has a poor menu, they should offer traditional foodo or something that represents the local culture.
The Hotel really recommended.
review_3_text: Amazing. I stayed in Comfandi and it was the best deposition because they have everything week scheduled. Salinas, Aguas tibias and Aguas Calientes. The place is excellent. They offer breakfast, lunch and dinner all included.
review_4_text: A wonderful place. The natural beauty of the setting and the thermal springs and pools close by are incredible.
review_5_text: Nice place for a weekend,  even one week

Maybe you should have responded, thanks for reporting, we will improve this part. Or something like that.

Cozy place, place to store the vehicle, and even more so if it is an NHR type vehicle because it is barred without a roof, which allows the vehicle to pass through since, due to its size, in many places it is difficult to store this type of vehicle. Finally, in terms of budget, it is very affordable (economical).
review_4_text: Me encantó y lo mejor me dejaron estar con mi mascota ella es bien portada y no molesta, ellos confiaron en nosotros y de verdad mil gracias
review_5_text: Un lugar aseado, un buen trato del personal pero demasiado ruido en la noche y cama incomoda.

opening_hours: Monday: Open 24 hours|Tuesday: Open 24 hours|Wednesday: Open 24 hours|Thursday: Open 24 hours|Friday: Open 24 hours|Saturday: Open 24 hours|Sunday: Open 24 hours
review_1_text:
I would like to recommend this hostel to you. The people who "work" there are as colorful as the walls. We have been traveling for 2 years and this was definitely the only hostel where I felt 100% like home from the first minute. The staff are always ready to help with anything and it never felt like we were starting to get on anyone's nerves. Thank you for everything. You are great.
We had a late checkIn after 11PM, no problem. The communication before we arrived was great. The hostel is within the old part with everything you need surrounded.
review_2_text: Good location, fun rooms with interesting art. Helpful staff. Not the most social hostel, breakfast is free but very basic
review_3_text:
The guy on the reception was really nice and friendly but he was just a volunteer in the hostel. But for all the rest I am really disappointed in the hostel. The rooms and the bathroom weren’t clean at all but the worse was the kitchen. There were cockroaches all over the kitchen big ones small ones and nobody cared.
I planed to stay longer but I had to change the hostel after one night…
review_4_text: I really enjoyed my stay at Lienzo Hostel. The staff are wonderful and helpful. They will help you arrange tours at reasonable cost. There is an overlook just a few blocks away to watch sunsets too. And unlike some fancy places in Popayán this hostel actually has hot water for showers!
review_5_text: Must be all the lonely planet readers that give this place great reviews, feeling like they need to sell and say everything is amazing. Why not just say it how it is. Yes the staff are friendly, the location is good, but the place is a dump. Rooms stink of smoke, beds are poor quality with old sheets, the bathrooms and kitchen are disgusting and even tho they have tried to be funky with the decor, it's of poor quality and there are paint splashes all over the floors. review_4_text:
I recently had the pleasure of staying at Hotel Encanto in the heart of Popayán, Colombia, and it was a truly delightful experience. From the moment I stepped through the doors, I was struck by the hotel's modern and elegant design. The minimalist decor creates a serene and stylish ambiance, perfectly blending contemporary aesthetics with a touch of sophistication.

The rooms are beautifully appointed, with sleek furniture and thoughtful touches that enhance the overall comfort. Everything felt brand new and meticulously maintained, making it easy to relax and unwind after a day of exploring the charming city of Popayán.

What truly sets Hotel Encanto apart, however, is the exceptional service provided by the staff. Every member of the team was incredibly courteous and kind, always going above and beyond to ensure my stay was perfect. Their genuine warmth and attentiveness made me feel welcome and well-cared for throughout my visit.

Located in the city center, Hotel Encanto offers convenient access to Popayán's historic sites, restaurants, and shops, making it an ideal choice for both leisure and business travelers. I wholeheartedly recommend Hotel Encanto to anyone looking for a blend of modern luxury and heartfelt hospitality in Popayán.

Luisa is a great girl! She deserves the best with his Soo cute son! Ciao Niño ❤️

review_2_text:
My motorbike got stolen directly in front of the hostel at bright daylight, even though i was told it’s okay to park it there for a few hours as long as I later park it inside (didn’t want to block the hallway). The woman and staff - excluding the manager, see below - were very nice. But at the time of the theft the lady didn’t have data on her phone nor was there a landline. Finally managed to get the number of the Police who arrived 1 hour later and didn’t do much.

I was able to buy the motorbike back from the thieves a few days later… 🤨  >>The woman in the other review got it wrong, the negotiations were NOT done through  this hostel, as I checked out the next day and went to a hostel that seemed to have a better understanding of helping me with this matter.

Without the stolen motorbike I would have given 4 stars, nice little place, good beds. But this info given was dangerously careless. Later, by other people, I was later told this area has a very high crime rate, so stuff gets stolen there all the time. Met some Italians who got their earphones stolen the same day in a cafe in the same area.

**Edit, as reply to the owners reply:
1. I didn’t have any bags on the bike, they were all in my room. The installed case on my bike, yes. But that can’t be removed.
2. Saying that I left my bags on the bike highlights that you weren’t there yourself. If you weren’t there all the time, how can you call me a liar &  be so sure what the woman said and didn’t say?
3. If she had told me that it COULD be dangerous and there is a chance the bike can get stolen, I would have put the bike inside, which I had planned for when it was getting dark anyway, I didn’t want to block the reception with my bike in front of it
4. This guy has an extremely rude way of replying to negative reviews, check his other replies. Not a good tactic to receive more customers.

review_5_text:
Came to the restaurant of Camino Real after reading about it in Lonely Planet and receiving a Rec from a Colombian friend in Cali.

I’m short: incredibly Disappointing! The food wasn’t good, the service wasn’t good, and the ambiance was stuffy and outdated.

The restaurant was empty except for three tables at 7:30pm on a Wednesday. The decor is going for a traditional/antique vibe with tons of interesting eclectic pieces serving as decorations (old irons, old posters, etc) but with the emptiness and stuffiness of the staff, it didn’t feel charming, but instead fell flat and outdated.

We ordered two different menus, each with a price of 60,000 COP. This was my most expensive meal in my three weeks in Colombia, and the worst. My courses included: the shrimp ravioli, asparagus salad, palate cleansing lulo “sherbet”, beef in wine sauce, cheese plate, and apple dessert.

I don’t eat much seafood, but the ravioli were actually made from the shrimp being butterflies open and stuffed with mint/onion and the plate was smothered with a butter sauce. The shrimp tasted tough and over cooked and I couldn’t taste anything but butter. The asparagus salad was a bed of ice berg, pickled white asparagus and an acidic unknown dressing. I do not like pickled asparagus or white asparagus very much, so it was a miss for me and flavorless. My dining partner’s second course was a trout that tasted very fishy and was underwhelming as well. My course didn’t seem up to par with her “main dish” next course, even though her tasting menu was the same price. The beef with wine sauce was nice, though the meat was a bit undercooked. I ordered medium rAre, but my meat was quite red throughout. The same was true for the pepper steak dish ordered by my dining companion. The steak was served with a side salad - the same iceberg lettuce, acidic unknown dressing, mango and green beans. Bland and boring. The other side was a small boiled potato with some herbs on top. Again, bland and boring.

Our desserts were no less disappointing. My dining companion ordered the Eduardo santos, a traditional dessert made with condensed milk and various fruits. It came out frozen like a Mexican-style popsicle and was difficult to eat, but not bad. The apple dessert I ordered was not only disgustingly sweet (it is made with puff pastries from the region that are coated intensely in sugar), but the apples that came on top didn’t even have the skin cut off and were flavored with a cinnamon that tasted like red hots. Not what you want in a dessert!

The restaurant didn’t offer us a drink
Menú - the waiter said it “isn’t complete”. They also don’t serve wine by the glass. At a restaurant that has won culinary awards?! Strange.

Finally, our waiter was attentive, but never once asked us if we were enjoying our meal or how the food was. Very strange since he was peering at us in the empty restaurant for the majority of our meal.

Overall, I recommend you don’t waste your money here. You can eat so much better in Colombia and for much cheaper. There’s a reason they won their culinary awards 30 years ago. Avoid!

review_1_text:
I had the pleasure of visiting the Observatorio Astronómico José de Caldas in Popayán, Cauca, and it exceeded all my expectations. The setting is absolutely stunning—peaceful and surrounded by beautiful nature, it feels like a perfect escape from the world. The observatory offers a fantastic opportunity to explore the beauty of the night sky in an intimate and tranquil atmosphere.

The rooms in the hostel were very simple but clean and comfortable, providing everything you need for a relaxing and enjoyable stay.

The hosts are incredibly kind and knowledgeable, making the experience not only educational but also very enjoyable. You can truly feel their love for what they do, and it’s contagious! A must-visit for anyone who appreciates nature, science, or simply a unique adventure under the stars.
review_2_text: I absolutely loved this experience! Learning about the rich history of astronomy through a Colombian perspective and the legacy of Francisco José de Caldas was so fascinating. On top of that, discovering more about sustainable agriculture and organic-based products was such a unique and rewarding touch. The interpreters were amazing and made everything so engaging. Plus, waking up to a gorgeous sunrise with birds singing was just magical. I highly recommend it to anyone visiting and encourage people to check out their Workaway page for incredible opportunities to volunteer, especially in aerospace projects. I can’t wait to see what they have planned for 2025!
review_3_text: This place is a construction that is born from perseverance and love, a place that invites you to rest and disconnect, my only observation is that please improve the cleanliness, I value the treatment and service of Mrs. Patricia and her staff, they have been very attentive, I had a very good rest. Thank you.
review_4_text:
Beautiful place with lots of nature and very friendly people.
Furthermore, I really like that it is a focus of research and would make visible many initiatives in the region, places like these definitely need to be supported :D, I hope to return soon.

review_1_text:
Such a nice place! We stayed there for a few nights after staying in Popayan for 3 weeks and it's absolutely stunning.
The owners are a welcoming family and the food is very good. We made homemade pizza, milked the cows, rode and fed the horses and fetched eggs. The waterfall is beautiful and the walk there is enjoyable. I absolutely recommend staying here.
review_2_text:
A beautiful, sustainable countryside heaven - you can do a 40min hike to a waterfall through three different types of forrest, milk the cows, learn how to make cheese, eat fresh vegetables from the 'huerta', watch colorful birds and hummingbirds. The hosts will make you feel like you are part of the family and will cook the most delicious meals.
They have built the house with the Guadua (colombian bamboo like tree) they planted 20 years ago which is replaced each time a tree is taken - everything about this place is trully sustainable: the food waste is used to feed the animals or for compost, they have created a water cleaning system, they plant their food. You can learn about their story and how they do things (Carlos might even teach you how to build).
Beware that you might not want to leave.

Room prices appear to be reasonable, with both air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned options. However, it is important to note that a surcharge is charged for the use of the pool, which may influence the total cost of the stay.

A positive feature is that the hotel owner is described as friendly, which can add a personal and welcoming touch to the guest experience, which I have personally experienced.

In summary, the Hotel El Paraíso in Taminango offers an attractive environment for a vacation, but could improve in aspects such as water quality, customer service and internet service. With proper attention to these details, it could become an even more attractive location for travelers looking to enjoy the region's natural beauty. Review: Out of the places we saw this was by far the best looking building. A super plus is the fact that they have a parking area which I highly recommend if you have a vehicle. Service was friendly and rooms were clean.

Honestly, we won't return that's why the service is terrible.

The owner, who is the same person who serves, for being the owner, seemed very uninterested, she even said that the girl from the bathroom was the only one who had entered the room, when she had also entered. I don't know, but I'll leave it there!

review_1_text:
Manhattan Hotel Review:

The Manhattan Hotel offers a mixed experience that is influenced by several aspects, both positive and negative. Located in a prime area, its convenient location provides easy access to various local attractions and nearby services, making it an attractive option for visitors.

In terms of facilities, the hotel mostly offers a pleasant and comfortable environment. The rooms are well-equipped and offer satisfactory amenities for a pleasant stay. However, one negative point to highlight is the narrow size of the bathroom, which may be uncomfortable for some guests.

Unfortunately, my experience was marred by the lack of human warmth and the unacceptable attitude of the staff. It is worrying to find homophobic and rude behavior by some staff towards certain guests. This type of behavior is not only unacceptable, but it also negatively impacts the overall guest experience and damages the hotel's reputation.

In summary, Hotel Manhattan offers satisfactory facilities and a convenient location, but the lack of hospitality and discriminatory attitude of the staff are issues that urgently need to be addressed. It is essential that the hotel promotes a welcoming and respectful environment for all guests, without exception, to ensure a positive and satisfying experience for all its visitors.

name: Hotel Riviera Confort
review_1_text:
What a great pleasure staying at Hotel Riviera Comfort for an entire month with my dog, and I can confidently say it was an incredible experience! From the moment I arrived, the staff went above and beyond to ensure my comfort. They were always friendly and accommodating, making me feel right at home.

The hotel is exceptionally clean, and my room was tidied every day with fresh towels, which I really appreciated. The Wi-Fi was fantastic, allowing me to stay connected easily. One of the highlights was the free coffee available in the lobby, which is a great perk to start the day.

The location is perfect, with a top-notch restaurant just around the corner offering delicious meals. I also enjoyed the rooftop area, which is a lovely spot to relax. The laundry service was a lifesaver, and having the option for restaurant deliveries in the evening made my stay even more convenient.

Security is a priority here, with cameras throughout the property, and I felt safe at all times. They also have a parking garage where I was able to store my motorcycle and trailer free of charge. It's clear that the owner takes great pride in this hotel, and it shows in the quality of service.

Overall, the price for what you get is excellent. I can't thank the two wonderful women working here enough for their pleasant and cheerful demeanor. If you're looking for a comfortable and secure place to stay, Hotel Riviera Comfort is the perfect choice. Highly recommend!

For more details, check out their website!

Thank you for an incredible stay in Pasto!!!

review_5_text: The rooms are very clean, the receptionists are super friendly, the price is good and the location is acceptable.

For tourists it has excellent places in terms of restaurants and resting places. Thank you Carlos and Eliza for your attention to my parents, they were happy.

name: Casa Colibri Pasto
opening_hours: Monday: 7:00 AM – 7:30 PM|Tuesday: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Wednesday: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Thursday: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Friday: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Saturday: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM|Sunday: 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM
review_1_text:
The place itself has a nice location, very central. Especially the rooms in the back side of the house dont have windows, so it can get very sticky.
Angela itself is not very friendly and you can feel, that she is only making it for the money.  I wouldn't recommend staying there. She was screaming at guests and when there was a big group in the house, it was very noisy and the doorbell was going until 1 am. They are cleaning the house only once a week, so it was dirty at the end of the week.

Would recommend being more friendly with the guests and offering a better service.
review_2_text:
I stayed there for carnivals season (Jan 2nd to the 7th) nice, cheap option, everything is clean and in good condition, staff and owner are super friendly and give you advice about everything.
I was able to cook a bit and got to know more travelers to hang out with.
Location is great, in a nice neighborhood and just few blocks from the carnival's parade, just by walking you can get to supermarkets, restaurants, bars, museums and parks. Buses and taxis are also available.
Cheers.
review_3_text:
I had a very positive experience at Casa Colibrí during my trip to Pasto. The place turned out to be an excellent accommodation option: the rooms are comfortable, everything is very clean, and it's located in a quiet and pleasant area, ideal for relaxing. The host, Ángela, was very kind and attentive; she provided guidance for our activities, helped us with guide contacts, and pointed out nearby places to visit.

Something we really appreciated was her willingness to accommodate us at a difficult time, as our initial reservation elsewhere fell through and we needed urgent accommodation. The hostel's location is strategic: we were able to easily navigate the city, go for walks at night, find food, and everything we needed without any inconvenience. Overall, the value for money was very good, and we felt very welcomed. I recommend Casa Colibrí as a warm, practical, and peaceful option for staying in Pasto.
review_4_text:
Casa Colibrí - Pasto is an excellent and welcoming hotel with spacious and very comfortable rooms. Located in a residential area north of the city, it offers excellent security and is close to renowned specialty clinics and shopping centers.
The owner, Mrs. Ángela, provides warm and friendly service throughout the stay.
review_5_text: It's a cozy and nice place, with an excellent location, ideal and comfortable in my case it was a long stay, Angela is a very good host.

The service was excellent and they were always friendly. It has private and covered parking for motorcycles and cars.
review_2_text: El hotel para el precio y lo que ofrece está bien, las habitaciones están bien de tamaño para una pareja, la ubicación es buena en época de carnavales por qué está cerca del las plazas de carnaval y el estadio que es donde comienza el desfile, la limpieza de los cuartos es buena y la ventilación también.
review_3_text: The place is very clean, the service is very friendly, very quiet to rest, it has a very familiar atmosphere and the price is very affordable, the facilities are very nice and modern
review_4_text: The hotel is technically new, rooms with just what is necessary, it does not have a kitchen, the manager is friendly although a little serious, the location is not the best, speaking with the locals they told me that it was a dangerous neighborhood, I don't know how papaya can be found there, in addition to the fact that there is a gallery next door and the dirt reaches almost to the hotel, a good place to spend the night and leave
review_5_text: La atención es excelente, un lugar muy agradable, confortables habtaciones, cuenta con wifi, baño privado, parqueadero.

Excellent place to enjoy nature and good food... My family and I have organized two meetings and we have felt very good, the service is very good, the presentation of the dishes is careful and the food is the same. It's super nice to be next to the fireplace while enjoying a hot drink. It has large gardens and a path to the lagoon.

review_5_text: A pleasant experience, it went very well for us, the rooms are well suited with heating (it is very important), good beds, good bathrooms and the view of the lagoon is simply spectacular! It would be very good if they fixed a small section towards the pier. I hope to return soon!

name: Apartahotel Vincent Suites
review_1_text:
In a few words: bedrooms are a scam and  customer service is terrible.
- single beds sold the price of double beds (inconvenient for 2 people, right?)
- bedsheets way too short for 2 people
- room prepared for only one person while booked for 2 (towel, welcome pack, etc.)
- no possibility to pay with credit card (inconvenient considering the amount, right?)
- room with no window to the outside, at ground floor, very noisy in the morning
- dishonest and disrespectful owner
For the same price, I seriously recommend to seek for another establishment. In any other place around, they would at least be decent enough to consider you as a customer.
review_2_text:
Cet hôtel est une fraude avec un service client déplorable. On a réservé une chambre double qui était en fait une chambre simple et la propriétaire n’a jamais admis son tord,
- Lit de 120 cm de large et 180 cm de long, beaucoup trop petit pour 2 surtout quand un des voyageurs fait 1m95 ! La gérante ne veut rien entendre sur le fait que les photos sont trompeuses et la prestation vendue une arnaque
- Couette trop petite pour 2 personnes, on se retrouve à dormir avec le couvre-lit
- Le terminal de carte bancaire ne marche pas, obligé de payer 130€ en cash
- Changement des horaires du petit déjeuner le deuxième jour, sur décision de l’administration : maintenant de 7h à 8h30, mais à 7h20 pas possible de manger, le personnel n’est pas là
- Propriétaire malhonnête et irrespectueuse qui n’a aucun sens du service client
review_3_text: Perfect

Good service, clean and comfortable rooms, includes satellite TV, hot water, Wi-Fi. (Good blankets and mattresses, but improve pillows)
The sector is very lonely, and causes a feeling of insecurity, but it is close to the terminal.
In short, good price and quality.
review_3_text: Good hotel in Pasto. The beds are good and have plenty of blankets for the cold. The rooms and bathroom are a bit small/narrow. It has parking and we had no problem with a small pet. The wifi works very well. The neighborhood is somewhat lonely but it is close to everything, it is quiet.
review_4_text: Good cost-benefit ratio. Quiet and well presented place. The rooms are practically new (remodeled). Could you change the pillows please, they are very hard, uncomfortable and heavy.
review_5_text: El internet muy regular, la cama con un colchón remalo, el baño raro porque de entrada está la ducha, luego el sanitario y al final lavamanos.  Estrecho para sentarse en el sanitario que las rodillas quedan pegadas a la pared.  No volveré

review_3_text: A highly recommended hotel, excellent service, the breakfast is delicious, and they treated us super well, always very friendly, they also helped us with information for the tours.
review_4_text: The best place to stay, delicious breakfasts. We were very well cared for 😊😊
review_5_text:
Excellent hotel alternative. We went like tourists by car through Nariño, my wife and our two boys, and arriving at this hotel after days of visits and roads, was like arriving home. In addition, their rate is very good for the benefit.

Simple breakfast. Spacious and impeccable rooms. Parking at the back. And in a calm residential area with a good location.

We would return! Oh, we will return!

name: Pucará Lodge
review_1_text:
It is a simply spectacular place, the rooms are very comfortable and the thermal blankets are incredible!!!  You won't be cold!!!
It's a place you fall in love with 💕. I would stay a thousand times in this hotel.
And not to mention the people who are in charge of care!! They are simply incredible. They care a lot about your well-being... I was really amazed 💕💕💕💕
review_2_text: Beautiful place, very friendly and helpful people. I had my first open water swim, and they rented me everything I needed, including the equipment and support. 10/10. I'll be back!
review_3_text:
A magical place with the utmost warmth from our hosts.

A beautiful place with unbeatable views of the Cocha and Corota mountains. The cabin is cozy and warm, the breakfast is delicious, and the best service is provided to guide us through the surrounding area and local traditions.

Thank you Jorge and Gloria for welcoming us with such love and allowing us to experience a wonderful experience.
review_4_text: A simply spectacular place. Warm, comfortable, and very clean rooms. The beds have thermal blankets. The views of La Cocha are comforting. The common areas are very pleasant. Every experience they offered exceeded my expectations. The food is unparalleled, and the hosts are on another level. Gloria, Jorge, and Aleja are wonderful people. Their generosity, kindness, and service-oriented approach made me never want to leave. I could definitely go back a thousand times.
review_5_text: Excellent stay! The cabins have everything necessary for a true rest and are designed with very good taste. Despite the rain, the owner (Jorge) went out of his way to make us feel at home upon our arrival: He himself helped us order food at the nearby restaurant and brought us hot drinks typical of the region to the cabin. Breakfast is delicious and healthy, prepared with local products. The person who cleans the cabins does an impeccable job. All in all, it was a fantastic experience. We wouldn't hesitate to return!

What a beautiful setting! Lakeview and surrounded by nature. Waking up with the birds in de background.
The cabana is very beautifully decorated with a jungle night sky in the bedroom.
There's 2 stoves ine for wood and one for electricity.
There is also a blender and toaster.

review_2_text:
A magical experience surrounded with all you can dream in an extraordinary location in la cocha. You have everything that you need inside an a portrait of heaven in your window.

Algo fenomenal poder disfrutar de una playa con una vista hermosa al despertar en la mañana, te recarga de vida cada momento en el que admiras la belleza del lugar
review_3_text: A very good experience, the place is very quiet and very beautiful
review_4_text: Es un lugar hermoso, que nos permitió compartir y conectar con la naturaleza. Alex fue muy amable, lo cual hizo nuestra estadía mucho mas amena.
review_5_text: Un sitio magnífico para descansar y recontrarse, Alex un muy buen anfitrión siempre presto a cualquier inquietud. Nuestros dos perros fueron acogidos y la pasaron  muy contentos, esperamos volver pronto.

name: Cabañas MERAK la cocha
address: Vía Laguna de la Cocha, Pasto
review_1_text:
The place is very cool, the attention and cordiality of the manager is very good, the food is delicious.

The only point to improve is the shuttle service to the cabins, since it is not clear and you must take land transportation from El Encano or cross La Cocha from the port and you still have to walk about 15 minutes.
review_2_text: The place is incredible, and the views of the lagoon are magnificent. It truly is a 5-star property, but the experience wasn't entirely satisfactory due to various incidents during our two-day stay. At check-in, the person in charge took about 30 minutes to arrive, and breakfast was delivered an hour later than requested. Furthermore, we had no hot water for two days, and although we mentioned it the day before, there was no solution. The morning before we left, the power also went out… We hope these issues improve so we can enjoy this incredible place.
review_3_text: Charming cabins located in the El Motilonnñ area of ​​the Encano district, Pasto, Nariño, Colombia. The cabins are well-equipped, have different rooms, and the staff is very attentive.
review_4_text:
A very cozy place to stay. The jacuzzi worked perfectly. The room was very comfortable. The only thing I recommend is that the breakfasts could improve their presentation.
The noise from other rooms is very audible.
review_5_text:
A very nice place, well-equipped for a couple of nights. The easiest way to get there is by road. I honestly didn't see a way to get there by boat. The view from that height is excellent.

I'm not giving it 5 stars because the TV didn't have a signal to watch anything.

name: Cabañas Anam cara
review_1_text: The place is beautiful, the attention is very special, I highly recommend this place, the view of the lagoon is phenomenal
review_2_text: Excellent place and very good service.

name: Tierra Encantada Glamping La Cocha

review_2_text: Muy bonito lugar. El servicio *****, de todo mi gusto.
review_3_text: excellent

name: Retazos - Glamping
review_1_text: Although the place is pleasant and ideal to get away from the routine of the city, the attention provided is terrible. First, the jacuzzi did not heat up so it could not be used, there was no toilet paper and the blankets showed traces of not having been washed. This ruined the experience we were hoping for.
review_2_text: Communication is terrible. They do not respond quickly, they do not clarify doubts and the information provided when contacting them is not enough.

review_1_text: We had an amazing time in Hacienda el Castillo with Gloria and Carlos Feilpe. The hotel is just outside Pasto in a tranquil and unique setting. We had a relaxing night chatting in front of the fire over a beer. In the morning we woke up to a beautiful view of the valley and walked down to the near by waterfalla. Such a beautiful setting and it is great to support such a personal and Authentic experience.
review_2_text:
Very bad attention. They promise that you can party until 6 in the morning and then the administrators turn off the light and rudely remove you......
Disgusting food and service at its finest.
The only good thing is its decoration and the false services that they supposedly offer and do not provide.
review_3_text: The only thing I can criticize is the bathrooms, which are unfortunately very old and should be remodeled to suit the customers.
review_4_text: A very nice and elegant place to celebrate
review_5_text: A very cozy and refreshing place. Ideal for resting and meeting nature. The rooms are spacious, beautiful and very neat with a private bathroom. Its facilities include a play area and living room, as well as public bathrooms and a hostel-style kitchen where food can be prepared and stored. We loved it. We hope to return. 5\5.

review_2_text: Needs to change service and hosting ......
review_3_text: Estuvimos en época de Carnaval así que la ubicación es muy central para desplazarse, aunque no tiene vista hacia ningún sitio más que la calle. El servicio es amable. Las habitaciones pueden mejorar, las camas son 2/5 cómodas pero se resbalan las sábanas, las almohadas no eran tan cómodas, y las tomas no están muy adecuadas.
review_4_text:
Atencion al cliente pesima, solo habia una señora que nos atendio bien. Estuvimos los 2 primeros dias sin que funcionara el agua caliente, reclamamos varias veces y no nos dieron solucion alguna. Al tercer dia, tras insistir mucho nos pasaron a otra habitacion.
No funcionaba el wifi en la habitacion, no me dieron llave de la caja fuerte, y algunos problemas mas. Las instalaciones de Spa no las tuvieron operativas y no tuvieron servicio de lavanderia, la excusa fueron los carnavales.
Para todo se inventaban excusas.
review_5_text: I loved the Hotel, the beautiful rooms were very comfortable, excellent...

name: Hotel Parque Reservado

review_2_text: Nice accommodation and great breakfast included in the fee. However, there was a musty smell all over the room.
review_3_text: Nice staff, incredibly loud street noise.
review_4_text: It's an excellent place to stay, although on weekends around 2-3am people come by making some noise (in bars). If you're one of those people who wakes up, I recommend a room that's not too close to the street.
review_5_text: It is a very comfortable hotel, in general the rooms are clean and the bathrooms are nice. I like this hotel because of the area because there are several quality restaurants around that you can visit. They always have coffee at the reception. I must also say that the service is very good.

name: HOTEL CATEDRAL LOFT BOUTIQUE
review_2_text: It is very nice, clean and central, staff is too friendly, the price is fair and the breakfast is delicious, I loved my visit from Medellín to Pasto.

review_2_text: Beautiful place, beautiful rooms cozy and stylish, a must when visiting Pasto!
review_3_text:
Great, the room is a bit cramped for the price, but it has a winning design.
Or, the coffee and pastry deli are great for those of us traveling with pets. It's located across from a very quiet park.
review_4_text: It is a very nice and well located hotel, the water for the shower was never hot and the toilet did not fill automatically, you can hear the television from the next room
review_5_text:
They placed me in a room that faced the street and there was a lot of noise at night, people talking loudly and motorcycles passing on the main avenue. The room is comfortable and neat, but it does not have all the elements that one would expect for the value one is paying. The included breakfast is fine, although they gave me a reheated arepas in a microwave and they didn't taste good. The kitchen does not have good ventilation and you can smell food if the windows are not open.

They have a good cafe on the first floor.

name: Chalet Guamuez

review_1_text: We had an excellent 200 gms smoked pink trout. One of the best, full of flavor. They had a limited menu during the carnival of Blacks and Whites due to many people for lunch. This place has a wonderful atmosphere and views to the La Cocha lake. Games for children pets allowed in the terrace.
review_2_text: Beautiful place. The staff is excellent and very welcomining. Each room has a fireplace which the staff lights for you at night. The food is also delicious. If you are looking for a beautiful, quiet and relaxing atmosphere with amazing food this is the place to go.
review_3_text: Great place to be with the family. Or the one you love... I mean chimney, cold weather, a nice cabana... To be closed with a good wine or something. Awesome plan, it's a shame I'm single hahaha
review_4_text: Love it. Great staff and good food. Awesome spots to enjoy nature.
review_5_text: Very nice place you can enjoy the view of the lake and the food is incredible good!

Its location makes it ideal because it has everything nearby: shops, pharmacies, cafes, restaurants, bars, tourist sites, shopping, etc. The place is very quiet, the included breakfast is delicious, the beds are comfortable, it has TV and Wi-Fi, and it is as beautiful as you can see in the photos.

name: Casa Blanca Hospedaje SAS
review_1_text:
I came to Pasto specifically for the carnival with a reservation made in advance through Booking.com, but the hotel canceled my reservation during the carnival period after I had already arrived in Pasto. They were not willing to honor the original price of my reservation, which has never happened to me in all the years I've used Booking.com. They are the only ones who have ever made such a demand.

The hotel wanted to charge me three times more than the price I paid for the reservation. After I refused the price increase, they canceled my reservation.

The hotel offered me to stay in an apartment shared with other people, but I didn’t feel safe in this situation, especially since tourists can be vulnerable to theft. I was forced to agree to this option because I had no other choice, but even that they canceled. I didn’t answer their phone call for half an hour because I was outside and in a situation where I was concerned for my safety. There are gangs of children in the area who spray powder and throw it in people's eyes, and in many cases, they rob tourists this way. That's why I try to avoid taking my phone out while walking around the city, and that's why I didn't answer the call for half an hour.

However, due to their desire to rent the apartment as quickly as possible, they sold it to someone else during that time. They showed no commitment to find me another place to stay after they canceled my reservation, which I made before the carnival events began.

As a result, I had no place to stay during the carnival when all the hotels in the area were fully booked. I tried to contact the hotel for assistance in finding an alternative solution, but they simply ignored my messages. This ignorance was simply embarrassing and disrespectful. I received no help, and in the end, I had to leave the city in the middle of the carnival because I had nowhere to sleep.

The hotel showed no empathy for the situation they created and behaved greedily. They took advantage of the carnival demand to raise prices unreasonably and were disrespectful to customers who refused to pay the inflated prices. I had a deeply disappointing experience that undermines basic customer service values and fair tourism practices.

I do not recommend anyone to trust this hotel, which ignores and disrespects its customers and does not know how to treat tourists. If they came to my country, they would receive a completely different kind of treatment. I have encountered amazing places and hotels in Colombia with exceptional customer service, but unfortunately, in Pasto, I experienced a shameful experience that I will never forget.

Thanks to the hotel for ruining my experience during the carnival events.

review_1_text:
The hotel is not perfect, but the flawless service makes up for it.

First the bad:
-The showerhead was broken. Not that big a deal, but it was like showering under a hose.
-The hot water pressure was variable, so taking a comfortable shower meant fiddling with the valve every few minutes.
-Noisy nights and mornings, vehicles outside and people in the dining area both at night and in the morning meant we needed earplugs.
-Temperature was not consistent. Two nights were perfectly comfortable, but one night we were too hot.

I did not bring up any of the negatives with the staff, they were not a big enough issue.

The good:
-Almost everything else.
-The people who work here are all super friendly, professional, helpful, knowledgeable, and ready to take time to make sure your needs are met. The staff was really very impressive and made us feel safe and comfortable.
-The restaurant is pretty good.
-They make eggs to-order if you decide to have the free breakfast. During our stay, the breakfast was simple but filling: fresh juice, coffee, milk, chocolate milk, arepas, bread, eggs, pineapple, cantaloupe, cereal, and yogurt.
-The location is very good, close to ATMs, restaurants, bars, shopping, and cafes. They have a private garage where taxis can safely drop you off, too.
-Decor inside is lovely in most areas. They do a good job keeping the hotel clean and in good repair.
-Beds were not too hard and came with plenty of blankets and pillows.

The main star of the hotel is the people.

name: Espeletia Lodge
review_1_text: Espeletia Lodge is beautiful in every way! The staff is so friendly, caring and helpful and everything felt so personal. The cabins are beautiful and comfortable and the nature all around the Lodge is wonderful and peaceful. I have no complaints at all. Please do visit this place if you can
review_2_text: This place feel like home, from the warm room until the food and the service. Beautiful view and magic forest just 5 min walk from the hotel
review_3_text:
Perfect  location, deep inside the magical Polylepis forest, near the stream and waterfalls. Arturo and his dad were kind and warm, always on the spot, generous and full of stories to tell.
Cabins are warm and comfortable. The site is peaceful and full of nature, frailejones and wildlife. We did an awesome bike ride to the lagoons from there and the 3 nights we spent there will stay with us forever.
Totally recommended.
review_4_text: Unique experience in an immersed in pure nature location
review_5_text: Excellent service, very cool guide and the walk he took us (approximately 3 hours. Because we told him that we liked to walk) he said that there are also shorter routes! And the food lady also served us very well, the lunch was super delicious (very good portion). And the room is like a Mini cabin with a spectacular view of the Frailejones, cold, but they give you thermal quilts and a heater for the room, and the shower water is also super hot. Nice to rest after the walk. Highly recommended!

name: Hotel Ecolodge Ankalli
review_1_text: A beautiful, welcoming, magical place where you can find profound peace surrounded by beautiful landscapes, delicious food, and excellent service. Highly recommended for a pleasant few days or for a perfect place to learn without interruptions.
review_2_text: We are a country that always looks north. How wonderful it is to have the opportunity to travel and discover Nariño and its beautiful geography, with its breathtaking landscapes. What better way to do it than through the locals and in the most genuine way, connecting with the traditions and stories of the locals. Traveling to Guachucal and having the opportunity to visit Ankalli opened my mind and heart to many things that, as a Colombian and as a journalist, I was completely unaware of. It was a very beautiful experience, full of reflection, stories, wonderful experiences, and delicious local cuisine. I wish every Colombian could experience this ecolodge. They would be so immersed in another part of Colombia that, for sure, they would feel the same way I do: I want to return. Thank you, Ankalli Ecolodge! Thank you for everything. The experience was incredible.
review_3_text: The accommodation was incredible. I thought it was unique in the mountains. We had fireplaces and very good local food. I would definitely return. I also really liked the trail we reached, which gave a view of the volcano.
review_4_text: I stayed with my wife at the Ankalli Ecolodge Hotel. It was a wonderful experience, with the natural surroundings, the attentiveness of the hosts, and their warmth in the cold weather. The food was spectacular, a lovely memory of a very good experience. Absolutely recommended.
review_5_text:
A beautiful place with lots of nature, gorgeous places to explore, great hosts, excellent cabins, thermal blankets, and heating. Delicious food 🍱
A place to discover, admire, care for, and protect.
